@code {
    private List<AccountModelDto> _accounts = new();
    private List<AccountModelDto> _accountsIncludChilds = new();
    private List<AccountRow> _displayRows = new();

    private AccountType? _typeFilter;
    private string _search = "";
    private bool _loading = true;
    private int _page = 1;
    private int _pageSize = 10;

    private class AccountRow
    {
        public string Type { get; set; } = "Row";
        public Guid? Id { get; set; }
        public string Code { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        public string AccountName { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        public AccountType AccountType { get; set; }
        public string ParentAccountName { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        public decimal Balance { get; set; }
        public string BalanceDisplay => Balance.ToString("N0");
        public bool IsSystemAccount { get; set; }
        public string GroupLabel { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        public decimal BalanceTotal { get; set; }
        public string BalanceTotalDisplay => BalanceTotal.ToString("N0");
    }

    private List<AccountModelDto> Filtered => _accounts.Where(a =>
        (_typeFilter == null || a.AccountType == _typeFilter.Value)
        && (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_search)
            || a.Code.Contains(_search, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            || a.Name.Contains(_search, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            || (a.ParentAccountName?.Contains(_search, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ?? false))).ToList();

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync() => await LoadAccounts();

    private async Task LoadAccounts()
    {
        _loading = true;
        try
        {
            if (_typeFilter.HasValue)
            {
                var result = await AccountingService.GetAccounts(null, _typeFilter, 1, 500);
                _accounts = result.Items;
            }
            else
            {
                _accounts = await AccountingService.GetChartOfAccounts();
            }

            var _parentAccounts = _accounts.Where(x => x.ParentAccountId == null).ToList();

            foreach (var account in _parentAccounts)
            {
                account.ChildAccounts = _accounts.Where(a => a.ParentAccountId == account.Id).OrderBy(a => a.Code).ToList();
                _accountsIncludChilds.Add(account);
            }
            


            //BuildDisplayRows();
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
        finally { _loading = false; }
    }

    private void BuildDisplayRows()
    {
        var filtered = Filtered;
        _displayRows = new List<AccountRow>();

        foreach (var parent in filtered.Where(a => a.ParentAccountId == null).OrderBy(a => a.Code))
        {
            var children = filtered.Where(a => a.ParentAccountId == parent.Id).OrderBy(a => a.Code).ToList();

            if (children.Count > 0)
            {
                // Parent WITH children: group header + children + group footer
                _displayRows.Add(new AccountRow
                {
                    Type = "GroupHeader",
                    GroupLabel = parent.Name,
                    Code = parent.Code,
                    AccountName = parent.Name,
                    AccountType = parent.AccountType,
                    ParentAccountName = parent.ParentAccountName ?? "-",
                    Balance = parent.Balance ?? 0m,
                    IsSystemAccount = parent.IsSystemAccount ?? false
                });

                foreach (var child in children)
                {
                    _displayRows.Add(new AccountRow
                    {
                        Type = "Row",
                        Id = child.Id,
                        Code = child.Code,
                        AccountName = child.Name,
                        AccountType = child.AccountType,
                        ParentAccountName = child.ParentAccountName ?? "-",
                        Balance = child.Balance ?? 0m,
                        IsSystemAccount = child.IsSystemAccount ?? false
                    });
                }

                _displayRows.Add(new AccountRow
                {
                    Type = "GroupFooter",
                    BalanceTotal = children.Sum(c => c.Balance ?? 0m)
                });
            }
            else
            {
                // Parent WITHOUT children: standalone row (no group wrapper)
                _displayRows.Add(new AccountRow
                {
                    Type = "Standalone",
                    Id = parent.Id,
                    Code = parent.Code,
                    AccountName = parent.Name,
                    AccountType = parent.AccountType,
                    ParentAccountName = parent.ParentAccountName ?? "-",
                    Balance = parent.Balance ?? 0m,
                    IsSystemAccount = parent.IsSystemAccount ?? false
                });
            }
        }

        // Add orphaned children (accounts with a parent not in the filtered set)
        var shownChildIds = _displayRows.Where(r => r.Type == "Row").Select(r => r.Id).ToHashSet();
        foreach (var orphan in filtered.Where(a => a.ParentAccountId != null && !shownChildIds.Contains(a.Id)).OrderBy(a => a.Code))
        {
            _displayRows.Add(new AccountRow
            {
                Type = "Row",
                Id = orphan.Id,
                Code = orphan.Code,
                AccountName = orphan.Name,
                AccountType = orphan.AccountType,
                ParentAccountName = orphan.ParentAccountName ?? "-",
                Balance = orphan.Balance ?? 0m,
                IsSystemAccount = orphan.IsSystemAccount ?? false
            });
        }
    }

    private int CountOf(AccountType t) => _accounts.Count(a => a.AccountType == t);

    private async Task OpenCreate()
    {
        var parameters = new DialogParameters<AccountDialog>
        {
            { x => x.dataModel, new AccountModelDto(){ Code = NumberGenerator.GenerateAccountCode() } }
        };
        var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<AccountDialog>("New Account", parameters,
            new DialogOptions { MaxWidth = MaxWidth.Small, FullWidth = true, CloseButton = true });
        var result = await dialog.Result;
        if (result != null && !result.Canceled && result.Data is AccountModelDto dto)
        {
            try
            {
                await AccountingService.CreateAccount(dto);
                Snackbar.Add("Account created", Severity.Success);
                await LoadAccounts();
            }
            catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
        }
    }

    private void OnSearchInput(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        _search = e.Value?.ToString() ?? "";
    }

    private async Task OnTypeChanged(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        var v = e.Value?.ToString();
        _typeFilter = string.IsNullOrEmpty(v) ? null : Enum.Parse<AccountType>(v);
        await LoadAccounts();
    }

    private async Task PickType(AccountType t)
    {
        _typeFilter = _typeFilter == t ? null : t;
        await LoadAccounts();
    }

    private async Task ResetFilters()
    {
        _search = "";
        _typeFilter = null;
        await LoadAccounts();
    }

    private int PageTotal => Math.Max(1, (int)Math.Ceiling(Filtered.Count / (double)_pageSize));

    private Task GoToPage(int pageIndex)
    {
        _page = Math.Clamp(pageIndex + 1, 1, PageTotal);
        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }

    private Task GoPrevPage() => GoToPage(_page - 2);

    private Task GoNextPage() => GoToPage(_page);

    private void OnPageSizeChanged(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        if (int.TryParse(e.Value?.ToString(), out var size) && size > 0)
        {
            _pageSize = size;
            _page = 1;
        }
    }
}

         <MudForm @ref="_form" Class="gap-3">

@code {
    [CascadingParameter] private IMudDialogInstance MudDialog { get; set; } = default!;
    private MudForm _form = default!;
    private PaymentNoteDto dataModel = new PaymentNoteDto();
    private List<InvoiceOptionDto> _invoices = new();

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        _invoices = await InvoiceService.GetRecentInvoiceOptions(1000, InvoiceType.Sales);
    }
    private Task<IEnumerable<ControlItemsDto>> SearchInvoice(string text, CancellationToken _)
    {
        IEnumerable<ControlItemsDto> baseResults;

        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text))
        {
            baseResults = _invoices.Where(c => c.Id != Guid.Empty).Select(c => new ControlItemsDto() { Id = c.Id, Name = $"{c.Name} > {c.InvoiceNumber} - {c.BalanceDue:C}" });
        }
        else
        {
            baseResults = _invoices.Where(c =>
                c.Id != Guid.Empty &&(
                    (c.Name.Contains(text, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) ||
                    (c.InvoiceNumber.Contains(text, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) ||
                    (c.BalanceDue.ToString().Contains(text, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) ||
                    (c.Email.Contains(text, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                )).Select(c => new ControlItemsDto() { Id = c.Id, Name = $"{c.Name} > {c.InvoiceNumber} - {c.BalanceDue:C}" });
        }

        var results = baseResults.OrderBy(x => x.Name).DistinctBy(c => c.Id);
        //results = baseResults.Concat(new[] { AddNewCustomerOption });

        // var results = new[] { AddNewCustomerOption }.Concat(baseResults).DistinctBy(c => c.Id);
        //var results = baseResults.Append(AddNewCustomerOption).DistinctBy(c => c.Id).ToList();

        return Task.FromResult(results);
    }

    private void Cancel() => MudDialog.Cancel();

    private async Task Submit()
    {
        await _form.ValidateAsync();

        if (!_form.IsValid)
            return;
            
        try
        {
            if (dataModel.CustomerDdlControl.SelectedItem != null)
            {
                var dto = new CreateCreditNoteDto((Guid)dataModel.CustomerDdlControl.SelectedItem.Id, dataModel.Amount, dataModel.Reason);
                await NoteService.CreateCreditNote(dto);
                MudDialog.Close(DialogResult.Ok(true));
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
    }
}

@code {
    private List<CreditNoteDto> _notes = new();
    private bool _loading = true;
    private string _search = "";
    private CreditNoteStatus? _statusFilter;
    private int _page = 1;
    private int _pageSize = 10;

    private int DraftCount => _notes.Count(n => n.Status == CreditNoteStatus.Draft);
    private int ApprovedCount => _notes.Count(n => n.Status == CreditNoteStatus.Approved);
    private int AppliedCount => _notes.Count(n => n.Status == CreditNoteStatus.Applied);
    private int CancelledCount => _notes.Count(n => n.Status == CreditNoteStatus.Cancelled);
    private string TotalAmount => _notes.Sum(n => n.Amount).ToString("N2");

  
    private List<CreditNoteDto> Filtered => _notes.Where(n =>
        (_statusFilter == null || n.Status == _statusFilter.Value)
        && (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_search)
            || n.CreditNoteNumber.Contains(_search, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            || n.InvoiceNumber.Contains(_search, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            || (n.Reason?.Contains(_search, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ?? false))).ToList();

    private List<CreditNoteDto> Paged => Filtered.Skip((_page - 1) * _pageSize).Take(_pageSize).ToList();

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync() => await Load();

    private async Task Load()
    {
        _loading = true;
        try
        {
            var result = await NoteService.GetCreditNotes(null, 1, 500);
            _notes = result.Items;
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
        finally { _loading = false; }
    }

    private async Task CreateNote()
    {
        var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<CreditNoteDialog>("New Credit Note",
            new DialogOptions { MaxWidth = MaxWidth.Small, FullWidth = true, CloseButton = true });
        var result = await dialog.Result;
        if (result is not null && !result.Canceled) await Load();
    }

    private async Task ApproveNote(Guid id)
    {
        try
        {
            await NoteService.ApproveCreditNote(id);
            Snackbar.Add("Credit note approved.", Severity.Success);
            await Load();
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
    }

    private void OnSearchInput(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        _search = e.Value?.ToString() ?? "";
        _page = 1;
    }

    private void OnStatusChanged(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        var v = e.Value?.ToString();
        _statusFilter = string.IsNullOrEmpty(v) ? null : Enum.Parse<CreditNoteStatus>(v);
        _page = 1;
    }

    private void PickStatus(CreditNoteStatus s)
    {
        _statusFilter = _statusFilter == s ? null : s;
        _page = 1;
    }

    private void ResetFilters()
    {
        _search = "";
        _statusFilter = null;
        _page = 1;
    }

    private int PageTotal => Math.Max(1, (int)Math.Ceiling(Filtered.Count / (double)_pageSize));

    private Task GoToPage(int pageIndex)
    {
        _page = Math.Clamp(pageIndex + 1, 1, PageTotal);
        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }

    private Task GoPrevPage() => GoToPage(_page - 2);

    private Task GoNextPage() => GoToPage(_page);

    private void OnPageSizeChanged(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        if (int.TryParse(e.Value?.ToString(), out var size) && size > 0)
        {
            _pageSize = size;
            _page = 1;
        }
    }
}

@code {
    private record StatementLine(DateTime Date, string Type, string Reference, decimal Debit, decimal Credit, decimal RunningBalance);

    private List<CustomerDto> _customers = new();
    private Guid? _customerId;
    private DateTime? _from = DateTime.Today.AddMonths(-3);
    private DateTime? _to = DateTime.Today;
    private CustomerDto? _selectedCustomer;
    private List<StatementLine> _statementLines = new();
    private decimal _totalInvoiced;
    private decimal _totalPaid;
    private decimal _balanceDue;
    private bool _loading;

    // Chart data
    private string[] _balanceTrendLabels = [];
    private List<ChartSeries<double>> _balanceTrendSeries = new();
    private string[] _monthlyBarLabels = [];
    private List<ChartSeries<double>> _monthlyBarSeries = new();

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        _customers = await CustomerService.GetActiveCustomersAsync();
    }

    private async Task LoadData()
    {
        if (!_customerId.HasValue) return;
        _loading = true;
        try
        {
            _selectedCustomer = _customers.FirstOrDefault(c => c.Id == _customerId.Value);
            var fromDate = _from ?? DateTime.Today.AddMonths(-3);
            var toDate = (_to ?? DateTime.Today).AddDays(1);

            var statement = await AccountingService.GetCustomerStatement(_customerId.Value, fromDate, toDate);
            var invoices = statement.Invoices;
            var payments = statement.Payments;

            var lines = new List<StatementLine>();
            decimal balance = 0;

            var allTxns = invoices.Select(i => new { Date = i.InvoiceDate, Type = "Invoice", Reference = i.InvoiceNumber, Debit = i.TotalAmount, Credit = 0m })
                .Concat(payments.Select(p => new { Date = p.PaymentDate, Type = "Payment", Reference = p.PaymentNumber, Debit = 0m, Credit = p.Amount }))
                .OrderBy(t => t.Date);

            foreach (var txn in allTxns)
            {
                balance += txn.Debit - txn.Credit;
                lines.Add(new StatementLine(txn.Date, txn.Type, txn.Reference, txn.Debit, txn.Credit, balance));
            }

            _statementLines = lines;
            _totalInvoiced = invoices.Sum(i => i.TotalAmount);
            _totalPaid = payments.Sum(p => p.Amount);
            _balanceDue = balance;

            BuildChartData();
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
        finally { _loading = false; }
    }

    private void BuildChartData()
    {
        if (!_statementLines.Any()) return;

        // Balance trend line - sample up to ~20 points
        var lines = _statementLines;
        int step = Math.Max(1, lines.Count / 20);
        var sampled = lines.Where((_, i) => i % step == 0 || i == lines.Count - 1).ToList();
        _balanceTrendLabels = sampled.Select(l => l.Date.ToString("MMM dd")).ToArray();
        _balanceTrendSeries = new List<ChartSeries<double>>
        {
            new() { Name = "Balance", Data = sampled.Select(l => (double)l.RunningBalance).ToArray() }
        };

        // Monthly debit/credit bar chart
        var monthly = _statementLines
            .GroupBy(l => new { l.Date.Year, l.Date.Month })
            .OrderBy(g => g.Key.Year).ThenBy(g => g.Key.Month)
            .ToList();

        _monthlyBarLabels = monthly.Select(g => new DateTime(g.Key.Year, g.Key.Month, 1).ToString("MMM yy")).ToArray();
        _monthlyBarSeries = new List<ChartSeries<double>>
        {
            new() { Name = "Debits", Data = monthly.Select(g => (double)g.Sum(l => l.Debit)).ToArray() },
            new() { Name = "Credits", Data = monthly.Select(g => (double)g.Sum(l => l.Credit)).ToArray() }
        };
    }
}

@code {
    [CascadingParameter] private IMudDialogInstance MudDialog { get; set; } = default!;
    private MudForm _form = default!;
    private PaymentNoteDto dataModel = new PaymentNoteDto();
    private List<InvoiceOptionDto> _invoices = new();

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        _invoices = await InvoiceService.GetRecentInvoiceOptions(1000, InvoiceType.Purchase);
    }
    private Task<IEnumerable<ControlItemsDto>> SearchInvoice(string text, CancellationToken _)
    {
        IEnumerable<ControlItemsDto> baseResults;

        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text))
        {
            baseResults = _invoices.Where(c => c.Id != Guid.Empty).Select(c => new ControlItemsDto() { Id = c.Id, Name = $"{c.Name} > {c.InvoiceNumber} - {c.BalanceDue:C}" });
        }
        else
        {
            baseResults = _invoices.Where(c =>
                c.Id != Guid.Empty && (
                    (c.Name.Contains(text, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) ||
                    (c.InvoiceNumber.Contains(text, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) ||
                    (c.BalanceDue.ToString().Contains(text, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) ||
                    (c.Email.Contains(text, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                )).Select(c => new ControlItemsDto() { Id = c.Id, Name = $"{c.Name} > {c.InvoiceNumber} - {c.BalanceDue:C}" });
        }

        var results = baseResults.OrderBy(x => x.Name).DistinctBy(c => c.Id);
        //results = baseResults.Concat(new[] { AddNewCustomerOption });

        // var results = new[] { AddNewCustomerOption }.Concat(baseResults).DistinctBy(c => c.Id);
        //var results = baseResults.Append(AddNewCustomerOption).DistinctBy(c => c.Id).ToList();

        return Task.FromResult(results);
    }

    private void Cancel() => MudDialog.Cancel();

    private async Task Submit()
    {
        await _form.ValidateAsync();

        if (!_form.IsValid)
            return;

        try
        {
            if (dataModel.CustomerDdlControl.SelectedItem != null)
            {
                var dto = new CreateDebitNoteDto((Guid)dataModel.CustomerDdlControl.SelectedItem.Id, dataModel.Amount, dataModel.Reason);
                await NoteService.CreateDebitNote(dto);
                MudDialog.Close(DialogResult.Ok(true));
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
    }
}

    private int ApprovedCount => _notes.Count(n => n.Status == DebitNoteStatus.Approved);

    private int CancelledCount => _notes.Count(n => n.Status == DebitNoteStatus.Cancelled);

    private List<DebitNoteDto> Filtered => _notes.Where(n =>

            || n.InvoiceNumber.Contains(_search, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            || (n.Reason?.Contains(_search, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ?? false))).ToList();

        if (result is not null && !result.Canceled) await Load();
    }

    private async Task ApproveNote(Guid id)
    {
        try
        {
            await NoteService.ApproveDebitNote(id);
            Snackbar.Add("Debit note approved.", Severity.Success);
            await Load();
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
    }

    private void OnSearchInput(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        _search = e.Value?.ToString() ?? "";
        _page = 1;
    }

    private void OnStatusChanged(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        var v = e.Value?.ToString();
        _statusFilter = string.IsNullOrEmpty(v) ? null : Enum.Parse<DebitNoteStatus>(v);
        _page = 1;
    }

    private void PickStatus(DebitNoteStatus s)
    {
        _statusFilter = _statusFilter == s ? null : s;
        _page = 1;
    }

    private void ResetFilters()
    {
        _search = "";
        _statusFilter = null;
        _page = 1;
    }

    private int PageTotal => Math.Max(1, (int)Math.Ceiling(Filtered.Count / (double)_pageSize));

    private Task GoToPage(int pageIndex)
    {
        _page = Math.Clamp(pageIndex + 1, 1, PageTotal);
        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }

    private Task GoNextPage() => GoToPage(_page);

    private void OnPageSizeChanged(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        if (int.TryParse(e.Value?.ToString(), out var size) && size > 0)

        <TmStatTile Icon="Î£" Number="@TotalDebitsText" Label="Total Debits" Tone="blue" />
        <TmStatTile Icon="Î£" Number="@TotalCreditsText" Label="Total Credits" Tone="purple" />

@code {
    private List<AccountModelDto> _accounts = new();
    private List<GeneralLedgerEntryDto> _allEntries = new();
    private List<GeneralLedgerEntryDto> _entries = new();
    private Guid? _selectedAccountId;
    private DateTime? _fromDate = new DateTime(DateTime.Today.Year, 1, 1);
    private DateTime? _toDate = DateTime.Today;
    private bool _loading = true;
    private bool _hasLoadedOnce;

    private int _currentPage;
    private int _pageSize = 25;
    private int _totalPages = 1;

    private string TotalDebitsText => _allEntries.Sum(e => e.DebitAmount).ToString("N2");
    private string TotalCreditsText => _allEntries.Sum(e => e.CreditAmount).ToString("N2");
    private string NetBalanceText => (_allEntries.Sum(e => e.DebitAmount) - _allEntries.Sum(e => e.CreditAmount)).ToString("N2");

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        try
        {
            var result = await AccountingService.GetAccounts(null, null, 1, 1000);
            _accounts = result.Items;
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add($"Error loading accounts: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error); }
        await LoadLedger();
    }

    private async Task LoadLedger()
    {
        _loading = true;
        try
        {
            var lines = await AccountingService.GetGeneralLedgerLines(_selectedAccountId, _fromDate, _toDate);

            decimal runningBalance = 0;
            _allEntries = lines.Select(l =>
            {
                runningBalance += l.Debit - l.Credit;
                return new GeneralLedgerEntryDto(l.EntryDate, l.EntryNumber, l.AccountCode, l.AccountName, l.Description, l.Debit, l.Credit, runningBalance);
            }).ToList();

            _hasLoadedOnce = true;
            ApplyPage();
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add($"Error: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error); }
        finally { _loading = false; }
    }

    // Running balance is computed over the full filtered set before paging, so it stays
    // continuous across pages; this only re-slices the loaded list.
    private void ApplyPage()
    {
        _totalPages = Math.Max(1, (int)Math.Ceiling(_allEntries.Count / (double)_pageSize));
        _currentPage = Math.Clamp(_currentPage, 0, _totalPages - 1);
        _entries = _allEntries.Skip(_currentPage * _pageSize).Take(_pageSize).ToList();
    }

    private async Task OnAccountChanged(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        _selectedAccountId = ParseGuid(e.Value);
        _currentPage = 0;
        await LoadLedger();
    }

    private async Task OnRangeChanged((DateTime? From, DateTime? To) range)
    {
        _fromDate = range.From;
        _toDate = range.To;
        _currentPage = 0;
        await LoadLedger();
    }

    private async Task ResetFilters()
    {
        _selectedAccountId = null;
        _fromDate = new DateTime(DateTime.Today.Year, 1, 1);
        _toDate = DateTime.Today;
        _currentPage = 0;
        await LoadLedger();
    }

    private static Guid? ParseGuid(object? value) =>
        Guid.TryParse(value?.ToString(), out var g) && g != Guid.Empty ? g : null;

    private Task GoToPage(int page)
    {
        _currentPage = Math.Clamp(page, 0, _totalPages - 1);
        ApplyPage();
        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }

    private Task GoPrevPage()
    {
        if (_currentPage > 0)
        {
            _currentPage--;
            ApplyPage();
        }
        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }

    private Task GoNextPage()
    {
        if (_currentPage < _totalPages - 1)
        {
            _currentPage++;
            ApplyPage();
        }
        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }

    private Task OnPageSizeChanged(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        if (int.TryParse(e.Value?.ToString(), out var sz))
        {
            _pageSize = Math.Clamp(sz, 1, 100);
            _currentPage = 0;
            ApplyPage();
        }
        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }

    private record GeneralLedgerEntryDto(DateTime EntryDate, string JournalNumber, string AccountCode, string AccountName, string? Description, decimal DebitAmount, decimal CreditAmount, decimal RunningBalance);
}

@code {
    // The old query pulled at most 500 rows (Take(500)) and then filtered/paged/stat-counted them in
    // memory. GetInvoicesAsync pages server-side, so ask for one big page to keep that exact window:
    // _items stays "the 500 newest matching invoices" and every stat tile / Paged below still works.
    private const int MaxRows = 500;

    private List<InvoiceDto> _items = new();
    private string _search = "";
    private InvoiceType? _typeFilter;
    private InvoiceStatus? _statusFilter;
    private bool _loading = true;
    private int _page = 1;
    private int _pageSize = 10;
    private InvoiceViewPanel? _invoiceViewPanel;

    private int OverdueCount => _items.Count(i => i.DueDate < DateTime.Today
        && i.Status != InvoiceStatus.Paid && i.Status != InvoiceStatus.Cancelled);

    private string OutstandingTotal => _items.Sum(i => i.BalanceDue).ToString("N0");

    private List<InvoiceDto> Filtered => _items.Where(i =>
        (_typeFilter == null || i.InvoiceType == _typeFilter.Value)
        && (_statusFilter == null || i.Status == _statusFilter.Value)
        && (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_search)
            || i.InvoiceNumber.Contains(_search, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            || (i.CustomerName?.Contains(_search, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ?? false)
            || (i.SupplierName?.Contains(_search, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ?? false))).ToList();

    private List<InvoiceDto> Paged => Filtered.Skip((_page - 1) * _pageSize).Take(_pageSize).ToList();

    private int CountOf(InvoiceStatus s) => _items.Count(i => i.Status == s);

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync() => await Load();

    private async Task Load()
    {
        _loading = true;
        try
        {
            // The Include(i => i.Customer)/Include(i => i.Supplier) this page used to declare were
            // only ever read to fill InvoiceDto.CustomerName / SupplierName â€” GetInvoicesAsync does
            // that join internally and returns the DTOs directly, so they are no longer needed here.
            var result = await InvoiceService.GetInvoicesAsync(
                search: _search, status: _statusFilter, type: _typeFilter, page: 1, pageSize: MaxRows);
            _items = result.Items;
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
        finally { _loading = false; }
    }

    private void OnSearchInput(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        _search = e.Value?.ToString() ?? "";
        _page = 1;
    }

    private async Task OnTypeChanged(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        var v = e.Value?.ToString();
        _typeFilter = string.IsNullOrEmpty(v) ? null
            : v == "sales" ? InvoiceType.Sales
            : v == "purchase" ? InvoiceType.Purchase
            : null;
        _page = 1;
        await Load();
    }

    private async Task OnStatusChanged(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        var v = e.Value?.ToString();
        _statusFilter = string.IsNullOrEmpty(v) ? null : Enum.Parse<InvoiceStatus>(v);
        _page = 1;
        await Load();
    }

    private async Task PickStatus(InvoiceStatus s)
    {
        _statusFilter = _statusFilter == s ? null : s;
        _page = 1;
        await Load();
    }

    private async Task ResetFilters()
    {
        _search = "";
        _typeFilter = null;
        _statusFilter = null;
        _page = 1;
        await Load();
    }

    private int PageTotal => Math.Max(1, (int)Math.Ceiling(Filtered.Count / (double)_pageSize));

    private Task GoToPage(int pageIndex)
    {
        _page = Math.Clamp(pageIndex + 1, 1, PageTotal);
        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }

    private Task GoPrevPage() => GoToPage(_page - 2);

    private Task GoNextPage() => GoToPage(_page);

    private async Task ViewInvoice(Guid id)
    {
        if (_invoiceViewPanel != null)
            await _invoiceViewPanel.OpenAsync(id);
    }

    private void OnPageSizeChanged(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        if (int.TryParse(e.Value?.ToString(), out var size) && size > 0)
        {
            _pageSize = size;
            _page = 1;
        }
    }

    private static string GetStatusPill(InvoiceStatus s) => s switch
    {
        InvoiceStatus.Draft => "tm-pill tm-pill-purple",
        InvoiceStatus.Sent => "tm-pill tm-pill-blue",
        InvoiceStatus.Paid => "tm-pill tm-pill-green",
        InvoiceStatus.PartiallyPaid => "tm-pill tm-pill-amber",
        InvoiceStatus.Overdue => "tm-pill tm-pill-red",
        InvoiceStatus.Cancelled => "tm-pill tm-pill-red",
        _ => "tm-pill tm-pill-blue"
    };
}

@code {
    private bool _open;
    private bool _animateIn;
    private bool _loading;
    private InvoiceDetailDto? _detail;
    private List<CreditNoteDto> _creditNotes = new();
    private List<DebitNoteDto> _debitNotes = new();

    private InvoiceDto? _invoice => _detail?.Invoice;

    private Color GetInvoiceStatusColor(InvoiceStatus status) => status switch
    {
        InvoiceStatus.Paid => Color.Success,
        InvoiceStatus.PartiallyPaid => Color.Warning,
        InvoiceStatus.Sent => Color.Info,
        InvoiceStatus.Draft => Color.Default,
        InvoiceStatus.Overdue => Color.Error,
        InvoiceStatus.Cancelled => Color.Error,
        _ => Color.Default
    };

    private Color GetNoteStatusColor(string status) => status switch
    {
        "Approved" => Color.Success,
        "Applied" => Color.Info,
        "Cancelled" => Color.Error,
        _ => Color.Default
    };

    private async Task DownloadPdf()
    {
        if (_invoice is null) return;
        try
        {
            var doc = await PrintRenderer.RenderInvoiceAsync(_detail!);
            await JS.InvokeVoidAsync("downloadFile", doc.Html, doc.FileName + ".pdf", doc.Title, doc.Reference);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            await JS.InvokeVoidAsync("alert", "Could not generate the PDF: " + ex.Message);
        }
    }

    private async Task PrintDoc()
    {
        if (_invoice is null) return;
        try
        {
            var doc = await PrintRenderer.RenderInvoiceAsync(_detail!);
            await JS.InvokeVoidAsync("printHtml", doc.Html, doc.Title, doc.Reference);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            await JS.InvokeVoidAsync("alert", "Could not print the document: " + ex.Message);
        }
    }

    public async Task OpenAsync(Guid id)
    {
        _open = true;
        _loading = true;
        _animateIn = false;
        _detail = null;
        _creditNotes = new();
        _debitNotes = new();
        StateHasChanged();

        await Task.Delay(20);
        _animateIn = true;
        StateHasChanged();

        try
        {
            _detail = await InvoiceService.GetInvoiceDetailAsync(id);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error);
        }

        if (_detail != null)
        {
            try
            {
                _creditNotes = await CreditDebitNoteService.GetCreditNotesForInvoice(id);
                _debitNotes = await CreditDebitNoteService.GetDebitNotesForInvoice(id);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Snackbar.Add("Could not load notes: " + ex.Message, Severity.Warning);
            }
        }

        _loading = false;
        StateHasChanged();
    }

    public void Close()
    {
        _open = false;
        _animateIn = false;
        _detail = null;
        _creditNotes = new();
        _debitNotes = new();
        StateHasChanged();
    }
}

<div class="tm-page">

    <div class="tm-stats">

@code {
    private enum JournalFlag { All, Auto, Manual, Reversed }

    private PagedResult<JournalEntryDto> _entries = new(new(), 0, 1, 10);
    private string _search = "";
    private JournalFlag _flag = JournalFlag.All;
    private bool _loading = true;
    private int _page = 1;
    private int _pageSize = 10;
    private int _totalCount;
    private int _autoCount;
    private int _reversedCount;
    private int _thisMonthCount;
    private decimal _pageDebits;
    private System.Timers.Timer? _debounce;

    private List<JournalEntryDto> Filtered => _entries.Items.Where(j =>
        (_flag == JournalFlag.All
            || (_flag == JournalFlag.Auto && j.IsAutoPosted)
            || (_flag == JournalFlag.Manual && !j.IsAutoPosted)
            || (_flag == JournalFlag.Reversed && j.IsReversed))
        && (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_search)
            || j.Reference.Contains(_search, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            || (j.Description?.Contains(_search, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ?? false))).ToList();

    private List<JournalEntryDto> Paged => Filtered.Skip((_page - 1) * _pageSize).Take(_pageSize).ToList();

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync() => await LoadEntries();

    private async Task LoadEntries()
    {
        _loading = true;
        try
        {
            _entries = await AccountingService.GetJournalEntries(_search, _page, _pageSize);
            _totalCount = _entries.TotalCount;
            _pageDebits = _entries.Items.Sum(j => j.Lines.Sum(l => l.Debit));
            await LoadCountsAsync();
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
        finally { _loading = false; }
    }

    private async Task LoadCountsAsync()
    {
        try
        {
            var all = await AccountingService.GetJournalEntries("", 1, 1000);
            var items = all.Items;
            _autoCount = items.Count(j => j.IsAutoPosted);
            _reversedCount = items.Count(j => j.IsReversed);
            var now = DateTime.Now;
            _thisMonthCount = items.Count(j => j.EntryDate.Year == now.Year && j.EntryDate.Month == now.Month);
        }
        catch { }
    }

    private async Task Reverse(Guid id)
    {
        var confirm = await DialogService.ShowMessageBoxAsync("Reverse Entry",
            "Are you sure you want to reverse this journal entry?", "Reverse", "Cancel");
        if (confirm == true)
        {
            try
            {
                await AccountingService.ReverseJournalEntry(id, "Manual reversal");
                Snackbar.Add("Journal entry reversed", Severity.Success);
                await LoadEntries();
            }
            catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
        }
    }

    private async Task OpenCreate()
    {
        var accounts = await AccountingService.GetChartOfAccounts();
        var parameters = new DialogParameters<JournalEntryDialog>
        {
            { x => x.Accounts, accounts },
            { x => x.OnSubmit, EventCallback.Factory.Create<CreateJournalEntryDto>(this, HandleFormSubmit) },
            { x => x.OnSubmitAndNew, EventCallback.Factory.Create<CreateJournalEntryDto>(this, HandleFormSubmit) },
            { x => x.OnCancel, EventCallback.Factory.Create(this, CloseDialog) }
        };
        var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<JournalEntryDialog>("New Journal Entry", parameters,
            new DialogOptions { MaxWidth = MaxWidth.Large, FullWidth = true, CloseButton = true, CloseOnEscapeKey = true });
        await dialog.Result;
    }

    private async Task HandleFormSubmit(CreateJournalEntryDto dto)
    {
        try
        {
            await AccountingService.CreateJournalEntry(dto);
            Snackbar.Add("Journal entry created", Severity.Success);
            await LoadEntries();
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
    }

    private Task CloseDialog() => Task.CompletedTask;

    private void OnSearchInput(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        _search = e.Value?.ToString() ?? "";
        _page = 1;
        _debounce?.Stop();
        _debounce?.Dispose();
        _debounce = new System.Timers.Timer(350) { AutoReset = false };
        _debounce.Elapsed += async (_, __) =>
        {
            await LoadEntries();
            await InvokeAsync(StateHasChanged);
        };
        _debounce.Start();
    }

    private void OnFlagChanged(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        _flag = e.Value?.ToString() switch
        {
            "auto" => JournalFlag.Auto,
            "manual" => JournalFlag.Manual,
            "reversed" => JournalFlag.Reversed,
            _ => JournalFlag.All
        };
        _page = 1;
    }

    private void PickAuto(bool auto) =>
        _flag = _flag == (auto ? JournalFlag.Auto : JournalFlag.Manual)
            ? JournalFlag.All
            : (auto ? JournalFlag.Auto : JournalFlag.Manual);

    private void PickReversed() =>
        _flag = _flag == JournalFlag.Reversed ? JournalFlag.All : JournalFlag.Reversed;

    private void ResetFilters()
    {
        _search = "";
        _flag = JournalFlag.All;
        _page = 1;
    }

    private int PageTotal => Math.Max(1, (int)Math.Ceiling(Filtered.Count / (double)_pageSize));

    private Task GoToPage(int pageIndex)
    {
        _page = Math.Clamp(pageIndex + 1, 1, PageTotal);
        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }

    private Task GoPrevPage() => GoToPage(_page - 2);

    private Task GoNextPage() => GoToPage(_page);

    private void OnPageSizeChanged(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        if (int.TryParse(e.Value?.ToString(), out var size) && size > 0)
        {
            _pageSize = size;
            _page = 1;
        }
    }
}

                                <MudIconButton Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Edit" Size="Size.Small" Color="Color.Info" OnClick="@(() => StartEditItem(itemIndex, context))" />
                                <MudIconButton Icon="@Icons.Material.Outlined.Delete" Size="Size.Small" Color="Color.Error" OnClick="@(() => dataModel.JournalLines.Remove(context))" />
                            </MudTd>
                        }
                    }
                </RowTemplate>
            </MudTable>

            <MudCard Class="mt-4">
                <MudCardHeader Class="pb-0 pt-2">
                    <MudText>Balance</MudText>
                    <hr class="border-1" />
                </MudCardHeader>
                <MudCardContent>
                    <MudGrid Class="pt-0">
                        <MudItem xs="3" Class="pe-2 pt-2">
                            <MudNumericField Value="@_totalDebit" Disabled="true" Label="Total Debit" Format="N2" ShrinkLabel="true" Variant="Variant.Outlined" Margin="Margin.Dense" Class="pb-1" />
                        </MudItem>
                        <MudItem xs="3" Class="pe-2 pt-2">
                            <MudNumericField Value="@_totalCredit" Disabled="true" Label="Total Credit" Format="N2" ShrinkLabel="true" Variant="Variant.Outlined" Margin="Margin.Dense" Class="pb-1" />
                        </MudItem>
                        <MudItem xs="3" Class="pe-2 pt-2">
                            <MudNumericField Value="@_difference" Disabled="true" Label="Difference" Format="N2" ShrinkLabel="true" Variant="Variant.Outlined" Margin="Margin.Dense" Class="pb-1" />
                        </MudItem>
                        <MudItem xs="3" Class="pe-2 pt-2">
                            <MudTextField Value="@(_isBalanced ? "Balanced" : "Imbalanced")" Disabled="true" Label="Status" ShrinkLabel="true" Variant="Variant.Outlined" Margin="Margin.Dense" Class="pb-1" />
                        </MudItem>
                    </MudGrid>
                </MudCardContent>
            </MudCard>
            <div class="d-flex gap-2 justify-end mt-4 pb-2">
                <MudButton @ref="CancleButtonRef" OnClick="Cancel">Cancel</MudButton>
               @*  <MudButton Color="Color.Primary" Variant="Variant.Filled" OnClick="Submit" Disabled="@(!_isBalanced)">
                    Post
                </MudButton>
                <MudButton Color="Color.Primary" Variant="Variant.Filled" OnClick="SubmitAndNew" Disabled="@(!_isBalanced)">
                    Post & New
                </MudButton> *@

                <MudButton Color="Color.Primary" Variant="Variant.Filled" OnClick="Submit">Post</MudButton>
                <MudButton Color="Color.Primary" Variant="Variant.Filled" OnClick="SubmitAndNew">Post & New</MudButton>
            </div>
        </div>

</MudDialog>


@inject IDialogService DialogService
@inject IAccountingService AccountingService
@inject ISnackbar Snackbar

@code {
    [CascadingParameter] private IMudDialogInstance MudDialog { get; set; } = default!;
    [Parameter] public List<AccountModelDto> Accounts { get; set; } = new();
    [Parameter] public CreateJournalEntryDtoModels dataModel { get; set; } = new CreateJournalEntryDtoModels();
    [Parameter] public EventCallback<CreateJournalEntryDto> OnSubmit { get; set; }
    [Parameter] public EventCallback<CreateJournalEntryDto> OnSubmitAndNew { get; set; }
    [Parameter] public EventCallback OnCancel { get; set; }

    private MudTextField<string>? RefDescription;
    private MudTextField<string>? RefLineDescription;
    private MudButton? CancleButtonRef;

    private static readonly ControlItemsDto AddNewAccountOption = new ControlItemsDto(){ Id = Guid.Empty, Name = "Add New" };

    private int _editingItemIndex = -1;

    private decimal _totalDebit;
    private decimal _totalCredit;
    private decimal _difference;
    private bool _isBalanced;

    protected override void OnInitialized()
    {
        if (dataModel.LineObj.AccountDdlControl.SelectedItem == null && Accounts.Count > 0)
        {
            var first = Accounts.First();
            dataModel.LineObj.AccountDdlControl.SelectedItem = new ControlItemsDto(){ Id = first.Id, Name = $"{first.Code} - {first.Name}", IsSelected = false };
            dataModel.LineObj.AccountDdlControl.SelectedText = $"{first.Code} - {first.Name}";
            dataModel.LineObj.AccountDdlControl.LastSelectedItem = dataModel.LineObj.AccountDdlControl.SelectedItem;
        }
    }

    private async Task OnAccountChanged()
    {
        var acc = dataModel.LineObj.AccountDdlControl.SelectedItem;

        if (acc?.Id == Guid.Empty)
        {
            var previousAccount = dataModel.LineObj.AccountDdlControl.SelectedItem;
            var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<AccountDialog>("New Account",
                new DialogParameters<AccountDialog>(),
                new DialogOptions { MaxWidth = MaxWidth.Small, FullWidth = true, CloseButton = true });
            var result = await dialog.Result;

            await dataModel.LineObj.AccountDdlControl.ControlRef.ResetAsync();

            if (result != null && !result.Canceled && result.Data is AccountModelDto dto)
            {
                var newAccountId = await AccountingService.CreateAccount(dto);
                Snackbar.Add("Account created successfully", Severity.Success);

                Accounts = await AccountingService.GetChartOfAccounts();

                acc = new ControlItemsDto(){ Id = newAccountId, Name = $"{dto.Code} - {dto.Name}" };

                dataModel.LineObj.AccountId = newAccountId;
                await UpdateControlSelection(dataModel.LineObj.AccountDdlControl, acc);

                StateHasChanged();
            }
            else
            {
                await UpdateControlSelection(dataModel.LineObj.AccountDdlControl, previousAccount);

                StateHasChanged();
            }
        }
        else
        {
            dataModel.LineObj.AccountId = acc != null ? (Guid)acc.Id : Guid.Empty;
            await UpdateControlSelection(dataModel.LineObj.AccountDdlControl, acc);
        }

        if (RefLineDescription is not null)
        {
            await RefLineDescription.FocusAsync();
        }
    }

    private async Task UpdateControlSelection(ControlDto control, ControlItemsDto? selectedItem)
    {
        if (selectedItem != null)
        {
            control.SelectedItem = selectedItem;
            control.LastSelectedItem = selectedItem;
            control.SelectedText = selectedItem.Name ?? selectedItem.Text1;
            control.SelectedIndex++;
        }
    }

    private Task<IEnumerable<ControlItemsDto>> SearchAccounts(string text, CancellationToken _)
    {
        IEnumerable<ControlItemsDto> baseResults;

        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text))
        {
            baseResults = Accounts.Where(a => a.IsActive==true).Select(a => new ControlItemsDto(){ Id = a.Id, Name = $"{a.Code} - {a.Name}", IsSelected = false });
        }
        else
        {
            baseResults = Accounts.Where(a =>
                a.IsActive==true &&
                (a.Name.Contains(text, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                 a.Code.Contains(text, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)))
                .Select(a => new ControlItemsDto(){ Id = a.Id, Name = $"{a.Code} - {a.Name}", IsSelected = false });
        }

        var results = baseResults.Append(AddNewAccountOption).DistinctBy(c => c.Id);

        return Task.FromResult(results);
    }

    private async Task StartEditItem(int index, CreateJournalEntryLineDto line)
    {
        if (dataModel.JournalLines.Any(x => x.AccountId == Guid.Empty)) return;

        _editingItemIndex = index;
        var account = Accounts.FirstOrDefault(a => a.Id == line.AccountId);
        dataModel.LineObj.AccountId = line.AccountId;
        dataModel.LineObj.AccountDdlControl.SelectedItem = account != default
            ? new ControlItemsDto(){ Id = account.Id, Name = $"{account.Code} - {account.Name}", IsSelected = false }
            : new ControlItemsDto(){ Id = Guid.Empty, Name = "", IsSelected = false };
        dataModel.LineObj.Description = line.Description;
        dataModel.LineObj.Debit = line.Debit;
        dataModel.LineObj.Credit = line.Credit;

        await UpdateControlSelection(dataModel.LineObj.AccountDdlControl, dataModel.LineObj.AccountDdlControl.SelectedItem);
    }

    private async Task SaveEditItem(int index)
    {
        if (dataModel.LineObj.AccountId == Guid.Empty) return;
        if (dataModel.LineObj.Debit < 0 || dataModel.LineObj.Credit < 0) return;
        if ((dataModel.LineObj.Debit > 0 && dataModel.LineObj.Credit > 0) ||
            (dataModel.LineObj.Debit == 0 && dataModel.LineObj.Credit == 0)) return;

        var updated = new CreateJournalEntryLineDto(
            dataModel.LineObj.AccountId,
            dataModel.LineObj.Debit,
            dataModel.LineObj.Credit,
            dataModel.LineObj.Description);

        dataModel.JournalLines[index] = updated;
        _editingItemIndex = -1;
        CalculateTotals();
    }

    private async Task CancelEditItem()
    {
        _editingItemIndex = -1;

        if (CancleButtonRef is not null)
        {
            await CancleButtonRef.FocusAsync();
        }
    }

    private async Task RemoveEditItem(CreateJournalEntryLineDto item)
    {
        dataModel.JournalLines.Remove(item);
        CalculateTotals();
        if (CancleButtonRef is not null)
        {
            await CancleButtonRef.FocusAsync();
        }
    }

    private async Task OnEditAccountChanged()
    {
        var acc = dataModel.LineObj.AccountDdlControl.SelectedItem;
        if (acc == null) return;

        dataModel.LineObj.AccountId = (Guid)acc.Id;
        dataModel.LineObj.AccountDdlControl.LastSelectedItem = acc;
        dataModel.LineObj.AccountDdlControl.SelectedText = acc?.Name;

        if (RefLineDescription is not null)
        {
            await RefLineDescription.FocusAsync();
        }
    }

    private async Task FocusAccountBox()
    {
        await Task.Delay(100);
        if (dataModel.LineObj.AccountDdlControl.ControlRef is not null)
        {
            await dataModel.LineObj.AccountDdlControl.ControlRef.ResetAsync();
            await dataModel.LineObj.AccountDdlControl.ControlRef.FocusAsync();
        }
    }

    private async Task AddNewItem()
    {
        var item = dataModel.JournalLines.Where(x => x.AccountId == Guid.Empty).FirstOrDefault();
        if (item != null) return;
        if (_editingItemIndex >= 0) return;

        dataModel.LineObj.AccountDdlControl.LastSelectedItem = null;
        dataModel.LineObj.AccountDdlControl.SelectedText = "";
        dataModel.LineObj.AccountDdlControl.SelectedItem = new ControlItemsDto(){ Id = Guid.Empty, Name = "", IsSelected = false };
        dataModel.LineObj.AccountId = Guid.Empty;
        dataModel.LineObj.Description = null;
        dataModel.LineObj.Debit = 0;
        dataModel.LineObj.Credit = 0;

        dataModel.JournalLines.Insert(0, new CreateJournalEntryLineDto(Guid.Empty, 0, 0, null));

        await FocusAccountBox();
    }

    private async Task AddItem()
    {
        var selected = dataModel.LineObj.AccountDdlControl.SelectedItem;
        if (selected == null || selected.Id == Guid.Empty) return;
        if (dataModel.LineObj.Debit < 0 || dataModel.LineObj.Credit < 0) return;
        if ((dataModel.LineObj.Debit > 0 && dataModel.LineObj.Credit > 0) ||
            (dataModel.LineObj.Debit == 0 && dataModel.LineObj.Credit == 0)) return;

        dataModel.JournalLines.Insert(dataModel.JournalLines.Count, new CreateJournalEntryLineDto((Guid)selected.Id, dataModel.LineObj.Debit, dataModel.LineObj.Credit, dataModel.LineObj.Description));
        dataModel.LineObj.AccountId = Guid.Empty;
        dataModel.LineObj.Description = null;
        dataModel.LineObj.Debit = 0;
        dataModel.LineObj.Credit = 0;
        CalculateTotals();

        if (Accounts.Count > 0)
        {
            var first = Accounts.First();
            dataModel.LineObj.AccountDdlControl.SelectedItem = new ControlItemsDto(){ Id = first.Id, Name = $"{first.Code} - {first.Name}", IsSelected = false };
            dataModel.LineObj.AccountDdlControl.SelectedText = $"{first.Code} - {first.Name}";
        }

        await FocusAccountBox();
    }

    private void CalculateTotals()
    {
        var committed = dataModel.JournalLines.Where(l => l.AccountId != Guid.Empty).ToList();
        _totalDebit = committed.Sum(l => l.Debit);
        _totalCredit = committed.Sum(l => l.Credit);
        _difference = _totalDebit - _totalCredit;
        _isBalanced = committed.Any() && Math.Abs(_difference) < 0.01m;
    }

    private void ResetForm()
    {
        dataModel.Description = null;
        dataModel.JournalLines = new List<CreateJournalEntryLineDto>();
        _editingItemIndex = -1;
        dataModel.LineObj.AccountId = Guid.Empty;
        dataModel.LineObj.Description = null;
        dataModel.LineObj.Debit = 0;
        dataModel.LineObj.Credit = 0;
        dataModel.LineObj.AccountDdlControl.LastSelectedItem = null;
        dataModel.LineObj.AccountDdlControl.SelectedText = "";

        if (Accounts.Count > 0)
        {
            var first = Accounts.First();
            dataModel.LineObj.AccountDdlControl.SelectedItem = new ControlItemsDto(){ Id = first.Id, Name = $"{first.Code} - {first.Name}", IsSelected = false };
            dataModel.LineObj.AccountDdlControl.SelectedText = $"{first.Code} - {first.Name}";
        }

        CalculateTotals();
    }

    private async Task Cancel()
    {
        await OnCancel.InvokeAsync();
        MudDialog.Cancel();
    }

    private async Task Submit()
    {
        CalculateTotals();
        if (!_isBalanced) return;

        var dto = new CreateJournalEntryDto(dataModel.EntryDate ?? DateTime.Today, dataModel.Description,
            dataModel.JournalLines.Where(l => l.AccountId != Guid.Empty).ToList());
        await OnSubmit.InvokeAsync(dto);
        MudDialog.Close(DialogResult.Ok(dto));
    }

    private async Task SubmitAndNew()
    {
        CalculateTotals();
        if (!_isBalanced) return;

        var dto = new CreateJournalEntryDto(dataModel.EntryDate ?? DateTime.Today, dataModel.Description,
            dataModel.JournalLines.Where(l => l.AccountId != Guid.Empty).ToList());
        await OnSubmitAndNew.InvokeAsync(dto);
        ResetForm();

        if (RefDescription is not null)
        {
            await RefDescription.FocusAsync();
        }
    }
}

@code {
    [CascadingParameter] private IMudDialogInstance MudDialog { get; set; } = null!;
    private MudForm _form = null!;

    private PaymentModelDto paymentModelDto = new PaymentModelDto();
    // private DateTime? _paymentDate = DateTime.Today;
    // private ControlItemsDto? _selectedCustomer;
    // private ControlItemsDto? _selectedSupplier;
    // private PaymentMethod _paymentMethod = PaymentMethod.BankTransfer;
    // private decimal _amount;
    // private string _reference = "";
    // private string _notes = "";

    private List<CustomerDto> _customers = new();
    private List<SupplierDto> _suppliers = new();
    private List<InvoiceDto> _invoices = new();

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        _customers = await CustomerService.GetActiveCustomersAsync();
        _suppliers = await SupplierService.GetActiveSuppliersAsync();
    }

    private Task<IEnumerable<ControlItemsDto>> SearchCustomers(string text, CancellationToken token)
    {
        IEnumerable<ControlItemsDto> results;
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text))
        {
            results = _customers.Select(c => new ControlItemsDto { Id = c.Id, Name = c.CustomerName });
        }
        else
        {
            results = _customers.Where(c => c.CustomerName.Contains(text, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                .Select(c => new ControlItemsDto { Id = c.Id, Name = c.CustomerName });
        }
        return Task.FromResult(results);
    }

    private Task<IEnumerable<ControlItemsDto>> SearchSuppliers(string text, CancellationToken token)
    {
        IEnumerable<ControlItemsDto> results;
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text))
        {
            results = _suppliers.Select(s => new ControlItemsDto { Id = s.Id, Name = s.SupplierName });
        }
        else
        {
            results = _suppliers.Where(s => s.SupplierName.Contains(text, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                .Select(s => new ControlItemsDto { Id = s.Id, Name = s.SupplierName });
        }
        return Task.FromResult(results);
    }
    private async Task OnPartyChanged()
    {
        var cust = paymentModelDto.SelectedParty;
        if (paymentModelDto.PaymentType == PaymentType.Receipt && cust != null)
        {
            _invoices = await InvoiceService.GetInvoiceByCustomer((Guid)cust.Id);
            //paymentModelDto.Invoices = invoices.Where(i => i != null).Select(i => new ControlItemsDto { Id = i!.Id, Name = i.InvoiceNumber }).ToList();
        }
        else if (paymentModelDto.PaymentType == PaymentType.Payment && cust != null)
        {
            _invoices = await InvoiceService.GetInvoiceBySupplier((Guid)cust.Id);
            //paymentModelDto.Invoices = invoices.Where(i => i != null).Select(i => new ControlItemsDto { Id = i!.Id, Name = i.InvoiceNumber }).ToList();
        }

    }
    private async Task Submit()
    {
        await _form.ValidateAsync();
        if (!_form.IsValid) return;

        try
        {
            
    //public record RecordPaymentDto(PaymentType PaymentType, Guid? CustomerId, Guid? SupplierId,
      //  Guid? InvoiceId, decimal Amount, PaymentMethod PaymentMethod,
//        string? Reference, DateTime PaymentDate);

            var dto = new RecordPaymentDto(
                paymentModelDto.PaymentType,
                paymentModelDto.PaymentType == PaymentType.Receipt ? (Guid)paymentModelDto.SelectedParty!.Id : null,
                paymentModelDto.PaymentType == PaymentType.Payment ? (Guid)paymentModelDto.SelectedParty!.Id : null,
                null,
                paymentModelDto.Amount,
                paymentModelDto.Method,
                paymentModelDto.PaymentMediaName,
                paymentModelDto.AccountName,
                paymentModelDto.AccountNumber,
                paymentModelDto.CheckOrCardNumber,
                paymentModelDto.Reference,
                paymentModelDto.PaymentDate ?? DateTime.Today,paymentModelDto.Notes);

            await AccountingService.RecordPayment(dto);
            Snackbar.Add("Payment recorded successfully", Severity.Success);
            MudDialog.Close(DialogResult.Ok(true));
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
    }

    private void Cancel() => MudDialog.Cancel();
}

@code {
    private List<PaymentListItemDto> _payments = new();
    private bool _loading = true;
    private string _search = "";
    private PaymentType? _typeFilter;
    private PaymentMethod? _methodFilter;
    private int _page = 1;
    private int _pageSize = 10;
    private PaymentViewPanel? _paymentViewPanel;

    private int _receiptCount => _payments.Count(p => p.PaymentType == PaymentType.Receipt);
    private int _paymentCount => _payments.Count(p => p.PaymentType != PaymentType.Receipt);
    private string ReceiptTotal => _payments.Where(p => p.PaymentType == PaymentType.Receipt).Sum(p => p.Amount).ToString("N0");
    private string PaymentTotal => _payments.Where(p => p.PaymentType != PaymentType.Receipt).Sum(p => p.Amount).ToString("N0");
    private string NetBalance
    {
        get
        {
            var net = _payments.Where(p => p.PaymentType == PaymentType.Receipt).Sum(p => p.Amount)
                   - _payments.Where(p => p.PaymentType != PaymentType.Receipt).Sum(p => p.Amount);
            return net.ToString("N0");
        }
    }

    private List<PaymentListItemDto> Filtered => _payments.Where(p =>
        (_typeFilter == null || p.PaymentType == _typeFilter.Value)
        && (_methodFilter == null || p.PaymentMethod == _methodFilter.Value)
        && (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_search)
            || p.PaymentNumber.Contains(_search, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            || p.PartyName.Contains(_search, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            || (p.Reference?.Contains(_search, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ?? false))).ToList();

    private List<PaymentListItemDto> Paged => Filtered.Skip((_page - 1) * _pageSize).Take(_pageSize).ToList();

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync() => await Load();

    private async Task Load()
    {
        _loading = true;
        try
        {
            _payments = await AccountingService.GetRecentPayments(500);
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
        finally { _loading = false; }
    }

    private async Task OpenCreateDialog()
    {
        var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<PaymentDialog>("Record Payment", new DialogParameters(),
            new DialogOptions { MaxWidth = MaxWidth.Medium, FullWidth = true, CloseButton = true });
        var result = await dialog.Result;
        if (result != null && !result.Canceled)
            await Load();
    }

    private void OnSearchInput(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        _search = e.Value?.ToString() ?? "";
        _page = 1;
    }

    private void OnTypeChanged(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        var v = e.Value?.ToString();
        _typeFilter = string.IsNullOrEmpty(v) ? null : Enum.Parse<PaymentType>(v);
        _page = 1;
    }

    private void OnMethodChanged(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        var v = e.Value?.ToString();
        _methodFilter = string.IsNullOrEmpty(v) ? null : Enum.Parse<PaymentMethod>(v);
        _page = 1;
    }

    private void PickType(PaymentType t)
    {
        _typeFilter = _typeFilter == t ? null : t;
        _page = 1;
    }

    private void ResetFilters()
    {
        _search = "";
        _typeFilter = null;
        _methodFilter = null;
        _page = 1;
    }

    private int PageTotal => Math.Max(1, (int)Math.Ceiling(Filtered.Count / (double)_pageSize));

    private Task GoToPage(int pageIndex)
    {
        _page = Math.Clamp(pageIndex + 1, 1, PageTotal);
        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }

    private Task GoPrevPage() => GoToPage(_page - 2);

    private Task GoNextPage() => GoToPage(_page);

    private void OnPageSizeChanged(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        if (int.TryParse(e.Value?.ToString(), out var size) && size > 0)
        {
            _pageSize = size;
            _page = 1;
        }
    }

    private async Task ViewPayment(PaymentListItemDto payment)
    {
        if (_paymentViewPanel != null)
            await _paymentViewPanel.OpenAsync(payment);
    }
}

@code {
    private bool _open;
    private bool _animateIn;
    private PaymentListItemDto? _payment;

    private static Color GetStatusColor(PaymentStatus status) => status switch
    {
        PaymentStatus.Completed => Color.Success,
        PaymentStatus.Pending => Color.Warning,
        PaymentStatus.Failed => Color.Error,
        PaymentStatus.Refunded => Color.Info,
        _ => Color.Default
    };

    private static Color GetTypeColor(PaymentType type) =>
        type == PaymentType.Receipt ? Color.Success : Color.Error;

    private bool IsMobileWallet => _payment?.PaymentMethod
        is PaymentMethod.Bkash or PaymentMethod.Nagad;

    private bool IsBankLike => _payment?.PaymentMethod
        is PaymentMethod.BankTransfer or PaymentMethod.Check or PaymentMethod.CreditCard;

    // Check, CreditCard, Bkash and Nagad always show their full detail set,
    // using "â€”" for values that were not captured.
    private bool ShowAllDetails => _payment?.PaymentMethod
        is PaymentMethod.Check or PaymentMethod.CreditCard or PaymentMethod.Bkash or PaymentMethod.Nagad;

    private bool ShowMediaRow => (ShowAllDetails && IsBankLike)
        || !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_payment?.PaymentMediaName);

    private bool ShowAccountNameRow => ShowAllDetails
        || !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_payment?.AccountName);

    private bool ShowAccountNumberRow => (ShowAllDetails && _payment?.PaymentMethod != PaymentMethod.CreditCard)
        || !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_payment?.AccountNumber);

    private bool ShowCheckCardRow => (ShowAllDetails && !IsMobileWallet)
        || !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_payment?.CheckOrCardNumber);

    private bool ShowReferenceRow => ShowAllDetails
        || !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_payment?.Reference);

    private bool ShowDetails => ShowMediaRow || ShowAccountNameRow || ShowAccountNumberRow
        || ShowCheckCardRow || ShowReferenceRow;

    private static string Display(string? value) =>
        string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value) ? "â€”" : value!;

    public async Task OpenAsync(PaymentListItemDto payment)
    {
        _payment = payment;
        _open = true;
        _animateIn = false;
        StateHasChanged();

        await Task.Delay(20);
        _animateIn = true;
        StateHasChanged();
    }

    public void Close()
    {
        _open = false;
        _animateIn = false;
        _payment = null;
        StateHasChanged();
    }
}

@code {
    private DateTime? _fromDate = new DateTime(DateTime.Today.Year, 1, 1);
    private DateTime? _toDate = DateTime.Today;
    private ProfitAndLossDto? _report;

    // Chart data
    private string[] _pnlBarLabels = { "Revenue", "Expenses", "Net Profit" };
    private List<ChartSeries<double>> _pnlBarSeries = new();
    private double[] _expenseDonutData = [];
    private string[] _expenseDonutLabels = [];
    private string[] _revenueBarLabels = [];
    private List<ChartSeries<double>> _revenueBarSeries = new();
    private async Task Generate()
    {
        try
        {
            _report = await AccountingService.GetProfitAndLoss(_fromDate ?? DateTime.Today.AddYears(-1), _toDate ?? DateTime.Today);

            // Revenue vs Expenses bar
            _pnlBarSeries = new List<ChartSeries<double>>
            {
                new() { Name = "Amount", Data = new double[] { (double)_report.TotalRevenue, (double)_report.TotalExpenses, (double)Math.Abs(_report.NetProfit) } }
            };

            // Expense breakdown donut
            var topExpenses = _report.ExpenseLines.OrderByDescending(e => e.Amount).Take(8).ToList();
            _expenseDonutLabels = topExpenses.Select(e => e.AccountName.Length > 18 ? e.AccountName[..18] + ".." : e.AccountName).ToArray();
            _expenseDonutData = topExpenses.Select(e => (double)e.Amount).ToArray();

            // Revenue bar
            _revenueBarLabels = _report.RevenueLines.Select(r => r.AccountName.Length > 15 ? r.AccountName[..15] + ".." : r.AccountName).ToArray();
            _revenueBarSeries = new List<ChartSeries<double>>
            {
                new() { Name = "Revenue", Data = _report.RevenueLines.Select(r => (double)r.Amount).ToArray() }
            };
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
    }
}

        </MudItem>
        <MudItem xs="12" sm="4">
            <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled" Color="Color.Primary" OnClick="Generate" Class="mt-2">

            </MudPaper>

                <MudIcon Icon="@(_report.TotalDebits == _report.TotalCredits ? Icons.Material.Filled.CheckCircle : Icons.Material.Filled.Error)"
                         Color="@(_report.TotalDebits == _report.TotalCredits ? Color.Success : Color.Error)" Size="Size.Large" Class="mr-3" />
                <div><MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Color="Color.Secondary">Balance</MudText>
                <MudText Typo="Typo.h5"><strong>@(Taka.Ho((_report.TotalDebits - _report.TotalCredits)))</strong></MudText></div>

                              XAxisLabels="@_acctTypeLabels" Width="100%" Height="300px" />
                </MudPaper>
            </MudItem>
        }

        {
            <MudItem xs="12" md="6">
                <MudPaper Class="pa-4" Elevation="3">

            </FooterContent>
        </MudTable>
    </MudPaper>

@code {
    private DateTime? _asOfDate = DateTime.Today;
    private TrialBalanceDto? _report;

    // Chart data
    private string[] _acctTypeLabels = [];
    private List<ChartSeries<double>> _acctTypeSeries = new();
    private string[] _typeDistLabels = [];
    private double[] _typeDistData = [];

    private async Task Generate()
    {
        try
        {
            _report = await AccountingService.GetTrialBalance(_asOfDate ?? DateTime.Today);

            // Group by account type
            var typeGroups = _report.Lines.GroupBy(l => l.AccountType.ToString()).ToList();
            _acctTypeLabels = typeGroups.Select(g => g.Key).ToArray();
            _acctTypeSeries = new List<ChartSeries<double>>
            {
                new() { Name = "Debits", Data = typeGroups.Select(g => (double)g.Sum(l => l.Debit)).ToArray() },
                new() { Name = "Credits", Data = typeGroups.Select(g => (double)g.Sum(l => l.Credit)).ToArray() }
            };

            // Balance by type donut
            var typeDist = typeGroups.Select(g => new {
                Type = g.Key,
                Balance = Math.Abs((double)g.Sum(l => l.Debit) - (double)g.Sum(l => l.Credit))
            }).Where(x => x.Balance > 0).ToList();
            _typeDistLabels = typeDist.Select(t => t.Type).ToArray();
            _typeDistData = typeDist.Select(t => t.Balance).ToArray();
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
    }
}

@code {
    private List<AuditLogDto> _logs = new();
    private string? _tableName;
    private string? _action;
    private int _page = 1;
    private int _totalPages = 1;
    private bool _loading;
    private bool _detailsVisible;
    private AuditLogDto? _selectedLog;

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync() => await LoadData();

    private async Task LoadData()
    {
        _loading = true;
        try
        {
            var result = await AuditLogService.GetAuditLogs(_tableName, _action, _page, 25);
            _logs = result.Items;
            _totalPages = result.TotalPages;
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
        finally { _loading = false; }
    }

    private void ShowDetails(AuditLogDto log)
    {
        _selectedLog = log;
        _detailsVisible = true;
    }

    private async Task OnPageChanged(int page)
    {
        _page = page;
        await LoadData();
    }
}

    {
        _loading = true;
        _policies = await ArchivalService.GetPolicies();
        _loading = false;
    }

    private async Task Create()
    {
        try
        {
            var dto = new CreateArchivalPolicyDto(_entityType, _retentionDays);
            await ArchivalService.CreatePolicy(dto);
            Snackbar.Add("Archival policy created.", Severity.Success);
            _showCreate = false;
            await Load();
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
    }

    private async Task Delete(Guid id)
    {
        try
        {
            await ArchivalService.DeletePolicy(id);
            Snackbar.Add("Policy deleted.", Severity.Success);
            await Load();
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
    }
}

            </MudTd>
        </RowTemplate>
    </MudTable>

<MudPaper Elevation="2" Class="pa-4 mt-4">
    <MudText Typo="Typo.h6" Class="mb-3">Assign Role to User</MudText>
    <MudGrid>
        <MudItem xs="12" sm="4">
            <MudAutocomplete T="UserDto" @bind-Value="_selectedUser" Label="Select User"
                             SearchFunc="SearchUsers" ToStringFunc="@(u => u?.FullName ?? "")"
                             ShrinkLabel="true" Variant="Variant.Outlined" Margin="Margin.Dense"/>
        </MudItem>
        <MudItem xs="12" sm="4">
            <MudSelect @bind-Value="_selectedRole" Label="Select Role" Variant="Variant.Outlined" Margin="Margin.Dense">
                @foreach (var role in _roles)
                {
                    <MudSelectItem Value="@role">@role</MudSelectItem>
                }
            </MudSelect>
        </MudItem>
        <MudItem xs="12" sm="4" Class="d-flex align-end gap-2">
            <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled" Color="Color.Primary" OnClick="AssignRole"
                       Disabled="@(_selectedUser == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(_selectedRole))">Assign</MudButton>
            <MudButton Variant="Variant.Outlined" Color="Color.Error" OnClick="RemoveRole"
                       Disabled="@(_selectedUser == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(_selectedRole))">Remove</MudButton>
        </MudItem>
    </MudGrid>

    @if (_selectedUser != null && _userRoles.Any())
    {
        <MudText Class="mt-3"><strong>Current Roles for @_selectedUser.FullName:</strong></MudText>
        <MudChipSet T="string" Class="mt-1">
            @foreach (var role in _userRoles)
            {
                <MudChip T="string" Color="Color.Info" Size="Size.Small">@role</MudChip>
            }
        </MudChipSet>
    }
</MudPaper>

@code {
    private List<string> _roles = new();
    private List<UserDto> _users = new();
    private List<string> _userRoles = new();
    private string _newRoleName = "";
    private string? _selectedRole;
    private UserDto? _selectedUser;
    private bool _loading = true;

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        await LoadRoles();
        _users = await UserService.GetUsers(null);
    }

    private async Task LoadRoles()
    {
        _loading = true;
        try { _roles = await UserService.GetRoles(); }
        catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add($"Error: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error); }
        finally { _loading = false; }
    }

    private async Task CreateRole()
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_newRoleName)) return;
        try
        {
            await UserService.CreateRole(_newRoleName.Trim());
            _newRoleName = "";
            await LoadRoles();
            Snackbar.Add("Role created", Severity.Success);
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
    }

    private async Task DeleteRole(string roleName)
    {
        var confirm = await DialogService.ShowMessageBoxAsync("Confirm Delete", $"Delete role '{roleName}'?", "Delete", "Cancel");
        if (confirm == true)
        {
            try
            {
                await UserService.DeleteRole(roleName);
                await LoadRoles();
                Snackbar.Add("Role deleted", Severity.Success);
            }
            catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
        }
    }

    private async Task<IEnumerable<UserDto>> SearchUsers(string? value, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value)) return _users.Take(10);
        return _users.Where(u => u.FullName.Contains(value, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)).Take(10);
    }

    private async Task AssignRole()
    {
        if (_selectedUser == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(_selectedRole)) return;
        try
        {
            await UserService.AssignRole(_selectedUser.Id, _selectedRole);
            _userRoles = await UserService.GetUserRoles(_selectedUser.Id);
            Snackbar.Add($"Role '{_selectedRole}' assigned to {_selectedUser.FullName}", Severity.Success);
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
    }

    private async Task RemoveRole()
    {
        if (_selectedUser == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(_selectedRole)) return;
        try
        {
            await UserService.RemoveRole(_selectedUser.Id, _selectedRole);
            _userRoles = await UserService.GetUserRoles(_selectedUser.Id);
            Snackbar.Add($"Role '{_selectedRole}' removed from {_selectedUser.FullName}", Severity.Success);
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
    }
}

                  OnKeyUp="@(async _ => await LoadData())" ShrinkLabel="true" Variant="Variant.Outlined" Margin="Margin.Dense"/>

<MudTable Items="_users" Hover="true" Striped="true" Loading="_loading">
    <HeaderContent>

    </HeaderContent>
    <RowTemplate>

        <MudTd DataLabel="Email">@context.Email</MudTd>
        <MudTd DataLabel="Department">@context.Department</MudTd>
        <MudTd DataLabel="Active">
            <MudChip T="string" Color="@(context.IsActive ? Color.Success : Color.Error)" Size="Size.Small">
                @(context.IsActive ? "Active" : "Inactive")
            </MudChip>
        </MudTd>
        <MudTd DataLabel="Created">@context.CreatedAt.ToShortDateString()</MudTd>
        <MudTd DataLabel="Last Login">@(context.LastLoginAt?.ToShortDateString() ?? "Never")</MudTd>
        <MudTd DataLabel="Actions">
            <MudIconButton Icon="@(context.IsActive ? Icons.Material.Filled.Block : Icons.Material.Filled.CheckCircle)"
                           Color="@(context.IsActive ? Color.Error : Color.Success)" Size="Size.Small"
                           OnClick="@(() => ToggleActive(context))"
                           Title="@(context.IsActive ? "Deactivate" : "Activate")" />
        </MudTd>
    </RowTemplate>
</MudTable>

@code {
    private List<UserDto> _users = new();
    private string? _search;
    private bool _loading;

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync() => await LoadData();

    private async Task LoadData()
    {
        _loading = true;
        try
        {
            // Was a raw DbContext.Set<ApplicationUser>() query. ApplicationUser is not a BaseEntity,
            // so it carries no global tenant filter, and that query had none of its own either â€”
            // it listed users from every tenant. The service scopes to the caller's tenant.
            _users = await UserManagementService.GetUsers(_search);
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
        finally { _loading = false; }
    }

    private async Task ToggleActive(UserDto user)
    {
        try
        {
            // ToggleUserActive does its own find-by-id and save. The previous version mutated the
            // tracked entity held by the table row and called SaveChangesAsync, which only worked
            // because the page and the context happened to share one change tracker.
            await UserManagementService.ToggleUserActive(user.Id);
            Snackbar.Add($"User {(user.IsActive ? "deactivated" : "activated")}.", Severity.Success);
            await LoadData();
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
    }
}

@code {

            Snackbar.Add("Kit created successfully.", Severity.Success);
            MudDialog.Close(DialogResult.Ok(true));

        catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
    }
}
