@code {
    private static class Col
    {
        public const string ProductName = "ProductName";
        public const string ProductSKU = "ProductSKU";
        public const string ComponentCount = "ComponentCount";
        public const string IsActive = "IsActive";
    }

    // â”€â”€â”€ List state â”€â”€â”€
    private PagedResultNew<KitDto> pagedResultNew = new();
    private KitPagedRequest pagedRequest = new()
    {
        SortColumn = Col.ProductName,
        SortAscending = true
    };

    private bool _loading = true;
    private bool _hasLoadedOnce;
    private bool _loadRunning;
    private bool _loadQueued;
    private CancellationTokenSource? _debounceCts;

    private string StatusValue => pagedRequest.IsActive switch
    {
        true => "active",
        false => "inactive",
        _ => ""
    };

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync() => await Load();

    private async Task Refresh() => await Load();

    /// <summary>
    /// Single-flight loader. The page and the services share one scoped DbContext, so two
    /// overlapping queries would throw "A second operation was started on this context
    /// instance". Callers that arrive mid-flight set a flag instead of starting a parallel
    /// query, and the running load then re-runs once with the newest filter state.
    /// </summary>
    private async Task Load()
    {
        if (_loadRunning)
        {
            _loadQueued = true;
            return;
        }

        _loadRunning = true;
        try
        {
            do
            {
                _loadQueued = false;
                await LoadCore();
            }
            while (_loadQueued);
        }
        finally { _loadRunning = false; }
    }

    private async Task LoadCore()
    {
        _loading = true;
        try
        {
            pagedResultNew = await KitService.GetKitsPagedAsync(pagedRequest);
            _hasLoadedOnce = true;
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
        finally { _loading = false; }
    }

    // â”€â”€â”€ Stats / sorting helpers â”€â”€â”€
    private string TotalCountText => Stat("TotalCount");
    private string ActiveCountText => Stat("ActiveCount");
    private string InactiveCountText => Stat("InactiveCount");
    private string TotalComponentsText => Stat("TotalComponents");
    private string AverageComponentsText => Stat("AverageComponents");
    private string SingleComponentCountText => Stat("SingleComponentCount");

    private string Stat(string key) =>
        pagedResultNew.Stats != null && pagedResultNew.Stats.TryGetValue(key, out var v) ? v.ToString() : "0";

    private async Task SortBy(string column)
    {
        if (pagedRequest.SortColumn == column)
            pagedRequest.SortAscending = !pagedRequest.SortAscending;
        else
        {
            pagedRequest.SortColumn = column;
            pagedRequest.SortAscending = true;
        }
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await Load();
    }

    private string SortIcon(string column)
    {
        if (pagedRequest.SortColumn != column) return "";
        return pagedRequest.SortAscending ? "â–²" : "â–¼";
    }

    private async Task OpenCreate()
    {
        var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<KitDialog>("New Kit");
        var result = await dialog.Result;
        if (result != null && !result.Canceled) await Load();
    }

    private async Task OpenAssemble(KitDto kit)
    {
        var parameters = new DialogParameters { ["Kit"] = kit, ["IsAssemble"] = true };
        var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<KitAssemblyDialog>("Assemble Kit", parameters);
        var result = await dialog.Result;
        if (result != null && !result.Canceled) { Snackbar.Add("Kit assembled.", Severity.Success); await Load(); }
    }

    private async Task OpenDisassemble(KitDto kit)
    {
        var parameters = new DialogParameters { ["Kit"] = kit, ["IsAssemble"] = false };
        var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<KitAssemblyDialog>("Disassemble Kit", parameters);
        var result = await dialog.Result;
        if (result != null && !result.Canceled) { Snackbar.Add("Kit disassembled.", Severity.Success); await Load(); }
    }

    // â”€â”€â”€ Filters â”€â”€â”€
    private void OnSearchInput(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        pagedRequest.SearchTerm = e.Value?.ToString() ?? "";
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;

        _debounceCts?.Cancel();
        _debounceCts?.Dispose();
        _debounceCts = new CancellationTokenSource();
        var token = _debounceCts.Token;

        _ = Task.Run(async () =>
        {
            try
            {
                await Task.Delay(400, token);
                if (token.IsCancellationRequested) return;
                await InvokeAsync(async () =>
                {
                    await Load();
                    StateHasChanged();
                });
            }
            catch (OperationCanceledException) { }
        });
    }

    private async Task OnStatusChanged(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        pagedRequest.IsActive = e.Value?.ToString() switch
        {
            "active" => true,
            "inactive" => false,
            _ => null
        };
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await Load();
    }

    private async Task FilterByStatus(bool? isActive)
    {
        pagedRequest.IsActive = pagedRequest.IsActive == isActive ? null : isActive;
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await Load();
    }

    private async Task ResetFilters()
    {
        pagedRequest.SearchTerm = "";
        pagedRequest.IsActive = null;
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await Load();
    }

    // â”€â”€â”€ Paging (zero-based, matches TmPager) â”€â”€â”€
    private async Task GoToPage(int page)
    {
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = Math.Clamp(page, 0, Math.Max(0, pagedResultNew.TotalPages - 1));
        await Load();
    }

    private async Task GoPrevPage()
    {
        if (pagedRequest.CurrentPage > 0)
        {
            pagedRequest.CurrentPage--;
            await Load();
        }
    }

    private async Task GoNextPage()
    {
        if (pagedRequest.CurrentPage < pagedResultNew.TotalPages - 1)
        {
            pagedRequest.CurrentPage++;
            await Load();
        }
    }

    private async Task OnPageSizeChanged(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        if (int.TryParse(e.Value?.ToString(), out var sz))
        {
            pagedRequest.PageSize = Math.Clamp(sz, 1, 100);
            pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
            await Load();
        }
    }

    public void Dispose()
    {
        _debounceCts?.Cancel();
        _debounceCts?.Dispose();
    }
}

@code {
    private static class Col
    {
        public const string ProductName = "ProductName";
        public const string ProductSKU = "ProductSKU";
        public const string WarehouseName = "WarehouseName";
        public const string Quantity = "Quantity";
        public const string ReservedQuantity = "ReservedQuantity";
        public const string AvailableQuantity = "AvailableQuantity";
        public const string ReorderStockLevel = "ReorderStockLevel";
    }

    private record WhItem(Guid Id, string Name, string Code);

    // â”€â”€â”€ List state â”€â”€â”€
    // Both views are the same query: Low Stock Alerts is this one pinned to LowStockOnly.
    private PagedResultNew<StockLevelDto> pagedResultNew = new();
    private StockLevelPagedRequest pagedRequest = new()
    {
        SortColumn = Col.ProductName,
        SortAscending = true
    };

    private List<WhItem> _warehouses = new();
    private bool _loading = true;
    private bool _hasLoadedOnce;
    private bool _showLowStock;
    private bool _loadRunning;
    private bool _loadQueued;
    private CancellationTokenSource? _debounceCts;

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        try
        {
            var whs = await WarehousesService.GetAllWarehousesAsync();
            _warehouses = whs.Select(w => new WhItem(w.Id, w.Name, w.Code)).ToList();
        }
        catch { }

        await LoadInventory();
    }

    private async Task Refresh() => await LoadInventory();

    /// <summary>
    /// Single-flight loader. The page and the services share one scoped DbContext, so two
    /// overlapping queries would throw "A second operation was started on this context
    /// instance". Callers that arrive mid-flight set a flag instead of starting a parallel
    /// query, and the running load then re-runs once with the newest filter state.
    /// </summary>
    private async Task LoadInventory()
    {
        if (_loadRunning)
        {
            _loadQueued = true;
            return;
        }

        _loadRunning = true;
        try
        {
            do
            {
                _loadQueued = false;
                await LoadInventoryCore();
            }
            while (_loadQueued);
        }
        finally { _loadRunning = false; }
    }

    private async Task LoadInventoryCore()
    {
        _loading = true;
        try
        {
            pagedRequest.LowStockOnly = _showLowStock;
            pagedResultNew = await InventoryService.GetStockLevelsPagedAsync(pagedRequest);
            _hasLoadedOnce = true;
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
        finally { _loading = false; }
    }

    // â”€â”€â”€ Stats / sorting helpers â”€â”€â”€
    private string TotalCountText => Stat("TotalCount");
    private string InStockCountText => Stat("InStockCount");
    private string OutOfStockCountText => Stat("OutOfStockCount");
    private string ReservedCountText => Stat("ReservedCount");
    private string LowStockCountText => Stat("LowStockCount");
    private string WarehouseCountText => Stat("WarehouseCount");

    private string Stat(string key) =>
        pagedResultNew.Stats != null && pagedResultNew.Stats.TryGetValue(key, out var v) ? v.ToString() : "0";

    private void SortBy(string column)
    {
        if (pagedRequest.SortColumn == column)
            pagedRequest.SortAscending = !pagedRequest.SortAscending;
        else
        {
            pagedRequest.SortColumn = column;
            pagedRequest.SortAscending = true;
        }
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
    }

    private string SortIcon(string column)
    {
        if (pagedRequest.SortColumn != column) return "";
        return pagedRequest.SortAscending ? "â–²" : "â–¼";
    }

    private async Task ToggleAlerts()
    {
        _showLowStock = !_showLowStock;
        pagedRequest.Status = null;
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        _hasLoadedOnce = false;
        await LoadInventory();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Stat-tile tabs. Same toggle rule as the Customer/Sales grids: clicking the
    /// active tile clears the filter. Tiles always act on the main Stock Levels
    /// view, so an active Low Stock Alerts view is exited first.
    /// </summary>
    private async Task FilterByStatus(string? status)
    {
        if (_showLowStock)
        {
            _showLowStock = false;
            _hasLoadedOnce = false;
        }
        pagedRequest.Status = pagedRequest.Status == status ? null : status;
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await LoadInventory();
    }

    // â”€â”€â”€ Filters â”€â”€â”€
    private void OnSearchInput(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        pagedRequest.SearchTerm = e.Value?.ToString() ?? "";
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;

        _debounceCts?.Cancel();
        _debounceCts?.Dispose();
        _debounceCts = new CancellationTokenSource();
        var token = _debounceCts.Token;

        _ = Task.Run(async () =>
        {
            try
            {
                await Task.Delay(400, token);
                if (token.IsCancellationRequested) return;
                await InvokeAsync(async () =>
                {
                    await LoadInventory();
                    StateHasChanged();
                });
            }
            catch (OperationCanceledException) { }
        });
    }

    private async Task OnWarehouseChanged(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        var v = e.Value?.ToString();
        pagedRequest.WarehouseId = string.IsNullOrEmpty(v) || !Guid.TryParse(v, out var g) ? null : g;
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await LoadInventory();
    }

    private async Task OnStatusChanged(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        var v = e.Value?.ToString();
        pagedRequest.Status = string.IsNullOrEmpty(v) ? null : v;
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await LoadInventory();
    }

    private async Task ResetFilters()
    {
        pagedRequest.SearchTerm = "";
        pagedRequest.Status = null;
        pagedRequest.WarehouseId = null;
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await LoadInventory();
    }

    // â”€â”€â”€ Paging (zero-based, matches TmPager) â”€â”€â”€
    private async Task GoToPage(int page)
    {
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = Math.Clamp(page, 0, Math.Max(0, pagedResultNew.TotalPages - 1));
        await LoadInventory();
    }

    private async Task GoPrevPage()
    {
        if (pagedRequest.CurrentPage > 0)
        {
            pagedRequest.CurrentPage--;
            await LoadInventory();
        }
    }

    private async Task GoNextPage()
    {
        if (pagedRequest.CurrentPage < pagedResultNew.TotalPages - 1)
        {
            pagedRequest.CurrentPage++;
            await LoadInventory();
        }
    }

    private async Task OnPageSizeChanged(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        if (int.TryParse(e.Value?.ToString(), out var sz))
        {
            pagedRequest.PageSize = Math.Clamp(sz, 1, 100);
            pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
            await LoadInventory();
        }
    }

    public void Dispose()
    {
        _debounceCts?.Cancel();
        _debounceCts?.Dispose();
    }
}

                        <th @onclick="@(() => SortBy(Col.MovementDate))">ðŸ“… Date @SortIcon(Col.MovementDate)</th>
                        <th @onclick="@(() => SortBy(Col.ProductName))">ðŸ“¦ Product @SortIcon(Col.ProductName)</th>
                        <th @onclick="@(() => SortBy(Col.WarehouseName))">Warehouse @SortIcon(Col.WarehouseName)</th>
                        <th @onclick="@(() => SortBy(Col.Type))">Type @SortIcon(Col.Type)</th>
                        <th style="text-align:right" @onclick="@(() => SortBy(Col.Quantity))">Quantity @SortIcon(Col.Quantity)</th>
                        <th @onclick="@(() => SortBy(Col.Reference))">Reference @SortIcon(Col.Reference)</th>
                        <th>Notes</th>
                    </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                    @if (!_hasLoadedOnce && _loading)
                    {
                        <tr><td colspan="7" style="text-align:center; padding:40px; color:#94a3b8;">Loading movements...</td></tr>
                    }
                    else if (pagedResultNew.Items.Count == 0)
                    {
                        <tr>
                            <td colspan="7" style="text-align:center; padding:40px;">
                                <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.SearchOff" Size="Size.Large" Style="color:#94a3b8;" Class="mb-2" />
                                <div style="color:#64748b;">No stock movements found â€” try a different search or filter</div>
                                <MudButton Variant="Variant.Text" Color="Color.Primary" Size="Size.Small" Class="mt-2" OnClick="ResetFilters">Clear filters</MudButton>
                            </td>
                        </tr>
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        @foreach (var m in pagedResultNew.Items)
                        {
                            <tr>
                                <td class="tm-dim">@m.MovementDate.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm")</td>
                                <td><span class="tm-veh"><span class="tm-veh-ico" style="background:@GetIconBg(m.Type)">ðŸ“¦</span>@m.ProductName</span></td>
                                <td class="tm-branch">@m.WarehouseName</td>
                                <td><span class="@GetTypePill(m.Type)"><span class="tm-dot"></span>@m.Type</span></td>
                                <td style="text-align:right">
                                    <span style="font-weight:700; color:@(m.Quantity >= 0 ? "#15803d" : "#dc2626")">
                                        @(m.Quantity > 0 ? "+" : "")@m.Quantity.ToString("0.##")
                                    </span>
                                </td>
                                <td class="tm-num">@(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(m.Reference) ? "-" : m.Reference)</td>
                                <td class="tm-dim">@(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(m.Notes) ? "-" : m.Notes)</td>
                            </tr>
                        }
                    }
                </tbody>
            </table>
        </div>
        <div style="opacity:@(_loading ? "0.55" : "1"); pointer-events:@(_loading ? "none" : "auto");">
            <TmPager CurrentPage="pagedResultNew.CurrentPage"
                     PageSize="pagedResultNew.PageSize"
                     TotalCount="pagedResultNew.TotalCount"
                     TotalPages="pagedResultNew.TotalPages"
                     ItemLabel="Stock Movements"
                     OnGoToPage="GoToPage"
                     OnPrev="GoPrevPage"
                     OnNext="GoNextPage"
                     OnPageSizeChanged="OnPageSizeChanged" />
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

@code {
    private static class Col
    {
        public const string MovementDate = "MovementDate";
        public const string ProductName = "ProductName";
        public const string WarehouseName = "WarehouseName";
        public const string Type = "Type";
        public const string Quantity = "Quantity";
        public const string Reference = "Reference";
    }

    private readonly List<StockMovementType> MovementTypes = Enum.GetValues<StockMovementType>().ToList();

    // â”€â”€â”€ List state â”€â”€â”€
    // Type stays null here; the Stock Transfers grid is this same query pinned to Transfer.
    private PagedResultNew<StockMovementDto> pagedResultNew = new();
    private StockMovementPagedRequest pagedRequest = new()
    {
        SortColumn = Col.MovementDate,
        SortAscending = false
    };

    private List<(Guid Id, string Name)> _warehouses = new();
    private bool _loading = true;
    private bool _hasLoadedOnce;
    private bool _loadRunning;
    private bool _loadQueued;
    private CancellationTokenSource? _debounceCts;

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        try
        {
            var warehouses = await WarehousesService.GetAllWarehousesAsync();
            _warehouses = warehouses
                .OrderBy(w => w.Name)
                .Select(w => (w.Id, w.Name))
                .ToList();
        }
        catch { }

        await Load();
    }

    private async Task Refresh() => await Load();

    /// <summary>
    /// Single-flight loader. The page and the services share one scoped DbContext, so two
    /// overlapping queries would throw "A second operation was started on this context
    /// instance". Callers that arrive mid-flight set a flag instead of starting a parallel
    /// query, and the running load then re-runs once with the newest filter state.
    /// </summary>
    private async Task Load()
    {
        if (_loadRunning)
        {
            _loadQueued = true;
            return;
        }

        _loadRunning = true;
        try
        {
            do
            {
                _loadQueued = false;
                await LoadCore();
            }
            while (_loadQueued);
        }
        finally { _loadRunning = false; }
    }

    private async Task LoadCore()
    {
        _loading = true;
        try
        {
            pagedResultNew = await InventoryService.GetStockMovementsPagedAsync(pagedRequest);
            _hasLoadedOnce = true;
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
        finally { _loading = false; }
    }

    // â”€â”€â”€ Stats / sorting helpers â”€â”€â”€
    private string TotalCountText => Stat("TotalCount");
    private string InCountText => Stat("StockInCount");
    private string OutCountText => Stat("StockOutCount");
    private string TransferCountText => Stat("TransferCount");
    private string AdjustmentCountText => Stat("AdjustmentCount");
    private string NetQuantityText => Stat("NetQuantity");

    private string Stat(string key) =>
        pagedResultNew.Stats != null && pagedResultNew.Stats.TryGetValue(key, out var v) ? v.ToString() : "0";

    private async Task SortBy(string column)
    {
        if (pagedRequest.SortColumn == column)
            pagedRequest.SortAscending = !pagedRequest.SortAscending;
        else
        {
            pagedRequest.SortColumn = column;
            pagedRequest.SortAscending = true;
        }
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await Load();
    }

    private string SortIcon(string column)
    {
        if (pagedRequest.SortColumn != column) return "";
        return pagedRequest.SortAscending ? "â–²" : "â–¼";
    }

    private static string GetTypePill(StockMovementType type) => type switch
    {
        StockMovementType.In => "tm-pill tm-pill-green",
        StockMovementType.Out => "tm-pill tm-pill-red",
        StockMovementType.Transfer => "tm-pill tm-pill-blue",
        StockMovementType.Adjustment => "tm-pill tm-pill-amber",
        StockMovementType.Return => "tm-pill tm-pill-purple",
        _ => "tm-pill tm-pill-blue"
    };

    private static string GetIconBg(StockMovementType type) => type switch
    {
        StockMovementType.In => "#dcfce7",
        StockMovementType.Out => "#fee2e2",
        StockMovementType.Transfer => "#dbeafe",
        StockMovementType.Adjustment => "#fef3c7",
        StockMovementType.Return => "#ede9fe",
        _ => "#e0e9ff"
    };

    // â”€â”€â”€ Filters â”€â”€â”€
    private void OnSearchInput(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        pagedRequest.SearchTerm = e.Value?.ToString() ?? "";
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;

        _debounceCts?.Cancel();
        _debounceCts?.Dispose();
        _debounceCts = new CancellationTokenSource();
        var token = _debounceCts.Token;

        _ = Task.Run(async () =>
        {
            try
            {
                await Task.Delay(400, token);
                if (token.IsCancellationRequested) return;
                await InvokeAsync(async () =>
                {
                    await Load();
                    StateHasChanged();
                });
            }
            catch (OperationCanceledException) { }
        });
    }

    private async Task OnTypeChanged(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        pagedRequest.Type = Enum.TryParse<StockMovementType>(e.Value?.ToString(), out var t) ? t : null;
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await Load();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Stat-tile tabs. Same toggle rule as the other grids: clicking the active
    /// tile clears the filter. Shares <c>pagedRequest.Type</c> with the Type
    /// dropdown so both stay in sync.
    /// </summary>
    private async Task FilterByType(StockMovementType? type)
    {
        pagedRequest.Type = pagedRequest.Type == type ? null : type;
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await Load();
    }

    private async Task OnWarehouseChanged(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        var v = e.Value?.ToString();
        pagedRequest.WarehouseId = string.IsNullOrEmpty(v) || !Guid.TryParse(v, out var g) ? null : g;
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await Load();
    }

    private async Task OnRangeChanged((DateTime? From, DateTime? To) range)
    {
        pagedRequest.From = range.From;
        pagedRequest.To = range.To;
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await Load();
    }

    private async Task ResetFilters()
    {
        pagedRequest.SearchTerm = "";
        pagedRequest.Type = null;
        pagedRequest.WarehouseId = null;
        pagedRequest.From = null;
        pagedRequest.To = null;
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await Load();
    }

    // â”€â”€â”€ Paging (zero-based, matches TmPager) â”€â”€â”€
    private async Task GoToPage(int page)
    {
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = Math.Clamp(page, 0, Math.Max(0, pagedResultNew.TotalPages - 1));
        await Load();
    }

    private async Task GoPrevPage()
    {
        if (pagedRequest.CurrentPage > 0)
        {
            pagedRequest.CurrentPage--;
            await Load();
        }
    }

    private async Task GoNextPage()
    {
        if (pagedRequest.CurrentPage < pagedResultNew.TotalPages - 1)
        {
            pagedRequest.CurrentPage++;
            await Load();
        }
    }

    private async Task OnPageSizeChanged(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        if (int.TryParse(e.Value?.ToString(), out var sz))
        {
            pagedRequest.PageSize = Math.Clamp(sz, 1, 100);
            pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
            await Load();
        }
    }

    public void Dispose()
    {
        _debounceCts?.Cancel();
        _debounceCts?.Dispose();
    }
}

@code {
    [Parameter] public Guid Id { get; set; }
    private StocktakeDto? _stocktake;
    private StocktakeVarianceDto? _variance;
    private List<StocktakeItemDto> _items = new();
    private Dictionary<Guid, int> _countValues = new();

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync() => await Load();

    private async Task Load()
    {
        _stocktake = await StocktakeService.GetStocktakeById(Id);
        _variance = await StocktakeService.GetVarianceReport(Id);
        _items = _variance.Items;
        foreach (var item in _items.Where(i => i.CountedQuantity.HasValue))
            _countValues[item.Id] = item.CountedQuantity!.Value;
    }

    private async Task SaveCount(Guid itemId)
    {
        try
        {
            await StocktakeService.RecordCount(new RecordStocktakeCountDto(itemId, _countValues.GetValueOrDefault(itemId), null));
            Snackbar.Add("Count recorded.", Severity.Success);
            await Load();
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
    }

    private async Task Approve()
    {
        try
        {
            await StocktakeService.ApproveStocktake(Id);
            Snackbar.Add("Stocktake approved. Stock adjusted.", Severity.Success);
            await Load();
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
    }
}

@code {
    private static class Col
    {
        public const string Warehouse = "Warehouse";
        public const string StartDate = "StartDate";
        public const string EndDate = "EndDate";
        public const string Status = "Status";
    }

    private readonly List<StocktakeStatus> StocktakeStatuses = Enum.GetValues<StocktakeStatus>().ToList();

    // â”€â”€â”€ List state â”€â”€â”€
    private PagedResultNew<StocktakeDto> pagedResultNew = new();
    private StocktakePagedRequest pagedRequest = new()
    {
        SortColumn = Col.StartDate,
        SortAscending = false
    };

    private List<WarehouseDto> _warehouses = new();
    private bool _loading = true;
    private bool _hasLoadedOnce;
    private bool _loadRunning;
    private bool _loadQueued;
    private CancellationTokenSource? _debounceCts;

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        try { _warehouses = await WarehousesService.GetAllWarehousesAsync(); }
        catch { }

        await LoadData();
    }

    private async Task Refresh() => await LoadData();

    /// <summary>
    /// Single-flight loader. The page and the services share one scoped DbContext, so two
    /// overlapping queries would throw "A second operation was started on this context
    /// instance". Callers that arrive mid-flight set a flag instead of starting a parallel
    /// query, and the running load then re-runs once with the newest filter state.
    /// </summary>
    private async Task LoadData()
    {
        if (_loadRunning)
        {
            _loadQueued = true;
            return;
        }

        _loadRunning = true;
        try
        {
            do
            {
                _loadQueued = false;
                await LoadDataCore();
            }
            while (_loadQueued);
        }
        finally { _loadRunning = false; }
    }

    private async Task LoadDataCore()
    {
        _loading = true;
        try
        {
            pagedResultNew = await StocktakeService.GetStocktakesPagedAsync(pagedRequest);
            _hasLoadedOnce = true;
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
        finally { _loading = false; }
    }

    // â”€â”€â”€ Stats / sorting helpers â”€â”€â”€
    private string TotalCountText => Stat("TotalCount");
    private string DraftCountText => Stat("DraftCount");
    private string InProgressCountText => Stat("InProgressCount");
    private string PendingApprovalCountText => Stat("PendingApprovalCount");
    private string ApprovedCountText => Stat("ApprovedCount");
    private string CancelledCountText => Stat("CancelledCount");

    private string Stat(string key) =>
        pagedResultNew.Stats != null && pagedResultNew.Stats.TryGetValue(key, out var v) ? v.ToString() : "0";

    private async Task SortBy(string column)
    {
        if (pagedRequest.SortColumn == column)
            pagedRequest.SortAscending = !pagedRequest.SortAscending;
        else
        {
            pagedRequest.SortColumn = column;
            pagedRequest.SortAscending = true;
        }
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await LoadData();
    }

    private string SortIcon(string column)
    {
        if (pagedRequest.SortColumn != column) return "";
        return pagedRequest.SortAscending ? "â–²" : "â–¼";
    }

    private async Task CreateNew()
    {
        var warehouses = await WarehousesService.GetActiveWarehousesAsync();
        var parameters = new DialogParameters<StocktakeCreateDialog> { { x => x.Warehouses, warehouses } };
        var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<StocktakeCreateDialog>("New Stocktake", parameters,
            new DialogOptions { MaxWidth = MaxWidth.Small, FullWidth = true, CloseButton = true });
        var result = await dialog.Result;
        if (result is not null && !result.Canceled) await LoadData();
    }

    private async Task Approve(Guid id)
    {
        try
        {
            await StocktakeService.ApproveStocktake(id);
            Snackbar.Add("Stocktake approved.", Severity.Success);
            await LoadData();
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
    }

    // â”€â”€â”€ Filters â”€â”€â”€
    private void OnSearchInput(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        pagedRequest.SearchTerm = e.Value?.ToString() ?? "";
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;

        _debounceCts?.Cancel();
        _debounceCts?.Dispose();
        _debounceCts = new CancellationTokenSource();
        var token = _debounceCts.Token;

        _ = Task.Run(async () =>
        {
            try
            {
                await Task.Delay(400, token);
                if (token.IsCancellationRequested) return;
                await InvokeAsync(async () =>
                {
                    await LoadData();
                    StateHasChanged();
                });
            }
            catch (OperationCanceledException) { }
        });
    }

    private async Task OnWarehouseChanged(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        pagedRequest.WarehouseId = ParseGuid(e.Value);
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await LoadData();
    }

    private async Task OnStatusChanged(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        pagedRequest.Status = Enum.TryParse<StocktakeStatus>(e.Value?.ToString(), out var s) ? s : null;
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await LoadData();
    }

    private async Task OnRangeChanged((DateTime? From, DateTime? To) range)
    {
        pagedRequest.From = range.From;
        pagedRequest.To = range.To;
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await LoadData();
    }

    private async Task FilterByStatus(StocktakeStatus? status)
    {
        pagedRequest.Status = pagedRequest.Status == status ? null : status;
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await LoadData();
    }

    private async Task ResetFilters()
    {
        pagedRequest.SearchTerm = "";
        pagedRequest.Status = null;
        pagedRequest.WarehouseId = null;
        pagedRequest.From = null;
        pagedRequest.To = null;
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await LoadData();
    }

    private static Guid? ParseGuid(object? value) =>
        Guid.TryParse(value?.ToString(), out var g) && g != Guid.Empty ? g : null;

    // â”€â”€â”€ Paging (zero-based, matches TmPager) â”€â”€â”€
    private async Task GoToPage(int page)
    {
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = Math.Clamp(page, 0, Math.Max(0, pagedResultNew.TotalPages - 1));
        await LoadData();
    }

    private async Task GoPrevPage()
    {
        if (pagedRequest.CurrentPage > 0)
        {
            pagedRequest.CurrentPage--;
            await LoadData();
        }
    }

    private async Task GoNextPage()
    {
        if (pagedRequest.CurrentPage < pagedResultNew.TotalPages - 1)
        {
            pagedRequest.CurrentPage++;
            await LoadData();
        }
    }

    private async Task OnPageSizeChanged(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        if (int.TryParse(e.Value?.ToString(), out var sz))
        {
            pagedRequest.PageSize = Math.Clamp(sz, 1, 100);
            pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
            await LoadData();
        }
    }

    private static string GetStatusPill(StocktakeStatus s) => s switch
    {
        StocktakeStatus.Draft => "tm-pill tm-pill-purple",
        StocktakeStatus.InProgress => "tm-pill tm-pill-amber",
        StocktakeStatus.PendingApproval => "tm-pill tm-pill-blue",
        StocktakeStatus.Approved => "tm-pill tm-pill-green",
        StocktakeStatus.Cancelled => "tm-pill tm-pill-red",
        _ => "tm-pill tm-pill-blue"
    };

    public void Dispose()
    {
        _debounceCts?.Cancel();
        _debounceCts?.Dispose();
    }
}

@inject ISnackbar Snackbar
@inject IInventoryService InventoryService
@code {
    [CascadingParameter] private IMudDialogInstance MudDialog { get; set; } = default!;
    [Parameter] public List<(Guid Id, string Name)> WareHouses { get; set; } = new();        
    [Parameter] public StockTransferDtoModel dataModel { get; set; } = new();

    private List<(Guid Id, string Name, string SKU, Guid WarehouseId, string WarehouseName, int AvailableQuantity)> Products { get; set; } = new();
    private int _editingItemIndex = -1;
    private static readonly ControlItemsDto AddNewOption = new() { Id = Guid.Empty, Name = "Add New", IsSelected = false };
    private MudNumericField<int>? RefQuantity;
    private MudSelect<Guid>? RefTarget;
    private MudSelect<Guid>? RefSource;
    private MudTextField<string>? RefNote;
    private bool _productsLoaded;

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        await EnsureProductsLoaded(WareHouses.Select(w => w.Id));

       // if (dataModel.ItemsLine.Count == 0)
          //  dataModel.ItemsLine.Insert(0, new StockTransferLineDto(Guid.NewGuid(), Guid.Empty, 0));
    }

    private string SourceName(Guid id) =>
        WareHouses.FirstOrDefault(w => w.Id == id).Name ?? "â€”";

    private int AvailableFor(Guid productId, Guid warehouseId) =>
        Products.Where(p => p.Id == productId && p.WarehouseId == warehouseId).Sum(p => p.AvailableQuantity);

    private async Task EnsureProductsLoaded(IEnumerable<Guid> warehouseIds)
    {
        if (_productsLoaded) return;
        _productsLoaded = true;

        var ids = warehouseIds.Where(w => w != Guid.Empty).Distinct().ToList();
        if (ids.Count == 0) return;

        try
        {
            var inventoryTracking = await InventoryService.GetInventoryTrackingByWarehouses(ids, 1, 100000);
            Products = inventoryTracking.Items
                .Select(x => (x.ProductId, x.ProductName, x.ProductSKU, x.WarehouseId, x.WarehouseName, x.AvailableQuantity))
                .ToList();
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _productsLoaded = false;
            Snackbar.Add($"Could not load warehouse stock: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error);
        }
    }

    private async Task OnTargetChanged(Guid value)
    {
        dataModel.TargetWarehouseId = value;
        dataModel.TargetWarehouseText = WareHouses.FirstOrDefault(w => w.Id == value).Name;
        if (RefNote is not null)
            await RefNote.FocusAsync();
    }

    private async Task UpdateControlSelection(ControlDto control, ControlItemsDto? selectedItem)
    {
        if (selectedItem != null)
        {
            control.SelectedItem = selectedItem;
            control.LastSelectedItem = selectedItem;
            control.SelectedText = selectedItem.Name ?? selectedItem.Text1;
            control.SelectedIndex++;
        }
    }

    private Task<IEnumerable<ControlItemsDto>> SearchProducts(string text, CancellationToken _)
    {
        // Only products stocked in the line's warehouse, with available quantity.
        var sourceId = dataModel.ProductObj.SourceWarehouseId;
        if (sourceId == Guid.Empty)
            return Task.FromResult(Enumerable.Empty<ControlItemsDto>());

        var query = Products.Where(c => c.Id != Guid.Empty
            && c.WarehouseId == sourceId
            && c.AvailableQuantity > 0);
        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text))
            query = query.Where(c => (c.Name ?? "").Contains(text, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                || (c.SKU ?? "").Contains(text, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));

        IEnumerable<ControlItemsDto> baseResults = query
            .OrderByDescending(c => c.AvailableQuantity)
            .Select(c => new ControlItemsDto() { Id = c.Id, Name = $"{c.Name} ({c.SKU}) - {c.AvailableQuantity} avail", IsSelected = false });

        return Task.FromResult(baseResults);
    }

    /// <summary>Warehouse picked first in the line: the product list changes, so any picked product is cleared.</summary>
    private void OnEntrySourceChanged(Guid value)
    {
        dataModel.ProductObj.SourceWarehouseId = value;
        dataModel.ProductObj.ProductId = Guid.Empty;
        dataModel.ProductObj.Quantity = 1;
        dataModel.ProductObj.ProductDdlControl.SelectedItem = null;
        dataModel.ProductObj.ProductDdlControl.SelectedText = null;
        dataModel.ProductObj.ProductDdlControl.SelectedIndex++;
    }

    private async Task OnProductChanged()
    {
        var prod = dataModel.ProductObj.ProductDdlControl.SelectedItem;
        if (prod == null || prod.Id == Guid.Empty) return;

        dataModel.ProductObj.ProductId = (Guid)prod.Id;
        if (dataModel.ProductObj.Quantity <= 0)
            dataModel.ProductObj.Quantity = 1;

        await UpdateControlSelection(dataModel.ProductObj.ProductDdlControl, prod);

        if (RefQuantity is not null)
            await RefQuantity.FocusAsync();
    }

    private async Task OnEditProductChanged()
    {
        var prod = dataModel.ProductObj.ProductDdlControl.SelectedItem;
        if (prod == null || prod.Id == Guid.Empty) return;

        dataModel.ProductObj.ProductId = (Guid)prod.Id;
        if (dataModel.ProductObj.Quantity <= 0)
            dataModel.ProductObj.Quantity = 1;

        await UpdateControlSelection(dataModel.ProductObj.ProductDdlControl, prod);

        if (RefQuantity is not null)
            await RefQuantity.FocusAsync();
    }

    private void StartEditItem(int index, StockTransferLineDto item)
    {
        if (dataModel.ItemsLine.Any(x => x.ProductId == Guid.Empty)) return;

        _editingItemIndex = index;
        var product = Products.FirstOrDefault(p => p.Id == item.ProductId);
        dataModel.ProductObj.ProductId = item.ProductId;
        dataModel.ProductObj.SourceWarehouseId = item.SourceWarehouseId;
        dataModel.ProductObj.ProductDdlControl.SelectedItem = product != default
            ? new ControlItemsDto() { Id = product.Id, Name = $"{product.Name} ({product.SKU})", IsSelected = false }
            : new ControlItemsDto() { Id = Guid.Empty, Name = "", IsSelected = false };
        dataModel.ProductObj.Quantity = item.Quantity;
    }

    private void SaveEditItem(int index)
    {
        if (dataModel.ProductObj.ProductId == Guid.Empty || dataModel.ProductObj.Quantity <= 0) return;
        if (!ValidateLineSource(dataModel.ProductObj.SourceWarehouseId, dataModel.ProductObj.ProductId, dataModel.ProductObj.Quantity)) return;

        dataModel.ItemsLine[index] = new StockTransferLineDto(
            dataModel.ItemsLine[index].Id,
            dataModel.ProductObj.ProductId,
            dataModel.ProductObj.Quantity,
            dataModel.ProductObj.SourceWarehouseId);
        _editingItemIndex = -1;
    }

    private void CancelEditItem() => _editingItemIndex = -1;

    private void RemoveEditItem(StockTransferLineDto item)
    {
        // Keep at least the entry row; removing the only blank row re-adds it on next Add.
        dataModel.ItemsLine.Remove(item);
    }

    private async Task AddNewItemForm()
    {
        if (dataModel.ItemsLine.Any(x => x.ProductId == Guid.Empty)) return;

        if (_editingItemIndex < 0)
        {
            dataModel.ProductObj.ProductId = Guid.Empty;
            dataModel.ProductObj.SourceWarehouseId = Guid.Empty;
            dataModel.ProductObj.Quantity = 1;
            dataModel.ProductObj.ProductDdlControl = new ControlDto();
            dataModel.ItemsLine.Insert(0, new StockTransferLineDto(Guid.NewGuid(), Guid.Empty, 0));
        }

        await FocusSelectBox();
    }

    private bool ValidateLineSource(Guid sourceWarehouseId, Guid productId, int quantity)
    {
        if (sourceWarehouseId == Guid.Empty)
        {
            Snackbar.Add("Please select the source warehouse for this line.", Severity.Warning);
            return false;
        }
        if (sourceWarehouseId == dataModel.TargetWarehouseId)
        {
            Snackbar.Add("A line cannot move stock into its own source warehouse.", Severity.Warning);
            return false;
        }
        var avail = AvailableFor(productId, sourceWarehouseId);
        if (quantity > avail)
        {
            Snackbar.Add($"Only {avail} unit(s) available in {SourceName(sourceWarehouseId)}.", Severity.Warning);
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    private async Task AddItem()
    {
        if (dataModel.ProductObj.ProductId == Guid.Empty || dataModel.ProductObj.Quantity <= 0) return;
        if (!ValidateLineSource(dataModel.ProductObj.SourceWarehouseId, dataModel.ProductObj.ProductId, dataModel.ProductObj.Quantity)) return;

        // var placeholder = dataModel.ItemsLine.FirstOrDefault(i => i.ProductId == Guid.Empty);
        // if (placeholder is not null)
        //     dataModel.ItemsLine.Remove(placeholder);

        dataModel.ItemsLine.Insert(dataModel.ItemsLine.Count,new StockTransferLineDto(Guid.NewGuid(), dataModel.ProductObj.ProductId, dataModel.ProductObj.Quantity, dataModel.ProductObj.SourceWarehouseId));

        dataModel.ProductObj.ProductId = Guid.Empty;
        dataModel.ProductObj.SourceWarehouseId = Guid.Empty;
        dataModel.ProductObj.Quantity = 1;

        await FocusSelectBox();
    }

    private async Task FocusSelectBox()
    {
        await Task.Delay(100);
        if (RefSource is not null)
        {
            await RefSource.ResetAsync();
            await RefSource.FocusAsync();
        }
    }

    private void Cancel() => MudDialog.Cancel();

    private void Submit()
    {
        if (dataModel.TargetWarehouseId == Guid.Empty)
        {
            Snackbar.Add("Please select the destination warehouse.", Severity.Warning);
            return;
        }
        var lines = dataModel.ItemsLine.Where(i => i.ProductId != Guid.Empty && i.Quantity > 0).ToList();
        if (lines.Count == 0)
        {
            Snackbar.Add("Please add at least one item line.", Severity.Warning);
            return;
        }
        if (lines.Any(i => i.SourceWarehouseId == Guid.Empty))
        {
            Snackbar.Add("Each line needs a source warehouse.", Severity.Warning);
            return;
        }
        if (lines.Any(i => i.SourceWarehouseId == dataModel.TargetWarehouseId))
        {
            Snackbar.Add("A line cannot move stock into its own source warehouse.", Severity.Warning);
            return;
        }

        // One batch per source warehouse, all into the single destination.        

        MudDialog.Close(DialogResult.Ok(dataModel));
    }
}

@code {
    private static class Col
    {
        public const string TransferDate = "TransferDate";
        public const string TransferNumber = "TransferNumber";
        public const string SourceWarehouse = "SourceWarehouse";
        public const string TargetWarehouse = "TargetWarehouse";
        public const string TotalQuantity = "TotalQuantity";
    }

    // â”€â”€â”€ List state â”€â”€â”€
    // The grid lists StockTransfer batches (one row per transfer, expandable lines).
    private PagedResultNew<StockTransferListDto> pagedResultNew = new();
    private StockTransferPagedRequest pagedRequest = new()
    {
        SortColumn = Col.TransferDate,
        SortAscending = false
    };

    private StockTransferViewPanel? _viewPanel;

    private List<(Guid Id, string Name)> _warehouses = new();
    private bool _loading = true;
    private bool _hasLoadedOnce;
    private bool _loadRunning;
    private bool _loadQueued;
    private CancellationTokenSource? _debounceCts;

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {  
        try
        {
            var warehouses = await WarehousesService.GetAllWarehousesAsync();
            _warehouses = warehouses
                .OrderBy(w => w.Name)
                .Select(w => (w.Id, w.Name))
                .ToList();
        }
        catch { }

        await Load();
    }

    private async Task Refresh() => await Load();

    /// <summary>
    /// Single-flight loader. The page and the services share one scoped DbContext, so two
    /// overlapping queries would throw "A second operation was started on this context
    /// instance". Callers that arrive mid-flight set a flag instead of starting a parallel
    /// query, and the running load then re-runs once with the newest filter state.
    /// </summary>
    private async Task Load()
    {
        if (_loadRunning)
        {
            _loadQueued = true;
            return;
        }

        _loadRunning = true;
        try
        {
            do
            {
                _loadQueued = false;
                await LoadCore();
            }
            while (_loadQueued);
        }
        finally { _loadRunning = false; }
    }

    private async Task LoadCore()
    {
        _loading = true;
        try
        {
            pagedResultNew = await InventoryService.GetStockTransfersPagedAsync(pagedRequest);
            _hasLoadedOnce = true;
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
        finally { _loading = false; }
    }

    // â”€â”€â”€ Stats / sorting helpers â”€â”€â”€
    private string TotalCountText => Stat("TotalCount");
    private string TotalLinesText => Stat("TotalLines");
    private string TotalUnitsText => Stat("TotalUnits");
    private string WarehouseCountText => Stat("WarehouseCount");
    private string CompletedCountText => Stat("CompletedCount");

    // The newest transfer on the current page â€” the grid is date-sorted, so it is the first row.
    private string LastTransferText =>
        pagedResultNew.Items.Count > 0 ? pagedResultNew.Items[0].TransferDate.ToString("dd MMM") : "-";

    private string Stat(string key) =>
        pagedResultNew.Stats != null && pagedResultNew.Stats.TryGetValue(key, out var v) ? v.ToString() : "0";

    private async Task SortBy(string column)
    {
        if (pagedRequest.SortColumn == column)
            pagedRequest.SortAscending = !pagedRequest.SortAscending;
        else
        {
            pagedRequest.SortColumn = column;
            pagedRequest.SortAscending = true;
        }
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await Load();
    }

    private string SortIcon(string column)
    {
        if (pagedRequest.SortColumn != column) return "";
        return pagedRequest.SortAscending ? "â–²" : "â–¼";
    }

    private static string StatusPill(StockTransferStatus status) => status switch
    {
        StockTransferStatus.Completed => "tm-pill-green",
        StockTransferStatus.Cancelled => "tm-pill-red",
        _ => "tm-pill-blue"
    };

    private async Task OpenTransferDialog(StockTransferListDto? existing = null)
    {
        StockTransferDtoModel model;
        string title;
        if (existing is null)
        {
            model = new StockTransferDtoModel();
            title = "New Stock Transfer";
        }
        else
        {
            model = new StockTransferDtoModel
            {
                TransferDate = existing.TransferDate,
                TargetWarehouseId = existing.TargetWarehouseId,
                Notes = existing.Notes,
                ItemsLine = existing.Items
                    .Select(i => new StockTransferLineDto(Guid.NewGuid(), i.ProductId, i.Quantity, existing.SourceWarehouseId))
                    .ToList()
            };
            // Blank entry row on top so more lines can be added immediately.
            model.ItemsLine.Insert(0, new StockTransferLineDto(Guid.NewGuid(), Guid.Empty, 0));
            title = $"Edit Transfer {existing.TransferNumber}";
        }

        var parameters = new DialogParameters<StockTransferDialog>
        {
            { x => x.WareHouses, _warehouses },
            { x => x.dataModel, model }
        };

        var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<StockTransferDialog>(title, parameters,
            new DialogOptions { MaxWidth = MaxWidth.Large, FullWidth = true, CloseButton = true });
        var result = await dialog.Result;

        if (result is not null && !result.Canceled && result.Data is StockTransferDtoModel dataModel)
        {
            try
            {
                if (dataModel.Id != Guid.Empty)
                {
                    // Same single source: update in place, keeps the transfer number.
                    //var transferNumber = await InventoryService.UpdateStockTransferAsync(existing.Id, batches[0]);
                   // Snackbar.Add($"Transfer {transferNumber} saved ({batches[0].Items.Count} line(s)).", Severity.Success);
                }
                else
                {
                    // Sources changed: reverse the old transfer, then post one batch per source.
                    if (existing is not null)
                        await InventoryService.CancelStockTransferAsync(existing.Id);
                    var numbers = new List<string>();
                    //foreach (var batch in batches)
                        numbers.Add(await InventoryService.CreateStockTransferAsync(dataModel));
                    Snackbar.Add($"Transfer(s) {string.Join(", ", numbers)} completed.", Severity.Success);
                }
                await Load();
            }
            catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
        }
    }

    private static Guid ParseGuid(object? v) =>
        Guid.TryParse(v?.ToString(), out var g) ? g : Guid.Empty;

    // â”€â”€â”€ Filters â”€â”€â”€
    private void OnSearchInput(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        pagedRequest.SearchTerm = e.Value?.ToString() ?? "";
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;

        _debounceCts?.Cancel();
        _debounceCts?.Dispose();
        _debounceCts = new CancellationTokenSource();
        var token = _debounceCts.Token;

        _ = Task.Run(async () =>
        {
            try
            {
                await Task.Delay(400, token);
                if (token.IsCancellationRequested) return;
                await InvokeAsync(async () =>
                {
                    await Load();
                    StateHasChanged();
                });
            }
            catch (OperationCanceledException) { }
        });
    }

    private async Task OnWarehouseChanged(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        var v = e.Value?.ToString();
        pagedRequest.WarehouseId = string.IsNullOrEmpty(v) ? null : ParseGuid(v);
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await Load();
    }

    private async Task OnRangeChanged((DateTime? From, DateTime? To) range)
    {
        pagedRequest.From = range.From;
        pagedRequest.To = range.To;
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await Load();
    }

    private async Task ResetFilters()
    {
        pagedRequest.SearchTerm = "";
        pagedRequest.WarehouseId = null;
        pagedRequest.Status = null;
        pagedRequest.From = null;
        pagedRequest.To = null;
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await Load();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// "Completed" tile: toggles the completed-only view.
    /// </summary>
    private async Task FilterCompleted()
    {
        pagedRequest.Status = pagedRequest.Status == StockTransferStatus.Completed ? null : StockTransferStatus.Completed;
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await Load();
    }

    private async Task OnStatusChanged(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        var v = e.Value?.ToString();
        pagedRequest.Status = Enum.TryParse<StockTransferStatus>(v, out var s) ? s : null;
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await Load();
    }

    // â”€â”€â”€ Paging (zero-based, matches TmPager) â”€â”€â”€
    private async Task GoToPage(int page)
    {
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = Math.Clamp(page, 0, Math.Max(0, pagedResultNew.TotalPages - 1));
        await Load();
    }

    private async Task GoPrevPage()
    {
        if (pagedRequest.CurrentPage > 0)
        {
            pagedRequest.CurrentPage--;
            await Load();
        }
    }

    private async Task GoNextPage()
    {
        if (pagedRequest.CurrentPage < pagedResultNew.TotalPages - 1)
        {
            pagedRequest.CurrentPage++;
            await Load();
        }
    }

    private async Task OnPageSizeChanged(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        if (int.TryParse(e.Value?.ToString(), out var sz))
        {
            pagedRequest.PageSize = Math.Clamp(sz, 1, 100);
            pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
            await Load();
        }
    }

    public void Dispose()
    {
        _debounceCts?.Cancel();
        _debounceCts?.Dispose();
    }
}

@code {
    [Parameter] public EventCallback OnTransferUpdated { get; set; }

    private bool _open;
    private bool _animateIn;
    private bool _loading;
    private StockTransferListDto? _transfer;
    private List<StockTransferItemDto> _items = new();

    private TableGroupDefinition<StockTransferItemDto> _groupDefinition = new()
    {
        GroupName = "Warehouse",
        Indentation = false,
        Expandable = true,
        IsInitiallyExpanded = true,
        Selector = (e) => e.SourceWarehouseName
    };

    /// <summary>Flattens lines for the grouped table (missing warehouse falls back to the header source).</summary>
    private void BuildItems()
    {
        var fallback = _transfer?.SourceWarehouseName ?? string.Empty;
        _items = (_transfer?.Items ?? new List<StockTransferItemDto>())
            .Select(i => string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(i.SourceWarehouseName) ? i with { SourceWarehouseName = fallback } : i)
            .OrderBy(i => i.SourceWarehouseName)
            .ThenBy(i => i.ProductName)
            .ToList();
    }

    public async Task OpenAsync(Guid id)
    {
        _open = true;
        _loading = true;
        _animateIn = false;
        _transfer = null;
        StateHasChanged();

        // Small delay so the panel renders before the slide-in class is added
        await Task.Delay(20);
        _animateIn = true;
        StateHasChanged();

        try
        {
            _transfer = await InventoryService.GetStockTransferByIdAsync(id);
            BuildItems();
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error);
        }

        _loading = false;
        StateHasChanged();
    }

    public void Close()
    {
        _open = false;
        _animateIn = false;
        _transfer = null;
        _items = new();
        StateHasChanged();
    }

    private async Task OpenEdit()
    {
        if (_transfer == null || _transfer.Status == StockTransferStatus.Cancelled) return;

        // var warehouses = await WarehousesService.GetAllWarehousesAsync();

        // var editModel = new StockTransferDtoModel
        // {

        //         .ToList()
        // };
        // // Blank entry row on top so more lines can be added immediately.

    <div class="tm-stats">

@code {
    private static class Col
    {
        public const string Name = "Name";
        public const string Code = "Code";
        public const string Location = "Location";
        public const string Address = "Address";
        public const string IsActive = "IsActive";
    }

    // â”€â”€â”€ List state â”€â”€â”€
    private PagedResultNew<BranchDto> pagedResultNew = new();
    private BranchPagedRequest pagedRequest = new()
    {
        SortColumn = Col.Name,
        SortAscending = true
    };

    private BranchDto _branchTemplate = new BranchDto(Guid.Empty, "", "", null, null, true);
    private bool _loading = true;
    private bool _hasLoadedOnce;
    private bool _loadRunning;
    private bool _loadQueued;
    private CancellationTokenSource? _debounceCts;

    private string StatusValue => pagedRequest.IsActive switch
    {
        true => "active",
        false => "inactive",
        _ => ""
    };

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync() => await LoadBranches();

    private async Task Refresh() => await LoadBranches();

    /// <summary>
    /// Single-flight loader. The page and the services share one scoped DbContext, so two
    /// overlapping queries would throw "A second operation was started on this context
    /// instance". Callers that arrive mid-flight set a flag instead of starting a parallel
    /// query, and the running load then re-runs once with the newest filter state.
    /// </summary>
    private async Task LoadBranches()
    {
        if (_loadRunning)
        {
            _loadQueued = true;
            return;
        }

        _loadRunning = true;
        try
        {
            do
            {
                _loadQueued = false;
                await LoadBranchesCore();
            }
            while (_loadQueued);
        }
        finally { _loadRunning = false; }
    }

    private async Task LoadBranchesCore()
    {
        _loading = true;
        try
        {
            pagedResultNew = await BranchService.GetBranchesPagedAsync(pagedRequest);
            _hasLoadedOnce = true;
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
        finally { _loading = false; }
    }

    // â”€â”€â”€ Stats / sorting helpers â”€â”€â”€
    private string TotalCountText => Stat("TotalCount");
    private string ActiveCountText => Stat("ActiveCount");
    private string InactiveCountText => Stat("InactiveCount");
    private string WithLocationCountText => Stat("WithLocationCount");
    private string UniqueCodeCountText => Stat("UniqueCodeCount");

    private string Stat(string key) =>
        pagedResultNew.Stats != null && pagedResultNew.Stats.TryGetValue(key, out var v) ? v.ToString() : "0";

    private void SortBy(string column)
    {
        if (pagedRequest.SortColumn == column)
            pagedRequest.SortAscending = !pagedRequest.SortAscending;
        else
        {
            pagedRequest.SortColumn = column;
            pagedRequest.SortAscending = true;
        }
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
    }

    private string SortIcon(string column)
    {
        if (pagedRequest.SortColumn != column) return "";
        return pagedRequest.SortAscending ? "â–²" : "â–¼";
    }


    private async Task OpenCreate()
    {
        var parameters = new DialogParameters<BrancheDialog>
        {
            { x => x.Branch, _branchTemplate }
        };

        var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<BrancheDialog>("New Branch", parameters,
            new DialogOptions { MaxWidth = MaxWidth.Medium, FullWidth = false, CloseButton = true });
        var result = await dialog.Result;

        if (result != null && !result.Canceled && result.Data is CreateBranchDto dto)
        {
            try
            {
                await BranchService.CreateBranch(dto);
                Snackbar.Add("Branch created successfully", Severity.Success);
                await LoadBranches();
            }
            catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
        }
    }

    private async Task OpenEdit(BranchDto item)
    {
        var entity = await BranchService.GetBranchById(item.Id);
        if (entity == null) return;

        var dto = new BranchDto(entity.Id, entity.Name, entity.Code, entity.Location, entity.Address, entity.IsActive);

        var parameters = new DialogParameters<BrancheDialog> { { x => x.Branch, dto } };
        var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<BrancheDialog>("Edit Branch", parameters,
            new DialogOptions { MaxWidth = MaxWidth.Medium, FullWidth = true, CloseButton = true });
        var result = await dialog.Result;
        if (result != null && !result.Canceled && result.Data is CreateBranchDto updated)
        {
            await BranchService.UpdateBranch(entity.Id, updated);
            Snackbar.Add("Branch updated", Severity.Success);
            await LoadBranches();
        }
    }

    private async Task Delete(Guid id)
    {
        var confirm = await DialogService.ShowMessageBoxAsync("Confirm", "Delete this branch?", "Delete", "Cancel");
        if (confirm == true)
        {
            var entity = await BranchService.GetBranchById(id);
            if (entity != null) { await BranchService.DeleteBranch(id); await LoadBranches(); }
        }
    }

    // â”€â”€â”€ Filters â”€â”€â”€
    private void OnSearchInput(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        pagedRequest.SearchTerm = e.Value?.ToString() ?? "";
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;

        _debounceCts?.Cancel();
        _debounceCts?.Dispose();
        _debounceCts = new CancellationTokenSource();
        var token = _debounceCts.Token;

        _ = Task.Run(async () =>
        {
            try
            {
                await Task.Delay(400, token);
                if (token.IsCancellationRequested) return;
                await InvokeAsync(async () =>
                {
                    await LoadBranches();
                    StateHasChanged();
                });
            }
            catch (OperationCanceledException) { }
        });
    }

    private async Task OnStatusChanged(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        pagedRequest.IsActive = e.Value?.ToString() switch
        {
            "active" => true,
            "inactive" => false,
            _ => null
        };
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await LoadBranches();
    }

    private async Task FilterByStatus(bool? isActive)
    {
        pagedRequest.IsActive = pagedRequest.IsActive == isActive ? null : isActive;
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await LoadBranches();
    }

    private async Task ResetFilters()
    {
        pagedRequest.SearchTerm = "";
        pagedRequest.IsActive = null;
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await LoadBranches();
    }

    // â”€â”€â”€ Paging (zero-based, matches TmPager) â”€â”€â”€
    private async Task GoToPage(int page)
    {
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = Math.Clamp(page, 0, Math.Max(0, pagedResultNew.TotalPages - 1));
        await LoadBranches();
    }

    private async Task GoPrevPage()
    {
        if (pagedRequest.CurrentPage > 0)
        {
            pagedRequest.CurrentPage--;
            await LoadBranches();
        }
    }

    private async Task GoNextPage()
    {
        if (pagedRequest.CurrentPage < pagedResultNew.TotalPages - 1)
        {
            pagedRequest.CurrentPage++;
            await LoadBranches();
        }
    }

    private async Task OnPageSizeChanged(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        if (int.TryParse(e.Value?.ToString(), out var sz))
        {
            pagedRequest.PageSize = Math.Clamp(sz, 1, 100);
            pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
            await LoadBranches();
        }
    }

    public void Dispose()
    {
        _debounceCts?.Cancel();
        _debounceCts?.Dispose();
    }
}

            <MudTextField @bind-Value="_code" Label="Code" Required="true" RequiredError="" Class="mt-3" ShrinkLabel="true" Variant="Variant.Outlined" Margin="Margin.Dense" />

                     OnPrev="GoPrevPage"
                     OnNext="GoNextPage"
                     OnPageSizeChanged="OnPageSizeChanged" />
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

@code {
    private static class Col
    {
        public const string Name = "Name";
        public const string Code = "Code";
        public const string Location = "Location";
        public const string Address = "Address";
        public const string IsActive = "IsActive";
    }

    // â”€â”€â”€ List state â”€â”€â”€
    private PagedResultNew<WarehouseDto> pagedResultNew = new();
    private WarehousePagedRequest pagedRequest = new()
    {
        SortColumn = Col.Name,
        SortAscending = true
    };

    private bool _loading = true;
    private bool _hasLoadedOnce;
    private bool _loadRunning;
    private bool _loadQueued;
    private CancellationTokenSource? _debounceCts;

    private string StatusValue => pagedRequest.IsActive switch
    {
        true => "active",
        false => "inactive",
        _ => ""
    };

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync() => await LoadData();

    private async Task Refresh() => await LoadData();

    /// <summary>
    /// Single-flight loader. The page and the services share one scoped DbContext, so two
    /// overlapping queries would throw "A second operation was started on this context
    /// instance". Callers that arrive mid-flight set a flag instead of starting a parallel
    /// query, and the running load then re-runs once with the newest filter state.
    /// </summary>
    private async Task LoadData()
    {
        if (_loadRunning)
        {
            _loadQueued = true;
            return;
        }

        _loadRunning = true;
        try
        {
            do
            {
                _loadQueued = false;
                await LoadDataCore();
            }
            while (_loadQueued);
        }
        finally { _loadRunning = false; }
    }

    private async Task LoadDataCore()
    {
        _loading = true;
        try
        {
            pagedResultNew = await WarehousesService.GetWarehousesPagedAsync(pagedRequest);
            _hasLoadedOnce = true;
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
        finally { _loading = false; }
    }

    // â”€â”€â”€ Stats / sorting helpers â”€â”€â”€
    private string TotalCountText => Stat("TotalCount");
    private string ActiveCountText => Stat("ActiveCount");
    private string InactiveCountText => Stat("InactiveCount");
    private string WithLocationCountText => Stat("WithLocationCount");
    private string UniqueCodeCountText => Stat("UniqueCodeCount");

    private string Stat(string key) =>
        pagedResultNew.Stats != null && pagedResultNew.Stats.TryGetValue(key, out var v) ? v.ToString() : "0";

    private void SortBy(string column)
    {
        if (pagedRequest.SortColumn == column)
            pagedRequest.SortAscending = !pagedRequest.SortAscending;
        else
        {
            pagedRequest.SortColumn = column;
            pagedRequest.SortAscending = true;
        }
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
    }

    private string SortIcon(string column)
    {
        if (pagedRequest.SortColumn != column) return "";
        return pagedRequest.SortAscending ? "â–²" : "â–¼";
    }

    private async Task OpenCreate()
    {
        var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<WarehouseDialog>("New Warehouse",
            new DialogOptions { MaxWidth = MaxWidth.Small, FullWidth = true, CloseButton = true });
        var result = await dialog.Result;
        if (result != null && !result.Canceled && result.Data is CreateWarehouseDto dto)
        {
            await WarehousesService.CreateWarehouseAsync(dto);
            Snackbar.Add("Warehouse created", Severity.Success);
            await LoadData();
        }
    }

    private async Task OpenEdit(WarehouseDto item)
    {
        var parameters = new DialogParameters<WarehouseDialog> { { x => x.Warehouse, item } };
        var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<WarehouseDialog>("Edit Warehouse", parameters,
            new DialogOptions { MaxWidth = MaxWidth.Small, FullWidth = true, CloseButton = true });
        var result = await dialog.Result;
        if (result != null && !result.Canceled && result.Data is CreateWarehouseDto dto)
        {
            await WarehousesService.UpdateWarehouseAsync(item.Id, dto);
            Snackbar.Add("Warehouse updated", Severity.Success);
            await LoadData();
        }
    }

    private async Task DeleteWarehouse(WarehouseDto item)
    {
        var confirm = await DialogService.ShowMessageBoxAsync("Confirm Delete",
            $"Are you sure you want to delete warehouse '{item.Name}'?", "Delete", "Cancel");
        if (confirm == true)
        {
            try
            {
                await WarehousesService.DeleteWarehouseAsync(item.Id);
                Snackbar.Add("Warehouse deleted", Severity.Success);
                await LoadData();
            }
            catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
        }
    }

    // â”€â”€â”€ Filters â”€â”€â”€
    private void OnSearchInput(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        pagedRequest.SearchTerm = e.Value?.ToString() ?? "";
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;

        _debounceCts?.Cancel();
        _debounceCts?.Dispose();
        _debounceCts = new CancellationTokenSource();
        var token = _debounceCts.Token;

        _ = Task.Run(async () =>
        {
            try
            {
                await Task.Delay(400, token);
                if (token.IsCancellationRequested) return;
                await InvokeAsync(async () =>
                {
                    await LoadData();
                    StateHasChanged();
                });
            }
            catch (OperationCanceledException) { }
        });
    }

    private async Task OnStatusChanged(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        pagedRequest.IsActive = e.Value?.ToString() switch
        {
            "active" => true,
            "inactive" => false,
            _ => null
        };
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await LoadData();
    }

    private async Task FilterByStatus(bool? isActive)
    {
        pagedRequest.IsActive = pagedRequest.IsActive == isActive ? null : isActive;
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await LoadData();
    }

    private async Task ResetFilters()
    {
        pagedRequest.SearchTerm = "";
        pagedRequest.IsActive = null;
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await LoadData();
    }

    // â”€â”€â”€ Paging (zero-based, matches TmPager) â”€â”€â”€
    private async Task GoToPage(int page)
    {
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = Math.Clamp(page, 0, Math.Max(0, pagedResultNew.TotalPages - 1));
        await LoadData();
    }

    private async Task GoPrevPage()
    {
        if (pagedRequest.CurrentPage > 0)
        {
            pagedRequest.CurrentPage--;
            await LoadData();
        }
    }

    private async Task GoNextPage()
    {
        if (pagedRequest.CurrentPage < pagedResultNew.TotalPages - 1)
        {
            pagedRequest.CurrentPage++;
            await LoadData();
        }
    }

    private async Task OnPageSizeChanged(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        if (int.TryParse(e.Value?.ToString(), out var sz))
        {
            pagedRequest.PageSize = Math.Clamp(sz, 1, 100);
            pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
            await LoadData();
        }
    }

    public void Dispose()
    {
        _debounceCts?.Cancel();
        _debounceCts?.Dispose();
    }
}

    <div class="doc-page"><div class="doc-empty">Loading documentâ€¦</div></div>
