@code {
    [Parameter] public string DocumentType { get; set; } = "";
    [Parameter] public Guid Id { get; set; }
    [SupplyParameterFromQuery(Name = "action")] public string? Action { get; set; }

    [Inject] private ISalesServices OrderService { get; set; } = default!;
    [Inject] private IPurchaseService PurchaseService { get; set; } = default!;
    [Inject] private IQuotationService QuotationService { get; set; } = default!;
    [Inject] private ISalesReturnService SalesReturnService { get; set; } = default!;
    [Inject] private IPurchaseReturnService PurchaseReturnService { get; set; } = default!;
    [Inject] private IInvoiceService InvoiceService { get; set; } = default!;
    [Inject] private IProductService ProductService { get; set; } = default!;
    [Inject] private IJSRuntime JS { get; set; } = default!;
    [Inject] private IServiceProvider Services { get; set; } = default!;
    [Inject] private ILoggerFactory LoggerFactory { get; set; } = default!;

    private bool _loading = true;
    private bool _autoHandled;
    private string? _error;

    private SalesOrderDto? _salesOrder;
    private PurchaseOrderDto? _purchaseOrder;
    private SalesQuoteDto? _quote;
    private SalesReturnDto? _salesReturn;
    private PurchaseReturnDto? _purchaseReturn;
    private InvoiceDetailDto? _invoiceDetail;
    private ProductDetailViewDto? _product;

    private string Kind => DocumentType.Trim().ToLowerInvariant();

    private string DocTitle => Kind switch
    {
        "sales-order" => "Sales Order",
        "purchase-order" => "Purchase Order",
        "quotation" => "Sales Quotation",
        "sales-return" => "Sales Return",
        "purchase-return" => "Purchase Return",
        "invoice" => "Invoice",
        "product" => "Product Details",
        _ => "Document"
    };

    private string DocRef => Kind switch
    {
        "sales-order" => _salesOrder?.OrderNumber ?? "â€”",
        "purchase-order" => _purchaseOrder?.OrderNumber ?? "â€”",
        "quotation" => _quote?.QuoteNumber ?? "â€”",
        "sales-return" => _salesReturn?.ReturnNumber ?? "â€”",
        "purchase-return" => _purchaseReturn?.ReturnNumber ?? "â€”",
        "invoice" => _invoiceDetail?.Invoice.InvoiceNumber ?? "â€”",
        "product" => _product?.SKU ?? "â€”",
        _ => "â€”"
    };

    private string StatusText => Kind switch
    {
        "sales-order" => _salesOrder?.Status.ToString() ?? "",
        "purchase-order" => _purchaseOrder?.Status.ToString() ?? "",
        "quotation" => _quote?.Status.ToString() ?? "",
        "sales-return" => _salesReturn?.Status.ToString() ?? "",
        "purchase-return" => _purchaseReturn?.Status.ToString() ?? "",
        "invoice" => _invoiceDetail?.Invoice.Status.ToString() ?? "",
        _ => ""
    };

    protected override async Task OnParametersSetAsync()
    {
        _loading = true;
        _error = null;
        _salesOrder = null;
        _purchaseOrder = null;
        _quote = null;
        _salesReturn = null;
        _purchaseReturn = null;
        _invoiceDetail = null;
        _product = null;

        try
        {
            switch (Kind)
            {
                case "sales-order":
                    _salesOrder = await OrderService.GetSalesOrderById(Id);
                    if (_salesOrder is null) _error = "Sales order not found.";
                    break;
                case "purchase-order":
                    _purchaseOrder = await PurchaseService.GetPurchaseOrderById(Id);
                    if (_purchaseOrder is null) _error = "Purchase order not found.";
                    break;
                case "quotation":
                    _quote = await QuotationService.GetSalesQuoteById(Id);
                    if (_quote is null) _error = "Quotation not found.";
                    break;
                case "sales-return":
                    _salesReturn = await SalesReturnService.GetSalesReturnById(Id);
                    if (_salesReturn is null) _error = "Sales return not found.";
                    break;
                case "purchase-return":
                    _purchaseReturn = await PurchaseReturnService.GetPurchaseReturnById(Id);
                    if (_purchaseReturn is null) _error = "Purchase return not found.";
                    break;
                case "invoice":
                    _invoiceDetail = await InvoiceService.GetInvoiceDetailAsync(Id);
                    if (_invoiceDetail is null) _error = "Invoice not found.";
                    break;
                case "product":
                    _product = await ProductService.GetProductDetailViewAsync(Id);
                    if (_product is null) _error = "Product not found.";
                    break;
                default:
                    _error = $"Unknown document type '{DocumentType}'.";
                    break;
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _error = $"Unable to load document: {ex.Message}";
        }

        _loading = false;
    }

    protected override async Task OnAfterRenderAsync(bool firstRender)
    {
        if (_autoHandled || _loading || _error is not null || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(Action)) return;
        _autoHandled = true;

        await Task.Delay(300);

        if (string.Equals(Action, "print", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
        {
            await PrintNow();
        }
        else if (string.Equals(Action, "pdf", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
        {
            await DownloadPdf();
        }
    }

    private async Task PrintNow() => await JS.InvokeVoidAsync("print");

    private async Task DownloadPdf()
    {
        var name = DocTitle + " " + (DocRef == "â€”" ? "" : DocRef);
        name = new string(name.Where(c => char.IsLetterOrDigit(c) || c == '-' || c == '_' || c == ' ').ToArray()).Trim();
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(name)) name = "document";

        try
        {
            var html = await RenderDocumentHtmlAsync();
            await JS.InvokeVoidAsync("downloadFile", html, name + ".pdf", DocTitle, DocRef == "â€”" ? "" : DocRef);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            await JS.InvokeVoidAsync("alert", "Could not generate the PDF: " + ex.Message);
        }
    }

    private async Task<string> RenderDocumentHtmlAsync()
    {
        await using var renderer = new HtmlRenderer(Services, LoggerFactory);

        var parameters = ParameterView.FromDictionary(new Dictionary<string, object?>
        {
            [nameof(PrintDocumentBody.DocTitle)] = DocTitle,
            [nameof(PrintDocumentBody.DocRef)] = DocRef,
            [nameof(PrintDocumentBody.StatusText)] = StatusText,
            [nameof(PrintDocumentBody.SalesOrder)] = _salesOrder,
            [nameof(PrintDocumentBody.PurchaseOrder)] = _purchaseOrder,
            [nameof(PrintDocumentBody.Quote)] = _quote,
            [nameof(PrintDocumentBody.SalesReturn)] = _salesReturn,
            [nameof(PrintDocumentBody.PurchaseReturn)] = _purchaseReturn,
            [nameof(PrintDocumentBody.InvoiceDetail)] = _invoiceDetail,
            [nameof(PrintDocumentBody.Product)] = _product
        });

        return await renderer.Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(async () =>
        {
            var output = await renderer.RenderComponentAsync<PrintDocumentBody>(parameters);
            return output.ToHtmlString();
        });
    }
}

    [CascadingParameter] private IMudDialogInstance MudDialog { get; set; } = default!;

    private string? _brandCode;
    private string? _description;
    private string? _logoUrl;
    private string _status = "Active";
    private string? _originCompany;
    private string? _originCountry;
    private int? _foundedYear;

    protected override void OnInitialized()
    {
        if (Brand != null)
        {
            _name = Brand.Name;
            _brandCode = Brand.BrandCode;
            _description = Brand.Description;
            _logoUrl = Brand.LogoUrl;
            _status = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(Brand.Status) ? "Active" : Brand.Status;
            _originCompany = Brand.OriginCompany;
            _originCountry = Brand.OriginCountry;
            _foundedYear = Brand.FoundedYear;
        }
    }

    private void Cancel() => MudDialog.Cancel();

    private async Task Submit()
    {   
        await _form.ValidateAsync();
        
        if (!_form.IsValid)
            return;     

        //MudDialog.Close(DialogResult.Ok(new CreateCategoryDto(trimmedName, _description, _parentId)));
        MudDialog.Close(DialogResult.Ok(new CreateBrandDto
        {
            Name = _name,
            BrandCode = _brandCode,
            Description = _description,
            LogoUrl = _logoUrl,
            Status = _status,
            OriginCompany = _originCompany,
            OriginCountry = _originCountry,
            FoundedYear = _foundedYear

        }));
    
    }

@code {
    private static class Col
    {
        public const string Name = "Name";
        public const string BrandCode = "BrandCode";
        public const string Status = "Status";
        public const string OriginCompany = "OriginCompany";
        public const string OriginCountry = "OriginCountry";
        public const string FoundedYear = "FoundedYear";
        public const string Description = "Description";
        public const string ProductCount = "ProductCount";
    }

    // â”€â”€â”€ List state â”€â”€â”€
    private PagedResultNew<BrandDto> pagedResultNew = new();
    private BrandPagedRequest pagedRequest = new()
    {
        SortColumn = Col.Name,
        SortAscending = true
    };

    private List<string> _companies = new();
    private bool _loading = true;
    private bool _hasLoadedOnce;
    private bool _loadRunning;
    private bool _loadQueued;
    private CancellationTokenSource? _debounceCts;

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        // The country dropdown lists every known origin, so it is fetched from the full
        // reference list once rather than from the current (filtered) page of the grid.
        try
        {
            var all = await BrandService.GetAllBrandsAsync();
             _companies = all
                 .Select(b => b.OriginCompany)
                 .Where(c => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(c))
                 .Select(c => c!)
                 .Distinct()
                 .OrderBy(c => c)
                 .ToList();
        }
        catch { }

        await LoadBrands();
    }

    private async Task Refresh() => await LoadBrands();

    /// <summary>
    /// Single-flight loader. The page and the services share one scoped DbContext, so two
    /// overlapping queries would throw "A second operation was started on this context
    /// instance". Callers that arrive mid-flight set a flag instead of starting a parallel
    /// query, and the running load then re-runs once with the newest filter state.
    /// </summary>
    private async Task LoadBrands()
    {
        if (_loadRunning)
        {
            _loadQueued = true;
            return;
        }

        _loadRunning = true;
        try
        {
            do
            {
                _loadQueued = false;
                await LoadBrandsCore();
            }
            while (_loadQueued);
        }
        finally { _loadRunning = false; }
    }

    private async Task LoadBrandsCore()
    {
        _loading = true;
        try
        {
            pagedResultNew = await BrandService.GetBrandsPagedAsync(pagedRequest);
            _hasLoadedOnce = true;
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
        finally { _loading = false; }
    }

    // â”€â”€â”€ Stats / sorting helpers â”€â”€â”€
    private string TotalCountText => Stat("TotalCount");
    private string ActiveCountText => Stat("ActiveCount");
    private string InactiveCountText => Stat("InactiveCount");
    private string WithProductsCountText => Stat("WithProductsCount");
    private string WithLogoCountText => Stat("WithLogoCount");
    private string CountryCountText => Stat("CountryCount");

    private string Stat(string key) =>
        pagedResultNew.Stats != null && pagedResultNew.Stats.TryGetValue(key, out var v) ? v.ToString() : "0";

    private void SortBy(string column)
    {
        if (pagedRequest.SortColumn == column)
            pagedRequest.SortAscending = !pagedRequest.SortAscending;
        else
        {
            pagedRequest.SortColumn = column;
            pagedRequest.SortAscending = true;
        }
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
    }

    private string SortIcon(string column)
    {
        if (pagedRequest.SortColumn != column) return "";
        return pagedRequest.SortAscending ? "â–²" : "â–¼";
    }

    private static bool IsActive(BrandDto b) => string.Equals(b.Status, "Active", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

    private static string Truncate(string value, int max)
        => value.Length <= max ? value : value[..max] + "â€¦";

    private static string GetIconBg(string? name)
    {
        var palettes = new[] { "#e0e9ff", "#fee2e2", "#dcfce7", "#ede9fe", "#ffedd5", "#e0f2fe", "#fef9c3" };
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(name)) return palettes[0];
        return palettes[Math.Abs(name.GetHashCode()) % palettes.Length];
    }

    // â”€â”€â”€ Filters â”€â”€â”€
    private void OnSearchInput(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        pagedRequest.SearchTerm = e.Value?.ToString() ?? "";
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;

        _debounceCts?.Cancel();
        _debounceCts?.Dispose();
        _debounceCts = new CancellationTokenSource();
        var token = _debounceCts.Token;

        _ = Task.Run(async () =>
        {
            try
            {
                await Task.Delay(400, token);
                if (token.IsCancellationRequested) return;
                await InvokeAsync(async () =>
                {
                    await LoadBrands();
                    StateHasChanged();
                });
            }
            catch (OperationCanceledException) { }
        });
    }

    private async Task OnStatusChanged(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        var v = e.Value?.ToString();
        pagedRequest.Status = string.IsNullOrEmpty(v) ? null : v;
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await LoadBrands();
    }

    private async Task OnCompanyChanged(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        var v = e.Value?.ToString();
        pagedRequest.OriginCompany = string.IsNullOrEmpty(v) ? null : v;
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await LoadBrands();
    }

    private async Task OnProductsChanged(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        var v = e.Value?.ToString();
        pagedRequest.ProductFilter = string.IsNullOrEmpty(v) ? null : v;
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await LoadBrands();
    }

    private async Task FilterByStatus(string status)
    {
        pagedRequest.Status = pagedRequest.Status == status ? null : status;
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await LoadBrands();
    }

    private async Task FilterByProducts(string productFilter)
    {
        pagedRequest.ProductFilter = pagedRequest.ProductFilter == productFilter ? null : productFilter;
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await LoadBrands();
    }

    private async Task ToggleWithLogo()
    {
        pagedRequest.HasLogo = pagedRequest.HasLogo == true ? null : true;
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await LoadBrands();
    }

    private async Task ResetFilters()
    {
        pagedRequest.SearchTerm = "";
        pagedRequest.Status = null;
        pagedRequest.OriginCompany = null;
        pagedRequest.ProductFilter = null;
        pagedRequest.HasLogo = null;
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await LoadBrands();
    }

    // â”€â”€â”€ Paging (zero-based, matches TmPager) â”€â”€â”€
    private async Task GoToPage(int page)
    {
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = Math.Clamp(page, 0, Math.Max(0, pagedResultNew.TotalPages - 1));
        await LoadBrands();
    }

    private async Task GoPrevPage()
    {
        if (pagedRequest.CurrentPage > 0)
        {
            pagedRequest.CurrentPage--;
            await LoadBrands();
        }
    }

    private async Task GoNextPage()
    {
        if (pagedRequest.CurrentPage < pagedResultNew.TotalPages - 1)
        {
            pagedRequest.CurrentPage++;
            await LoadBrands();
        }
    }

    private async Task OnPageSizeChanged(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        if (int.TryParse(e.Value?.ToString(), out var sz))
        {
            pagedRequest.PageSize = Math.Clamp(sz, 1, 100);
            pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
            await LoadBrands();
        }
    }

    private async Task OpenCreateDialog()
    {
        var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<BrandDialog>("New Brand",
            new DialogOptions { MaxWidth = MaxWidth.Small, FullWidth = true, CloseButton = true });
        var result = await dialog.Result;

        if (result != null && !result.Canceled && result.Data is CreateBrandDto dto)
        {
            await BrandService.CreateBrandAsync(new CreateBrandDto
            {
                Name = dto.Name,
                BrandCode = dto.BrandCode,
                Description = dto.Description,
                LogoUrl = dto.LogoUrl,
                Status = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(dto.Status) ? "Active" : dto.Status,
                OriginCompany = dto.OriginCompany,
                OriginCountry = dto.OriginCountry,
                FoundedYear = dto.FoundedYear
            });

            Snackbar.Add("Brand created", Severity.Success);
            await ReloadCountries();
            await LoadBrands();
        }
    }

    private async Task OpenEditDialog(BrandDto brand)
    {
        var parameters = new DialogParameters<BrandDialog>
        {
            { x => x.Brand, brand }
        };

        var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<BrandDialog>("Edit Brand", parameters,
            new DialogOptions { MaxWidth = MaxWidth.Small, FullWidth = true, CloseButton = true });
        var result = await dialog.Result;

        if (result != null && !result.Canceled && result.Data is CreateBrandDto dto)
        {
            var entity = await BrandService.UpdateBrandAsync(brand.Id, dto);
            if (entity)
            {
                Snackbar.Add("Brand updated", Severity.Success);
                await ReloadCountries();
                await LoadBrands();
            }
        }
    }

    private async Task DeleteBrand(Guid id)
    {
        var confirm = await DialogService.ShowMessageBoxAsync("Confirm Delete", "Are you sure you want to delete this brand?", "Delete", "Cancel");
        if (confirm == true)
        {
            await BrandService.DeleteBrandAsync(id);
            Snackbar.Add("Brand deleted", Severity.Success);
            await ReloadCountries();
            await LoadBrands();
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Refetches the country dropdown after a write so a new origin shows up.</summary>
    private async Task ReloadCountries()
    {
        try
        {
            var all = await BrandService.GetAllBrandsAsync();
            _companies = all
                .Select(b => b.OriginCompany)
                .Where(c => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(c))
                .Select(c => c!)
                .Distinct()
                .OrderBy(c => c)
                .ToList();
        }
        catch { }
    }

    public void Dispose()
    {
        _debounceCts?.Cancel();
        _debounceCts?.Dispose();
    }
}

@code {
    private static class Col
    {
        public const string Name = "Name";
        public const string Description = "Description";
        public const string Path = "Path";
        public const string ProductCount = "ProductCount";
    }

    // â”€â”€â”€ List state â”€â”€â”€
    private PagedResultNew<CategoryDto> pagedResultNew = new();
    private CategoryPagedRequest pagedRequest = new()
    {
        SortColumn = Col.Name,
        SortAscending = true
    };

    private List<CategoryDto> _allCategories = new();
    private bool _loading = true;
    private bool _hasLoadedOnce;
    private bool _loadRunning;
    private bool _loadQueued;
    private CancellationTokenSource? _debounceCts;

    private string LevelValue => pagedRequest.Level?.ToString() ?? "";

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        // The create/edit dialogs offer the full category tree as a parent picker, so the whole
        // (small) list is fetched once through the service rather than the grid query.
        try { _allCategories = await CategoryService.GetAllCategoriesAsync(); }
        catch { }

        await LoadCategories();
    }

    private async Task Refresh() => await LoadCategories();

    /// <summary>
    /// Single-flight loader. The page and the services share one scoped DbContext, so two
    /// overlapping queries would throw "A second operation was started on this context
    /// instance". Callers that arrive mid-flight set a flag instead of starting a parallel
    /// query, and the running load then re-runs once with the newest filter state.
    /// </summary>
    private async Task LoadCategories()
    {
        if (_loadRunning)
        {
            _loadQueued = true;
            return;
        }

        _loadRunning = true;
        try
        {
            do
            {
                _loadQueued = false;
                await LoadCategoriesCore();
            }
            while (_loadQueued);
        }
        finally { _loadRunning = false; }
    }

    private async Task LoadCategoriesCore()
    {
        _loading = true;
        try
        {
            pagedResultNew = await CategoryService.GetCategoriesPagedAsync(pagedRequest);
            _hasLoadedOnce = true;
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add($"Error loading categories: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error); }
        finally { _loading = false; }
    }

    // â”€â”€â”€ Stats / sorting helpers â”€â”€â”€
    private string TotalCountText => Stat("TotalCount");
    private string TopLevelCountText => Stat("TopLevelCount");
    private string SubLevelCountText => Stat("SubLevelCount");
    private string WithProductsCountText => Stat("WithProductsCount");
    private string WithoutProductsCountText => Stat("WithoutProductsCount");
    private string MaxDepthText => Stat("MaxDepth");

    private string Stat(string key) =>
        pagedResultNew.Stats != null && pagedResultNew.Stats.TryGetValue(key, out var v) ? v.ToString() : "0";

    private void SortBy(string column)
    {
        if (pagedRequest.SortColumn == column)
            pagedRequest.SortAscending = !pagedRequest.SortAscending;
        else
        {
            pagedRequest.SortColumn = column;
            pagedRequest.SortAscending = true;
        }
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
    }

    private string SortIcon(string column)
    {
        if (pagedRequest.SortColumn != column) return "";
        return pagedRequest.SortAscending ? "â–²" : "â–¼";
    }

    private static string Truncate(string value, int max)
        => value.Length <= max ? value : value[..max] + "â€¦";

    private static int GetLevel(CategoryDto c)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(c.Path)) return 1;
        return c.Path.Count(ch => ch == '>') + 1;
    }

    private static string GetIconBg(string? name)
    {
        var palettes = new[] { "#e0e9ff", "#fee2e2", "#dcfce7", "#ede9fe", "#ffedd5", "#e0f2fe", "#fef9c3" };
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(name)) return palettes[0];
        return palettes[Math.Abs(name.GetHashCode()) % palettes.Length];
    }

    // â”€â”€â”€ Filters â”€â”€â”€
    private void OnSearchInput(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        pagedRequest.SearchTerm = e.Value?.ToString() ?? "";
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;

        _debounceCts?.Cancel();
        _debounceCts?.Dispose();
        _debounceCts = new CancellationTokenSource();
        var token = _debounceCts.Token;

        _ = Task.Run(async () =>
        {
            try
            {
                await Task.Delay(400, token);
                if (token.IsCancellationRequested) return;
                await InvokeAsync(async () =>
                {
                    await LoadCategories();
                    StateHasChanged();
                });
            }
            catch (OperationCanceledException) { }
        });
    }

    private async Task OnLevelChanged(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        pagedRequest.Level = int.TryParse(e.Value?.ToString(), out var lvl) ? lvl : null;
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await LoadCategories();
    }

    private async Task OnProductsChanged(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        var v = e.Value?.ToString();
        pagedRequest.ProductFilter = string.IsNullOrEmpty(v) ? null : v;
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await LoadCategories();
    }

    private async Task FilterByLevel(int level)
    {
        pagedRequest.Level = pagedRequest.Level == level ? null : level;
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await LoadCategories();
    }

    private async Task FilterByProducts(string productFilter)
    {
        pagedRequest.ProductFilter = pagedRequest.ProductFilter == productFilter ? null : productFilter;
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await LoadCategories();
    }

    private async Task ResetFilters()
    {
        pagedRequest.SearchTerm = "";
        pagedRequest.Level = null;
        pagedRequest.ProductFilter = null;
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await LoadCategories();
    }

    // â”€â”€â”€ Paging (zero-based, matches TmPager) â”€â”€â”€
    private async Task GoToPage(int page)
    {
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = Math.Clamp(page, 0, Math.Max(0, pagedResultNew.TotalPages - 1));
        await LoadCategories();
    }

    private async Task GoPrevPage()
    {
        if (pagedRequest.CurrentPage > 0)
        {
            pagedRequest.CurrentPage--;
            await LoadCategories();
        }
    }

    private async Task GoNextPage()
    {
        if (pagedRequest.CurrentPage < pagedResultNew.TotalPages - 1)
        {
            pagedRequest.CurrentPage++;
            await LoadCategories();
        }
    }

    private async Task OnPageSizeChanged(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        if (int.TryParse(e.Value?.ToString(), out var sz))
        {
            pagedRequest.PageSize = Math.Clamp(sz, 1, 100);
            pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
            await LoadCategories();
        }
    }

    private async Task OpenCreateDialog()
    {
        var parameters = new DialogParameters<CategoryDialog>
        {
            { x => x.AllCategories, _allCategories }
        };
        var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<CategoryDialog>("New Category", parameters,
            new DialogOptions { MaxWidth = MaxWidth.Small, FullWidth = true, CloseButton = true });
        var result = await dialog.Result;

        if (result != null && !result.Canceled && result.Data is CreateCategoryDto dto)
        {
            await CategoryService.CreateCategoryAsync(dto);
            Snackbar.Add("Category created", Severity.Success);
            await ReloadAll();
        }
    }

    private async Task OpenEditDialog(CategoryDto category)
    {
        var parameters = new DialogParameters<CategoryDialog>
        {
            { x => x.Category, category },
            { x => x.AllCategories, _allCategories }
        };
        var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<CategoryDialog>("Edit Category", parameters,
            new DialogOptions { MaxWidth = MaxWidth.Small, FullWidth = true, CloseButton = true });
        var result = await dialog.Result;

        if (result != null && !result.Canceled && result.Data is CreateCategoryDto dto)
        {
            await CategoryService.UpdateCategoryAsync(category.Id, dto);
            Snackbar.Add("Category updated", Severity.Success);
            await ReloadAll();
        }
    }

    private async Task DeleteCategory(Guid id)
    {
        var confirm = await DialogService.ShowMessageBoxAsync("Confirm Delete", "Are you sure you want to delete this category?", "Delete", "Cancel");
        if (confirm == true)
        {
            await CategoryService.DeleteCategoryAsync(id);
            Snackbar.Add("Category deleted", Severity.Success);
            await ReloadAll();
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Refetches the parent-picker tree alongside the grid after a write.</summary>
    private async Task ReloadAll()
    {
        try { _allCategories = await CategoryService.GetAllCategoriesAsync(); }
        catch { }
        await LoadCategories();
    }

    public void Dispose()
    {
        _debounceCts?.Cancel();
        _debounceCts?.Dispose();
    }
}

            <RichTextField @bind-Value="_description" Label="Description" Lines="2" Class="mt-3" />

                @foreach (var cat in AllCategories.Where(c => Category == null || c.Id != Category.Id))

@code {
    [CascadingParameter] private IMudDialogInstance MudDialog { get; set; } = default!;
    [Parameter] public CategoryDto? Category { get; set; }
    [Parameter] public List<CategoryDto> AllCategories { get; set; } = new();
    private MudForm _form = default;

    private string _name = "";
    private string? _description;
    private Guid? _parentId;

    protected override void OnInitialized()
    {
        if (Category != null)
        {
            _name = Category.Name;
            _description = Category.Description;
            _parentId = Category.ParentCategoryId;
        }
    }
    private string? ValidateName(string? name)
    {
        var trimmed = name?.Trim() ?? string.Empty;
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(trimmed))
            return "";

        // Duplicate check (case-insensitive, trimmed, globally unique)
        var duplicate = AllCategories.Any(c =>
            !string.Equals(c.Id.ToString(), Category?.Id.ToString(), StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) &&
            string.Equals(c.Name.Trim(), trimmed, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));

        if (duplicate)
            return $"A category named '{trimmed}' already exists.";

        return null;
    }

    private void Cancel() => MudDialog.Cancel();
    private async Task Submit()
    {
        await _form.ValidateAsync();

        if (!_form.IsValid)
            return;

        MudDialog.Close(DialogResult.Ok(new CreateCategoryDto(_name, _description, _parentId)));
    } 
}

@inject IDialogService DialogService
@inject ICategoryService CategoryService
@inject IBrandService BrandService

@code {
    [CascadingParameter] private IMudDialogInstance MudDialog { get; set; } = default!;
    [Parameter] public ProductDetailsDto DataModel { get; set; }
    [Parameter] public List<CategoryDto> Categories { get; set; } = new();
    [Parameter] public List<BrandDto> Brands { get; set; } = new();
    private MudForm _form = default!;
    MudTextField<string> RefModel = default!;


    [Parameter] public List<ControlItemsDto> AllCategories { get; set; } = new();
    [Parameter] public List<ControlItemsDto> AllBrands { get; set; } = new();
    private static readonly ControlItemsDto AddNewCategoryOption = new ControlItemsDto { Id = Guid.Empty, Name = "Add New", Text1 = "Add New", Text2 = string.Empty };
    private static readonly ControlItemsDto AddNewBrandOption = new ControlItemsDto { Id = Guid.Empty, Name = "Add New", Text1 = "Add New", Text2 = string.Empty };

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        Categories = Categories.Where(c => c.Id != Guid.Empty).ToList();
        Brands = Brands.Where(b => b.Id != Guid.Empty).ToList();

        if (Categories is List<CategoryDto> cat)
        {
            AllCategories.AddRange(cat.Select(c => new ControlItemsDto { Id = c.Id, Name = c.Name, Text1 = c.Path, Text2 = c.ParentCategoryId?.ToString() }));
        }

        if (Brands is List<BrandDto> brand)
        {
            AllBrands.AddRange(brand.Select(b => new ControlItemsDto { Id = b.Id, Name = b.Name, Text1 = b.Description, Text2 = b.LogoUrl }));
        }   

        if (DataModel is ProductDetailsDto details)
        {
            // _categoryId = details.CategoryId;
            var selectedCategory = GetRealCategoryById(details.CategoryId);
            await UpdateCategorySelection(selectedCategory);
            // DataModel.CategoryControl.SelectedItem = GetRealCategoryById(details.CategoryId);
            // DataModel.CategoryControl.LastSelectedItem = DataModel.CategoryControl.SelectedItem;
            // DataModel.CategoryControl.SelectedText = CategoryToDisplay(DataModel.CategoryControl.SelectedItem);
            // DataModel.CategoryControl.SelectedIndex = 1;


            //    _brandId = details.BrandId;

            var selectedBrand = GetRealBrandById(details.BrandId);
            await UpdateBrandSelection(selectedBrand);

            // DataModel.BrandControl.SelectedItem = GetRealBrandById(details.BrandId);
            // DataModel.BrandControl.LastSelectedItem = DataModel.BrandControl.SelectedItem;
            // DataModel.BrandControl.SelectedText = BrandToDisplay(DataModel.BrandControl.SelectedItem);
            // DataModel.BrandControl.SelectedIndex = 2;
        }

    }

    private Task<IEnumerable<ControlItemsDto>> SearchCategories(string text, CancellationToken _)
    {
        IEnumerable<ControlItemsDto> baseResults;

        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text))
        {
            baseResults = AllCategories.Where(c => c.Id != Guid.Empty);
        }
        else
        {
            baseResults = AllCategories.Where(c =>
                c.Id != Guid.Empty &&
                (c.Name.Contains(text, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                 (c.Text1 != null && c.Text1.Contains(text, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))));
        }

        var results = baseResults.OrderBy(x => x.Name).DistinctBy(c => c.Id);
        results = baseResults.Concat(new[] { AddNewCategoryOption });
        return Task.FromResult(results);
    }

    private Task<IEnumerable<ControlItemsDto>> SearchBrands(string text, CancellationToken _)
    {
        IEnumerable<ControlItemsDto> baseResults;

        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text))
        {
            baseResults = AllBrands.Where(b => b.Id != Guid.Empty);
        }
        else
        {
            baseResults = AllBrands.Where(b =>
                b.Id != Guid.Empty &&
                b.Name.Contains(text, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
        }

        
        var results = baseResults.OrderBy(x => x.Name).DistinctBy(c => c.Id);
        results = baseResults.Concat(new[] { AddNewBrandOption });
        
        return Task.FromResult(results);
    }

    private async Task OnCategoryChanged()
    {
        var cat = DataModel.CategoryControl.SelectedItem;

        if (cat?.Id == Guid.Empty)
        {
            var previousCategory = DataModel.CategoryControl.LastSelectedItem;
            var parameters = new DialogParameters<CategoryDialog>
            {
                { x => x.AllCategories, Categories.Where(c => c.Id != Guid.Empty).Select(c => new CategoryDto(c.Id, c.Name, c.Description, c.ParentCategoryId, null, 0, c.Path, c.CreatedAt)).ToList() }
            };

            var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<CategoryDialog>("New Category", parameters,
                new DialogOptions { MaxWidth = MaxWidth.Small, FullWidth = true, CloseButton = true });
            var result = await dialog.Result;

            await DataModel.CategoryControl.ControlRef.ResetAsync();

            if (result != null && !result.Canceled && result.Data is CreateCategoryDto dto)
            {
                var categoryId = await CategoryService.CreateCategoryAsync(dto);
                var created = await CategoryService.GetCategoryByIdAsync(categoryId);

                cat = new ControlItemsDto() { Id = created.Id, Name = created.Name, Text1 = created.Description, Text2 = created.Path };

                Categories = await CategoryService.GetAllCategoriesAsync();

                await UpdateCategorySelection(cat);

                StateHasChanged();
            }
            else
            {
                // DataModel.CategoryControl.SelectedItem = previousCategory;
                // DataModel.CategoryControl.LastSelectedItem = previousCategory;
                // DataModel.CategoryId = previousCategory?.Id ?? Guid.Empty;
                // DataModel.CategoryControl.SelectedText = CategoryToDisplay(previousCategory);
                // DataModel.CategoryControl.SelectedIndex++;

                await UpdateCategorySelection(previousCategory);
                StateHasChanged();
            }
        }
        else
        {
            await UpdateCategorySelection(cat);

            // DataModel.CategoryId = cat?.Id ?? Guid.Empty;
            // DataModel.CategoryControl.LastSelectedItem = cat;
            // DataModel.CategoryControl.SelectedText = CategoryToDisplay(cat);
        }

        if (DataModel.BrandControl.ControlRef is not null)
        {   
            await Task.Delay(50);
            await DataModel.BrandControl.ControlRef.FocusAsync();
        }
    }

    private async Task UpdateCategorySelection(ControlItemsDto? selectedCategory)
    {
        if (selectedCategory!=null){
            DataModel.CategoryControl.SelectedItem = selectedCategory;
            DataModel.CategoryControl.LastSelectedItem = selectedCategory;
            DataModel.CategoryId = selectedCategory?.Id ?? Guid.Empty;
            DataModel.CategoryControl.SelectedText = selectedCategory.Name??selectedCategory.Text1;
            DataModel.CategoryControl.SelectedIndex++;
        }
    }
    private async Task UpdateBrandSelection(ControlItemsDto? selectedBrand)
    {
        if (selectedBrand != null)
        {
            DataModel.BrandControl.SelectedItem = selectedBrand;
            DataModel.BrandControl.LastSelectedItem = selectedBrand;
            DataModel.BrandId = selectedBrand?.Id ?? Guid.Empty;
            DataModel.BrandControl.SelectedText = selectedBrand.Name ?? selectedBrand.Text1;
            DataModel.BrandControl.SelectedIndex++;
        }
    }

    private ControlItemsDto? GetRealCategoryById(Guid categoryId)
    {
        if (categoryId == Guid.Empty)
            return null;

        return AllCategories.FirstOrDefault(c => c.Id == categoryId);
    }

    private async Task OnBrandChanged()
    {
        var brand = DataModel.BrandControl.SelectedItem;

        if (brand?.Id == Guid.Empty)
        {
            var previousBrand = DataModel.BrandControl.LastSelectedItem; ;

            var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<BrandDialog>("New Brand",
                new DialogOptions { MaxWidth = MaxWidth.Small, FullWidth = true, CloseButton = true });
            var result = await dialog.Result;

            await DataModel.BrandControl.ControlRef.ResetAsync();

            if (result != null && !result.Canceled && result.Data is CreateBrandDto dto)
            {
                var brandId = await BrandService.CreateBrandAsync(dto);

                Brands = await BrandService.GetAllBrandsAsync();

                var newBrand = new ControlItemsDto { Id = brandId, Name = dto.Name, Text1 = dto.Description, Text2 = dto.LogoUrl };
                AllBrands.Add(newBrand);

                await UpdateBrandSelection(newBrand);
                // _selectedBrand = GetRealBrandById(entity.Id);
                // _lastBrandSelection = _selectedBrand;
                // DataModel.BrandId = _selectedBrand?.Id;
                // _brandText = BrandToDisplay(_selectedBrand);
                // _selectedBrandIndex++;

                StateHasChanged();
            }
            else
            {
                await UpdateBrandSelection(previousBrand);

                // _selectedBrand = previousBrand;
                // _lastBrandSelection = _selectedBrand;
                // DataModel.BrandId = previousBrand?.Id;
                // _brandText = BrandToDisplay(_selectedBrand);
                StateHasChanged();
            }

            return;
        }

        await UpdateBrandSelection(brand);


        if (RefModel is not null)
        {
            await RefModel.FocusAsync();
        }
    }

    private ControlItemsDto? GetRealBrandById(Guid? brandId)
    {
        if (!brandId.HasValue || brandId.Value == Guid.Empty)
            return null;

        return AllBrands.FirstOrDefault(b => b.Id == brandId.Value);
    }

    private static string? CategoryToDisplay(ControlItemsDto? category)
        => category?.Text1 ?? category?.Name;

    private static string? BrandToDisplay(ControlItemsDto? brand)
        => brand?.Name ?? brand?.Text1;

    private void Cancel() => MudDialog.Cancel();

    private async Task Submit()
    {
        await _form.ValidateAsync();

        if (!_form.IsValid)
            return;

        DataModel.BrandId = DataModel.BrandControl.SelectedItem?.Id;
        DataModel.BrandName = DataModel.BrandControl.SelectedItem?.Name;
        DataModel.CategoryId = DataModel.CategoryControl.SelectedItem?.Id;
        DataModel.CategoryName = DataModel.CategoryControl.SelectedItem?.Name;

        MudDialog.Close(DialogResult.Ok(DataModel));
    }
}

@code {
    [Parameter] public Guid Id { get; set; }

    private ProductDetailViewDto? _product;
    private bool _loading = true;
    private string _activeTab = "overview";
    private List<ProductWarehouseStockDto> _inventories = new();
    private List<StockMovementReportRowDto> _movements = new();
    private List<ProductOrderLineDto> _salesOrderLines = new();
    private List<ProductOrderLineDto> _purchaseOrderLines = new();

    private int Margin => _product is { SellingPrice: > 0 }
        ? (int)((_product.SellingPrice - _product.CostPrice) / _product.SellingPrice * 100)
        : 0;

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync() => await LoadProduct();

    private string GetStockStatus()
    {
        if (_product == null) return "-";
        var total = _product.TotalAvailable;
        if (total <= 0) return "Out of Stock";
        if (total <= _product.ReorderStockLevel) return "Low Stock";
        return "In Stock";
    }

    private string GetStockPillClass()
    {
        var s = GetStockStatus();
        return s == "In Stock" ? "tm-pill tm-pill-green" : s == "Low Stock" ? "tm-pill tm-pill-amber" : "tm-pill tm-pill-red";
    }

    private string GetOrderPill(string status)
    {
        var s = (status ?? "").ToLower();
        if (s.Contains("complet") || s.Contains("deliver")) return "tm-pill-green";
        if (s.Contains("cancel")) return "tm-pill-red";
        if (s.Contains("load") || s.Contains("pend")) return "tm-pill-amber";
        if (s.Contains("assign") || s.Contains("approv")) return "tm-pill-blue";
        if (s.Contains("route") || s.Contains("process")) return "tm-pill-purple";
        return "tm-pill-gray";
    }

    private void GoBack() => Navigation.NavigateTo("/products/list");

    private async Task LoadProduct()
    {
        _loading = true;
        try
        {
            _product = await ProductService.GetProductDetailViewAsync(Id);

            if (_product != null)
            {
                _inventories = _product.WarehouseStock;
                _movements = _product.Movements;
                _salesOrderLines = _product.SalesOrderLines;
                _purchaseOrderLines = _product.PurchaseOrderLines;
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Snackbar.Add($"Error loading product: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error);
        }
        _loading = false;
    }

    private Task AddStock()
    {
        Snackbar.Add("Use the Adjust Stock dialog to add stock.", Severity.Info);
        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }

    private Task AdjustStock()
    {
        Snackbar.Add("Stock adjustment â€” open from Stock Movements page.", Severity.Info);
        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }

    private Task TransferStock()
    {
        Navigation.NavigateTo("/inventory/transfers");
        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }

    private Task GoCreatePurchaseOrder()
    {
        Navigation.NavigateTo("/orders/purchase");
        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }

    private Task GoCreateSalesOrder()
    {
        Navigation.NavigateTo("/orders/sales");
        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }

    private async Task DeleteProduct()
    {
        var confirmed = await DialogService.ShowMessageBoxAsync(
            "Delete Product",
            $"Are you sure you want to delete '{_product?.Name}'? This action cannot be undone.",
            yesText: "Delete", cancelText: "Cancel");

        if (confirmed == true && _product != null)
        {
            try
            {
                await ProductService.DeleteProductAsync(_product.Id);
                Snackbar.Add("Product deleted.", Severity.Success);
                Navigation.NavigateTo("/products");
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Snackbar.Add($"Error deleting: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error);
            }
        }
    }
}

@code {

    //private List<ProductDto> _products = new();
    private List<ProductDto> _statsCache = new();
    private List<CategoryDto> _categories = new();
    private List<BrandDto> _brands = new();
    private System.Timers.Timer? _debounce;

    private PagedResultNew<ProductDto> pagedResultNew = new();
    private ProductPagedRequest pagedRequest = new();

    // Paging state lives on pagedRequest (CurrentPage is zero-based) and TmPager binds straight
    // to pagedResultNew, so the pager highlight and the query always agree on the current page.
    private bool _loading = true;
    bool _hasLoadedOnce = false;
    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        try
        {
            _categories = await CategoryService.GetAllCategoriesAsync();
            //_categoryCount = _categories.Count; 
        }
        catch { }
        try
        {
            _brands = await BrandService.GetAllBrandsAsync();
            //_brandCount = _brands.Count;
        }
        catch { }
        await LoadProducts();
    }

    private void NavigateToDetail(Guid id) => Navigation.NavigateTo($"/products/details/{id}");

    private ProductViewPanel? _viewPanel;

    private async Task OpenDetails(Guid id)
    {
        if (_viewPanel != null)
            await _viewPanel.OpenAsync(id);
    }

    private string GetStockStatus(ProductDto p)
    {
        if (p.TotalStock <= 0) return "Out of Stock";
        if (p.TotalStock <= p.ReorderStockLevel) return "Low Stock";
        return "In Stock";
    }

    private string GetIconBg(string? cat)
    {
        var palettes = new[] { "#e0e9ff", "#fee2e2", "#dcfce7", "#ede9fe", "#ffedd5", "#e0f2fe", "#fef9c3" };
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(cat)) return palettes[0];
        return palettes[Math.Abs(cat.GetHashCode()) % palettes.Length];
    }

    private async Task LoadProducts()
    {
        _loading = true;
        try
        {
            //pagedResultNew = await ProductService.GetProductsAsync(pagedRequest);

            // Deleting the last row on the last page, or narrowing a filter, can leave the
            // current page past the end. Step back until a page has content, otherwise the table
            // renders empty while the pager still points at a valid-looking page number.
            if (pagedResultNew.Items.Count == 0 && pagedRequest.CurrentPage > 0)
            {
                pagedRequest.CurrentPage--;              
            }            
            pagedResultNew = await ProductService.GetProductsAsync(pagedRequest);

            _hasLoadedOnce = true;
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Snackbar.Add($"Error loading products: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error);
        }
        finally { _loading = false; }
    }

    private void OnSearchInput(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        pagedRequest.SearchTerm = e.Value?.ToString() ?? "";
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        _debounce?.Stop();
        _debounce?.Dispose();
        _debounce = new System.Timers.Timer(400) { AutoReset = false };
        _debounce.Elapsed += async (_, __) =>
        {
            await InvokeAsync(async () => { await LoadProducts(); StateHasChanged(); });
        };
        _debounce.Start();
    }

    private async Task OnCategoryChanged(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        var v = e.Value?.ToString();
        pagedRequest.CategoryId = string.IsNullOrEmpty(v) ? Guid.Empty : Guid.Parse(v);
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await LoadProducts();
    }

    private async Task OnBrandChanged(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        var v = e.Value?.ToString();
        pagedRequest.BrandId = string.IsNullOrEmpty(v) ? Guid.Empty : Guid.Parse(v);
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await LoadProducts();
    }

    private async Task OnStockStatusChanged(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        pagedRequest.Status = Enum.TryParse<StockFilter>(e.Value?.ToString(), out var status) ? status : null;
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await LoadProducts();
    }

    private async Task FilterByStatus(StockFilter? f)
    {
        pagedRequest.Status = f;
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await LoadProducts();
        StateHasChanged();
    }

    private void ClearFilterAndFocusCategory() { }
    private void ClearFilterAndFocusBrand() { }

    private async Task ResetFilters()
    {
        pagedRequest.SearchTerm = "";
        pagedRequest.CategoryId = null;
        pagedRequest.BrandId = null;
        pagedRequest.Status = null;
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await LoadProducts();
    }


    private async Task GoToPage(int page)
    {
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = Math.Clamp(page, 0, Math.Max(0, pagedResultNew.TotalPages - 1));
        await LoadProducts();
    }
    private async Task GoPrevPage()
    {
        if (pagedRequest.CurrentPage > 0)
        {
            pagedRequest.CurrentPage--;
            await LoadProducts();
        }
    }

    private async Task GoNextPage()
    {
        if (pagedRequest.CurrentPage < pagedResultNew.TotalPages - 1)
        {
            pagedRequest.CurrentPage++;
            await LoadProducts();
        }
    }

    private async Task OnPageSizeChanged(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        if (int.TryParse(e.Value?.ToString(), out var sz))
        {
            pagedRequest.PageSize = Math.Clamp(sz, 1, 100);
            pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
            await LoadProducts();
        }
    }

    private async Task OpenAddEditDialog(ProductDto? product)
    {
        var categories = await CategoryService.GetAllCategoriesAsync();
        var brands = await BrandService.GetAllBrandsAsync();
        var detailsDto = new ProductDetailsDto()
            {
                Barcode = NumberGenerator.GenerateCode("PRD"),
                SKU=NumberGenerator.GenerateCode("SKU"),
            };
        if (product != null)
        {
            var fullProduct = await ProductService.GetProductDetailsByIdAsync(product.Id);
            detailsDto = new ProductDetailsDto()
            {
                Id = fullProduct?.Id ?? Guid.Empty,
                Name = fullProduct?.Name,
                SKU = fullProduct?.SKU ?? "",
                Barcode = fullProduct?.Barcode,
                Description = fullProduct?.Description,
                CostPrice = fullProduct?.CostPrice ?? 0,
                SellingPrice = fullProduct?.SellingPrice ?? 0,
                WholeSellingPrice = fullProduct?.WholeSellingPrice ?? 0,
                ReorderStockLevel = fullProduct?.ReorderStockLevel ?? 0,
                MinOrderQuantity = fullProduct?.MinOrderQuantity ?? 0,
                CategoryId = fullProduct?.CategoryId ?? Guid.Empty,
                CategoryName = product?.CategoryName,
                BrandId = fullProduct?.BrandId,
                BrandName = fullProduct?.BrandName,
                ImageUrl = fullProduct?.ImageUrl,
                IsKit = fullProduct?.IsKit ?? false,
                Model = fullProduct?.Model,
                OriginCountry = fullProduct?.OriginCountry ?? "",
                OriginManufacturer = fullProduct?.OriginManufacturer ?? ""
            };
        };

        var parameters = new DialogParameters<ProductAddEditDialog>
        {
            { x => x.DataModel, detailsDto },
            { x => x.Categories, categories.ToList() },
            { x => x.Brands, brands.ToList() }
        };

        var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<ProductAddEditDialog>("New Product", parameters, new DialogOptions
        {
            MaxWidth = MaxWidth.Medium,
            FullWidth = true,
            CloseButton = true
        });

        var result = await dialog.Result;

        if (result != null && !result.Canceled && result.Data is ProductDetailsDto dto)
        {
            if (dto.Id == Guid.Empty)
            {
                await ProductService.CreateProductAsync(dto);
            }
            else
            {
                await ProductService.UpdateProductDetailsAsync(dto);
            }
            Snackbar.Add(dto.Id == Guid.Empty ? "Product created successfully" : "Product updated successfully", Severity.Success);
            await LoadProducts();
        }
    }

    private async Task DeleteProduct(Guid id)
    {
        var confirm = await DialogService.ShowMessageBoxAsync("Confirm Delete",
            "Are you sure you want to delete this product?", "Delete", "Cancel");
        if (confirm == true)
        {
            await ProductService.DeleteProductAsync(id);
            Snackbar.Add("Product deleted", Severity.Success);
            await LoadProducts();
        }
    }
}

@code {
    private bool _open;
    private bool _animateIn;
    private bool _loading;
    private ProductDetailViewDto? _details;

    private async Task DownloadPdf()
    {
        if (_details is null) return;
        try
        {
            var doc = await PrintRenderer.RenderProductAsync(_details);
            await JS.InvokeVoidAsync("downloadFile", doc.Html, doc.FileName + ".pdf", doc.Title, doc.Reference);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            await JS.InvokeVoidAsync("alert", "Could not generate the PDF: " + ex.Message);
        }
    }

    private async Task PrintDoc()
    {
        if (_details is null) return;
        try
        {
            var doc = await PrintRenderer.RenderProductAsync(_details);
            await JS.InvokeVoidAsync("printHtml", doc.Html, doc.Title, doc.Reference);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            await JS.InvokeVoidAsync("alert", "Could not print the document: " + ex.Message);
        }
    }

    public async Task OpenAsync(Guid id)
    {
        _open = true;
        _loading = true;
        _animateIn = false;
        _details = null;
        StateHasChanged();

        // Small delay so the panel renders before the slide-in class is added
        await Task.Delay(20);
        _animateIn = true;
        StateHasChanged();

        try
        {
            _details = await ProductService.GetProductDetailViewAsync(id);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error);
        }

        _loading = false;
        StateHasChanged();
    }

    public void Close()
    {
        _open = false;
        _animateIn = false;
        _details = null;
        StateHasChanged();
    }
}

@code {
    private List<LandedCostComponentDto> _components = new();
    private List<LandedCostAllocationDto> _allocations = new();
    private List<PurchaseOrderOptionDto> _purchaseOrders = new();
    private Guid? _filterPoId;
    private bool _showAdd;
    private string _newName = "", _newType = "";
    private decimal _newRate;

    private string TotalAllocated => _allocations.Sum(a => a.Amount).ToString("N0");

    private string AvgRate => _components.Count == 0
        ? "0.00%"
        : _components.Average(c => (double)c.DefaultRate).ToString("P2");

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        _purchaseOrders = await PurchaseService.GetRecentPurchaseOrders(100);
        await Load();
    }

    private async Task Load()
    {
        try
        {
            _components = await LandedCostService.GetComponents();
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
        await LoadAllocations();
    }

    private async Task LoadAllocations()
    {
        try { _allocations = await LandedCostService.GetAllocations(_filterPoId); }
        catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
    }

    private async Task AddComponent()
    {
        try
        {
            await LandedCostService.CreateComponent(new CreateLandedCostComponentDto(_newName, _newType, _newRate));
            Snackbar.Add("Component added.", Severity.Success);
            _showAdd = false;
            _newName = ""; _newType = ""; _newRate = 0;
            await Load();
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
    }

    private void CancelAdd()
    {
        _showAdd = false;
        _newName = ""; _newType = ""; _newRate = 0;
    }

    private async Task OnPoChanged(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        var v = e.Value?.ToString();
        _filterPoId = string.IsNullOrEmpty(v) ? null : Guid.Parse(v);
        await LoadAllocations();
    }

    private async Task ClearPoFilter()
    {
        _filterPoId = null;
        await LoadAllocations();
    }
}

                            <MudNumericField @bind-Value="dataModel.DueAmount" ReadOnly="true" Label="Due Amount" Format="N2" ShrinkLabel="true" Variant="Variant.Outlined" Margin="Margin.Dense" Class="pb-1" />
                        </MudItem>
                    </MudGrid>
                    @{
                        CalculationBalance();
                    }
                </MudCardContent>
            </MudCard>

        </MudForm>
    </DialogContent>
    <DialogActions>
        <MudButton OnClick="Cancel">Cancel</MudButton>
        <MudButton Color="Color.Primary" Variant="Variant.Filled" OnClick="Submit" Disabled="@(!dataModel.ItemsLine.Any(i => i.ProductId != Guid.Empty))">
            Save
        </MudButton>
    </DialogActions>
</MudDialog>



@inject IDialogService DialogService

@code {

    protected override void OnInitialized()

    private void OnScanKeyDown(KeyboardEventArgs e)
    {
        if (e.Key == "Enter" && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_scanInput))
        {
            var sn = _scanInput.Trim();
            if (!_scannedSerials.Any(s => s.SerialNumber.Equals(sn, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)))
            {
                _scannedSerials.Add(new PurchaseSerialEntryDto(
                    SerialNumber: sn,
                    Barcode: sn,
                    WarrantyStartDate: _warrantyStart,
                    WarrantyEndDate: _warrantyEnd,
                    BinLocation: _binLocation));
            }
            _scanInput = string.Empty;
        }
    }


    private async Task OnSupplierChanged()
    {
        var cust = dataModel.SupplierDdlControl.SelectedItem;

        if (cust?.Id == Guid.Empty)
        {
            var previousCustomer = dataModel.SupplierDdlControl.LastSelectedItem;
            var parameters = new DialogParameters<SupplierDialog>
            {
                  { x => x.Supplier, new SupplierDto()}
            };

            var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<SupplierDialog>("New Supplier", parameters,
                new DialogOptions { MaxWidth = MaxWidth.Small, FullWidth = true, CloseButton = true });

            await dataModel.SupplierDdlControl.ControlRef.ResetAsync();


            if (result != null && !result.Canceled && result.Data is SupplierDto dto)
            {
                var newSupplierId = await SupplierService.CreateSupplierAsync(dto);

                Suppliers = await SupplierService.GetActiveSuppliersAsync();

                cust = new ControlItemsDto() { Id = newSupplierId, Name = dto.SupplierName, IsSelected = false };

                await UpdateControlSelection(dataModel.SupplierDdlControl, cust);
                //var latestCustomers = await DbContext.Customers.ToListAsync();

                // dataModel.SelectedSupplier = Suppliers.Where(x => x.Id == newCustomer.Id).Select(c => new ControlItemsDto(c.Id, c.SupplierName, false)).FirstOrDefault();
                //_selectedCustomer = Customers.FirstOrDefault();
                //  dataModel.LastSupplierSelection = dataModel.SelectedSupplier;
                //_customerId = _selectedCustomer?.Id ?? Guid.Empty;
                // dataModel.SupplierText = dataModel.SelectedSupplier?.Name;

                StateHasChanged();
            }
            else
            {
                //dataModel.SelectedSupplier = previousCustomer;
                //dataModel.LastSupplierSelection = dataModel.SelectedSupplier;
                //_customer = previousCustomer;
                //dataModel.SupplierText = dataModel.SelectedSupplier?.Name;
                await UpdateControlSelection(dataModel.SupplierDdlControl, previousCustomer);
                StateHasChanged();
            }
        }
        else
        {
            //dataModel.SelectedSupplier = cust;
            //dataModel.LastSupplierSelection = dataModel.SelectedSupplier;
            //dataModel.SupplierText = dataModel.SelectedSupplier?.Name;
            await UpdateControlSelection(dataModel.SupplierDdlControl, cust);
        }

        if (RefWarehouse is not null)
        {
            await RefWarehouse.FocusAsync();
        }
    }


    private async Task OnWarehouseChanged(Guid? value)
    {
        dataModel.WarehouseId = value;
        if (dataModel.WarehouseId is null)
        {
            dataModel.WarehouseText = string.Empty;
        }
        else
        {
            var selectedWarehouse = WareHouses.FirstOrDefault(w => w.Id == dataModel.WarehouseId);
            dataModel.WarehouseText = selectedWarehouse.Name;
        }

        if (dataModel.WarehouseId is null && RefWarehouse is not null)
        {
            await RefWarehouse.FocusAsync();
        }
        else if (RefNote is not null)
        {
            await RefNote.FocusAsync();
        }
    }

    private async Task UpdateControlSelection(ControlDto control, ControlItemsDto? selectedItem)
    {
        if (selectedItem != null)
        {
            control.SelectedItem = selectedItem;
            control.LastSelectedItem = selectedItem;
            control.SelectedText = selectedItem.Name ?? selectedItem.Text1;
            control.SelectedIndex++;
        }
    }

    private Task<IEnumerable<ControlItemsDto>> SearchSuppliers(string text, CancellationToken _)
    {
        IEnumerable<ControlItemsDto> baseResults;

        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text))
        {
            baseResults = Suppliers.Where(c => c.Id != Guid.Empty).Select(c => new ControlItemsDto() { Id = c.Id, Name = c.SupplierName, IsSelected = false });
        }
        else
        {
            baseResults = Suppliers.Where(c =>
                c.Id != Guid.Empty &&
                (c.SupplierName.Contains(text, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)))
                .Select(c => new ControlItemsDto() { Id = c.Id, Name = c.SupplierName, IsSelected = false });
        }

        //var results = new[] { AddNewCustomerOption }.Concat(baseResults).DistinctBy(c => c.Id);
        var results = baseResults.Append(AddNewOption).DistinctBy(c => c.Id);

        return Task.FromResult(results);
    }


    private async Task OnProductChanged()
    {
        var prod = dataModel.ProductObj.ProductDdlControl.SelectedItem;

        if (prod?.Id == Guid.Empty)
        {
            var categories = await CategoryService.GetAllCategoriesAsync();
            var brands = await BrandService.GetAllBrandsAsync();
            var parameters = new DialogParameters<ProductAddEditDialog>
            {
                { x => x.DataModel, new ProductDetailsDto()},
                { x => x.Categories, categories },
                { x => x.Brands, brands }
            };

            var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<ProductAddEditDialog>("New Product", parameters,
                new DialogOptions { MaxWidth = MaxWidth.Medium, FullWidth = true, CloseButton = true });
            var result = await dialog.Result;

            await dataModel.ProductObj.ProductDdlControl.ControlRef.ResetAsync();

            if (result != null && !result.Canceled && result.Data is ProductDetailsDto dto)
            {
                var newProductId = await ProductService.CreateProductAsync(dto);
                Snackbar.Add("Product created successfully", Severity.Success);

                Products = (await ProductService.GetProductOptionsAsync())
                    .Select(p => (p.Id, p.Name, p.Sku, p.SellingPrice)).ToList();

                prod = new ControlItemsDto() { Id = newProductId, Name = dto.Name, IsSelected = false };
                //_lastProductSelection = prod;
                //  dataModel.SelectedItem.SelectedProduct = prod;
                //  _productText = prod?.Name;

                var p = Products.FirstOrDefault(p => p.Id == prod.Id);
                if (p != default)
                {
                    dataModel.ProductObj.ProductId = p.Id;
                    dataModel.ProductObj.Quantity = 1;
                    dataModel.ProductObj.UnitPrice = p.Price;
                    dataModel.ProductObj.DiscountType = (int)DiscountType.Percentage;
                    dataModel.ProductObj.DiscountAmount = 0m;
                    dataModel.ProductObj.TotalDiscount = 0m;
                }

                await UpdateControlSelection(dataModel.ProductObj.ProductDdlControl, prod);

                StateHasChanged();
            }
            else
            {
                var previousProduct = dataModel.ProductObj.ProductDdlControl.SelectedItem;
                var p = Products.FirstOrDefault(p => p.Id == previousProduct?.Id);
                if (p != default)
                {
                    dataModel.ProductObj.ProductId = p.Id;
                    dataModel.ProductObj.Quantity = 1;
                    dataModel.ProductObj.UnitPrice = p.Price;
                    dataModel.ProductObj.DiscountType = (int)DiscountType.Percentage;
                    dataModel.ProductObj.DiscountAmount = 0m;
                    dataModel.ProductObj.TotalDiscount = 0m;
                }

                // _lastProductSelection = previousProduct;
                //_productText = previousProduct?.Name;

                await UpdateControlSelection(dataModel.ProductObj.ProductDdlControl, previousProduct);

                StateHasChanged();
            }
        }
        else
        {
            var p = Products.FirstOrDefault(p => p.Id == prod?.Id);
            if (p != default)
            {
                dataModel.ProductObj.ProductId = p.Id;
                dataModel.ProductObj.Quantity = 1;
                dataModel.ProductObj.UnitPrice = p.Price;
                dataModel.ProductObj.DiscountType = (int)DiscountType.Percentage;
                dataModel.ProductObj.DiscountAmount = 0m;
                dataModel.ProductObj.TotalDiscount = 0m;
            }

            await UpdateControlSelection(dataModel.ProductObj.ProductDdlControl, prod);
        }

        if (RefQuantity is not null)
        {
            await RefQuantity.FocusAsync();
        }
    }

    private Task<IEnumerable<ControlItemsDto>> SearchProducts(string text, CancellationToken _)
    {
        IEnumerable<ControlItemsDto> baseResults;

        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text))
        {
            baseResults = Products.Where(c => c.Id != Guid.Empty).Select(c => new ControlItemsDto() { Id = c.Id, Name = c.Name, IsSelected = false });
        }
        else
        {
            baseResults = Products.Where(c =>
                c.Id != Guid.Empty &&
                (c.Name.Contains(text, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)))
                .Select(c => new ControlItemsDto() { Id = c.Id, Name = c.Name, IsSelected = false });
        }

        //var results = new[] { AddNewCustomerOption }.Concat(baseResults).DistinctBy(c => c.Id);
        var results = baseResults.Append(AddNewOption).DistinctBy(c => c.Id);

        return Task.FromResult(results);
    }


    private async Task StartEditItem(int index, CreatePurchaseOrderItemDto item)
    {
        if (dataModel.ItemsLine.Any(x => x.ProductId == Guid.Empty)) return;

        _editingItemIndex = index;
        var product = Products.FirstOrDefault(p => p.Id == item.ProductId);
        dataModel.ProductObj.ProductId = item.ProductId;
        dataModel.ProductObj.ProductDdlControl.SelectedItem = product != default
            ? new ControlItemsDto() { Id = product.Id, Name = product.Name, IsSelected = false }
            : new ControlItemsDto() { Id = Guid.Empty, Name = "", IsSelected = false };
        dataModel.ProductObj.Quantity = item.Quantity;
        dataModel.ProductObj.UnitPrice = item.UnitPrice;
        dataModel.ProductObj.DiscountAmount = item.DiscountAmount;
        dataModel.ProductObj.DiscountType = item.DiscountType;
        dataModel.ProductObj.TotalDiscount = item.TotalDiscount;
        dataModel.ProductObj.TotalPrice = item.TotalPrice;
        //_editProductText = product != default ? product.Name : "";
        //_editLastProductSelection = dataModel.ProductObj.ProductDdlControl.SelectedItem;
    }

    private async Task SaveEditItem(int index)
    {
        if (dataModel.ProductObj.ProductId == Guid.Empty || dataModel.ProductObj.Quantity <= 0) return;

        CalculateLineTotal();
        var updated = new CreatePurchaseOrderItemDto(
            dataModel.ProductObj.Id,
            dataModel.ProductObj.ProductId,
            dataModel.ProductObj.Quantity,
            dataModel.ProductObj.UnitPrice,
            dataModel.ProductObj.DiscountAmount,
            (DiscountType)dataModel.ProductObj.DiscountType,
            dataModel.ProductObj.TotalDiscount,
            dataModel.ProductObj.TotalPrice,
            null,
            dataModel.ItemsLine[index].Serials);

        dataModel.ItemsLine[index] = updated;
        dataModel.SubTotal = dataModel.ItemsLine.Sum(i => i.TotalPrice);
        _editingItemIndex = -1;
    }

    private async Task CancelEditItem()
    {
        _editingItemIndex = -1;

        if (RefDiscountAmount is not null)
        {
            await RefDiscountAmount.FocusAsync();
        }
    }
    private async Task RemoveEditItem(CreatePurchaseOrderItemDto item)
    {
        dataModel.ItemsLine.Remove(item);
        if (RefDiscountAmount is not null)
        {
            await RefDiscountAmount.FocusAsync();
        }
    }
    private async Task OnEditProductChanged()
    {
        var prod = dataModel.ProductObj.ProductDdlControl.SelectedItem;
        if (prod == null) return;

        var p = Products.FirstOrDefault(p => p.Id == prod.Id);
        if (p != default)
        {
            dataModel.ProductObj.ProductId = p.Id;
            dataModel.ProductObj.UnitPrice = p.Price;
            dataModel.ProductObj.DiscountType = (int)DiscountType.Percentage;
            dataModel.ProductObj.DiscountAmount = 0m;
            dataModel.ProductObj.TotalDiscount = 0m;
        }
        //_editLastProductSelection = prod;
        //_editProductText = prod?.Name;
        await UpdateControlSelection(dataModel.ProductObj.ProductDdlControl, prod);



        if (RefQuantity is not null)
        {
            await RefQuantity.FocusAsync();
        }
    }

    private async Task AddNewItemForm()
    {
        if (dataModel.ItemsLine.Any(x => x.ProductId == Guid.Empty)) return;

        if (_editingItemIndex < 0)
        {
            _scanInput = string.Empty;
            _scannedSerials = new();
            _warrantyStart = null;
            _warrantyEnd = null;
            _binLocation = null;
            dataModel.ItemsLine.Insert(0, new CreatePurchaseOrderItemDto(Guid.NewGuid(), Guid.Empty, 0, 0, 0, DiscountType.Percentage, 0, 0, null));
        }
        await FocusSelectBox();

    }

    private async Task AddItem()
    {
        if (dataModel.ProductObj.ProductId == Guid.Empty || dataModel.ProductObj.Quantity <= 0) return;

        dataModel.ItemsLine.Insert(dataModel.ItemsLine.Count, new CreatePurchaseOrderItemDto(Guid.NewGuid(), dataModel.ProductObj.ProductId, dataModel.ProductObj.Quantity, dataModel.ProductObj.UnitPrice, dataModel.ProductObj.DiscountAmount, (DiscountType)dataModel.ProductObj.DiscountType, dataModel.ProductObj.TotalDiscount, dataModel.ProductObj.TotalPrice, null, null));
        dataModel.ProductObj.Quantity = 1;
        dataModel.ProductObj.DiscountAmount = 0;
        dataModel.ProductObj.SelectedSerialIds = new();
        dataModel.SubTotal = dataModel.ItemsLine.Sum(i => i.TotalPrice);

        if (Products.Count > 0) { dataModel.ProductObj.ProductId = Products.First().Id; dataModel.ProductObj.UnitPrice = Products.First().Price; }

        await FocusSelectBox();
    }

    private async Task FocusSelectBox()
    {
        await Task.Delay(100);
        if (dataModel.ProductObj.ProductDdlControl.ControlRef is not null)
        {
            await dataModel.ProductObj.ProductDdlControl.ControlRef.ResetAsync();
            await dataModel.ProductObj.ProductDdlControl.ControlRef.FocusAsync();
        }
    }

    private void CalculateLineTotal()
    {
        dataModel.ProductObj.TotalDiscount = 0;
        if (dataModel.ProductObj.DiscountType == (int)DiscountType.Percentage)
        {
            dataModel.ProductObj.TotalDiscount = (dataModel.ProductObj.UnitPrice * dataModel.ProductObj.Quantity) * (dataModel.ProductObj.DiscountAmount / 100);
        }
        else
        {
            dataModel.ProductObj.TotalDiscount = dataModel.ProductObj.DiscountAmount;
        }

        dataModel.ProductObj.TotalPrice = ((dataModel.ProductObj.UnitPrice * dataModel.ProductObj.Quantity) - dataModel.ProductObj.TotalDiscount);
    }

    private async Task Cancel() => MudDialog.Cancel();

    private async Task Submit()
    {

        await _form.ValidateAsync();

        if (!_form.IsValid)
            return;

        MudDialog.Close(DialogResult.Ok(
        new CreatePurchaseOrderDto(dataModel.SupplierDdlControl.SelectedItem?.Id, dataModel.WarehouseId, dataModel.Notes, null, null,
            dataModel.ItemsLine.Where(i => i.ProductId != Guid.Empty).ToList())));
    }


    private async Task CalculationBalance()
    {
        decimal totalVatAmount = 0;
        decimal vat = dataModel.TaxAmount;
        if (vat > 0)
            totalVatAmount = (dataModel.SubTotal) * ((dataModel.TaxAmount) / 100); ;

        dataModel.TotalAmount = (dataModel.SubTotal) + totalVatAmount;

        decimal? discountAmt = 0m;

        if (dataModel.DiscountType == (int)DiscountType.Percentage)
        {
            discountAmt = (dataModel.SubTotal) * (dataModel.DiscountAmount / 100);
        }
        else
        {
            discountAmt = dataModel.DiscountAmount;
        }

        dataModel.TotalAmount = dataModel.TotalAmount - (discountAmt ?? 0);

        dataModel.DueAmount = (dataModel.TotalAmount) - (dataModel.PaidAmount);
    }

}
