@code {
    private static class Col
    {
        public const string OrderNumber = "OrderNumber";
        public const string PurchaseDate = "PurchaseDate";
        public const string Supplier = "Supplier";
        public const string Warehouse = "Warehouse";
        public const string TotalAmount = "TotalAmount";
        public const string DueAmount = "DueAmount";
        public const string Status = "Status";
    }

    private readonly List<PurchaseOrderStatus> OrderStatuses = Enum.GetValues<PurchaseOrderStatus>().ToList();

    // â”€â”€â”€ List state â”€â”€â”€
    private PagedResultNew<PurchaseOrderDto> pagedResultNew = new();
    private PurchaseOrderPagedRequest pagedRequest = new()
    {
        SortColumn = Col.PurchaseDate,
        SortAscending = false
    };


    private List<SupplierDto> _suppliers = new();
    private List<ProductDto> productDtos = new();

    private List<(Guid Id, string Name)> _warehouses = new();
    private bool _loading = true;
    private bool _hasLoadedOnce;
    private bool _loadRunning;
    private bool _loadQueued;
    private decimal _pageValue;
    private CancellationTokenSource? _debounceCts;

    private PurchaseOrderViewPanel? _purchaseOrderViewPanel;

    private async Task ViewOrder(Guid id)
    {
        if (_purchaseOrderViewPanel != null)
            await _purchaseOrderViewPanel.OpenAsync(id);
    }

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        try
        {
            var suppliers = await SupplierService.GetSuppliersAsync("", 1, 1000);
            _suppliers = suppliers.Items;
            var result = await ProductService.GetProductsAsync(new ProductPagedRequest());
            productDtos = result.Items;

        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            // Previously an empty catch. An unlogged swallow here left the supplier picker silently
            // empty, which is indistinguishable from a tenant that has no suppliers â€” and left no
            // error anywhere to diagnose it from.
            Logger.LogError(ex, "Supplier lookup failed; the new-order supplier picker will be empty.");
            Snackbar.Add("Could not load suppliers.", Severity.Error);
        }

        try
        {
            var warehouses = await WarehousesService.GetAllWarehousesAsync();
            _warehouses = warehouses
                .OrderBy(w => w.Name)
                .Select(w => new ValueTuple<Guid, string>(w.Id, w.Name))
                .ToList();
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Logger.LogError(ex, "Warehouse lookup failed; the new-order warehouse picker will be empty.");
            Snackbar.Add("Could not load warehouses.", Severity.Error);
        }

        await LoadOrders();
    }

    private async Task Refresh() => await LoadOrders();

    /// <summary>
    /// Single-flight loader. The page and the services share one scoped DbContext, so two
    /// overlapping queries would throw "A second operation was started on this context
    /// instance". Callers that arrive mid-flight set a flag instead of starting a parallel
    /// query, and the running load then re-runs once with the newest filter state.
    /// </summary>
    private async Task LoadOrders()
    {
        if (_loadRunning)
        {
            _loadQueued = true;
            return;
        }

        _loadRunning = true;
        try
        {
            do
            {
                _loadQueued = false;
                await LoadOrdersCore();
            }
            while (_loadQueued);
        }
        finally { _loadRunning = false; }
    }

    private async Task LoadOrdersCore()
    {
        _loading = true;
        try
        {
            pagedResultNew = await PurchaseService.GetPurchaseOrdersAsync(pagedRequest);
            _pageValue = pagedResultNew.Items.Sum(o => o.TotalAmount);
            _hasLoadedOnce = true;
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Logger.LogError(ex, "Failed to load purchase orders for page {Page}.", pagedRequest.CurrentPage);
            Snackbar.Add($"Error loading purchase orders: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error);
        }
        finally { _loading = false; }
    }

    // â”€â”€â”€ Stats / sorting helpers â”€â”€â”€
    private string TotalCountText => Stat("TotalCount");
    private string DraftCountText => Stat("DraftCount");
    private string ApprovedCountText => Stat("ApprovedCount");
    private string PartialCountText => Stat("PartiallyReceivedCount");
    private string ReceivedCountText => Stat("ReceivedCount");
    private string PageValueText => _pageValue.ToString("N0");

    private string Stat(string key) =>
        pagedResultNew.Stats != null && pagedResultNew.Stats.TryGetValue(key, out var v) ? v.ToString() : "0";

    private void SortBy(string column)
    {
        if (pagedRequest.SortColumn == column)
            pagedRequest.SortAscending = !pagedRequest.SortAscending;
        else
        {
            pagedRequest.SortColumn = column;
            pagedRequest.SortAscending = true;
        }
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
    }

    private string SortIcon(string column)
    {
        if (pagedRequest.SortColumn != column) return "";
        return pagedRequest.SortAscending ? "â–²" : "â–¼";
    }

    // â”€â”€â”€ Filters â”€â”€â”€
    private void OnSearchInput(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        pagedRequest.SearchTerm = e.Value?.ToString() ?? "";
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;

        _debounceCts?.Cancel();
        _debounceCts?.Dispose();
        _debounceCts = new CancellationTokenSource();
        var token = _debounceCts.Token;

        _ = Task.Run(async () =>
        {
            try
            {
                await Task.Delay(400, token);
                if (token.IsCancellationRequested) return;
                await InvokeAsync(async () =>
                {
                    await LoadOrders();
                    StateHasChanged();
                });
            }
            catch (OperationCanceledException) { }
        });
    }

    private async Task OnSupplierChanged(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        pagedRequest.SupplierId = ParseGuid(e.Value);
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await LoadOrders();
    }

    private async Task OnWarehouseChanged(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        pagedRequest.WarehouseId = ParseGuid(e.Value);
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await LoadOrders();
    }

    private async Task OnStatusChanged(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        pagedRequest.Status = Enum.TryParse<PurchaseOrderStatus>(e.Value?.ToString(), out var s) ? s : null;
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await LoadOrders();
    }

    private async Task OnRangeChanged((DateTime? From, DateTime? To) range)
    {
        pagedRequest.From = range.From;
        pagedRequest.To = range.To;
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await LoadOrders();
    }

    private async Task FilterByStatus(PurchaseOrderStatus? status)
    {
        pagedRequest.Status = pagedRequest.Status == status ? null : status;
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await LoadOrders();
    }

    private async Task ResetFilters()
    {
        pagedRequest.SearchTerm = "";
        pagedRequest.Status = null;
        pagedRequest.SupplierId = null;
        pagedRequest.WarehouseId = null;
        pagedRequest.From = null;
        pagedRequest.To = null;
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await LoadOrders();
    }

    private static Guid? ParseGuid(object? value) =>
        Guid.TryParse(value?.ToString(), out var g) && g != Guid.Empty ? g : null;

    // â”€â”€â”€ Paging (zero-based, matches TmPager) â”€â”€â”€
    private async Task GoToPage(int page)
    {
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = Math.Clamp(page, 0, Math.Max(0, pagedResultNew.TotalPages - 1));
        await LoadOrders();
    }

    private async Task GoPrevPage()
    {
        if (pagedRequest.CurrentPage > 0)
        {
            pagedRequest.CurrentPage--;
            await LoadOrders();
        }
    }

    private async Task GoNextPage()
    {
        if (pagedRequest.CurrentPage < pagedResultNew.TotalPages - 1)
        {
            pagedRequest.CurrentPage++;
            await LoadOrders();
        }
    }

    private async Task OnPageSizeChanged(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        if (int.TryParse(e.Value?.ToString(), out var sz))
        {
            pagedRequest.PageSize = Math.Clamp(sz, 1, 100);
            pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
            await LoadOrders();
        }
    }

    private static string GetStatusPill(PurchaseOrderStatus s) => s switch
    {
        PurchaseOrderStatus.Draft => "tm-pill tm-pill-purple",
        PurchaseOrderStatus.Submitted => "tm-pill tm-pill-blue",
        PurchaseOrderStatus.Approved => "tm-pill tm-pill-green",
        PurchaseOrderStatus.PartiallyReceived => "tm-pill tm-pill-amber",
        PurchaseOrderStatus.Received => "tm-pill tm-pill-teal",
        PurchaseOrderStatus.Closed => "tm-pill tm-pill-blue",
        PurchaseOrderStatus.Cancelled => "tm-pill tm-pill-red",
        _ => "tm-pill tm-pill-blue"
    };

    private async Task Approve(Guid id)
    {
        try
        {
            await PurchaseService.ApprovePurchaseOrder(id);
            Snackbar.Add("PO approved", Severity.Success);
            await LoadOrders();
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
    }

    private async Task ReceiveGoods(PurchaseOrderDto po)
    {
        var detail = await PurchaseService.GetPurchaseOrderById(po.Id);
        if (detail == null) return;

        var lines = detail.Items
            .Where(i => i.ReceivedQuantity < i.Quantity)
            .Select(i => new GoodsReceivedLineDto(i.Id, i.ProductId, i.Quantity - i.ReceivedQuantity))
            .ToList();

        if (!lines.Any()) { Snackbar.Add("All items already received", Severity.Info); return; }

        var confirm = await DialogService.ShowMessageBoxAsync("Receive Goods",
            $"Receive all outstanding items for {po.OrderNumber}?", "Receive", "Cancel");
        if (confirm == true)
        {
            try
            {
                await PurchaseService.ReceiveGoods(po.Id, lines);
                Snackbar.Add("Goods received successfully", Severity.Success);
                await LoadOrders();
            }
            catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
        }
    }

    private async Task OpenCreateEdit(Guid? orderId)
    {
        // Reference data comes from the services, not the page's DbContext â€” the page and the
        // services share one scoped context, so querying it directly races the list query.
        var suppliers = _suppliers;
        var wareHouse = _warehouses;
        var dataModel = new PurchaseOrderDtoModels();
        string dialogTitle = "New Purchase";

        if (orderId.HasValue){
            var order = await PurchaseService.GetPurchaseOrderById(orderId.Value);
            if (order == null) { Snackbar.Add("Purchase order not found", Severity.Error); return; }

            dialogTitle = $"Edit PO #{order.OrderNumber}";
            var supplierItem = suppliers.Where(s => s.Id == order.SupplierId)
                .Select(s => new ControlItemsDto() {Id= s.Id, IsSelected = false, Name = s.SupplierName })
                .FirstOrDefault() ?? new ControlItemsDto() { Id = order.SupplierId, Name = order.SupplierName, IsSelected = false };

            dataModel = new PurchaseOrderDtoModels()
                {
                    PurchaseDate = order.PurchaseDate,
                    SupplierId = order.SupplierId,
                    WarehouseId = order.WarehouseId,
                    DiscountAmount = order.DiscountAmount,
                    TaxAmount = order.TaxAmount,
                    DiscountType = order.DiscountType,
                    DueAmount = order.DueAmount,
                    TotalAmount = order.TotalAmount,
                //LabourCharge = order.LabourCharge,
                //TruckCharge = order.TruckCharge,
                    SubTotal = order.SubTotal,
                    PaidAmount = order.PaidAmount,
                    Notes = order.Notes,
                    SupplierDdlControl = new ControlDto()
                    {
                        SelectedItem = supplierItem,
                        SelectedText = supplierItem?.Name,
                        LastSelectedItem = supplierItem
                    },
                    ItemsLine = order.Items.Select(i => new CreatePurchaseOrderItemDto(i.Id, i.ProductId, i.Quantity, i.UnitPrice,
                        i.DiscountAmount, i.DiscountType, i.TotalDiscount, i.LineTotalPrice, null, null)).ToList()
                };
        }

        var parameters = new DialogParameters<PurchaseOrderDialog>
        {
            { x => x.Suppliers, suppliers.Where(s => s.IsActive).ToList() },
            { x => x.Products, productDtos.Select(p => (p.Id, p.Name, p.SKU, p.CostPrice)).ToList() },
            { x => x.WareHouses, wareHouse.Select(p => (p.Id, p.Name)).ToList() },
            {x=>x.dataModel, dataModel }
        };

        var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<PurchaseOrderDialog>(dialogTitle, parameters,
            new DialogOptions { MaxWidth = MaxWidth.Large, FullWidth = true, CloseButton = true });
        var result = await dialog.Result;

        if (result != null && !result.Canceled && result.Data is CreatePurchaseOrderDto dto)
        {
            try
            {
                if (orderId.HasValue)
                {
                    await PurchaseService.UpdatePurchaseOrder(orderId.Value, dto);
                    Snackbar.Add("Purchase order updated", Severity.Success);
                }
                else
                {
                    await PurchaseService.CreatePurchaseOrder(dto);
                    Snackbar.Add("Purchase order created", Severity.Success);
                }
                await LoadOrders();
            }
            catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
        }
    }

    private async Task CancelPO(Guid id)
    {
        var confirm = await DialogService.ShowMessageBoxAsync("Cancel Purchase Order",
            "Are you sure you want to cancel this purchase order?", "Yes, Cancel", "No");
        if (confirm == true)
        {
            try
            {
                await PurchaseService.CancelPurchaseOrder(id);
                Snackbar.Add("Purchase order cancelled", Severity.Warning);
                await LoadOrders();
            }
            catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
        }
    }

    private async Task DeletePO(Guid id)
    {
        var confirm = await DialogService.ShowMessageBoxAsync("Delete Purchase Order",
            "This will permanently delete the purchase order. Continue?", "Yes, Delete", "No");
        if (confirm == true)
        {
            try
            {
                await PurchaseService.DeletePurchaseOrder(id);
                Snackbar.Add("Purchase order deleted", Severity.Success);
                await LoadOrders();
            }
            catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
        }
    }

    public void Dispose()
    {
        _debounceCts?.Cancel();
        _debounceCts?.Dispose();
    }
}

@code {
    private bool _open;
    private bool _animateIn;
    private bool _loading;
    private PurchaseOrderDto? _order;

    private async Task DownloadPdf()
    {
        if (_order is null) return;
        try
        {
            var doc = await PrintRenderer.RenderPurchaseOrderAsync(_order);
            await JS.InvokeVoidAsync("downloadFile", doc.Html, doc.FileName + ".pdf", doc.Title, doc.Reference);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            await JS.InvokeVoidAsync("alert", "Could not generate the PDF: " + ex.Message);
        }
    }

    private async Task PrintDoc()
    {
        if (_order is null) return;
        try
        {
            var doc = await PrintRenderer.RenderPurchaseOrderAsync(_order);
            await JS.InvokeVoidAsync("printHtml", doc.Html, doc.Title, doc.Reference);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            await JS.InvokeVoidAsync("alert", "Could not print the document: " + ex.Message);
        }
    }

    public async Task OpenAsync(Guid id)
    {
        _open = true;
        _loading = true;
        _animateIn = false;
        _order = null;
        StateHasChanged();

        await Task.Delay(20);
        _animateIn = true;
        StateHasChanged();

        try
        {
            _order = await PurchaseService.GetPurchaseOrderById(id);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error);
        }

        _loading = false;
        StateHasChanged();
    }

    public void Close()
    {
        _open = false;
        _animateIn = false;
        _order = null;
        StateHasChanged();
    }
}

@code {
    [CascadingParameter] private IMudDialogInstance MudDialog { get; set; } = null!;
    private List<PurchaseOrderOptionDto> _purchaseOrders = new();
    private PurchaseReturnDto purchaseReturnDto = new PurchaseReturnDto();
    private SupplierDto supplierDto = null;

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        _purchaseOrders = await PurchaseService.GetRecentPurchaseOrders(50);
    }
    private Task<IEnumerable<ControlItemsDto>> SearchPurchaseOrder(string text, CancellationToken _)
    {
        IEnumerable<ControlItemsDto> baseResults;

        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text))
        {
            baseResults = _purchaseOrders.Where(c => c.Id != Guid.Empty).Select(c => new ControlItemsDto() { Id = c.Id, Name = c.OrderNumber, IsSelected = false });
        }
        else
        {
            baseResults = _purchaseOrders.Where(c =>
                c.Id != Guid.Empty &&
                (c.OrderNumber.Contains(text, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)))
                .Select(c => new ControlItemsDto() { Id = c.Id, Name = c.OrderNumber, IsSelected = false });
        }

        //var results = new[] { AddNewCustomerOption }.Concat(baseResults).DistinctBy(c => c.Id);
        var results = baseResults.DistinctBy(c => c.Id);

        return Task.FromResult(results);
    }
    private void CalculateLineTotal(PurchaseReturnItemDto context)
    {
        context.LineTotal = context.Quantity * context.UnitCost;

        //        _purchaseOrders[index].Line.TotalPrice = ((dataModel.ProductObj.UnitPrice * dataModel.ProductObj.Quantity) - dataModel.ProductObj.TotalDiscount);
    }
    private void UpdateLineTotal(PurchaseReturnItemDto item, int quantity, decimal unitCost)
    {
        item.Quantity = quantity;
        item.UnitCost = unitCost;
        CalculateLineTotal(item);
    }
    private async Task OnPurchaseOrderChanged()
    {
        if (purchaseReturnDto.PurchaseReturnDdlControl.SelectedItem != null)
        {
            PurchaseOrderDto detail = await PurchaseService.GetPurchaseOrderById(purchaseReturnDto.PurchaseReturnDdlControl.SelectedItem?.Id ?? Guid.Empty);

            if (detail is not null)
            {
                purchaseReturnDto.ItemsLine = detail.Items.Select(i => new PurchaseReturnItemDto
                {
                    ProductId = i.ProductId,
                    ProductName = i.ProductName,
                    Quantity = i.Quantity,
                    UnitCost = i.UnitPrice,
                    LineTotal = i.Quantity * i.UnitPrice,
                }).ToList();
                
              supplierDto= await SupplierService.GetSupplierByIdAsync(detail.SupplierId);

            }
        }

    }

    private async Task Submit()
    {
        try
        {
            if (purchaseReturnDto.PurchaseReturnDdlControl.SelectedItem != null)
            {
                purchaseReturnDto.PurchaseOrderId = purchaseReturnDto.PurchaseReturnDdlControl.SelectedItem?.Id ?? Guid.Empty;
                                purchaseReturnDto.PurchaseOrderNumber = purchaseReturnDto.PurchaseReturnDdlControl.SelectedItem?.Name ?? string.Empty;
            }
            MudDialog.Close(DialogResult.Ok(purchaseReturnDto));
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
    }

    private void Cancel() => MudDialog.Cancel();

}

<PurchaseReturnViewPanel @ref="_purchaseReturnViewPanel" />

@code {
    private static class Col
    {
        public const string ReturnNumber = "ReturnNumber";
        public const string PurchaseOrderNumber = "PurchaseOrderNumber";
        public const string TotalAmount = "TotalAmount";
        public const string Reason = "Reason";
        public const string Status = "Status";
    }

    private readonly List<PurchaseReturnStatus> ReturnStatuses = Enum.GetValues<PurchaseReturnStatus>().ToList();

    // â”€â”€â”€ List state â”€â”€â”€
    private PagedResultNew<PurchaseReturnDto> pagedResultNew = new();
    private PurchaseReturnPagedRequest pagedRequest = new()
    {
        SortColumn = "CreatedAt",
        SortAscending = false
    };

    private bool _loading = true;
    private bool _hasLoadedOnce;
    private bool _loadRunning;
    private bool _loadQueued;
    private CancellationTokenSource? _debounceCts;

    private PurchaseReturnViewPanel? _purchaseReturnViewPanel;

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync() => await Load();

    private async Task Refresh() => await Load();

    /// <summary>
    /// Single-flight loader. The page and the services share one scoped DbContext, so two
    /// overlapping queries would throw "A second operation was started on this context
    /// instance". Callers that arrive mid-flight set a flag instead of starting a parallel
    /// query, and the running load then re-runs once with the newest filter state.
    /// </summary>
    private async Task Load()
    {
        if (_loadRunning)
        {
            _loadQueued = true;
            return;
        }

        _loadRunning = true;
        try
        {
            do
            {
                _loadQueued = false;
                await LoadCore();
            }
            while (_loadQueued);
        }
        finally { _loadRunning = false; }
    }

    private async Task LoadCore()
    {
        _loading = true;
        try
        {
            pagedResultNew = await PurchaseReturnService.GetPurchaseReturnsAsync(pagedRequest);
            _hasLoadedOnce = true;
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
        finally { _loading = false; }
    }

    // â”€â”€â”€ Stats / sorting helpers â”€â”€â”€
    private string TotalCountText => Stat("TotalCount");
    private string DraftCountText => Stat("DraftCount");
    private string ApprovedCountText => Stat("ApprovedCount");
    private string ShippedCountText => Stat("ShippedCount");
    private string CompletedCountText => Stat("CompletedCount");
    private string TotalReturnedText =>
        int.TryParse(Stat("TotalReturned"), out var v) ? v.ToString("N0") : "0";

    private string Stat(string key) =>
        pagedResultNew.Stats != null && pagedResultNew.Stats.TryGetValue(key, out var v) ? v.ToString() : "0";

    private void SortBy(string column)
    {
        if (pagedRequest.SortColumn == column)
            pagedRequest.SortAscending = !pagedRequest.SortAscending;
        else
        {
            pagedRequest.SortColumn = column;
            pagedRequest.SortAscending = true;
        }
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
    }

    private string SortIcon(string column)
    {
        if (pagedRequest.SortColumn != column) return "";
        return pagedRequest.SortAscending ? "â–²" : "â–¼";
    }

    private async Task OpenCreate()
    {
        var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<PurchaseReturnDialog>("New Purchase Return",
                new DialogOptions { MaxWidth = MaxWidth.Medium, FullWidth = true, CloseButton = true });

        var result = await dialog.Result;

        if (result != null && !result.Canceled && result.Data is PurchaseReturnDto dto)
        {
            await PurchaseReturnService.CreatePurchaseReturn(dto);
            Snackbar.Add(dto.Id == Guid.Empty ? "Purchase return created successfully" : "Purchase return updated successfully", Severity.Success);
            await Load();
        }
    }

    private async Task Approve(Guid id)
    {
        try { await PurchaseReturnService.ApprovePurchaseReturn(id); Snackbar.Add("Approved.", Severity.Success); await Load(); }
        catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
    }

    private async Task Complete(Guid id)
    {
        try { await PurchaseReturnService.CompletePurchaseReturn(id); Snackbar.Add("Completed.", Severity.Success); await Load(); }
        catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
    }

    private async Task ViewReturn(Guid id)
    {
        if (_purchaseReturnViewPanel != null)
            await _purchaseReturnViewPanel.OpenAsync(id);
    }

    // â”€â”€â”€ Filters â”€â”€â”€
    private void OnSearchInput(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        pagedRequest.SearchTerm = e.Value?.ToString() ?? "";
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;

        _debounceCts?.Cancel();
        _debounceCts?.Dispose();
        _debounceCts = new CancellationTokenSource();
        var token = _debounceCts.Token;

        _ = Task.Run(async () =>
        {
            try
            {
                await Task.Delay(400, token);
                if (token.IsCancellationRequested) return;
                await InvokeAsync(async () =>
                {
                    await Load();
                    StateHasChanged();
                });
            }
            catch (OperationCanceledException) { }
        });
    }

    private async Task OnStatusChanged(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        pagedRequest.Status = Enum.TryParse<PurchaseReturnStatus>(e.Value?.ToString(), out var s) ? s : null;
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await Load();
    }

    private async Task OnRangeChanged((DateTime? From, DateTime? To) range)
    {
        pagedRequest.From = range.From;
        pagedRequest.To = range.To;
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await Load();
    }

    private async Task FilterByStatus(PurchaseReturnStatus? status)
    {
        pagedRequest.Status = pagedRequest.Status == status ? null : status;
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await Load();
    }

    private async Task ResetFilters()
    {
        pagedRequest.SearchTerm = "";
        pagedRequest.Status = null;
        pagedRequest.From = null;
        pagedRequest.To = null;
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await Load();
    }

    // â”€â”€â”€ Paging (zero-based, matches TmPager) â”€â”€â”€
    private async Task GoToPage(int page)
    {
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = Math.Clamp(page, 0, Math.Max(0, pagedResultNew.TotalPages - 1));
        await Load();
    }

    private async Task GoPrevPage()
    {
        if (pagedRequest.CurrentPage > 0)
        {
            pagedRequest.CurrentPage--;
            await Load();
        }
    }

    private async Task GoNextPage()
    {
        if (pagedRequest.CurrentPage < pagedResultNew.TotalPages - 1)
        {
            pagedRequest.CurrentPage++;
            await Load();
        }
    }

    private async Task OnPageSizeChanged(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        if (int.TryParse(e.Value?.ToString(), out var sz))
        {
            pagedRequest.PageSize = Math.Clamp(sz, 1, 100);
            pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
            await Load();
        }
    }

    private static string GetStatusPill(PurchaseReturnStatus s) => s switch
    {
        PurchaseReturnStatus.Draft => "tm-pill tm-pill-purple",
        PurchaseReturnStatus.Approved => "tm-pill tm-pill-amber",
        PurchaseReturnStatus.Shipped => "tm-pill tm-pill-blue",
        PurchaseReturnStatus.Completed => "tm-pill tm-pill-green",
        PurchaseReturnStatus.Cancelled => "tm-pill tm-pill-red",
        _ => "tm-pill tm-pill-blue"
    };

    public void Dispose()
    {
        _debounceCts?.Cancel();
        _debounceCts?.Dispose();
    }
}

@code {
    private bool _open;
    private bool _animateIn;
    private bool _loading;
    private PurchaseReturnDto? _return;

    private async Task DownloadPdf()
    {
        if (_return is null) return;
        try
        {
            var doc = await PrintRenderer.RenderPurchaseReturnAsync(_return);
            await JS.InvokeVoidAsync("downloadFile", doc.Html, doc.FileName + ".pdf", doc.Title, doc.Reference);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            await JS.InvokeVoidAsync("alert", "Could not generate the PDF: " + ex.Message);
        }
    }

    private async Task PrintDoc()
    {
        if (_return is null) return;
        try
        {
            var doc = await PrintRenderer.RenderPurchaseReturnAsync(_return);
            await JS.InvokeVoidAsync("printHtml", doc.Html, doc.Title, doc.Reference);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            await JS.InvokeVoidAsync("alert", "Could not print the document: " + ex.Message);
        }
    }

    public async Task OpenAsync(Guid id)
    {
        _open = true;
        _loading = true;
        _animateIn = false;
        _return = null;
        StateHasChanged();

        await Task.Delay(20);
        _animateIn = true;
        StateHasChanged();

        try
        {
            _return = await PurchaseReturnService.GetPurchaseReturnById(id);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error);
        }

        _loading = false;
        StateHasChanged();
    }

    public void Close()
    {
        _open = false;
        _animateIn = false;
        _return = null;
        StateHasChanged();
    }
}

@code {
    [Parameter] public Guid Id { get; set; }
    private RfqRequestDto? _rfq;
    private List<SupplierDto> _suppliers = new();
    private bool _showResponse;
    private Guid _respSupplierId;
    private decimal _respPrice;
    private int _respLeadTime;
    private DateTime? _respValidUntil;

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        _suppliers = await SupplierService.GetActiveSuppliersAsync();
        await Load();
    }

    private async Task Load()
    {
        _rfq = await RfqService.GetRfqRequestById(Id);
    }

    private void ShowAddResponse() => _showResponse = true;

    private async Task SubmitResponse()
    {
        try
        {
            await RfqService.AddSupplierResponse(new CreateRfqSupplierResponseDto(
                Id, _respSupplierId, _respPrice, _respLeadTime,
                _respValidUntil.HasValue ? DateTime.SpecifyKind(_respValidUntil.Value, DateTimeKind.Utc) : null, null));
            Snackbar.Add("Response added.", Severity.Success);
            _showResponse = false;
            await Load();
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
    }

    private async Task Award(Guid responseId)
    {
        try
        {
            await RfqService.AwardRfq(Id, responseId);
            Snackbar.Add("RFQ awarded.", Severity.Success);
            await Load();
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
    }

    private async Task ConvertToPO(Guid responseId)
    {
        try
        {
            var poId = await RfqService.ConvertRfqToPurchaseOrder(Id, responseId);
            Snackbar.Add("Purchase Order created.", Severity.Success);
            Navigation.NavigateTo("/orders/purchase");
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
    }
}

<div class="tm-page">

    <div class="tm-stats">

                        {

@code {
    private List<RfqRequestDto> _rfqs = new();
    private string? _search;
    private RfqStatus? _statusFilter;
    private int _page = 1;
    private int _pageSize = 25;
    private int _totalCount;
    private int _draftCount, _sentCount, _receivedCount, _awardedCount;
    private bool _loading;
    private System.Timers.Timer? _debounce;

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        await LoadData();
        await LoadCountsAsync();
    }

    private async Task LoadData()
    {
        _loading = true;
        try
        {
            var result = await RfqService.GetRfqRequests(_search, _statusFilter, _page, _pageSize);
            _rfqs = result.Items;
            _totalCount = result.TotalCount;
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
        finally { _loading = false; }
    }

    private async Task LoadCountsAsync()
    {
        try
        {
            var all = await RfqService.GetRfqRequests(null, null, 1, 500);
            var items = all.Items;
            _draftCount = items.Count(r => r.Status == RfqStatus.Draft);
            _sentCount = items.Count(r => r.Status == RfqStatus.Sent);
            _receivedCount = items.Count(r => r.Status == RfqStatus.Received);
            _awardedCount = items.Count(r => r.Status == RfqStatus.Awarded);
        }
        catch { }
    }

    private int CountOf(RfqStatus s) => s switch
    {
        RfqStatus.Draft => _draftCount,
        RfqStatus.Sent => _sentCount,
        RfqStatus.Received => _receivedCount,
        RfqStatus.Awarded => _awardedCount,
        _ => 0
    };

    private static string BestQuote(RfqRequestDto r)
    {
        if (r.SupplierResponses == null || r.SupplierResponses.Count == 0) return "-";
        var best = r.SupplierResponses.Min(x => x.QuotedPrice);
        return best.ToString("N0");
    }

    private void ViewRfq(Guid id) => Navigation.NavigateTo("/quotes/rfq/" + id);

    private async Task OpenCreate()
    {
        var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<RfqCreateDialog>("New RFQ",
            new DialogOptions { MaxWidth = MaxWidth.Medium, FullWidth = true, CloseButton = true });
        var result = await dialog.Result;
        if (result is not null && !result.Canceled)
        {
            await LoadData();
            await LoadCountsAsync();
        }
    }

    private void OnSearchInput(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        _search = e.Value?.ToString();
        _page = 1;
        _debounce?.Stop();
        _debounce?.Dispose();
        _debounce = new System.Timers.Timer(350) { AutoReset = false };
        _debounce.Elapsed += async (_, __) =>
        {
            await LoadData();
            await InvokeAsync(StateHasChanged);
        };
        _debounce.Start();
    }

    private async Task OnStatusChanged(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        var v = e.Value?.ToString();
        _statusFilter = string.IsNullOrEmpty(v) ? null : Enum.Parse<RfqStatus>(v);
        _page = 1;
        await LoadData();
    }

    private async Task PickStatus(RfqStatus s)
    {
        _statusFilter = _statusFilter == s ? null : s;
        _page = 1;
        await LoadData();
    }

    private async Task ResetFilters()
    {
        _search = null;
        _statusFilter = null;
        _page = 1;
        await LoadData();
    }

    private int PageTotal => Math.Max(1, (int)Math.Ceiling(_totalCount / (double)_pageSize));

    private async Task OnPageChanged(int page)
    {
        _page = Math.Clamp(page, 1, PageTotal);
        await LoadData();
    }

    private async Task OnPageSizeChanged(int size)
    {
        _pageSize = size;
        _page = 1;
        await LoadData();
    }

    private Task GoToPage(int pageIndex) => OnPageChanged(pageIndex + 1);

    private Task GoPrevPage() => OnPageChanged(_page - 1);

    private Task GoNextPage() => OnPageChanged(_page + 1);

    private Task OnPageSizeChanged(ChangeEventArgs e)
        => int.TryParse(e.Value?.ToString(), out var size) && size > 0
            ? OnPageSizeChanged(size)
            : Task.CompletedTask;

    private static string GetStatusPill(RfqStatus s) => s switch
    {
        RfqStatus.Draft => "tm-pill tm-pill-purple",
        RfqStatus.Sent => "tm-pill tm-pill-blue",
        RfqStatus.Received => "tm-pill tm-pill-amber",
        RfqStatus.Awarded => "tm-pill tm-pill-green",
        RfqStatus.Closed => "tm-pill tm-pill-red",
        _ => "tm-pill tm-pill-blue"
    };
}

<MudDialog>

        <MudForm @ref="_form">

@* â”€â”€â”€ Supplier Detail Slider Panel (consistent with Global Search) â”€â”€â”€ *@
<SupplierViewPanel @ref="_supplierViewPanel" />

@code {
    private static class Col
    {
        public const string SupplierName = "SupplierName";
        public const string Email = "Email";
        public const string Phone = "Phone";
        public const string ContactPerson = "ContactPerson";
        public const string City = "City";
        public const string PaymentTerms = "PaymentTerms";
        public const string IsActive = "IsActive";
    }

    // â”€â”€â”€ List state â”€â”€â”€
    private PagedResultNew<SupplierDto> pagedResultNew = new();
    private SupplierPagedRequest pagedRequest = new()
    {
        SortColumn = Col.SupplierName,
        SortAscending = true
    };

    private List<string> _cities = new();
    private bool _loading = true;
    private bool _hasLoadedOnce;
    private bool _loadRunning;
    private bool _loadQueued;
    private CancellationTokenSource? _debounceCts;

    private SupplierViewPanel? _supplierViewPanel;

    private List<string> Cities => _cities;
    private string StatusValue => pagedRequest.IsActive switch
    {
        true => "active",
        false => "inactive",
        _ => ""
    };

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        try { _cities = await SupplierService.GetSupplierCitiesAsync(); } catch { }
        await LoadData();
    }

    private async Task Refresh() => await LoadData();

    /// <summary>
    /// Single-flight loader. The page and the services share one scoped DbContext, so two
    /// overlapping queries would throw "A second operation was started on this context
    /// instance". Callers that arrive mid-flight set a flag instead of starting a parallel
    /// query, and the running load then re-runs once with the newest filter state.
    /// </summary>
    private async Task LoadData()
    {
        if (_loadRunning)
        {
            _loadQueued = true;
            return;
        }

        _loadRunning = true;
        try
        {
            do
            {
                _loadQueued = false;
                await LoadDataCore();
            }
            while (_loadQueued);
        }
        finally { _loadRunning = false; }
    }

    private async Task LoadDataCore()
    {
        _loading = true;
        try
        {
            pagedResultNew = await SupplierService.GetSuppliersAsync(pagedRequest);
            _hasLoadedOnce = true;
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
        finally { _loading = false; }
    }

    // â”€â”€â”€ Stats / sorting helpers â”€â”€â”€
    private string TotalCountText => Stat("TotalCount");
    private string ActiveCountText => Stat("ActiveCount");
    private string InactiveCountText => Stat("InactiveCount");
    private string WithEmailCountText => Stat("WithEmailCount");
    private string AvgLeadTimeText => Stat("AverageLeadTime");
    private string AvgRatingText =>
        int.TryParse(Stat("AverageRating"), out var v) ? (v / 10m).ToString("0.0") : "0.0";

    private string Stat(string key) =>
        pagedResultNew.Stats != null && pagedResultNew.Stats.TryGetValue(key, out var v) ? v.ToString() : "0";

    private async Task SortBy(string column)
    {
        if (pagedRequest.SortColumn == column)
            pagedRequest.SortAscending = !pagedRequest.SortAscending;
        else
        {
            pagedRequest.SortColumn = column;
            pagedRequest.SortAscending = true;
        }
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await LoadData();
    }

    private string SortIcon(string column)
    {
        if (pagedRequest.SortColumn != column) return "";
        return pagedRequest.SortAscending ? "â–²" : "â–¼";
    }

    private async Task OpenCreate()
    {
        var parameters = new DialogParameters<SupplierDialog> { { x => x.Supplier, new SupplierDto() } };
        var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<SupplierDialog>("New Supplier", parameters,
            new DialogOptions { MaxWidth = MaxWidth.Medium, FullWidth = true, CloseButton = true });
        var result = await dialog.Result;
        if (result != null && !result.Canceled && result.Data is SupplierDto dto)
        {
            await SupplierService.CreateSupplierAsync(dto);
            Snackbar.Add("Supplier created", Severity.Success);
            await LoadData();
        }
    }

    private async Task OpenEdit(SupplierDto entity)
    {
        if (entity == null) return;

        var parameters = new DialogParameters<SupplierDialog> { { x => x.Supplier, entity } };
        var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<SupplierDialog>("Edit Supplier", parameters,
            new DialogOptions { MaxWidth = MaxWidth.Medium, FullWidth = true, CloseButton = true });
        var result = await dialog.Result;
        if (result != null && !result.Canceled && result.Data is SupplierDto updated)
        {
            await SupplierService.UpdateSupplierAsync(updated.Id, updated);
            Snackbar.Add("Supplier updated", Severity.Success);
            await LoadData();
        }
    }

    private async Task Delete(SupplierDto supplier)
    {
        var confirm = await DialogService.ShowMessageBoxAsync("Confirm", "Delete this supplier?", "Delete", "Cancel");
        if (confirm == true)
        {
            await SupplierService.DeleteSupplierAsync(supplier.Id);
            Snackbar.Add($" Supplier {supplier.SupplierName} deleted", Severity.Warning);
            await LoadData();
        }
    }

    private async Task ViewSupplier(Guid id)
    {
        if (_supplierViewPanel != null)
            await _supplierViewPanel.OpenAsync(id);
    }

    private static string GetStatusPill(PurchaseOrderStatus s) => s switch
    {
        PurchaseOrderStatus.Draft => "tm-pill tm-pill-purple",
        PurchaseOrderStatus.Submitted => "tm-pill tm-pill-blue",
        PurchaseOrderStatus.Approved => "tm-pill tm-pill-green",
        PurchaseOrderStatus.PartiallyReceived => "tm-pill tm-pill-amber",
        PurchaseOrderStatus.Received => "tm-pill tm-pill-teal",
        PurchaseOrderStatus.Closed => "tm-pill tm-pill-blue",
        PurchaseOrderStatus.Cancelled => "tm-pill tm-pill-red",
        _ => "tm-pill tm-pill-blue"
    };

    // â”€â”€â”€ Filters â”€â”€â”€
    private void OnSearchInput(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        pagedRequest.SearchTerm = e.Value?.ToString() ?? "";
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;

        _debounceCts?.Cancel();
        _debounceCts?.Dispose();
        _debounceCts = new CancellationTokenSource();
        var token = _debounceCts.Token;

        _ = Task.Run(async () =>
        {
            try
            {
                await Task.Delay(400, token);
                if (token.IsCancellationRequested) return;
                await InvokeAsync(async () =>
                {
                    await LoadData();
                    StateHasChanged();
                });
            }
            catch (OperationCanceledException) { }
        });
    }

    private async Task OnStatusChanged(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        pagedRequest.IsActive = e.Value?.ToString() switch
        {
            "active" => true,
            "inactive" => false,
            _ => null
        };
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await LoadData();
    }

    private async Task OnCityChanged(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        var v = e.Value?.ToString();
        pagedRequest.City = string.IsNullOrEmpty(v) ? null : v;
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await LoadData();
    }

    private async Task FilterByStatus(bool? isActive)
    {
        pagedRequest.IsActive = pagedRequest.IsActive == isActive ? null : isActive;
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await LoadData();
    }

    private async Task ResetFilters()
    {
        pagedRequest.SearchTerm = "";
        pagedRequest.IsActive = null;
        pagedRequest.City = null;
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await LoadData();
    }

    // â”€â”€â”€ Paging (zero-based, matches TmPager) â”€â”€â”€
    private async Task GoToPage(int page)
    {
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = Math.Clamp(page, 0, Math.Max(0, pagedResultNew.TotalPages - 1));
        await LoadData();
    }

    private async Task GoPrevPage()
    {
        if (pagedRequest.CurrentPage > 0)
        {
            pagedRequest.CurrentPage--;
            await LoadData();
        }
    }

    private async Task GoNextPage()
    {
        if (pagedRequest.CurrentPage < pagedResultNew.TotalPages - 1)
        {
            pagedRequest.CurrentPage++;
            await LoadData();
        }
    }

    private async Task OnPageSizeChanged(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        if (int.TryParse(e.Value?.ToString(), out var sz))
        {
            pagedRequest.PageSize = Math.Clamp(sz, 1, 100);
            pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
            await LoadData();
        }
    }

    private static string GetInitials(string? name)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(name)) return "?";
        var parts = name.Trim().Split(' ', StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
        return parts.Length == 1
            ? parts[0][..1].ToUpperInvariant()
            : (parts[0][..1] + parts[^1][..1]).ToUpperInvariant();
    }

    public void Dispose()
    {
        _debounceCts?.Cancel();
        _debounceCts?.Dispose();
    }
}

@code {
    private bool _open;
    private bool _animateIn;
    private bool _loading;
    private SupplierDto? _supplier;
    private List<PurchaseOrderDto> _recentOrders = new();
    private List<StatementInvoiceRowDto> _invoices = new();
    private List<StatementPaymentRowDto> _payments = new();
    private List<DebitNoteDto> _debitNotes = new();
    private List<PurchaseOrderItemDto> _purchaseItems = new();

    public async Task OpenAsync(Guid id)
    {
        _open = true;
        _loading = true;
        _animateIn = false;
        _supplier = null;
        _recentOrders = new();
        _debitNotes = new();
        StateHasChanged();

        await Task.Delay(20);
        _animateIn = true;
        StateHasChanged();

        try
        {
            _supplier = await SupplierService.GetSupplierByIdAsync(id);
            if (_supplier != null)
            {
                var history = await PurchaseService.GetPurchaseOrdersAsync(new PurchaseOrderPagedRequest
                {
                    SupplierId = id,
                    CurrentPage = 0,
                    PageSize = 100,
                    SortColumn = "PurchaseDate",
                    SortAscending = false
                });
                _recentOrders = history.Items;

                var statement = await AccountingService.GetSupplierStatement(id, new DateTime(2000, 1, 1), DateTime.UtcNow.AddDays(1));
                _invoices = statement.Invoices.OrderByDescending(i => i.InvoiceDate).ToList();
                _payments = statement.Payments.OrderByDescending(p => p.PaymentDate).ToList();

                _debitNotes = await CreditDebitNoteService.GetDebitNotesForSupplier(id);
                _debitNotes = _debitNotes.OrderByDescending(d => d.InvoiceNumber).ToList();

                _purchaseItems=await PurchaseService.GetPurchaseItemsOrderByCustomer(id);

            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error);
        }

        _loading = false;
        StateHasChanged();
    }

    public void Close()
    {
        _open = false;
        _animateIn = false;
        _supplier = null;
        _debitNotes = new();
        StateHasChanged();
    }

    private static Color GetNoteStatusColor(string status) => status switch
    {
        "Approved" => Color.Success,
        "Applied" => Color.Info,
        "Cancelled" => Color.Error,
        _ => Color.Default
    };

    private async Task DownloadPdf()
    {
        if (_supplier is null) return;
        try
        {
            var doc = await PrintRenderer.RenderSupplierAsync(_supplier, _recentOrders);
            await JS.InvokeVoidAsync("downloadFile", doc.Html, doc.FileName + ".pdf", doc.Title, doc.Reference);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            await JS.InvokeVoidAsync("alert", "Could not generate the PDF: " + ex.Message);
        }
    }

    private async Task PrintDoc()
    {
        if (_supplier is null) return;
        try
        {
            var doc = await PrintRenderer.RenderSupplierAsync(_supplier, _recentOrders);
            await JS.InvokeVoidAsync("printHtml", doc.Html, doc.Title, doc.Reference);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            await JS.InvokeVoidAsync("alert", "Could not print the document: " + ex.Message);
        }
    }
}

<MudTable Items="_allItems" Hover="true" Striped="true" Loading="_loading" Dense="true">

        <MudTh>Product</MudTh>

        <MudTd DataLabel="Class">
            <MudChip T="string" Color="@(context.Class == "A" ? Color.Success : context.Class == "B" ? Color.Warning : Color.Error)" Size="Size.Small">
                @context.Class
            </MudChip>
        </MudTd>
    </RowTemplate>
</MudTable>

@code {
    private record AbcRow(string ProductName, string SKU, decimal Revenue, decimal RevenuePercent, decimal CumulativePercent, string Class);

    private List<AbcRow> _allItems = new();
    private List<AbcRow> _aItems = new();
    private List<AbcRow> _bItems = new();
    private List<AbcRow> _cItems = new();
    private int _aPercent = 80;
    private int _bPercent = 15;
    private bool _loading;
    private bool _loaded;

    // Chart data
    private string[] _classLabels = { "Class A", "Class B", "Class C" };
    private double[] _classItemsData = [];
    private double[] _classRevenueData = [];
    private List<ChartSeries<double>> _classBarSeries = new();
    private string[] _paretoLabels = [];
    private List<ChartSeries<double>> _paretoSeries = new();

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync() => await LoadData();

    private async Task LoadData()
    {
        _loading = true;
        try
        {
            var items = await ReportsService.GetProductRevenueAsync();

            var totalRevenue = items.Sum(i => i.Revenue);
            if (totalRevenue == 0) totalRevenue = 1;

            decimal cumulative = 0;
            _allItems = items.Select(i =>
            {
                var pct = i.Revenue / totalRevenue * 100;
                cumulative += pct;
                var cls = cumulative <= _aPercent ? "A" : cumulative <= _aPercent + _bPercent ? "B" : "C";
                return new AbcRow(i.ProductName, i.SKU, i.Revenue, pct, cumulative, cls);
            }).ToList();

            _aItems = _allItems.Where(i => i.Class == "A").ToList();
            _bItems = _allItems.Where(i => i.Class == "B").ToList();
            _cItems = _allItems.Where(i => i.Class == "C").ToList();
            _loaded = true;

            // Class distribution charts
            _classItemsData = new double[] { _aItems.Count, _bItems.Count, _cItems.Count };
            _classRevenueData = new double[] { (double)_aItems.Sum(i => i.Revenue), (double)_bItems.Sum(i => i.Revenue), (double)_cItems.Sum(i => i.Revenue) };
            _classBarSeries = new List<ChartSeries<double>>
            {
                new() { Name = "Items", Data = _classItemsData },
                new() { Name = "Revenue ($K)", Data = new double[] {
                    (double)_aItems.Sum(i => i.Revenue) / 1000,
                    (double)_bItems.Sum(i => i.Revenue) / 1000,
                    (double)_cItems.Sum(i => i.Revenue) / 1000 } }
            };

            // Pareto curve
            var step = Math.Max(1, _allItems.Count / 20);
            var paretoItems = _allItems.Where((_, idx) => idx % step == 0 || idx == _allItems.Count - 1).ToList();
            _paretoLabels = paretoItems.Select((_, idx) => $"{(idx * step + 1)}").ToArray();
            _paretoSeries = new List<ChartSeries<double>>
            {
                new() { Name = "Cumulative %", Data = paretoItems.Select(i => (double)i.CumulativePercent).ToArray() }
            };
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
        finally { _loading = false; }
    }
}

        <MudTd DataLabel="Last Movement">@(context.LastMovementDate?.ToShortDateString() ?? "Never")</MudTd>
        <MudTd DataLabel="Days Idle" Style="text-align:right">
            <MudChip T="string" Size="Size.Small" Color="@(context.DaysSinceLastMovement > 180 ? Color.Error : Color.Warning)">
                @context.DaysSinceLastMovement days
            </MudChip>
        </MudTd>

@code {
    private List<DeadStockItemDto> _items = new();
    private int _daysThreshold = 90;
    private bool _loading;

    // Chart data
    private string[] _whLabels = [];
    private double[] _whData = [];
    private string[] _ageBucketLabels = [];
    private double[] _ageBucketData = [];
    private string[] _topDeadLabels = [];
    private List<ChartSeries<double>> _topDeadSeries = new();

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync() => await LoadData();

    private async Task LoadData()
    {
        _loading = true;
        try
        {
            _items = await ReportsService.GetDeadStockAsync(_daysThreshold);

            // Warehouse donut
            var whGroups = _items.GroupBy(i => i.WarehouseName).ToList();
            _whLabels = whGroups.Select(g => g.Key).ToArray();
            _whData = whGroups.Select(g => (double)g.Sum(i => i.Value)).ToArray();

            // Age bucket pie
            var buckets = new[] {
                ("90-180 days", _items.Where(i => i.DaysSinceLastMovement >= 90 && i.DaysSinceLastMovement < 180).Count()),
                ("180-365 days", _items.Where(i => i.DaysSinceLastMovement >= 180 && i.DaysSinceLastMovement < 365).Count()),
                ("365+ days", _items.Where(i => i.DaysSinceLastMovement >= 365).Count())
            }.Where(b => b.Item2 > 0).ToList();
            _ageBucketLabels = buckets.Select(b => b.Item1).ToArray();
            _ageBucketData = buckets.Select(b => (double)b.Item2).ToArray();

            // Top dead stock bar
            var topDead = _items.OrderByDescending(i => i.Value).Take(8).ToList();
            _topDeadLabels = topDead.Select(i => i.ProductName.Length > 12 ? i.ProductName[..12] + ".." : i.ProductName).ToArray();
            _topDeadSeries = new List<ChartSeries<double>>
            {
                new() { Name = "Value", Data = topDead.Select(i => (double)i.Value).ToArray() }
            };
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
        finally { _loading = false; }
    }
}

                    <MudChart T=double ChartType="ChartType.Bar" ChartSeries="@_topCostSeries"
                              XAxisLabels="@_topCostLabels" Width="100%" Height="300px" />
                </MudPaper>
            </MudItem>
        }
        @if (_costBreakdownLabels.Length > 0)
        {
            <MudItem xs="12" md="6">
                <MudPaper Class="pa-4" Elevation="3">
                    <MudText Typo="Typo.h6" Class="mb-2">Cost Breakdown (Top 8 Products)</MudText>
                    <MudChart T=double ChartType="ChartType.Donut" InputData="@_costBreakdownData"
                              InputLabels="@_costBreakdownLabels" Width="100%" Height="300px" />
                </MudPaper>
            </MudItem>
        }
    </MudGrid>
}

<MudTable Items="_rows" Hover="true" Striped="true" Loading="_loading" Dense="true">
    <HeaderContent>
        <MudTh>Product</MudTh>
        <MudTh>SKU</MudTh>
        <MudTh Style="text-align:right">Total Qty</MudTh>
        <MudTh Style="text-align:right">Unit Cost</MudTh>
        <MudTh Style="text-align:right">Total Value</MudTh>
        <MudTh Style="text-align:right">Landed Cost</MudTh>
        <MudTh Style="text-align:right">Effective Cost</MudTh>
    </HeaderContent>
    <RowTemplate>
        <MudTd>@context.ProductName</MudTd>
        <MudTd>@context.SKU</MudTd>
        <MudTd Style="text-align:right">@context.TotalQty</MudTd>
        <MudTd Style="text-align:right">@Taka.H(context.UnitCost)</MudTd>
        <MudTd Style="text-align:right">@Taka.H(context.TotalValue)</MudTd>
        <MudTd Style="text-align:right">@Taka.H(context.LandedCost)</MudTd>
        <MudTd Style="text-align:right">@Taka.H(context.EffectiveCost)</MudTd>
    </RowTemplate>
</MudTable>

@code {
    private record CostingRow(string ProductName, string SKU, int TotalQty, decimal UnitCost, decimal TotalValue, decimal LandedCost, decimal EffectiveCost);

    private List<CostingRow> _rows = new();
    private string _costingMethod = "WeightedAverage";
    private bool _loading;

    // Chart data
    private string[] _topCostLabels = [];
    private List<ChartSeries<double>> _topCostSeries = new();
    private string[] _costBreakdownLabels = [];
    private double[] _costBreakdownData = [];

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync() => await LoadData();

    private async Task LoadData()
    {
        _loading = true;
        try
        {
            var inventories = await ReportsService.GetInventoryCostingRowsAsync();

            var allocations = await LandedCostService.GetAllocations(null);
            var landedByPo = allocations.GroupBy(a => a.PurchaseOrderId)
                .ToDictionary(g => g.Key ?? Guid.Empty, g => g.Sum(a => a.Amount));

            var totalLanded = landedByPo.Values.Sum();
            var totalInventoryValue = inventories.Sum(i => i.TotalQuantity * i.UnitCost);

            _rows = inventories.Select(i =>
            {
                var value = i.TotalQuantity * i.UnitCost;
                var landedShare = totalInventoryValue > 0 ? totalLanded * (value / totalInventoryValue) : 0;
                var effectiveCost = i.TotalQuantity > 0 ? (value + landedShare) / i.TotalQuantity : i.UnitCost;
                return new CostingRow(i.ProductName, i.SKU, i.TotalQuantity, i.UnitCost, value, landedShare, effectiveCost);
            })
            .OrderByDescending(r => r.TotalValue)
            .ToList();

            // Top products bar chart
            var topCost = _rows.Take(10).ToList();
            _topCostLabels = topCost.Select(r => r.ProductName.Length > 12 ? r.ProductName[..12] + ".." : r.ProductName).ToArray();
            _topCostSeries = new List<ChartSeries<double>>
            {
                new() { Name = "Inventory Value", Data = topCost.Select(r => (double)r.TotalValue).ToArray() },
                new() { Name = "Landed Cost", Data = topCost.Select(r => (double)r.LandedCost).ToArray() }
            };

            // Cost breakdown donut
            var topBreakdown = _rows.Take(8).ToList();
            _costBreakdownLabels = topBreakdown.Select(r => r.ProductName.Length > 15 ? r.ProductName[..15] + ".." : r.ProductName).ToArray();
            _costBreakdownData = topBreakdown.Select(r => (double)(r.TotalValue + r.LandedCost)).ToArray();
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
        finally { _loading = false; }
    }
}

@code {
    private record StockRow(string ProductName, string SKU, string WarehouseName, int Quantity, int Reserved, int Available, decimal Value);
    private record ValuationRow(string ProductName, string SKU, int TotalQty, decimal CostPrice, decimal TotalValue);

    private string _reportType = "StockLevel";
    private Guid? _warehouseId;
    private List<WarehouseDto> _warehouses = new();
    private List<StockRow> _stockTotals = new();
    private List<StockMovementReportRowDto> _movements = new();
    private List<ValuationRow> _valuationRows = new();
    private bool _loading;

    // Chart data - Stock Level
    private string[] _whStockLabels = [];
    private double[] _whStockData = [];
    private string[] _topValueLabels = [];
    private List<ChartSeries<double>> _topValueSeries = new();

    // Chart data - Movements
    private string[] _movementTypeLabels = [];
    private double[] _movementTypeData = [];
    private string[] _movementTrendLabels = [];
    private List<ChartSeries<double>> _movementTrendSeries = new();

    // Chart data - Valuation
    private string[] _valChartLabels = [];
    private List<ChartSeries<double>> _valChartSeries = new();

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        _warehouses = await WarehousesService.GetActiveWarehousesAsync();
        await LoadData();
    }

    private async Task LoadData()
    {
        _loading = true;
        try
        {
            var report = await ReportsService.GetInventoryReportAsync(_reportType, _warehouseId);

            if (_reportType == "StockLevel")
            {
                _stockTotals = report.Stock
                    .Select(s => new StockRow(
                        s.ProductName, s.SKU, s.WarehouseName,
                        s.Quantity, s.Reserved, s.Available, s.Value))
                    .ToList();

                // Warehouse donut chart
                var whGroups = _stockTotals.GroupBy(s => s.WarehouseName).ToList();
                _whStockLabels = whGroups.Select(g => g.Key).ToArray();
                _whStockData = whGroups.Select(g => (double)g.Sum(s => s.Quantity)).ToArray();

                // Top products by value bar chart
                var topVal = _stockTotals.OrderByDescending(s => s.Value).Take(10).ToList();
                _topValueLabels = topVal.Select(s => s.ProductName.Length > 12 ? s.ProductName[..12] + ".." : s.ProductName).ToArray();
                _topValueSeries = new List<ChartSeries<double>>
                {
                    new() { Name = "Value", Data = topVal.Select(s => (double)s.Value).ToArray() }
                };
            }
            else if (_reportType == "Movements")
            {
                _movements = report.Movements;

                // Movement type pie
                var typeGroups = _movements.GroupBy(m => m.MovementType).ToList();
                _movementTypeLabels = typeGroups.Select(g => g.Key.ToString()).ToArray();
                _movementTypeData = typeGroups.Select(g => (double)g.Count()).ToArray();

                // Movement trend line
                var trendGroups = _movements.GroupBy(m => m.MovementDate.Date).OrderBy(g => g.Key).ToList();
                _movementTrendLabels = trendGroups.Select(g => g.Key.ToString("MMM dd")).ToArray();
                _movementTrendSeries = new List<ChartSeries<double>>
                {
                    new() { Name = "Movements", Data = trendGroups.Select(g => (double)g.Sum(m => Math.Abs(m.Quantity))).ToArray() }
                };
            }
            else
            {
                _valuationRows = report.Valuation
                    .Select(v => new ValuationRow(v.ProductName, v.SKU, v.TotalQuantity, v.CostPrice, v.TotalValue))
                    .ToList();

                // Valuation bar chart
                var topValuation = _valuationRows.Take(10).ToList();
                _valChartLabels = topValuation.Select(v => v.ProductName.Length > 12 ? v.ProductName[..12] + ".." : v.ProductName).ToArray();
                _valChartSeries = new List<ChartSeries<double>>
                {
                    new() { Name = "Total Value", Data = topValuation.Select(v => (double)v.TotalValue).ToArray() }
                };
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
        finally { _loading = false; }
    }
}

@code {
    private DateTime? _from = DateTime.Today.AddMonths(-1);
    private DateTime? _to = DateTime.Today;
    private string _reportType = "Summary";
    private bool _summaryLoaded;
    private bool _loading;

    // KPIs
    private int _totalOrders;
    private decimal _totalRevenue;
    private int _totalItemsSold;
    private decimal _totalInvoiced;
    private decimal _totalCollected;
    private int _cancelledOrders;

    // Table data
    private List<CustomerSalesRow> _customerData = new();
    private List<ProductSalesRow> _productData = new();
    private List<RecentOrderRow> _recentOrders = new();

    // Chart data
    private string[] _dailySalesLabels = [];
    private List<ChartSeries<double>> _dailySalesSeries = new();
    private double[] _customerChartData = [];
    private string[] _customerChartLabels = [];
    private string[] _productChartLabels = [];
    private List<ChartSeries<double>> _productChartSeries = new();
    private double[] _statusChartData = [];
    private string[] _statusChartLabels = [];
    private string[] _monthlyBarLabels = [];
    private List<ChartSeries<double>> _monthlyBarSeries = new();
    private double[] _paymentMethodData = [];
    private string[] _paymentMethodLabels = [];

    private record CustomerSalesRow(string Name, int OrderCount, decimal Revenue, decimal Invoiced, decimal Collected, decimal Outstanding);
    private record ProductSalesRow(string ProductName, decimal Revenue, int UnitsSold, decimal TaxAmount);
    private record RecentOrderRow(string OrderNumber, DateTime OrderDate, string CustomerName, string Status, decimal TotalAmount);

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync() => await LoadData();

    private async Task LoadData()
    {
        _loading = true;
        try
        {
            var fromDate = _from ?? DateTime.Today.AddMonths(-1);
            var toDate = (_to ?? DateTime.Today).AddDays(1);

            var report = await ReportsService.GetSalesReportAsync(fromDate, toDate);
            var orders = report.Orders;
            var invoices = report.Invoices;
            var payments = report.Payments;

            // â”€â”€ KPIs â”€â”€
            _totalOrders = orders.Count;
            _totalRevenue = orders.Sum(o => o.TotalAmount);
            _totalItemsSold = orders.SelectMany(o => o.Items).Sum(i => i.Quantity);
            _totalInvoiced = invoices.Sum(i => i.TotalAmount);
            _totalCollected = payments.Sum(p => p.Amount);
            _cancelledOrders = orders.Count(o => o.Status == OrderStatus.Cancelled);
            _summaryLoaded = true;

            // â”€â”€ Customer breakdown (orders + invoices + payments) â”€â”€
            var invByCustomer = invoices.Where(i => i.CustomerId.HasValue)
                .GroupBy(i => i.CustomerName)
                .ToDictionary(g => g.Key, g => g.Sum(i => i.TotalAmount));

            var paidByCustomer = payments.Where(p => p.CustomerId.HasValue)
                .GroupBy(p => p.CustomerId!.Value)
                .ToDictionary(g => g.Key, g => g.Sum(p => p.Amount));

            // Build a customer-name-to-id lookup from invoices
            var custNameIdMap = invoices.Where(i => i.CustomerId.HasValue)
                .Select(i => new { i.CustomerName, CustomerId = i.CustomerId!.Value })
                .DistinctBy(x => x.CustomerName)
                .ToDictionary(x => x.CustomerName, x => x.CustomerId);

            _customerData = orders.GroupBy(o => o.CustomerName)
                .Select(g =>
                {
                    var custName = g.Key;
                    var invoiced = invByCustomer.GetValueOrDefault(custName, 0m);
                    var custId = custNameIdMap.GetValueOrDefault(custName);
                    var collected = custId != Guid.Empty ? paidByCustomer.GetValueOrDefault(custId, 0m) : 0m;
                    return new CustomerSalesRow(custName, g.Count(), g.Sum(o => o.TotalAmount), invoiced, collected, invoiced - collected);
                })
                .OrderByDescending(c => c.Revenue)
                .ToList();

            // â”€â”€ Product breakdown â”€â”€
            _productData = orders.SelectMany(o => o.Items)
                .GroupBy(i => i.ProductName)
                .Select(g => new ProductSalesRow(g.Key, g.Sum(i => i.LineTotalPrice), g.Sum(i => i.Quantity), 0))
                .OrderByDescending(p => p.Revenue)
                .ToList();

            // â”€â”€ Recent orders â”€â”€
            _recentOrders = orders.OrderByDescending(o => o.OrderDate).Take(20)
                .Select(o => new RecentOrderRow(o.OrderNumber, o.OrderDate, o.CustomerName, o.Status.ToString(), o.TotalAmount))
                .ToList();

            BuildChartData(orders, invoices, payments);
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
        finally { _loading = false; }
    }

    private void BuildChartData(List<SalesReportOrderDto> orders, List<SalesReportInvoiceDto> invoices, List<SalesReportPaymentDto> payments)
    {
        // â”€â”€ Daily sales trend (line) â”€â”€
        var dailyGroups = orders.GroupBy(o => o.OrderDate.Date).OrderBy(g => g.Key).ToList();
        int step = Math.Max(1, dailyGroups.Count / 25);
        var sampled = dailyGroups.Where((_, i) => i % step == 0 || i == dailyGroups.Count - 1).ToList();
        _dailySalesLabels = sampled.Select(g => g.Key.ToString("MMM dd")).ToArray();
        _dailySalesSeries = new List<ChartSeries<double>>
        {
            new() { Name = "Revenue", Data = sampled.Select(g => (double)g.Sum(o => o.TotalAmount)).ToArray() },
            new() { Name = "Orders", Data = sampled.Select(g => (double)g.Count()).ToArray() }
        };

        // â”€â”€ Orders by status (donut) â”€â”€
        var statusGroups = orders.GroupBy(o => o.Status).Where(g => g.Any()).ToList();
        _statusChartLabels = statusGroups.Select(g => g.Key.ToString()).ToArray();
        _statusChartData = statusGroups.Select(g => (double)g.Count()).ToArray();

        // â”€â”€ Customer donut â”€â”€
        var topCustomers = _customerData.Take(8).ToList();
        _customerChartLabels = topCustomers.Select(c => c.Name.Length > 12 ? c.Name[..12] + ".." : c.Name).ToArray();
        _customerChartData = topCustomers.Select(c => (double)c.Revenue).ToArray();

        // â”€â”€ Product bar chart â”€â”€
        var topProducts = _productData.Take(10).ToList();
        _productChartLabels = topProducts.Select(p => p.ProductName.Length > 12 ? p.ProductName[..12] + ".." : p.ProductName).ToArray();
        _productChartSeries = new List<ChartSeries<double>>
        {
            new() { Name = "Revenue", Data = topProducts.Select(p => (double)p.Revenue).ToArray() },
            new() { Name = "Units Sold", Data = topProducts.Select(p => (double)p.UnitsSold).ToArray() }
        };

        // â”€â”€ Monthly revenue & collection (bar) â”€â”€
        var monthlyOrders = orders.GroupBy(o => new { o.OrderDate.Year, o.OrderDate.Month }).OrderBy(g => g.Key.Year).ThenBy(g => g.Key.Month).ToList();
        var monthlyInv = invoices.GroupBy(i => new { i.InvoiceDate.Year, i.InvoiceDate.Month }).ToDictionary(g => g.Key, g => g.Sum(i => i.TotalAmount));
        var monthlyPay = payments.GroupBy(p => new { p.PaymentDate.Year, p.PaymentDate.Month }).ToDictionary(g => g.Key, g => g.Sum(p => p.Amount));

        _monthlyBarLabels = monthlyOrders.Select(g => new DateTime(g.Key.Year, g.Key.Month, 1).ToString("MMM yy")).ToArray();
        _monthlyBarSeries = new List<ChartSeries<double>>
        {
            new() { Name = "Revenue", Data = monthlyOrders.Select(g => (double)g.Sum(o => o.TotalAmount)).ToArray() },
            new() { Name = "Invoiced", Data = monthlyOrders.Select(g => (double)monthlyInv.GetValueOrDefault(new { g.Key.Year, g.Key.Month }, 0m)).ToArray() },
            new() { Name = "Collected", Data = monthlyOrders.Select(g => (double)monthlyPay.GetValueOrDefault(new { g.Key.Year, g.Key.Month }, 0m)).ToArray() }
        };

        // â”€â”€ Payments by method (pie) â”€â”€
        var methodGroups = payments.GroupBy(p => p.PaymentMethod).Where(g => g.Any()).ToList();
        _paymentMethodLabels = methodGroups.Select(g => g.Key.ToString()).ToArray();
        _paymentMethodData = methodGroups.Select(g => (double)g.Sum(p => p.Amount)).ToArray();
    }

 
}

@code {
    private DateTime? _fromDate = DateTime.Today.AddMonths(-3);
    private DateTime? _toDate = DateTime.Today;
    private decimal _outputTax, _inputTax, _netTax;
    private List<TaxRateRow> _taxByRate = new();
    private bool _loading = true;

    // Chart data
    private List<ChartSeries<double>> _taxComparisonSeries = new();
    private string[] _taxCompLabels = { "Output Tax", "Input Tax", "Net Liability" };
    private double[] _taxRateChartData = [];
    private string[] _taxRateChartLabels = [];
    private string[] _monthlyTaxLabels = [];
    private List<ChartSeries<double>> _monthlyTaxSeries = new();

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync() => await Load();

    private async Task Load()
    {
        _loading = true;
        var from = _fromDate ?? DateTime.Today.AddMonths(-3);
        var to = _toDate ?? DateTime.Today;

        var report = await ReportsService.GetTaxReportAsync(from, to);

        _outputTax = report.OutputTax;
        _inputTax = report.InputTax;
        _netTax = report.NetTax;

        _taxByRate = report.TaxRates
            .Select(t => new TaxRateRow
            {
                TaxName = t.TaxName,
                Rate = t.Rate,
                TaxableAmount = 0,
                TaxAmount = 0
            }).ToList();

        // Tax comparison bar
        _taxComparisonSeries = new List<ChartSeries<double>>
        {
            new() { Name = "Amount", Data = new double[] { (double)_outputTax, (double)_inputTax, (double)Math.Abs(_netTax) } }
        };

        // Tax by rate donut
        if (_taxByRate.Any())
        {
            _taxRateChartLabels = _taxByRate.Select(t => $"{t.TaxName} ({t.Rate}%)").ToArray();
            _taxRateChartData = _taxByRate.Select(t => (double)t.Rate).ToArray();
        }

        // Monthly tax trend
        if (report.Periods.Count > 1)
        {
            _monthlyTaxLabels = report.Periods.Select(m => m.Period.ToString("MMM yy")).ToArray();
            _monthlyTaxSeries = new List<ChartSeries<double>>
            {
                new() { Name = "Output Tax", Data = report.Periods.Select(m => (double)m.OutputTax).ToArray() },
                new() { Name = "Input Tax", Data = report.Periods.Select(m => (double)m.InputTax).ToArray() }
            };
        }

        _loading = false;
    }

    private class TaxRateRow
    {
        public string TaxName { get; set; } = "";
        public decimal Rate { get; set; }
        public decimal TaxableAmount { get; set; }
        public decimal TaxAmount { get; set; }
    }
}

<MudDialog>

                    <MudTextField @bind-Value="Customer.CustomerEmail" Label="Customer Email" InputType="InputType.Email" ShrinkLabel="true" Variant="Variant.Outlined" Margin="Margin.Dense" class="mb-5" />
                    <MudTextField @bind-Value="Customer.CustomerPhone" Label="Customer Phone" AdornmentAriaLabel="Phone" ShrinkLabel="true" Variant="Variant.Outlined" Margin="Margin.Dense" />
                </MudItem>
                <MudItem xs="12" sm="6" class="d-flex column-gap-3 flex-column">
