@code {
    private static class Col
    {
        public const string CustomerName = "CustomerName";
        public const string Email = "Email";
        public const string Phone = "Phone";
        public const string ContactPerson = "ContactPerson";
        public const string City = "City";
        public const string CreditLimit = "CreditLimit";
        public const string PaymentTerms = "PaymentTerms";
        public const string IsActive = "IsActive";
    }

    // â”€â”€â”€ List state â”€â”€â”€
    private PagedResultNew<CustomerDto> pagedResultNew = new();
    private CustomerPagedRequest pagedRequest = new()
    {
        SortColumn = Col.CustomerName,
        SortAscending = true
    };

    private List<string> _cities = new();
    private bool _loading = true;
    private bool _hasLoadedOnce;
    private bool _loadRunning;
    private bool _loadQueued;
    private CancellationTokenSource? _debounceCts;

    private CustomerViewPanel? _customerViewPanel;

    private List<string> Cities => _cities;
    private string StatusValue => pagedRequest.IsActive switch
    {
        true => "active",
        false => "inactive",
        _ => ""
    };

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        try { _cities = await CustomerService.GetCustomerCitiesAsync(); } catch { }
        await LoadData();
    }

    private async Task Refresh() => await LoadData();

    /// <summary>
    /// Single-flight loader. The page and the services share one scoped DbContext, so two
    /// overlapping queries would throw "A second operation was started on this context
    /// instance". Callers that arrive mid-flight set a flag instead of starting a parallel
    /// query, and the running load then re-runs once with the newest filter state.
    /// </summary>
    private async Task LoadData()
    {
        if (_loadRunning)
        {
            _loadQueued = true;
            return;
        }

        _loadRunning = true;
        try
        {
            do
            {
                _loadQueued = false;
                await LoadDataCore();
            }
            while (_loadQueued);
        }
        finally { _loadRunning = false; }
    }

    private async Task LoadDataCore()
    {
        _loading = true;
        try
        {
            pagedResultNew = await CustomerService.GetCustomersAsync(pagedRequest);
            _hasLoadedOnce = true;
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
        finally { _loading = false; }
    }

    // â”€â”€â”€ Stats / sorting helpers â”€â”€â”€
    private string TotalCountText => Stat("TotalCount");
    private string ActiveCountText => Stat("ActiveCount");
    private string InactiveCountText => Stat("InactiveCount");
    private string TaxExemptCountText => Stat("TaxExemptCount");
    private string CityCountText => Stat("CityCount");
    private string TotalCreditLimitText =>
        int.TryParse(Stat("TotalCreditLimit"), out var v) ? v.ToString("N0") : "0";

    private string Stat(string key) =>
        pagedResultNew.Stats != null && pagedResultNew.Stats.TryGetValue(key, out var v) ? v.ToString() : "0";

    private void SortBy(string column)
    {
        if (pagedRequest.SortColumn == column)
            pagedRequest.SortAscending = !pagedRequest.SortAscending;
        else
        {
            pagedRequest.SortColumn = column;
            pagedRequest.SortAscending = true;
        }
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
    }

    private string SortIcon(string column)
    {
        if (pagedRequest.SortColumn != column) return "";
        return pagedRequest.SortAscending ? "â–²" : "â–¼";
    }

    private static string GetInitials(string? name)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(name)) return "?";
        var parts = name.Trim().Split(' ', StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
        return parts.Length == 1
            ? parts[0][..1].ToUpperInvariant()
            : (parts[0][..1] + parts[^1][..1]).ToUpperInvariant();
    }

    private static string GetAvatarBg(string? name)
    {
        var palettes = new[] { "#e0e9ff", "#fee2e2", "#dcfce7", "#ede9fe", "#ffedd5", "#e0f2fe", "#fef9c3" };
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(name)) return palettes[0];
        return palettes[Math.Abs(name.GetHashCode()) % palettes.Length];
    }

    // â”€â”€â”€ Filters â”€â”€â”€
    private void OnSearchInput(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        pagedRequest.SearchTerm = e.Value?.ToString() ?? "";
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;

        _debounceCts?.Cancel();
        _debounceCts?.Dispose();
        _debounceCts = new CancellationTokenSource();
        var token = _debounceCts.Token;

        _ = Task.Run(async () =>
        {
            try
            {
                await Task.Delay(400, token);
                if (token.IsCancellationRequested) return;
                await InvokeAsync(async () =>
                {
                    await LoadData();
                    StateHasChanged();
                });
            }
            catch (OperationCanceledException) { }
        });
    }

    private async Task OnStatusChanged(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        pagedRequest.IsActive = e.Value?.ToString() switch
        {
            "active" => true,
            "inactive" => false,
            _ => null
        };
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await LoadData();
    }

    private async Task OnCityChanged(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        var v = e.Value?.ToString();
        pagedRequest.City = string.IsNullOrEmpty(v) ? null : v;
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await LoadData();
    }

    private async Task FilterByStatus(bool? isActive)
    {
        pagedRequest.IsActive = pagedRequest.IsActive == isActive ? null : isActive;
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await LoadData();
    }

    private async Task ResetFilters()
    {
        pagedRequest.SearchTerm = "";
        pagedRequest.IsActive = null;
        pagedRequest.City = null;
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await LoadData();
    }

    // â”€â”€â”€ Paging (zero-based, matches TmPager) â”€â”€â”€
    private async Task GoToPage(int page)
    {
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = Math.Clamp(page, 0, Math.Max(0, pagedResultNew.TotalPages - 1));
        await LoadData();
    }

    private async Task GoPrevPage()
    {
        if (pagedRequest.CurrentPage > 0)
        {
            pagedRequest.CurrentPage--;
            await LoadData();
        }
    }

    private async Task GoNextPage()
    {
        if (pagedRequest.CurrentPage < pagedResultNew.TotalPages - 1)
        {
            pagedRequest.CurrentPage++;
            await LoadData();
        }
    }

    private async Task OnPageSizeChanged(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        if (int.TryParse(e.Value?.ToString(), out var sz))
        {
            pagedRequest.PageSize = Math.Clamp(sz, 1, 100);
            pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
            await LoadData();
        }
    }

    private async Task OpenCreate()
    {
        var parameters = new DialogParameters<CustomerDialog> { { x => x.Customer, new CustomerDto() } };
        var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<CustomerDialog>("New Customer", parameters,
            new DialogOptions { MaxWidth = MaxWidth.Medium, FullWidth = true, CloseButton = true });
        var result = await dialog.Result;
        if (result != null && !result.Canceled && result.Data is CustomerDto dto)
        {
            await CustomerService.CreateCustomerAsync(dto);
            Snackbar.Add("Customer created", Severity.Success);
            await LoadData();
        }
    }

    private async Task OpenEdit(CustomerDto entity)
    {
        if (entity == null) return;

        var parameters = new DialogParameters<CustomerDialog> { { x => x.Customer, entity } };
        var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<CustomerDialog>("Edit Customer", parameters,
            new DialogOptions { MaxWidth = MaxWidth.Medium, FullWidth = true, CloseButton = true });
        var result = await dialog.Result;
        if (result != null && !result.Canceled && result.Data is CustomerDto updated)
        {
            await CustomerService.UpdateCustomerAsync(updated.Id, updated);
            Snackbar.Add("Customer updated", Severity.Success);
            await LoadData();
        }
    }

    private async Task Delete(CustomerDto entity)
    {
        var confirm = await DialogService.ShowMessageBoxAsync("Confirm", "Delete this customer?", "Delete", "Cancel");
        if (confirm == true)
        {
            await CustomerService.DeleteCustomerAsync(entity.Id);
            Snackbar.Add($"Customer {entity.CustomerName} deleted", Severity.Warning);
            await LoadData();
        }
    }

    private async Task ViewCustomer(Guid id)
    {
        if (_customerViewPanel != null)
            await _customerViewPanel.OpenAsync(id);
    }

    public void Dispose()
    {
        _debounceCts?.Cancel();
        _debounceCts?.Dispose();
    }
}

@code {
    private bool _open;
    private bool _animateIn;
    private bool _loading;
    private CustomerDto? _customer;
    private List<SalesOrderDto> _recentOrders = new();
    private List<StatementInvoiceRowDto> _invoices = new();
    private List<StatementPaymentRowDto> _payments = new();
    private List<CreditNoteDto> _creditNotes = new();
    private List<SalesOrderItemDto> _salesItems = new();

    // private decimal _historyTotal;
    // private decimal _historyPaid;
    // private decimal _historyDue;
    private decimal _outstanding;

    public async Task OpenAsync(Guid id)
    {
        _open = true;
        _loading = true;
        _animateIn = false;
        _customer = null;
        _recentOrders = new();
        _invoices = new();
        _payments = new();
        _creditNotes = new();
        _outstanding = 0;
        StateHasChanged();

        await Task.Delay(20);
        _animateIn = true;
        StateHasChanged();

        try
        {
            _customer = await CustomerService.GetCustomerByIdAsync(id);
            if (_customer != null)
            {
                var history = await SalesServices.GetSalesOrdersAsync(new SalesPagedRequest
                {
                    CustomerId = id,
                    CurrentPage = 0,
                    PageSize = 10000,
                    SortColumn = "OrderDate",
                    SortAscending = false
                });
                _recentOrders = history.Items; 
                _recentOrders = _recentOrders.OrderBy(o => o.OrderNumber).ToList();
                _outstanding = _recentOrders.Sum(o => o.DueAmount);                
       
                var statement = await AccountingService.GetCustomerStatement(id, new DateTime(2000, 1, 1), DateTime.UtcNow.AddDays(1));
                _invoices = statement.Invoices.OrderByDescending(i => i.InvoiceDate).ToList();
                _payments = statement.Payments.OrderByDescending(p => p.PaymentDate).ToList();

                _creditNotes = await CreditDebitNoteService.GetCreditNotesForCustomer(id);
                _creditNotes = _creditNotes.OrderByDescending(c => c.InvoiceNumber).ToList();

                _salesItems = await SalesServices.GetSalesItemsOrderByCustomer(id);

            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error);
        }

        _loading = false;
        StateHasChanged();
    }

    public void Close()
    {
        _open = false;
        _animateIn = false;
        _customer = null;
        _creditNotes = new();
        StateHasChanged();
    }

    private async Task DownloadPdf()
    {
        if (_customer is null) return;
        try
        {
            var doc = await PrintRenderer.RenderCustomerAsync(_customer, _outstanding, _recentOrders, _invoices);
            await JS.InvokeVoidAsync("downloadFile", doc.Html, doc.FileName + ".pdf", doc.Title, doc.Reference);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            await JS.InvokeVoidAsync("alert", "Could not generate the PDF: " + ex.Message);
        }
    }

    private async Task PrintDoc()
    {
        if (_customer is null) return;
        try
        {
            var doc = await PrintRenderer.RenderCustomerAsync(_customer, _outstanding, _recentOrders, _invoices);
            await JS.InvokeVoidAsync("printHtml", doc.Html, doc.Title, doc.Reference);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            await JS.InvokeVoidAsync("alert", "Could not print the document: " + ex.Message);
        }
    }
}

@code {
    private static class Col
    {
        public const string OrderNumber = "OrderNumber";
        public const string OrderDate = "OrderDate";
        public const string Customer = "Customer";
        public const string Branch = "Branch";
        public const string TotalAmount = "TotalAmount";
        public const string DueAmount = "DueAmount";
        public const string Status = "Status";
    }

    private readonly List<OrderStatus> OrderStatuses = Enum.GetValues<OrderStatus>().ToList();

    // â”€â”€â”€ List state â”€â”€â”€
    private PagedResultNew<SalesOrderDto> pagedResultNew = new();
    private SalesPagedRequest pagedRequest = new()
    {
        SortColumn = Col.OrderDate,
        SortAscending = false
    };

    private List<CustomerDto> _customers = new();
    private List<BranchDto> _branches = new();
    private bool _loading = true;
    private bool _hasLoadedOnce;
    private bool _loadRunning;
    private bool _loadQueued;
    private decimal _pageValue;
    private CancellationTokenSource? _debounceCts;

    // â”€â”€â”€ Drawer state â”€â”€â”€
    private bool _drawerOpen;
    private string _drawerTitle = "";
    private SalesOrderDto? _viewOrder;

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        // These two lookups used bare `catch { }` blocks, so a failed query left the customer/branch
        // dropdowns silently empty and read as "no customers exist". Surface the failure instead.
        try
        {
            _customers = await CustomerService.GetActiveCustomersAsync();
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Logger.LogError(ex, "Failed to load active customers for the order filter");
            Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error);
        }

        try
        {
            _branches = await BranchService.GetActiveBranchesAsync();
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Logger.LogError(ex, "Failed to load active branches for the order filter");
            Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error);
        }

        await LoadOrders();
    }

    private async Task Refresh() => await LoadOrders();

    /// <summary>
    /// Single-flight loader. The page and the services share one scoped DbContext, so two
    /// overlapping queries would throw "A second operation was started on this context
    /// instance". Callers that arrive mid-flight set a flag instead of starting a parallel
    /// query, and the running load then re-runs once with the newest filter state.
    /// </summary>
    private async Task LoadOrders()
    {
        if (_loadRunning)
        {
            _loadQueued = true;
            return;
        }

        _loadRunning = true;
        try
        {
            do
            {
                _loadQueued = false;
                await LoadOrdersCore();
            }
            while (_loadQueued);
        }
        finally { _loadRunning = false; }
    }

    private async Task LoadOrdersCore()
    {
        _loading = true;
        try
        {
            pagedResultNew = await OrderService.GetSalesOrdersAsync(pagedRequest);
            _pageValue = pagedResultNew.Items.Sum(o => o.TotalAmount);
            _hasLoadedOnce = true;
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Snackbar.Add($"Error loading orders: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error);
        }
        finally { _loading = false; }
    }

    // â”€â”€â”€ Stats / sorting helpers â”€â”€â”€
    private string TotalCountText => Stat("TotalCount");
    private string PendingCountText => Stat("PendingCount");
    private string ApprovedCountText => Stat("ApprovedCount");
    private string ShippedCountText => Stat("ShippedCount");
    private string DeliveredCountText => Stat("DeliveredCount");
    private string PageValueText => _pageValue.ToString("N0");

    private string Stat(string key) =>
        pagedResultNew.Stats != null && pagedResultNew.Stats.TryGetValue(key, out var v) ? v.ToString() : "0";

    private void SortBy(string column)
    {
        if (pagedRequest.SortColumn == column)
            pagedRequest.SortAscending = !pagedRequest.SortAscending;
        else
        {
            pagedRequest.SortColumn = column;
            pagedRequest.SortAscending = true;
        }
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
    }

    private string SortIcon(string column)
    {
        if (pagedRequest.SortColumn != column) return "";
        return pagedRequest.SortAscending ? "â–²" : "â–¼";
    }

    // â”€â”€â”€ Filters â”€â”€â”€
    private void OnSearchInput(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        pagedRequest.SearchTerm = e.Value?.ToString() ?? "";
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;

        _debounceCts?.Cancel();
        _debounceCts?.Dispose();
        _debounceCts = new CancellationTokenSource();
        var token = _debounceCts.Token;

        _ = Task.Run(async () =>
        {
            try
            {
                await Task.Delay(400, token);
                if (token.IsCancellationRequested) return;
                await InvokeAsync(async () =>
                {
                    await LoadOrders();
                    StateHasChanged();
                });
            }
            catch (OperationCanceledException) { }
        });
    }

    private async Task OnCustomerChanged(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        pagedRequest.CustomerId = ParseGuid(e.Value);
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await LoadOrders();
    }

    private async Task OnBranchChanged(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        pagedRequest.BranchId = ParseGuid(e.Value);
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await LoadOrders();
    }

    private async Task OnStatusChanged(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        pagedRequest.Status = Enum.TryParse<OrderStatus>(e.Value?.ToString(), out var s) ? s : null;
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await LoadOrders();
    }

    private async Task OnRangeChanged((DateTime? From, DateTime? To) range)
    {
        pagedRequest.From = range.From;
        pagedRequest.To = range.To;
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await LoadOrders();
    }

    private async Task FilterByStatus(OrderStatus? status)
    {
        pagedRequest.Status = pagedRequest.Status == status ? null : status;
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await LoadOrders();
    }

    private async Task ResetFilters()
    {
        pagedRequest.SearchTerm = "";
        pagedRequest.Status = null;
        pagedRequest.CustomerId = null;
        pagedRequest.BranchId = null;
        pagedRequest.From = null;
        pagedRequest.To = null;
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await LoadOrders();
    }

    private static Guid? ParseGuid(object? value) =>
        Guid.TryParse(value?.ToString(), out var g) && g != Guid.Empty ? g : null;

    // â”€â”€â”€ Paging (zero-based, matches TmPager) â”€â”€â”€
    private async Task GoToPage(int page)
    {
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = Math.Clamp(page, 0, Math.Max(0, pagedResultNew.TotalPages - 1));
        await LoadOrders();
    }

    private async Task GoPrevPage()
    {
        if (pagedRequest.CurrentPage > 0)
        {
            pagedRequest.CurrentPage--;
            await LoadOrders();
        }
    }

    private async Task GoNextPage()
    {
        if (pagedRequest.CurrentPage < pagedResultNew.TotalPages - 1)
        {
            pagedRequest.CurrentPage++;
            await LoadOrders();
        }
    }

    private async Task OnPageSizeChanged(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        if (int.TryParse(e.Value?.ToString(), out var sz))
        {
            pagedRequest.PageSize = Math.Clamp(sz, 1, 100);
            pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
            await LoadOrders();
        }
    }

    private async Task Approve(Guid id)
    {
        try
        {
            await OrderService.ApproveOrder(id);
            Snackbar.Add("Order approved successfully", Severity.Success);
            await LoadOrders();
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
    }

    private async Task Cancel(Guid id)
    {
        var confirm = await DialogService.ShowMessageBoxAsync("Cancel Order", "Are you sure?", "Yes, Cancel", "No");
        if (confirm == true)
        {
            try
            {
                await OrderService.CancelOrder(id, "Cancelled by user");
                Snackbar.Add("Order cancelled", Severity.Warning);
                await LoadOrders();
            }
            catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
        }
    }

    private async Task ViewOrder(Guid id)
    {
        _viewOrder = null;
        _drawerTitle = "Loadingâ€¦";
        _drawerOpen = true;
        try
        {
            _viewOrder = await OrderService.GetSalesOrderById(id);
            _drawerTitle = $"Order #{_viewOrder?.OrderNumber}";
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
    }

    private void CloseDrawer() => _drawerOpen = false;

    private async Task ApproveAndRefresh(Guid id)
    {
        await Approve(id);
        CloseDrawer();
    }

    private async Task CancelFromDrawer(Guid id)
    {
        await Cancel(id);
        if (_drawerOpen && _viewOrder?.Id == id)
            _viewOrder = await OrderService.GetSalesOrderById(id);
    }

    private async Task OpenCreate()
    {
        // BUGFIX (was a duplicate lookup): the customer list is already loaded â€” and name-sorted â€”
        // by OnInitializedAsync. Only re-query when that load failed, otherwise reuse _customers.
        var customers = _customers.Count > 0
            ? _customers
            : await CustomerService.GetActiveCustomersAsync();

        var products = await ProductService.GetProductOptionsAsync();

        var parameters = new DialogParameters<SalesOrderDialog>
        {
            { x => x.Customers, customers },
            { x => x.Products, products.Select(p => (p.Id, p.Name, p.Sku, p.SellingPrice)).ToList() }
        };

        var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<SalesOrderDialog>("New Sales Order", parameters,
            new DialogOptions { MaxWidth = MaxWidth.Large, FullWidth = true, CloseButton = true });
        var result = await dialog.Result;

        if (result != null && !result.Canceled && result.Data is CreateSalesOrderDto dto)
        {
            try
            {
                await OrderService.CreateSalesOrder(dto);
                Snackbar.Add("Sales order created successfully", Severity.Success);
                await LoadOrders();
            }
            catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
        }
    }

    private static string GetStatusPill(OrderStatus s) => s switch
    {
        OrderStatus.Pending => "tm-pill tm-pill-amber",
        OrderStatus.Approved => "tm-pill tm-pill-blue",
        OrderStatus.Shipped => "tm-pill tm-pill-purple",
        OrderStatus.Delivered => "tm-pill tm-pill-green",
        OrderStatus.Cancelled => "tm-pill tm-pill-red",
        _ => "tm-pill tm-pill-blue"
    };

    public void Dispose()
    {
        _debounceCts?.Cancel();
        _debounceCts?.Dispose();
    }
}

@inject IDialogService DialogService
@inject ICustomerService CustomerService
@inject IProductService ProductService
@inject ICategoryService CategoryService
@inject IBrandService BrandService
@inject ISnackbar Snackbar

@code {
    [CascadingParameter] private IMudDialogInstance MudDialog { get; set; } = default!;
    [Parameter] public List<CustomerDto> Customers { get; set; } = new();
    [Parameter] public List<ProductOptionDto> Products { get; set; } = new();
    [Parameter] public CreateSalesQuotationDto dataModel { get; set; } = new CreateSalesQuotationDto();
    [Parameter] public EventCallback<CreateSalesQuoteDto> OnSubmit { get; set; }
    [Parameter] public EventCallback<CreateSalesQuoteDto> OnSubmitAndPrint { get; set; }
    [Parameter] public EventCallback OnCancel { get; set; }

    private static readonly ControlItemsDto AddNewCustomerOption = new() { Id = Guid.Empty, Name = "Add New" };
    private static readonly ControlItemsDto AddNewProductOption = new() { Id = Guid.Empty, Name = "Add New" };

    private MudIconButton? AddButtonRef;
    private MudNumericField<int>? RefQuantity;
    private MudNumericField<decimal>? RefSubTotal;
    private int _editingItemIndex = -1;

    /// <summary>Rows that have actually been committed; the draft row (ProductId empty) is excluded.</summary>
    private IEnumerable<CreateSalesQuoteItemDto> CommittedItems =>
        dataModel.ItemsLine.Where(i => i.ProductId != Guid.Empty);

    private bool HasItems => CommittedItems.Any();

    private decimal DiscountTotal => CommittedItems.Sum(LineDiscount);

    protected override Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        // The DTO seeds both dates from DateTime.UtcNow. A date picker wants local dates, and
        // "today" for the user is off by one whenever the server sits near UTC midnight.
        dataModel.QuatationDate = (dataModel.QuatationDate ?? DateTime.UtcNow).ToLocalTime().Date;
        dataModel.ValidUntil = (dataModel.ValidUntil ?? DateTime.UtcNow.AddDays(30)).ToLocalTime().Date;
        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }

    // â”€â”€â”€ Line maths â”€â”€â”€

    /// <summary>
    /// Recomputes the draft line's discount and net total. Called from the render block of the
    /// row that is being edited, so the read-only Line Total cell stays in step with the inputs.
    /// </summary>
    private void CalculateLineTotal()
    {
        var line = dataModel.ProductObj;
        var gross = line.UnitPrice * line.Quantity;

        line.TotalDiscount = line.DiscountType == DiscountType.Percentage
            ? gross * (line.DiscountAmount / 100m)
            : Math.Min(line.DiscountAmount, gross);

        line.TotalPrice = gross - line.TotalDiscount;
    }

    // A committed row carries only a discount percentage, so the money values the summary card
    // needs are derived instead of stored on the row.
    private static decimal LineGross(CreateSalesQuoteItemDto item) => item.UnitPrice * item.Quantity;

    private static decimal LineDiscount(CreateSalesQuoteItemDto item) =>
        LineGross(item) * (item.DiscountPercent / 100m);

    private static decimal LineTotal(CreateSalesQuoteItemDto item) => LineGross(item) - LineDiscount(item);

    /// <summary>Rolls committed lines up into the header totals shown in the summary card.</summary>
    private void CalculationBalance()
    {
        dataModel.SubTotal = CommittedItems.Sum(LineTotal);
        dataModel.TotalAmount = dataModel.SubTotal;
    }

    private static string DiscountLabel(CreateSalesQuoteItemDto item) =>
        $"{item.DiscountPercent.ToString("N1")}%";

    // Products is a list of tuples, so a miss returns `default`, not null. Null-safe on purpose:
    // a quote line can outlive the product being deactivated and dropped from the picker list.
    private string ProductLabel(Guid productId)
    {
        var p = Products.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Id == productId);
        return p == default ? "-" : $"{p.Name} ({p.Sku})";
    }

    // â”€â”€â”€ Customer picker â”€â”€â”€

    private async Task OnCustomerChanged()
    {
        var cust = dataModel.CustomerDdlControl.SelectedItem;

        if (cust?.Id == Guid.Empty)
        {
            var parameters = new DialogParameters<CustomerDialog>
            {
                {
                    x => x.Customer,
                    new CustomerDto
                    {
                        Id = Guid.Empty, CustomerName = string.Empty, CustomerEmail = string.Empty,
                        CustomerPhone = string.Empty, Address = string.Empty, City = string.Empty,
                        Zila = string.Empty, State = string.Empty, Country = string.Empty,
                        PostalCode = string.Empty, CreditLimit = 0, PaymentTerms = string.Empty,
                        IsActive = false, IsTaxExempt = false
                    }
                }
            };

            var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<CustomerDialog>("New Customer", parameters,
                new DialogOptions { MaxWidth = MaxWidth.Small, FullWidth = true, CloseButton = true });
            var result = await dialog.Result;

            await dataModel.CustomerDdlControl.ControlRef.ResetAsync();

            if (result != null && !result.Canceled && result.Data is CustomerDto dto)
            {
                // The service owns the insert + SaveChanges; hand-building an entity here would
                // leak a tracked entity into this component's scoped context.
                var newCustomerId = await CustomerService.CreateCustomerAsync(dto);
                Snackbar.Add("Customer created successfully", Severity.Success);

                Customers = await CustomerService.GetActiveCustomersAsync();
                cust = new ControlItemsDto { Id = newCustomerId, Name = dto.CustomerName };
            }

            await UpdateControlSelection(dataModel.CustomerDdlControl, cust);
            StateHasChanged();
        }
        else
        {
            await UpdateControlSelection(dataModel.CustomerDdlControl, cust);
        }

        if(AddButtonRef is not null){
            await AddButtonRef.FocusAsync();
        }
    }

    private static Task UpdateControlSelection(ControlDto control, ControlItemsDto? selectedItem)
    {
        if (selectedItem != null)
        {
            control.SelectedItem = selectedItem;
            control.LastSelectedItem = selectedItem;
            control.SelectedText = selectedItem.Name ?? selectedItem.Text1;
            control.SelectedIndex++;
        }

        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }

    private Task<IEnumerable<ControlItemsDto>> SearchCustomers(string text, CancellationToken _)
    {
        IEnumerable<ControlItemsDto> baseResults;

        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text))
        {
            baseResults = Customers.Where(c => c.Id != Guid.Empty)
                .Select(c => new ControlItemsDto { Id = c.Id, Name = c.CustomerName });
        }
        else
        {
            baseResults = Customers.Where(c =>
                    c.Id != Guid.Empty &&
                    c.CustomerName.Contains(text, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                .Select(c => new ControlItemsDto { Id = c.Id, Name = c.CustomerName });
        }

        return Task.FromResult(baseResults
            .OrderBy(x => x.Name)
            .DistinctBy(c => c.Id)
            .Append(AddNewCustomerOption));
    }

    private Task<IEnumerable<ControlItemsDto>> SearchProducts(string text, CancellationToken _)
    {
        IEnumerable<ControlItemsDto> baseResults;

        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text))
        {
            baseResults = Products.Where(c => c.Id != Guid.Empty)
                .Select(c => new ControlItemsDto { Id = c.Id, Name = c.Name, IsSelected = false });
        }
        else
        {
            baseResults = Products.Where(c =>
                    c.Id != Guid.Empty &&
                    c.Name.Contains(text, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                .Select(c => new ControlItemsDto { Id = c.Id, Name = c.Name, IsSelected = false });
        }

        return Task.FromResult(baseResults
            .DistinctBy(c => c.Id)
            .Append(AddNewProductOption));
    }


    // â”€â”€â”€ Product picker â”€â”€â”€

    private void ResetDraft()
    {
        dataModel.ProductObj.ProductDdlControl.LastSelectedItem = null;
        dataModel.ProductObj.ProductDdlControl.SelectedText = "";
        dataModel.ProductObj.ProductDdlControl.SelectedItem =
            new ControlItemsDto { Id = Guid.Empty, Name = "", IsSelected = false };
        dataModel.ProductObj.ProductId = Guid.Empty;
        dataModel.ProductObj.Quantity = 1;
        dataModel.ProductObj.UnitPrice = 0;
        dataModel.ProductObj.DiscountAmount = 0;
        dataModel.ProductObj.DiscountType = DiscountType.Percentage;
        dataModel.ProductObj.TotalDiscount = 0;
        dataModel.ProductObj.TotalPrice = 0;
        dataModel.ProductObj.Serial = Guid.Empty;
        dataModel.ProductObj.SelectedSerialIds = new List<Guid>();
    }

    private async Task OnProductChanged()
    {
        var prod = dataModel.ProductObj.ProductDdlControl.SelectedItem;

        if (prod?.Id == Guid.Empty)
        {
            var categories = await CategoryService.GetAllCategoriesAsync();
            var brands = await BrandService.GetAllBrandsAsync();
            var parameters = new DialogParameters<ProductAddEditDialog>
            {
                { x => x.DataModel, new ProductDetailsDto() },
                { x => x.Categories, categories },
                { x => x.Brands, brands }
            };

            var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<ProductAddEditDialog>("New Product", parameters,
                new DialogOptions { MaxWidth = MaxWidth.Medium, FullWidth = true, CloseButton = true });
            var result = await dialog.Result;

            await dataModel.ProductObj.ProductDdlControl.ControlRef.ResetAsync();

            if (result != null && !result.Canceled && result.Data is ProductDetailsDto dto)
            {
                // Same reasoning as the customer path: let the service insert and save.
                var newProductId = await ProductService.CreateProductAsync(dto);
                Snackbar.Add("Product created successfully", Severity.Success);

                Products = await ProductService.GetProductOptionsAsync();

                await UpdateControlSelection(dataModel.ProductObj.ProductDdlControl,
                    new ControlItemsDto { Id = newProductId, Name = dto.Name, IsSelected = false });
            }
            else
            {
                // Restore whatever the row held before "Add New" was picked, so cancelling the
                // product dialog doesn't silently clear the line.
                await UpdateControlSelection(dataModel.ProductObj.ProductDdlControl,
                    dataModel.ProductObj.ProductDdlControl.LastSelectedItem);
            }

            StateHasChanged();
        }
        else
        {
            ApplyProductToDraft(prod);
            await UpdateControlSelection(dataModel.ProductObj.ProductDdlControl, prod);
        }

        if (RefQuantity is not null)
            await RefQuantity.FocusAsync();
    }

    private async Task OnEditProductChanged()
    {
        var prod = dataModel.ProductObj.ProductDdlControl.SelectedItem;
        if (prod == null) return;

        ApplyProductToDraft(prod);

        dataModel.ProductObj.ProductDdlControl.LastSelectedItem = prod;
        dataModel.ProductObj.ProductDdlControl.SelectedText = prod.Name;

        if (RefQuantity is not null)
            await RefQuantity.FocusAsync();
    }

    private async Task ApplyProductToDraft(ControlItemsDto prod)
    {
        var p = Products.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Id == prod.Id);
        if (p == default) return;

        dataModel.ProductObj.ProductId = p.Id;
        dataModel.ProductObj.UnitPrice = p.SellingPrice;
        dataModel.ProductObj.Quantity = 1;
        dataModel.ProductObj.DiscountAmount = 0;
        dataModel.ProductObj.DiscountType = DiscountType.Percentage;
        dataModel.ProductObj.TotalDiscount = 0;
        dataModel.ProductObj.TotalPrice = 0;
    }

    // â”€â”€â”€ Line editing â”€â”€â”€

    private async Task AddNewItem()
    {
        if (dataModel.ItemsLine.Any(x => x.ProductId == Guid.Empty)) return;
        if (_editingItemIndex >= 0) return;

        ResetDraft();
        // ItemsLine holds the service-level record, which is a positional record with no
        // parameterless ctor. The all-zero ProductId marks it as the unpublished draft row;
        // the fields the editors bind to live on dataModel.ProductObj.
        dataModel.ItemsLine.Insert(0, new CreateSalesQuoteItemDto(Guid.Empty, 0, 0, 0));

        await FocusSelectBox();
    }

    private async Task AddItem()
    {
        CalculateLineTotal();

        var draft = dataModel.ProductObj;
        if (draft.ProductId == Guid.Empty || draft.Quantity <= 0) return;

        dataModel.ItemsLine.Add(new CreateSalesQuoteItemDto(
            draft.ProductId,
            draft.Quantity,
            draft.UnitPrice,
            ToDiscountPercent(draft)));

        ResetDraft();
        CalculationBalance();

        await FocusSelectBox();
    }
    private async Task FocusSelectBox()
    {
        await Task.Delay(100);
        if (dataModel.ProductObj.ProductDdlControl.ControlRef is not null)
        {
            await dataModel.ProductObj.ProductDdlControl.ControlRef.ResetAsync();
            await dataModel.ProductObj.ProductDdlControl.ControlRef.FocusAsync();
        }
    }
    // CreateSalesQuoteDto carries a percentage per line only, so a Fixed discount has to be
    // restated as the percentage of the line gross that yields the same money value.
    private static decimal ToDiscountPercent(SalesQuotationItemDto draft)
    {
        var gross = draft.UnitPrice * draft.Quantity;
        if (gross <= 0m) return 0m;

        // Reuse the discount the dialog already resolved rather than re-deriving the money value.
        return draft.DiscountType == DiscountType.Percentage
            ? draft.DiscountAmount
            : draft.TotalDiscount / gross * 100m;
    }

    private async Task StartEditItem(int index, CreateSalesQuoteItemDto item)
    {
        if (dataModel.ItemsLine.Any(x => x.ProductId == Guid.Empty)) return;

        _editingItemIndex = index;

        var product = Products.FirstOrDefault(p => p.Id == item.ProductId);
        var draft = dataModel.ProductObj;
        draft.ProductId = item.ProductId;
        draft.ProductDdlControl.SelectedItem = product != default
            ? new ControlItemsDto { Id = product.Id, Name = product.Name, IsSelected = false }
            : new ControlItemsDto { Id = Guid.Empty, Name = "", IsSelected = false };
        draft.Quantity = item.Quantity;
        draft.UnitPrice = item.UnitPrice;

        // The stored row only kept the percentage, so that is what comes back into the editor.
        draft.DiscountType = DiscountType.Percentage;
        draft.DiscountAmount = item.DiscountPercent;
        draft.TotalDiscount = LineDiscount(item);
        draft.TotalPrice = LineTotal(item);

        await UpdateControlSelection(draft.ProductDdlControl, draft.ProductDdlControl.SelectedItem);
    }

    private async Task SaveEditItem(int index)
    {
        CalculateLineTotal();

        var draft = dataModel.ProductObj;
        if (draft.ProductId == Guid.Empty || draft.Quantity <= 0) return;

        dataModel.ItemsLine[index] = new CreateSalesQuoteItemDto(
            draft.ProductId,
            draft.Quantity,
            draft.UnitPrice,
            ToDiscountPercent(draft));

        _editingItemIndex = -1;
        ResetDraft();
        CalculationBalance();

        if (RefSubTotal is not null)
            await RefSubTotal.FocusAsync();
    }

    private async Task RemoveItem(CreateSalesQuoteItemDto item)
    {
        // Records compare by value, so drop by index rather than letting Remove() take the
        // first line-equal row. Also covers the draft row, which has no entry in CommittedItems.
        var index = dataModel.ItemsLine.IndexOf(item);
        if (index < 0) return;

        dataModel.ItemsLine.RemoveAt(index);
        CalculationBalance();
    }

    private async Task RemoveEditItem(CreateSalesQuoteItemDto item)
    {
        dataModel.ItemsLine.Remove(item);
        if (RefSubTotal is not null)
            await RefSubTotal.FocusAsync();
    }
    private async Task CancelEditItem()
    {
        _editingItemIndex = -1;
        ResetDraft();

        if (RefSubTotal is not null)
            await RefSubTotal.FocusAsync();
    }

    // â”€â”€â”€ Submit â”€â”€â”€

    private async Task Cancel()
    {
        await OnCancel.InvokeAsync();
        MudDialog.Cancel();
    }

    private async Task Submit()
    {
        if (!Validate(out var customerId))
            return;

        var dto = BuildQuoteDto(customerId);
        await OnSubmit.InvokeAsync(dto);
        MudDialog.Close(DialogResult.Ok(dto));
    }

    private async Task SubmitAndPrint()
    {
        if (!Validate(out var customerId))
            return;

        var dto = BuildQuoteDto(customerId);
        await OnSubmitAndPrint.InvokeAsync(dto);
        MudDialog.Close(DialogResult.Ok(dto));
    }

    private CreateSalesQuoteDto BuildQuoteDto(Guid customerId) =>
        new(
            customerId,
            dataModel.QuatationDate ?? DateTime.Today,
            dataModel.ValidUntil ?? DateTime.Today.AddDays(30),
            dataModel.Notes,
            CommittedItems.ToList());

    private bool Validate(out Guid customerId)
    {
        customerId = Guid.Empty;

        var selected = dataModel.CustomerDdlControl.SelectedItem;
        if (selected?.Id is Guid id && id != Guid.Empty)
            customerId = id;

        if (customerId == Guid.Empty)
        {
            Snackbar.Add("Please select a customer", Severity.Warning);
            return false;
        }

        // Keep the bound model's own customer field in step with what the picker resolved.
        dataModel.CustomerId = customerId;

        if (!HasItems)
        {
            Snackbar.Add("Please add at least one item", Severity.Warning);
            return false;
        }

        if (dataModel.ValidUntil.HasValue && dataModel.QuatationDate.HasValue &&
            dataModel.ValidUntil.Value.Date < dataModel.QuatationDate.Value.Date)
        {
            Snackbar.Add("Valid Until cannot be earlier than the Quote Date", Severity.Warning);
            return false;
        }

        return true;
    }
}

@code {
    private static class Col
    {
        public const string QuoteNumber = "QuoteNumber";
        public const string QuoteDate = "QuoteDate";
        public const string Customer = "Customer";
        public const string ValidUntil = "ValidUntil";
        public const string TotalAmount = "TotalAmount";
        public const string Status = "Status";
    }

    private readonly List<QuoteStatus> QuoteStatuses = Enum.GetValues<QuoteStatus>().ToList();

    // â”€â”€â”€ List state â”€â”€â”€
    private PagedResultNew<SalesQuoteDto> pagedResultNew = new();
    private QuotationPagedRequest pagedRequest = new()
    {
        SortColumn = Col.QuoteDate,
        SortAscending = false
    };

    
    private List<ProductOptionDto> _productOptionDtos = new();
    private List<CustomerDto> _customers = new();
    private bool _loading = true;
    private bool _hasLoadedOnce;
    private bool _loadRunning;
    private bool _loadQueued;
    private CancellationTokenSource? _debounceCts;

    private QuotationViewPanel? _quotationViewPanel;

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        // This lookup used a bare `catch { }`, so a failed query left the customer dropdown
        // silently empty and read as "no customers exist". Surface the failure instead.
        try
        {
            _customers = await CustomerService.GetActiveCustomersAsync();
            _productOptionDtos = await ProductService.GetProductOptionsAsync();

        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Logger.LogError(ex, "Failed to load active customers for the quotation filter");
            Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error);
        }

        await Load();
    }

    private async Task Refresh() => await Load();

    /// <summary>
    /// Single-flight loader. The page and the services share one scoped DbContext, so two
    /// overlapping queries would throw "A second operation was started on this context
    /// instance". Callers that arrive mid-flight set a flag instead of starting a parallel
    /// query, and the running load then re-runs once with the newest filter state.
    /// </summary>
    private async Task Load()
    {
        if (_loadRunning)
        {
            _loadQueued = true;
            return;
        }

        _loadRunning = true;
        try
        {
            do
            {
                _loadQueued = false;
                await LoadCore();
            }
            while (_loadQueued);
        }
        finally { _loadRunning = false; }
    }

    private async Task LoadCore()
    {
        _loading = true;
        try
        {
            pagedResultNew = await QuotationService.GetSalesQuotesAsync(pagedRequest);
            _hasLoadedOnce = true;
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add($"Error loading quotations: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error); }
        finally { _loading = false; }
    }

    // â”€â”€â”€ Stats / sorting helpers â”€â”€â”€
    private string TotalCountText => Stat("TotalCount");
    private string DraftCountText => Stat("DraftCount");
    private string SentCountText => Stat("SentCount");
    private string AcceptedCountText => Stat("AcceptedCount");
    private string RejectedCountText => Stat("RejectedCount");
    private string TotalValueText =>
        int.TryParse(Stat("TotalValue"), out var v) ? v.ToString("N0") : "0";

    private string Stat(string key) =>
        pagedResultNew.Stats != null && pagedResultNew.Stats.TryGetValue(key, out var v) ? v.ToString() : "0";

    private void SortBy(string column)
    {
        if (pagedRequest.SortColumn == column)
            pagedRequest.SortAscending = !pagedRequest.SortAscending;
        else
        {
            pagedRequest.SortColumn = column;
            pagedRequest.SortAscending = true;
        }
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
    }

    private string SortIcon(string column)
    {
        if (pagedRequest.SortColumn != column) return "";
        return pagedRequest.SortAscending ? "â–²" : "â–¼";
    }

    // â”€â”€â”€ Filters â”€â”€â”€
    private void OnSearchInput(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        pagedRequest.SearchTerm = e.Value?.ToString() ?? "";
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;

        _debounceCts?.Cancel();
        _debounceCts?.Dispose();
        _debounceCts = new CancellationTokenSource();
        var token = _debounceCts.Token;

        _ = Task.Run(async () =>
        {
            try
            {
                await Task.Delay(400, token);
                if (token.IsCancellationRequested) return;
                await InvokeAsync(async () =>
                {
                    await Load();
                    StateHasChanged();
                });
            }
            catch (OperationCanceledException) { }
        });
    }

    private async Task OnCustomerChanged(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        pagedRequest.CustomerId = ParseGuid(e.Value);
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await Load();
    }

    private async Task OnStatusChanged(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        pagedRequest.Status = Enum.TryParse<QuoteStatus>(e.Value?.ToString(), out var s) ? s : null;
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await Load();
    }

    private async Task OnRangeChanged((DateTime? From, DateTime? To) range)
    {
        pagedRequest.From = range.From;
        pagedRequest.To = range.To;
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await Load();
    }

    private async Task FilterByStatus(QuoteStatus? status)
    {
        pagedRequest.Status = pagedRequest.Status == status ? null : status;
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await Load();
    }

    private async Task ResetFilters()
    {
        pagedRequest.SearchTerm = "";
        pagedRequest.Status = null;
        pagedRequest.CustomerId = null;
        pagedRequest.From = null;
        pagedRequest.To = null;
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await Load();
    }

    private static Guid? ParseGuid(object? value) =>
        Guid.TryParse(value?.ToString(), out var g) && g != Guid.Empty ? g : null;

    // â”€â”€â”€ Paging (zero-based, matches TmPager) â”€â”€â”€
    private async Task GoToPage(int page)
    {
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = Math.Clamp(page, 0, Math.Max(0, pagedResultNew.TotalPages - 1));
        await Load();
    }

    private async Task GoPrevPage()
    {
        if (pagedRequest.CurrentPage > 0)
        {
            pagedRequest.CurrentPage--;
            await Load();
        }
    }

    private async Task GoNextPage()
    {
        if (pagedRequest.CurrentPage < pagedResultNew.TotalPages - 1)
        {
            pagedRequest.CurrentPage++;
            await Load();
        }
    }

    private async Task OnPageSizeChanged(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        if (int.TryParse(e.Value?.ToString(), out var sz))
        {
            pagedRequest.PageSize = Math.Clamp(sz, 1, 100);
            pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
            await Load();
        }
    }

    private async Task ViewQuote(Guid id)
    {
        if (_quotationViewPanel != null)
            await _quotationViewPanel.OpenAsync(id);
    }

    private async Task OpenCreateDialog() => await ShowSalesQuotationDialog("New Quotation");

    private async Task ShowSalesQuotationDialog(string title)
    {
     

        var parameters = new DialogParameters<QuotationDialog>
        {
            { x => x.Customers, _customers },
            { x => x.Products, _productOptionDtos },
            { x => x.dataModel, new CreateSalesQuotationDto() },
            { x => x.OnSubmit, EventCallback.Factory.Create<CreateSalesQuoteDto>(this, HandleFormSubmit) },
            { x => x.OnSubmitAndPrint, EventCallback.Factory.Create<CreateSalesQuoteDto>(this, HandleFormSubmitAndPrint) }
        };

        await DialogService.ShowAsync<QuotationDialog>(title, parameters,
            new DialogOptions
            {
                MaxWidth = MaxWidth.Large,
                FullWidth = true,
                CloseOnEscapeKey = true,
                CloseButton = true
            });
    }
    private async Task HandleFormSubmit(CreateSalesQuoteDto model)
    {
        if (model == null) return;

        try
        {
            await QuotationService.CreateSalesQuote(model);
            Snackbar.Add("Quotation created successfully", Severity.Success);
            await Load();
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
    }

    // Quote PDF/print generation isn't wired up yet. Kept so the dialog's second button has
    // somewhere to land; today it is the same save.
    private async Task HandleFormSubmitAndPrint(CreateSalesQuoteDto model) => await HandleFormSubmit(model);

    private async Task AcceptQuote(Guid id)
    {
        try
        {
            await QuotationService.AcceptQuote(id);
            Snackbar.Add("Quote accepted", Severity.Success);
            await Load();
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
    }

    private async Task RejectQuote(Guid id)
    {
        var confirm = await DialogService.ShowMessageBoxAsync("Reject Quotation",
            "Are you sure? This cannot be undone.", "Yes, Reject", "No");
        if (confirm != true) return;

        try
        {
            await QuotationService.RejectQuote(id, "Rejected by user");
            Snackbar.Add("Quote rejected", Severity.Info);
            await Load();
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
    }

    private async Task ConvertToOrder(Guid id)
    {
        var confirm = await DialogService.ShowMessageBoxAsync("Convert to Order",
            "A new sales order will be created from this quotation. Continue?", "Yes, Convert", "No");
        if (confirm != true) return;

        try
        {
            await QuotationService.ConvertQuoteToOrder(id);
            Snackbar.Add("Quotation converted to Sales Order", Severity.Success);
            await Load();
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
    }

    private static string GetStatusPill(QuoteStatus status) => status switch
    {
        QuoteStatus.Draft => "tm-pill tm-pill-purple",
        QuoteStatus.Sent => "tm-pill tm-pill-blue",
        QuoteStatus.Accepted => "tm-pill tm-pill-green",
        QuoteStatus.Rejected => "tm-pill tm-pill-red",
        QuoteStatus.Expired => "tm-pill tm-pill-amber",
        QuoteStatus.Converted => "tm-pill tm-pill-green",
        _ => "tm-pill tm-pill-blue"
    };

    public void Dispose()
    {
        _debounceCts?.Cancel();
        _debounceCts?.Dispose();
    }
}

@inject ISnackbar Snackbar
@inject IJSRuntime JS

@code {
    private bool _open;
    private bool _animateIn;
    private bool _loading;
    private SalesQuoteDto? _quote;

    private async Task DownloadPdf()
    {
        if (_quote is null) return;
        try
        {
            var doc = await PrintRenderer.RenderQuoteAsync(_quote);
            await JS.InvokeVoidAsync("downloadFile", doc.Html, doc.FileName + ".pdf", doc.Title, doc.Reference);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            await JS.InvokeVoidAsync("alert", "Could not generate the PDF: " + ex.Message);
        }
    }

    private async Task PrintDoc()
    {
        if (_quote is null) return;
        try
        {
            var doc = await PrintRenderer.RenderQuoteAsync(_quote);
            await JS.InvokeVoidAsync("printHtml", doc.Html, doc.Title, doc.Reference);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            await JS.InvokeVoidAsync("alert", "Could not print the document: " + ex.Message);
        }
    }

    public async Task OpenAsync(Guid id)
    {
        _open = true;
        _loading = true;
        _animateIn = false;
        _quote = null;
        StateHasChanged();

        await Task.Delay(20);
        _animateIn = true;
        StateHasChanged();

        try
        {
            _quote = await QuotationService.GetSalesQuoteById(id);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error);
        }

        _loading = false;
        StateHasChanged();
    }

    public void Close()
    {
        _open = false;
        _animateIn = false;
        _quote = null;
        StateHasChanged();
    }
}

@code {
    // â”€â”€â”€ Sortable column keys (constants avoid nested quotes in markup lambdas) â”€â”€â”€
    private static class Col
    {
        public const string OrderNumber = "OrderNumber";
        public const string OrderDate = "OrderDate";
        public const string Customer = "Customer";
        public const string Branch = "Branch";
        public const string SubTotal = "SubTotal";
        public const string TotalAmount = "TotalAmount";
        public const string PaidAmount = "PaidAmount";
        public const string DueAmount = "DueAmount";
        public const string Status = "Status";
    }

    // â”€â”€â”€ Lifecycle statuses owned by this page (Pending/Approved live on /sales/orders) â”€â”€â”€
    private readonly List<OrderStatus> SalesStatuses =Enum.GetValues<OrderStatus>().ToList();

    // â”€â”€â”€ List state â”€â”€â”€
    private PagedResultNew<SalesOrderDto> pagedResultNew = new();
    private SalesPagedRequest pagedRequest = new()
    {
        SortColumn = Col.OrderDate,
        SortAscending = false
    };

    private List<CustomerDto> _customers = new();
    private List<BranchDto> _branches = new();
    private bool _loading = true;
    private bool _hasLoadedOnce;
    private bool _loadRunning;
    private bool _loadQueued;
    private decimal _pageValue;
    private CancellationTokenSource? _debounceCts;

    // â”€â”€â”€ Drawer state â”€â”€â”€
    private enum SliderMode { View, Edit, Create }
    private SliderMode _drawerMode = SliderMode.View;
    private SalesOrderDto? _editingOrder;
    private SalesOrderViewPanel? _salesOrderViewPanel;
    private CreateSalesOrderDtoModels _editModel = new();    
    private List<(Guid Id, string Name, string SKU, decimal Price)> _drawerProducts = new();

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        try { _branches = await BranchService.GetBranches(); } catch { }
        try
        {
            var customers = await CustomerService.GetCustomersAsync(null, 1, 500);
            _customers = customers.Items;

            var products = await ProductService.GetProductsAsync(new ProductPagedRequest());
            _drawerProducts = products.Items.OrderBy(p => p.Name).ToList().Select(p => (p.Id, p.Name, p.SKU, p.SellingPrice)).ToList();

        }
        catch { }

        await LoadOrders();
    }

    private async Task Refresh() => await LoadOrders();

    /// <summary>
    /// Single-flight loader. The page and the services share one scoped DbContext, so two
    /// overlapping queries would throw "A second operation was started on this context
    /// instance". Callers that arrive mid-flight set a flag instead of starting a parallel
    /// query, and the running load then re-runs once with the newest filter state.
    /// </summary>
    private async Task LoadOrders()
    {
        if (_loadRunning)
        {
            _loadQueued = true;
            return;
        }

        _loadRunning = true;
        try
        {
            do
            {
                _loadQueued = false;
                await LoadOrdersCore();
            }
            while (_loadQueued);
        }
        finally { _loadRunning = false; }
    }

    private async Task LoadOrdersCore()
    {
        _loading = true;
        try
        {
            pagedResultNew = await OrderService.GetSalesOrdersAsync(pagedRequest);
            _pageValue = pagedResultNew.Items.Sum(o => o.TotalAmount);
            _hasLoadedOnce = true;
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Snackbar.Add($"Error loading sales: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error);
        }
        finally { _loading = false; }
    }

    // â”€â”€â”€ Stats / sorting helpers â”€â”€â”€
    private string TotalCountText => Stat("TotalCount");
    private string SoldCountText => Stat("SoldCount");
    private string PackedCountText => Stat("PackedCount");
    private string ShippedCountText => Stat("ShippedCount");
    private string DeliveredCountText => Stat("DeliveredCount");
    private string PageValueText => _pageValue.ToString("N0");

    private string Stat(string key) =>
        pagedResultNew.Stats != null && pagedResultNew.Stats.TryGetValue(key, out var v) ? v.ToString() : "0";

    private void SortBy(string column)
    {
        if (pagedRequest.SortColumn == column)
            pagedRequest.SortAscending = !pagedRequest.SortAscending;
        else
        {
            pagedRequest.SortColumn = column;
            pagedRequest.SortAscending = true;
        }
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
    }

    private string SortIcon(string column)
    {
        if (pagedRequest.SortColumn != column) return "";
        return pagedRequest.SortAscending ? "â–²" : "â–¼";
    }

    // â”€â”€â”€ Filters â”€â”€â”€
    private void OnSearchInput(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        pagedRequest.SearchTerm = e.Value?.ToString() ?? "";
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;

        _debounceCts?.Cancel();
        _debounceCts?.Dispose();
        _debounceCts = new CancellationTokenSource();
        var token = _debounceCts.Token;

        _ = Task.Run(async () =>
        {
            try
            {
                await Task.Delay(400, token);
                if (token.IsCancellationRequested) return;
                await InvokeAsync(async () =>
                {
                    await LoadOrders();
                    StateHasChanged();
                });
            }
            catch (OperationCanceledException) { }
        });
    }

    private async Task OnCustomerChanged(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        pagedRequest.CustomerId = ParseGuid(e.Value);
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await LoadOrders();
    }

    private async Task OnBranchChanged(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        pagedRequest.BranchId = ParseGuid(e.Value);
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await LoadOrders();
    }

    private async Task OnStatusChanged(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        pagedRequest.Status = Enum.TryParse<OrderStatus>(e.Value?.ToString(), out var s) ? s : null;
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await LoadOrders();
    }

    private async Task OnRangeChanged((DateTime? From, DateTime? To) range)
    {
        pagedRequest.From = range.From;
        pagedRequest.To = range.To;
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await LoadOrders();
    }

    private async Task FilterByStatus(OrderStatus? status)
    {
        pagedRequest.Status = status;
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await LoadOrders();
    }

    private async Task ResetFilters()
    {
        pagedRequest.SearchTerm = "";
        pagedRequest.Status = null;
        pagedRequest.CustomerId = null;
        pagedRequest.BranchId = null;
        pagedRequest.From = null;
        pagedRequest.To = null;
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await LoadOrders();
    }

    private static Guid? ParseGuid(object? value) =>
        Guid.TryParse(value?.ToString(), out var g) && g != Guid.Empty ? g : null;

    // â”€â”€â”€ Paging (zero-based, matches TmPager) â”€â”€â”€
    private async Task GoToPage(int page)
    {
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = Math.Clamp(page, 0, Math.Max(0, pagedResultNew.TotalPages - 1));
        await LoadOrders();
    }

    private async Task GoPrevPage()
    {
        if (pagedRequest.CurrentPage > 0)
        {
            pagedRequest.CurrentPage--;
            await LoadOrders();
        }
    }

    private async Task GoNextPage()
    {
        if (pagedRequest.CurrentPage < pagedResultNew.TotalPages - 1)
        {
            pagedRequest.CurrentPage++;
            await LoadOrders();
        }
    }

    private async Task OnPageSizeChanged(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        if (int.TryParse(e.Value?.ToString(), out var sz))
        {
            pagedRequest.PageSize = Math.Clamp(sz, 1, 100);
            pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
            await LoadOrders();
        }
    }

    private static string GetStatusPill(OrderStatus s) => s switch
    {
        OrderStatus.Pending => "tm-pill tm-pill-amber",
        OrderStatus.Approved => "tm-pill tm-pill-blue",
        OrderStatus.Sold => "tm-pill tm-pill-purple",
        OrderStatus.Packed => "tm-pill tm-pill-amber",
        OrderStatus.Shipped => "tm-pill tm-pill-blue",
        OrderStatus.PartiallyShipped => "tm-pill tm-pill-teal",
        OrderStatus.Delivered => "tm-pill tm-pill-green",
        OrderStatus.Cancelled => "tm-pill tm-pill-red",
        _ => "tm-pill tm-pill-blue"
    };

    // â”€â”€â”€ Row actions â”€â”€â”€
    private async Task Approve(Guid id)
    {
        try
        {
            await OrderService.ApproveOrder(id);
            Snackbar.Add("Order approved successfully", Severity.Success);
            await LoadOrders();
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
    }

    private async Task Cancel(Guid id)
    {
        var confirm = await DialogService.ShowMessageBoxAsync("Cancel Sales", "Are you sure?", "Yes, Cancel", "No");
        if (confirm == true)
        {
            try
            {
                await OrderService.CancelOrder(id, "Cancelled by user");
                Snackbar.Add("Sales cancelled", Severity.Warning);
                await LoadOrders();
            }
            catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
        }
    }

    private async Task ViewOrder(Guid id)
    {
        if (_salesOrderViewPanel != null)
            await _salesOrderViewPanel.OpenAsync(id);
    }

    private async Task<SalesOrderDto> GetOrderDetails(Guid Id)
    {
        return await OrderService.GetSalesOrderById(Id);
    }
    

    // â”€â”€â”€ Create/Update/Delete â”€â”€â”€
    private async Task OpenCreateEdit(Guid? orderId)
    {
        var dataModel = new CreateSalesOrderDtoModels();
        string dialogTitle = "New Sales";
        _drawerMode = SliderMode.View;
        _editingOrder = null;

        if (orderId.HasValue)
        {
            var order = await GetOrderDetails(orderId.Value);
            if (order == null) { Snackbar.Add("Sales order not found", Severity.Error); return; }
            dialogTitle = $"Edit Sale #{order.OrderNumber}";
            _editingOrder = order;
            _drawerMode = SliderMode.Edit;

            dataModel = new CreateSalesOrderDtoModels
            {
                BranchId = order.BranchId ?? Guid.Empty,
                SalesDate = order.OrderDate,
                Naration = order.Naration,
                Chalan = order.Chalan,
                Notes = order.Notes,
                SubTotal = order.SubTotal,
                LabourCharge = order.LabourCharge,
                TruckCharge = order.TruckCharge,
                TaxAmount = order.TaxAmount,
                DiscountAmount = order.DiscountAmount,
                DiscountType = order.DiscountType,
                TotalAmount = order.TotalAmount,
                PaidAmount = order.PaidAmount,
                DueAmount = order.DueAmount,
                CustomerDdlControl = new ControlDto
                {
                    SelectedItem = new ControlItemsDto
                    {
                        Id = order.CustomerId,
                        Name = order.Customer?.CustomerName ?? "",
                        IsSelected = false
                    }
                },
                ItemsLine = order.Items.Select(i => new CreateSalesOrderItemDto(
                    i.ProductId, i.Quantity, i.UnitPrice, i.DiscountAmount, i.DiscountType,
                    i.TotalDiscount, i.LineTotalPrice, null, null)).ToList()
            };

        }

        var parameters = new DialogParameters<SalesOrderDialog>
        {
            { x => x.Customers, _customers },
            { x => x.Products, _drawerProducts },
            { x => x.dataModel, dataModel },
            { x => x.OnSubmit, EventCallback.Factory.Create<CreateSalesOrderDto>(this, HandleFormSubmit) },
            { x => x.OnSubmitAndPrint, EventCallback.Factory.Create<CreateSalesOrderDto>(this, HandleFormSubmitAndPrint) },
            { x => x.OnCancel, EventCallback.Factory.Create(this, CloseDialog) }
        };

        var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<SalesOrderDialog>(dialogTitle, parameters,
            new DialogOptions
            {
                MaxWidth = MaxWidth.Large,
                FullWidth = true,
                CloseOnEscapeKey = true,
                CloseButton = true
            });

        await dialog.Result;

    }

    private async Task HandleFormSubmit(CreateSalesOrderDto dto)
    {
        try
        {
            if (_drawerMode == SliderMode.Edit && _editingOrder != null)
            {
                await OrderService.UpdateSalesOrder(_editingOrder.Id, dto);
                Snackbar.Add("Sales order updated", Severity.Success);
            }
            else
            {
                await OrderService.CreateSalesOrder(dto);
                Snackbar.Add("Sales created successfully", Severity.Success);
            }
            await LoadOrders();
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
    }

    private async Task HandleFormSubmitAndPrint(CreateSalesOrderDto dto)
    {
        await HandleFormSubmit(dto);
    }
    
    private Task CloseDialog() => Task.CompletedTask;

    private async Task DeleteOrder(Guid id)
    {
        var confirm = await DialogService.ShowMessageBoxAsync("Delete Sales Order",
            "This will permanently delete the sales order. Continue?", "Yes, Delete", "No");
        if (confirm == true)
        {
            try
            {
                await OrderService.DeleteSalesOrder(id);
                Snackbar.Add("Sales order deleted", Severity.Success);
                await LoadOrders();
            }
            catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
        }
    }

    public void Dispose()
    {
        _debounceCts?.Cancel();
        _debounceCts?.Dispose();
    }
}
