        </div>
    </DialogActions>
</MudDialog>


@inject IDialogService DialogService
@inject IBranchService BranchService
@inject ICustomerService CustomerService
@inject IProductService ProductService
@inject ICategoryService CategoryService
@inject IBrandService BrandService
@inject IProductSerialService ProductSerialService
@inject ISnackbar Snackbar

@code {
    [CascadingParameter] private IMudDialogInstance MudDialog { get; set; } = default!;
    [Parameter] public List<CustomerDto> Customers { get; set; } = new();
    [Parameter] public List<(Guid Id, string Name, string SKU, decimal Price)> Products { get; set; } = new();
    [Parameter] public CreateSalesOrderDtoModels dataModel { get; set; } = new CreateSalesOrderDtoModels();
    [Parameter] public EventCallback<CreateSalesOrderDto> OnSubmit { get; set; }
    [Parameter] public EventCallback<CreateSalesOrderDto> OnSubmitAndPrint { get; set; }
    [Parameter] public EventCallback OnCancel { get; set; }

    private MudForm _form = default;

    private MudTextField<string>? RefNaration;
    private MudNumericField<int> RefQuantity;
    private MudNumericField<decimal>? RefDiscountAmount;

    private List<BranchDto> _Branches = new();
    private static readonly ControlItemsDto AddNewCustomerOption = new ControlItemsDto() { Id = Guid.Empty, Name = "Add New" };

    // private MudAutocomplete<FilterItem> CustomerDropDownControl = default!;
    // private string? _customerText;
    // private FilterItem? _lastCustomerSelection;

    private string _branchtext = "";
    private int _editingItemIndex = -1;

    private static readonly ControlItemsDto AddNewProductOption = new() { Id = Guid.Empty, Name = "Add New", IsSelected = false };


    private List<ProductSerialDto> _availableSerials = new();
    private IReadOnlyCollection<Guid> _selectedSerialSet = Array.Empty<Guid>();

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        _Branches = await BranchService.GetBranches();

        if (dataModel.BranchId == Guid.Empty)
            dataModel.BranchId = _Branches.FirstOrDefault()?.Id ?? Guid.Empty;

        //if (dataModel.CustomerDdlControl.SelectedItem != null && dataModel.CustomerDdlControl.SelectedItem?.Id == Guid.Empty && Customers.Count > 0)
        //  dataModel.CustomerDdlControl.SelectedItem = Customers.Select(x => new ControlItemsDto() { Id = x.Id, Name = x.CustomerName, IsSelected = x.IsActive }).First();

        if (dataModel.CustomerDdlControl.SelectedItem != null && dataModel.CustomerDdlControl.SelectedItem?.Id != Guid.Empty)
        {
            dataModel.CustomerDdlControl.SelectedText = dataModel.CustomerDdlControl.SelectedItem.Name;
            dataModel.CustomerDdlControl.LastSelectedItem = dataModel.CustomerDdlControl.SelectedItem;
        }

        if (dataModel.ProductObj.ProductId == Guid.Empty && Products.Count > 0)
        {
            dataModel.ProductObj.ProductId = Products.First().Id;
            dataModel.ProductObj.UnitPrice = Products.First().Price;
        }
    }
    
    private async Task OnBranncheChanged(Guid? value)
    {
        dataModel.BranchId=value;

        await Task.Delay(100);
        if (dataModel.CustomerDdlControl.ControlRef is not null)
        {
            await dataModel.CustomerDdlControl.ControlRef.FocusAsync();
        }
    }
    
    protected async Task OnBrancheValueChanged(Guid brancheId)
    {
        var branche = _Branches.FirstOrDefault(b => b.Id == brancheId);
        dataModel.BranchName = branche?.Name;
        _branchtext = branche?.Name;
        dataModel.BranchId = brancheId;
    }

    private async Task OnCustomerChanged()
    {
        var cust = dataModel.CustomerDdlControl.SelectedItem;

        if (cust?.Id == Guid.Empty)
        {
            var previousCustomer = dataModel.CustomerDdlControl.SelectedItem;
            var parameters = new DialogParameters<CustomerDialog>
            {
                { x => x.Customer, new CustomerDto(){ Id = Guid.Empty, CustomerName = string.Empty, CustomerEmail = string.Empty, CustomerPhone = string.Empty, Address = string.Empty, City = string.Empty, Zila = string.Empty, State = string.Empty, Country = string.Empty, PostalCode = string.Empty, CreditLimit = 0, PaymentTerms = string.Empty, IsActive = false, IsTaxExempt = false } }
                //{ x => x.Customer, Customers.Where(c => c.Id != Guid.Empty).FirstOrDefault() }
            };

            var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<CustomerDialog>("New Customer", parameters,
                new DialogOptions { MaxWidth = MaxWidth.Small, FullWidth = true, CloseButton = true });
            var result = await dialog.Result;

            await dataModel.CustomerDdlControl.ControlRef.ResetAsync();

            if (result != null && !result.Canceled && result.Data is CustomerDto dto)
            {
                // The service owns the insert + SaveChanges; the old code hand-built an entity and
                // saved through the page's scoped DbContext, which leaked a tracked entity here.
                var newCustomerId = await CustomerService.CreateCustomerAsync(dto);
                Snackbar.Add("Customer created successfully", Severity.Success);

                Customers = await CustomerService.GetActiveCustomersAsync();

                cust = new ControlItemsDto() { Id = newCustomerId, Name = dto.CustomerName };

                await UpdateControlSelection(dataModel.CustomerDdlControl, cust);

                StateHasChanged();
            }
            else
            {
                await UpdateControlSelection(dataModel.CustomerDdlControl, cust);

                //dataModel.SelectedCustomer = previousCustomer;
                //_lastCustomerSelection = dataModel.SelectedCustomer;
                //_customer = previousCustomer;
                //_customerText = dataModel.SelectedCustomer?.Name;

                StateHasChanged();
            }
        }
        else
        {
            await UpdateControlSelection(dataModel.CustomerDdlControl, cust);
            //dataModel.SelectedCustomer = cust;
            //_lastCustomerSelection = dataModel.SelectedCustomer;
            //_customerText = dataModel.SelectedCustomer?.Name;
        }

        if (RefNaration is not null)
        {
            await RefNaration.FocusAsync();
        }
    }

    private async Task UpdateControlSelection(ControlDto control, ControlItemsDto? selectedItem)
    {
        if (selectedItem != null)
        {
            control.SelectedItem = selectedItem;
            control.LastSelectedItem = selectedItem;
            control.SelectedText = selectedItem.Name ?? selectedItem.Text1;
            control.SelectedIndex++;
        }
    }

    private Task<IEnumerable<ControlItemsDto>> SearchCustomers(string text, CancellationToken _)
    {
        IEnumerable<ControlItemsDto> baseResults;

        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text))
        {
            baseResults = Customers.Where(c => c.Id != Guid.Empty).Select(c => new ControlItemsDto() { Id = c.Id, Name = c.CustomerName });
        }
        else
        {
            baseResults = Customers.Where(c =>
                c.Id != Guid.Empty &&
                (c.CustomerName.Contains(text, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)))
                .Select(c => new ControlItemsDto() { Id = c.Id, Name = c.CustomerName });
        }

        var results = baseResults.OrderBy(x => x.Name).DistinctBy(c => c.Id);
        results = baseResults.Concat(new[] { AddNewCustomerOption });

        // var results = new[] { AddNewCustomerOption }.Concat(baseResults).DistinctBy(c => c.Id);
        //var results = baseResults.Append(AddNewCustomerOption).DistinctBy(c => c.Id).ToList();

        return Task.FromResult(results);
    }

    private async Task OnProductFilterChanged(Guid productId)
    {
        var p = Products.FirstOrDefault(p => p.Id == productId);
        if (p != default)
        {
            dataModel.ProductObj.ProductId = p.Id;
            dataModel.ProductObj.Quantity = 1;
            dataModel.ProductObj.UnitPrice = p.Price;
            dataModel.ProductObj.DiscountType = (int)DiscountType.Percentage;
            dataModel.ProductObj.DiscountAmount = 0m;
            dataModel.ProductObj.TotalDiscount = 0m;
        }
    }

    private async Task StartEditItem(int index, CreateSalesOrderItemDto item)
    {
        if (dataModel.ItemsLine.Any(x => x.ProductId == Guid.Empty)) return;

        _editingItemIndex = index;
        var product = Products.FirstOrDefault(p => p.Id == item.ProductId);
        dataModel.ProductObj.ProductId = item.ProductId;
        dataModel.ProductObj.ProductDdlControl.SelectedItem = product != default
            ? new ControlItemsDto() { Id = product.Id, Name = product.Name, IsSelected = false }
            : new ControlItemsDto() { Id = Guid.Empty, Name = "", IsSelected = false };
        dataModel.ProductObj.Quantity = item.Quantity;
        dataModel.ProductObj.UnitPrice = item.UnitPrice;
        dataModel.ProductObj.DiscountAmount = item.DiscountAmount;
        dataModel.ProductObj.DiscountType = item.DiscountType;
        dataModel.ProductObj.TotalDiscount = item.TotalDiscount;
        dataModel.ProductObj.TotalPrice = item.TotalPrice;

        await UpdateControlSelection(dataModel.ProductObj.ProductDdlControl, dataModel.ProductObj.ProductDdlControl.SelectedItem);

        //_editProductText = product != default ? product.Name : "";
        //_editLastProductSelection = dataModel.ProductObj.ProductDdlControl;
    }

    private async Task SaveEditItem(int index)
    {
        if (dataModel.ProductObj.ProductId == Guid.Empty || dataModel.ProductObj.Quantity <= 0) return;

        CalculateLineTotal();
        var updated = new CreateSalesOrderItemDto(
            dataModel.ProductObj.ProductId,
            dataModel.ProductObj.Quantity,
            dataModel.ProductObj.UnitPrice,
            dataModel.ProductObj.DiscountAmount,
            dataModel.ProductObj.DiscountType,
            dataModel.ProductObj.TotalDiscount,
            dataModel.ProductObj.TotalPrice,
            null,
            dataModel.ItemsLine[index].SerialIds);

        dataModel.ItemsLine[index] = updated;
        dataModel.SubTotal = dataModel.ItemsLine.Sum(i => i.TotalPrice);
        _editingItemIndex = -1;
    }

    private async Task CancelEditItem()
    {
        _editingItemIndex = -1;

        if (RefDiscountAmount is not null)
        {
            await RefDiscountAmount.FocusAsync();
        }
    }
    
    private async Task RemoveEditItem(CreateSalesOrderItemDto item)
    {
        dataModel.ItemsLine.Remove(item);
        if (RefDiscountAmount is not null)
        {
            await RefDiscountAmount.FocusAsync();
        }
    }
    
    private async Task OnEditProductChanged()
    {
        var prod = dataModel.ProductObj.ProductDdlControl?.SelectedItem;
        if (prod == null) return;

        var p = Products.FirstOrDefault(p => p.Id == prod.Id);
        if (p != default)
        {
            dataModel.ProductObj.ProductId = p.Id;
            dataModel.ProductObj.UnitPrice = p.Price;
            dataModel.ProductObj.DiscountType = (int)DiscountType.Percentage;
            dataModel.ProductObj.DiscountAmount = 0m;
            dataModel.ProductObj.TotalDiscount = 0m;
        }
        dataModel.ProductObj.ProductDdlControl.LastSelectedItem = prod;
        dataModel.ProductObj.ProductDdlControl.SelectedText = prod?.Name;

        if (RefQuantity is not null)
        {
            await RefQuantity.FocusAsync();
        }
    }
    
    private async Task FocusSelectBox()
    {
        await Task.Delay(100);
        if (dataModel.ProductObj.ProductDdlControl.ControlRef is not null)
        {
            await dataModel.ProductObj.ProductDdlControl.ControlRef.ResetAsync();
            await dataModel.ProductObj.ProductDdlControl.ControlRef.FocusAsync();
        }
    }
   
    private async Task AddNewItem()
    {
        var item = dataModel.ItemsLine.Where(x => x.ProductId == Guid.Empty).FirstOrDefault();
        if (item != null) return;
        if (_editingItemIndex >= 0) return;

        dataModel.ProductObj.ProductDdlControl.LastSelectedItem = null;
        dataModel.ProductObj.ProductDdlControl.SelectedText = "";
        _availableSerials = new();
        _selectedSerialSet = Array.Empty<Guid>();
        dataModel.ProductObj.ProductDdlControl.SelectedItem = new ControlItemsDto() { Id = Guid.Empty, Name = "", IsSelected = false };
        dataModel.ProductObj.SelectedSerialIds = new();

        dataModel.ItemsLine.Insert(0, new CreateSalesOrderItemDto(Guid.Empty, 0, 0, 0, (int)DiscountType.Percentage, 0, 0, null));
        dataModel.ProductObj.Quantity = 1;
        dataModel.ProductObj.DiscountAmount = 0;

        await FocusSelectBox();
    }

    private async Task AddItem()
    {

        if (dataModel.ProductObj.ProductDdlControl.SelectedItem.Id == Guid.Empty || dataModel.ProductObj.Quantity <= 0) return;

        dataModel.ItemsLine.Insert(dataModel.ItemsLine.Count, new CreateSalesOrderItemDto(dataModel.ProductObj.ProductDdlControl.SelectedItem.Id, dataModel.ProductObj.Quantity, dataModel.ProductObj.UnitPrice, dataModel.ProductObj.DiscountAmount, dataModel.ProductObj.DiscountType, dataModel.ProductObj.TotalDiscount, dataModel.ProductObj.TotalPrice, null, _selectedSerialSet.Count > 0 ? _selectedSerialSet.ToList() : null));
        dataModel.ProductObj.Quantity = 1;
        dataModel.ProductObj.DiscountAmount = 0;
        dataModel.ProductObj.SelectedSerialIds = new();
        dataModel.SubTotal = dataModel.ItemsLine.Sum(i => i.TotalPrice);
        _availableSerials = new();
        _selectedSerialSet = Array.Empty<Guid>();

        if (Products.Count > 0) { dataModel.ProductObj.ProductDdlControl.SelectedItem.Id = Products.First().Id; dataModel.ProductObj.ProductDdlControl.SelectedItem.Name = Products.First().Name; }

        //dataModel.ItemsLine = dataModel.ItemsLine.OrderByDescending(x => x.ProductId).ToList();

        await FocusSelectBox();
    }

    private async Task OnProductChanged()
    {
        var prod = dataModel.ProductObj.ProductDdlControl.SelectedItem;

        if (prod?.Id == Guid.Empty)
        {
            var categories = await CategoryService.GetAllCategoriesAsync();
            var brands = await BrandService.GetAllBrandsAsync();
            var parameters = new DialogParameters<ProductAddEditDialog>
            {   { x => x.DataModel, new ProductDetailsDto() },
                { x => x.Categories, categories },
                { x => x.Brands, brands }
            };

            var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<ProductAddEditDialog>("New Product", parameters,
                new DialogOptions { MaxWidth = MaxWidth.Medium, FullWidth = true, CloseButton = true });
            var result = await dialog.Result;

            await dataModel.ProductObj.ProductDdlControl.ControlRef.ResetAsync();

            if (result != null && !result.Canceled && result.Data is ProductDetailsDto dto)
            {
                // The service owns the insert + SaveChanges (and the product cache invalidation);
                // the old code hand-built the entity and saved through the page's DbContext.
                var newProductId = await ProductService.CreateProductAsync(dto);
                Snackbar.Add("Product created successfully", Severity.Success);

                var latestProducts = await ProductService.GetProductOptionsAsync();
                Products = latestProducts.Select(p => (p.Id, p.Name, p.Sku, p.SellingPrice)).ToList();

                prod = new ControlItemsDto() { Id = newProductId, Name = dto.Name, IsSelected = false };


                var p = Products.FirstOrDefault(p => p.Id == prod.Id);
                if (p != default)
                {
                    dataModel.ProductObj.ProductId = p.Id;
                    dataModel.ProductObj.Quantity = 1;
                    dataModel.ProductObj.UnitPrice = p.Price;
                    dataModel.ProductObj.DiscountType = (int)DiscountType.Percentage;
                    dataModel.ProductObj.DiscountAmount = 0m;
                    dataModel.ProductObj.TotalDiscount = 0m;
                }
                // dataModel.ProductObj.ProductDdlControl.SelectedItem = prod;
                // dataModel.ProductObj.ProductDdlControl.LastSelectedItem = prod;
                // dataModel.ProductObj.ProductDdlControl.SelectedText = prod?.Name;

                await UpdateControlSelection(dataModel.ProductObj.ProductDdlControl, prod);

                StateHasChanged();
            }
            else
            {
                var previousProduct = dataModel.ProductObj.ProductDdlControl.LastSelectedItem;
                var p = Products.FirstOrDefault(p => p.Id == previousProduct?.Id);
                if (p != default)
                {
                    dataModel.ProductObj.ProductId = p.Id;
                    dataModel.ProductObj.Quantity = 1;
                    dataModel.ProductObj.UnitPrice = p.Price;
                    dataModel.ProductObj.DiscountType = (int)DiscountType.Percentage;
                    dataModel.ProductObj.DiscountAmount = 0m;
                    dataModel.ProductObj.TotalDiscount = 0m;
                }

                await UpdateControlSelection(dataModel.ProductObj.ProductDdlControl, previousProduct);

                StateHasChanged();
            }
        }
        else
        {
            var p = Products.FirstOrDefault(p => p.Id == prod?.Id);
            if (p != default)
            {
                dataModel.ProductObj.ProductId = p.Id;
                dataModel.ProductObj.Quantity = 1;
                dataModel.ProductObj.UnitPrice = p.Price;
                dataModel.ProductObj.DiscountType = (int)DiscountType.Percentage;
                dataModel.ProductObj.DiscountAmount = 0m;
                dataModel.ProductObj.TotalDiscount = 0m;

                // Load available serials for this product
                _selectedSerialSet = Array.Empty<Guid>();
                _availableSerials = await ProductSerialService.GetAvailableSerialsByProduct(p.Id);
            }
            await UpdateControlSelection(dataModel.ProductObj.ProductDdlControl, prod);
        }

        if (RefQuantity is not null)
        {
            await RefQuantity.FocusAsync();
        }
    }

    private Task<IEnumerable<ControlItemsDto>> SearchProducts(string text, CancellationToken _)
    {
        IEnumerable<ControlItemsDto> baseResults;

        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text))
        {
            baseResults = Products.Where(c => c.Id != Guid.Empty).Select(c => new ControlItemsDto() { Id = c.Id, Name = c.Name, IsSelected = false });
        }
        else
        {
            baseResults = Products.Where(c =>
                c.Id != Guid.Empty &&
                (c.Name.Contains(text, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)))
                .Select(c => new ControlItemsDto() { Id = c.Id, Name = c.Name, IsSelected = false });
        }

        //var results = new[] { AddNewCustomerOption }.Concat(baseResults).DistinctBy(c => c.Id);
        var results = baseResults.Append(AddNewCustomerOption).DistinctBy(c => c.Id);

        return Task.FromResult(results);
    }

    private async Task ToggleSerial(Guid id, bool selected)
    {
        if (selected) _selectedSerialSet = _selectedSerialSet.Append(id).ToArray();
        else _selectedSerialSet = _selectedSerialSet.Where(x => x != id).ToArray();
    }

    private void CalculateLineTotal()
    {
        dataModel.ProductObj.TotalDiscount = 0;
        if (dataModel.ProductObj.DiscountType == (int)DiscountType.Percentage)
        {
            dataModel.ProductObj.TotalDiscount = (dataModel.ProductObj.UnitPrice * dataModel.ProductObj.Quantity) * (dataModel.ProductObj.DiscountAmount / 100);
        }
        else
        {
            dataModel.ProductObj.TotalDiscount = dataModel.ProductObj.DiscountAmount;
        }

        dataModel.ProductObj.TotalPrice = ((dataModel.ProductObj.UnitPrice * dataModel.ProductObj.Quantity) - dataModel.ProductObj.TotalDiscount);
    }

    private void CalculationBalance()
    {
        decimal totalVatAmount = 0;
        decimal vat = dataModel.TaxAmount;
        if (vat > 0)
            totalVatAmount = (dataModel.SubTotal) * ((dataModel.TaxAmount) / 100); ;

        dataModel.TotalAmount = (dataModel.SubTotal) + totalVatAmount + (dataModel.LabourCharge) + (dataModel.TruckCharge);

        decimal? discountAmt = 0m;

        if (dataModel.DiscountType == (int)DiscountType.Percentage)
        {
            discountAmt = (dataModel.SubTotal) * (dataModel.DiscountAmount / 100);
        }
        else
        {
            discountAmt = dataModel.DiscountAmount;
        }

        dataModel.TotalAmount = dataModel.TotalAmount - (discountAmt ?? 0);

        dataModel.DueAmount = (dataModel.TotalAmount) - (dataModel.PaidAmount);
    }

    private async Task Cancel()
    {
        await OnCancel.InvokeAsync();
        MudDialog.Cancel();
    }

    private async Task Submit()
    {
        
        await _form.ValidateAsync();

        if (!_form.IsValid)
            return;

        var dto = new CreateSalesOrderDto(dataModel.CustomerDdlControl.SelectedItem.Id, null, dataModel.BranchId, dataModel.Notes, null, null, null,
            OrderStatus.Sold, dataModel.SalesDate ?? DateTime.Today, dataModel.SubTotal, dataModel.LabourCharge, dataModel.TruckCharge,
            dataModel.TaxAmount, dataModel.DiscountType, dataModel.DiscountAmount, dataModel.TotalAmount, dataModel.PaidAmount, dataModel.DueAmount, dataModel.ItemsLine);
        await OnSubmit.InvokeAsync(dto);
        MudDialog.Close(DialogResult.Ok(dto));
    }

    private async Task SubmitToPrint()
    {
        await _form.ValidateAsync();

        if (!_form.IsValid)
            return;

        var dto = new CreateSalesOrderDto(dataModel.CustomerDdlControl.SelectedItem.Id, null, dataModel.BranchId, dataModel.Notes, null, null, null,
            OrderStatus.Delivered, dataModel.SalesDate ?? DateTime.Today, dataModel.SubTotal, dataModel.LabourCharge, dataModel.TruckCharge,
            dataModel.TaxAmount, dataModel.DiscountType, dataModel.DiscountAmount, dataModel.TotalAmount, dataModel.PaidAmount, dataModel.DueAmount, dataModel.ItemsLine);
        await OnSubmitAndPrint.InvokeAsync(dto);
        MudDialog.Close(DialogResult.Ok(dto));
    }

    private string GetMultiSelectionText(IReadOnlyList<string> selectedValues)
    {
        // if (_multiselectionTextChoice)
        // {
        //     return $"Selected state{(selectedValues.Count > 1 ? "s" : "")}: {string.Join(", ", selectedValues.Select(x => x))}";
        // }

        if (selectedValues.Count == 0)
            return "No serials selected";

        return $"{selectedValues.Count} serial{(selectedValues.Count > 1 ? "s" : "")} selected";
    }

}

@code {
    [Parameter] public EventCallback OnOrderUpdated { get; set; }

    private bool _open;
    private bool _animateIn;
    private bool _loading;
    private SalesOrderDto? _order;

    private async Task DownloadPdf()
    {
        if (_order is null) return;
        try
        {
            var doc = await PrintRenderer.RenderSalesOrderAsync(_order);
            await JS.InvokeVoidAsync("downloadFile", doc.Html, doc.FileName + ".pdf", doc.Title, doc.Reference);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            await JS.InvokeVoidAsync("alert", "Could not generate the PDF: " + ex.Message);
        }
    }

    private async Task PrintDoc()
    {
        if (_order is null) return;
        try
        {
            var doc = await PrintRenderer.RenderSalesOrderAsync(_order);
            await JS.InvokeVoidAsync("printHtml", doc.Html, doc.Title, doc.Reference);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            await JS.InvokeVoidAsync("alert", "Could not print the document: " + ex.Message);
        }
    }

    public async Task OpenAsync(Guid id)
    {
        _open = true;
        _loading = true;
        _animateIn = false;
        _order = null;
        StateHasChanged();

        // Small delay so the panel renders before the slide-in class is added
        await Task.Delay(20);
        _animateIn = true;
        StateHasChanged();

        try
        {
            _order = await OrderService.GetSalesOrderById(id);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error);
        }

        _loading = false;
        StateHasChanged();
    }

    public void Close()
    {
        _open = false;
        _animateIn = false;
        _order = null;
        StateHasChanged();
    }

    private async Task OpenEdit()
    {
        if (_order == null) return;

        // One service call each â€” this previously ran the same customer + product lookup twice
        // (once against the page's scoped DbContext) only to bind the editor's pickers.
        var customers = await CustomerService.GetActiveCustomersAsync();
        var products = await ProductService.GetProductOptionsAsync();

        var editModel = new CreateSalesOrderDtoModels
        {
            BranchId = _order.BranchId ?? Guid.Empty,
            BranchName = _order.Branch?.Name,
            Notes = _order.Notes,
            SalesDate = _order.OrderDate,
            Naration = _order.Naration,
            Chalan = _order.Chalan,
            SubTotal = _order.SubTotal,
            LabourCharge = _order.LabourCharge,
            TruckCharge = _order.TruckCharge,
            TaxAmount = _order.TaxAmount,
            DiscountAmount = _order.DiscountAmount,
            DiscountType =  _order.DiscountType,
            TotalAmount = _order.TotalAmount,
            PaidAmount = _order.PaidAmount,
            DueAmount = _order.DueAmount,
            CustomerDdlControl=new ControlDto()
            {
                SelectedItem = _order.CustomerId != Guid.Empty
                    ? new ControlItemsDto() { Id = _order.CustomerId, Name = _order.Customer?.CustomerName ?? "", IsSelected = false }
                    : new ControlItemsDto() { Id = Guid.Empty, Name = "", IsSelected = false }
                
            }, 
            ItemsLine = _order.Items
                .Select(i => new CreateSalesOrderItemDto(
                    i.ProductId, i.Quantity, i.UnitPrice,
                    i.DiscountAmount, i.DiscountType,
                    i.TotalDiscount, i.LineTotalPrice, null))
                .ToList()
        };

        var parameters = new DialogParameters<SalesOrderDialog>
        {
            { x => x.Customers, customers },
            { x => x.Products, products.Select(p => (p.Id, p.Name, p.Sku, p.SellingPrice)).ToList() },
            { x => x.dataModel, editModel }
        };

        var orderId = _order.Id;
        var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<SalesOrderDialog>(
            $"Edit Sales Order â€” {_order.OrderNumber}", parameters,
            new DialogOptions { MaxWidth = MaxWidth.Large, FullWidth = true, CloseButton = true });

        var result = await dialog.Result;

        if (result != null && !result.Canceled && result.Data is CreateSalesOrderDto dto)
        {
            try
            {
                await OrderService.UpdateSalesOrder(orderId, dto);
                Snackbar.Add("Sales order updated successfully", Severity.Success);

                // Refresh panel with updated order
                _loading = true;
                StateHasChanged();
                _order = await OrderService.GetSalesOrderById(orderId);
                _loading = false;
                StateHasChanged();

                await OnOrderUpdated.InvokeAsync();
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error);
            }
        }
    }
}

@code {
    [CascadingParameter] private IMudDialogInstance MudDialog { get; set; } = null!;
    private List<SalesOrderDto> salesOrders = new();
    private SalesReturnDto salesReturnDto = new();
    private CustomerDto customer = null;

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        var result = await OrderService.GetSalesOrders(null, null, 1, 200);
        salesOrders = result.Items;
    }

    private Task<IEnumerable<ControlItemsDto>> SearchSalesOrder(string text, CancellationToken _)
    {
        var results = salesOrders
            .Where(order => string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text) || order.OrderNumber.Contains(text, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            .Select(order => new ControlItemsDto { Id = order.Id, Name = order.OrderNumber, IsSelected = false });
        return Task.FromResult<IEnumerable<ControlItemsDto>>(results);
    }

    private async Task OnSalesOrderChanged()
    {
        if (salesReturnDto.SalesReturnDdlControl.SelectedItem is null)
            return;

        SalesOrderDto? detail = await OrderService.GetSalesOrderById(salesReturnDto.SalesReturnDdlControl.SelectedItem.Id);
        if (detail is null)
        {
            salesReturnDto.ItemsLine = new List<SalesReturnItemDto>();
            return;
        }
        customer = detail.Customer;

        salesReturnDto.ItemsLine = detail.Items.Select(item => new SalesReturnItemDto
        {
            ProductId = item.ProductId,
            ProductName = item.ProductName,
            Quantity = item.Quantity,
            UnitPrice = item.UnitPrice,
            LineTotal = item.Quantity * item.UnitPrice
        }).ToList();
    }

    private static void UpdateLineTotal(SalesReturnItemDto item, int quantity, decimal unitPrice)
    {
        item.Quantity = quantity;
        item.UnitPrice = unitPrice;
        item.LineTotal = quantity * unitPrice;
    }

    private void Submit()
    {
        if (salesReturnDto.SalesReturnDdlControl.SelectedItem is null)
        {
            Snackbar.Add("Select a sales order.", Severity.Warning);
            return;
        }

        salesReturnDto.SalesOrderId = salesReturnDto.SalesReturnDdlControl.SelectedItem.Id;
        salesReturnDto.SalesOrderNumber = salesReturnDto.SalesReturnDdlControl.SelectedItem.Name;
        salesReturnDto.TotalAmount = salesReturnDto.ItemsLine.Where(item => item.IsSelected).Sum(item => item.LineTotal);
        MudDialog.Close(DialogResult.Ok(salesReturnDto));
    }

    private void Cancel() => MudDialog.Cancel();
}

<SalesReturnViewPanel @ref="_salesReturnViewPanel" />

@code {
    private static class Col
    {
        public const string ReturnNumber = "ReturnNumber";
        public const string SalesOrderNumber = "SalesOrderNumber";
        public const string TotalAmount = "TotalAmount";
        public const string Reason = "Reason";
        public const string Status = "Status";
    }

    private readonly List<SalesReturnStatus> ReturnStatuses = Enum.GetValues<SalesReturnStatus>().ToList();

    // â”€â”€â”€ List state â”€â”€â”€
    private PagedResultNew<SalesReturnDto> pagedResultNew = new();
    private SalesReturnPagedRequest pagedRequest = new()
    {
        SortColumn = "CreatedAt",
        SortAscending = false
    };

    private bool _loading = true;
    private bool _hasLoadedOnce;
    private bool _loadRunning;
    private bool _loadQueued;
    private CancellationTokenSource? _debounceCts;

    private SalesReturnViewPanel? _salesReturnViewPanel;

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync() => await Load();

    private async Task Refresh() => await Load();

    /// <summary>
    /// Single-flight loader. The page and the services share one scoped DbContext, so two
    /// overlapping queries would throw "A second operation was started on this context
    /// instance". Callers that arrive mid-flight set a flag instead of starting a parallel
    /// query, and the running load then re-runs once with the newest filter state.
    /// </summary>
    private async Task Load()
    {
        if (_loadRunning)
        {
            _loadQueued = true;
            return;
        }

        _loadRunning = true;
        try
        {
            do
            {
                _loadQueued = false;
                await LoadCore();
            }
            while (_loadQueued);
        }
        finally { _loadRunning = false; }
    }

    private async Task LoadCore()
    {
        _loading = true;
        try
        {
            pagedResultNew = await SalesReturnService.GetSalesReturnsAsync(pagedRequest);
            _hasLoadedOnce = true;
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
        finally { _loading = false; }
    }

    // â”€â”€â”€ Stats / sorting helpers â”€â”€â”€
    private string TotalCountText => Stat("TotalCount");
    private string DraftCountText => Stat("DraftCount");
    private string ApprovedCountText => Stat("ApprovedCount");
    private string ReceivedCountText => Stat("ReceivedCount");
    private string CompletedCountText => Stat("CompletedCount");
    private string TotalReturnedText =>
        int.TryParse(Stat("TotalReturned"), out var v) ? v.ToString("N0") : "0";

    private string Stat(string key) =>
        pagedResultNew.Stats != null && pagedResultNew.Stats.TryGetValue(key, out var v) ? v.ToString() : "0";

    private void SortBy(string column)
    {
        if (pagedRequest.SortColumn == column)
            pagedRequest.SortAscending = !pagedRequest.SortAscending;
        else
        {
            pagedRequest.SortColumn = column;
            pagedRequest.SortAscending = true;
        }
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
    }

    private string SortIcon(string column)
    {
        if (pagedRequest.SortColumn != column) return "";
        return pagedRequest.SortAscending ? "â–²" : "â–¼";
    }

    // â”€â”€â”€ Filters â”€â”€â”€
    private void OnSearchInput(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        pagedRequest.SearchTerm = e.Value?.ToString() ?? "";
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;

        _debounceCts?.Cancel();
        _debounceCts?.Dispose();
        _debounceCts = new CancellationTokenSource();
        var token = _debounceCts.Token;

        _ = Task.Run(async () =>
        {
            try
            {
                await Task.Delay(400, token);
                if (token.IsCancellationRequested) return;
                await InvokeAsync(async () =>
                {
                    await Load();
                    StateHasChanged();
                });
            }
            catch (OperationCanceledException) { }
        });
    }

    private async Task OnStatusChanged(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        pagedRequest.Status = Enum.TryParse<SalesReturnStatus>(e.Value?.ToString(), out var s) ? s : null;
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await Load();
    }

    private async Task OnRangeChanged((DateTime? From, DateTime? To) range)
    {
        pagedRequest.From = range.From;
        pagedRequest.To = range.To;
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await Load();
    }

    private async Task FilterByStatus(SalesReturnStatus? status)
    {
        pagedRequest.Status = pagedRequest.Status == status ? null : status;
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await Load();
    }

    private async Task ResetFilters()
    {
        pagedRequest.SearchTerm = "";
        pagedRequest.Status = null;
        pagedRequest.From = null;
        pagedRequest.To = null;
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
        await Load();
    }

    // â”€â”€â”€ Paging (zero-based, matches TmPager) â”€â”€â”€
    private async Task GoToPage(int page)
    {
        pagedRequest.CurrentPage = Math.Clamp(page, 0, Math.Max(0, pagedResultNew.TotalPages - 1));
        await Load();
    }

    private async Task GoPrevPage()
    {
        if (pagedRequest.CurrentPage > 0)
        {
            pagedRequest.CurrentPage--;
            await Load();
        }
    }

    private async Task GoNextPage()
    {
        if (pagedRequest.CurrentPage < pagedResultNew.TotalPages - 1)
        {
            pagedRequest.CurrentPage++;
            await Load();
        }
    }

    private async Task OnPageSizeChanged(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        if (int.TryParse(e.Value?.ToString(), out var sz))
        {
            pagedRequest.PageSize = Math.Clamp(sz, 1, 100);
            pagedRequest.CurrentPage = 0;
            await Load();
        }
    }

    private async Task OpenCreate()
    {
        var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<SalesReturnDialog>("New Sales Return",
            new DialogOptions { MaxWidth = MaxWidth.Medium, FullWidth = true, CloseButton = true });
        var result = await dialog.Result;

        if (result is not null && !result.Canceled && result.Data is SalesReturnDto dto)
        {
            await SalesReturnService.CreateSalesReturn(dto);
            Snackbar.Add("Sales return created successfully.", Severity.Success);
            await Load();
        }
    }

    private async Task Approve(Guid id)
    {
        try
        {
            await SalesReturnService.ApproveSalesReturn(id);
            Snackbar.Add("Return approved.", Severity.Success);
            await Load();
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
    }

    private async Task Complete(Guid id)
    {
        try
        {
            await SalesReturnService.CompleteSalesReturn(id);
            Snackbar.Add("Return completed.", Severity.Success);
            await Load();
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
    }

    private async Task ViewReturn(Guid id)
    {
        if (_salesReturnViewPanel != null)
            await _salesReturnViewPanel.OpenAsync(id);
    }

    private static string GetStatusPill(SalesReturnStatus s) => s switch
    {
        SalesReturnStatus.Draft => "tm-pill tm-pill-purple",
        SalesReturnStatus.Approved => "tm-pill tm-pill-amber",
        SalesReturnStatus.Received => "tm-pill tm-pill-blue",
        SalesReturnStatus.Completed => "tm-pill tm-pill-green",
        SalesReturnStatus.Cancelled => "tm-pill tm-pill-red",
        _ => "tm-pill tm-pill-blue"
    };

    public void Dispose()
    {
        _debounceCts?.Cancel();
        _debounceCts?.Dispose();
    }
}

@code {
    private bool _open;
    private bool _animateIn;
    private bool _loading;
    private SalesReturnDto? _return;

    private async Task DownloadPdf()
    {
        if (_return is null) return;
        try
        {
            var doc = await PrintRenderer.RenderSalesReturnAsync(_return);
            await JS.InvokeVoidAsync("downloadFile", doc.Html, doc.FileName + ".pdf", doc.Title, doc.Reference);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            await JS.InvokeVoidAsync("alert", "Could not generate the PDF: " + ex.Message);
        }
    }

    private async Task PrintDoc()
    {
        if (_return is null) return;
        try
        {
            var doc = await PrintRenderer.RenderSalesReturnAsync(_return);
            await JS.InvokeVoidAsync("printHtml", doc.Html, doc.Title, doc.Reference);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            await JS.InvokeVoidAsync("alert", "Could not print the document: " + ex.Message);
        }
    }

    public async Task OpenAsync(Guid id)
    {
        _open = true;
        _loading = true;
        _animateIn = false;
        _return = null;
        StateHasChanged();

        await Task.Delay(20);
        _animateIn = true;
        StateHasChanged();

        try
        {
            _return = await SalesReturnService.GetSalesReturnById(id);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error);
        }

        _loading = false;
        StateHasChanged();
    }

    public void Close()
    {
        _open = false;
        _animateIn = false;
        _return = null;
        StateHasChanged();
    }
}

@code {
    private const int MaxResults = 500;

    private string _query = "";
    private GlobalSearchResultDto _results = new();
    private bool _loading;
    private bool _hasSearched;
    private int _activeTab;
    private int TotalResults=0;

    /// <summary>Which entity kinds participate in the search. Every kind is selected by default so the
    /// out-of-the-box behaviour matches the pre-filter search.</summary>
    private IReadOnlyCollection<SearchEntity> _selectedEntities = new List<SearchEntity>();

    private ProductViewPanel? _productViewPanel;
    private CustomerViewPanel? _customerViewPanel;
    private SupplierViewPanel? _supplierViewPanel;
    private SalesOrderViewPanel? _salesOrderViewPanel;
    private PurchaseOrderViewPanel? _purchaseOrderViewPanel;

    private async Task OpenProduct(Guid id)
    {
        if (_productViewPanel != null)
            await _productViewPanel.OpenAsync(id);
    }

    private async Task OpenCustomer(Guid id)
    {
        if (_customerViewPanel != null)
            await _customerViewPanel.OpenAsync(id);
    }

    private async Task OpenSupplier(Guid id)
    {
        if (_supplierViewPanel != null)
            await _supplierViewPanel.OpenAsync(id);
    }

    private async Task OpenSalesOrder(Guid id)
    {
        if (_salesOrderViewPanel != null)
            await _salesOrderViewPanel.OpenAsync(id);
    }

    private async Task OpenPurchaseOrder(Guid id)
    {
        if (_purchaseOrderViewPanel != null)
            await _purchaseOrderViewPanel.OpenAsync(id);
    }

    /// <summary>The selected entity kinds, in enum order (the same order the tabs are rendered).</summary>
    private List<SearchEntity> SelectedEntities =>
        Enum.GetValues<SearchEntity>().Cast<SearchEntity>().Where(_selectedEntities.Contains).ToList();

    private int CountFor(SearchEntity entity) => entity switch
    {
        SearchEntity.Products => _results.ProductItems.Count,
        SearchEntity.Customers => _results.CustomersItems.Count,
        SearchEntity.Suppliers => _results.SuppliersItems.Count,
        SearchEntity.SalesOrders => _results.SalesOrdersItems.Count,
        SearchEntity.PurchaseOrders => _results.PurchaseOrdersItems.Count,
        _ => 0
    };

    // private int TotalResults => SelectedEntities.Sum(CountFor);

    /// <summary>
    /// First tab that has something to show. Tabs are only rendered for checked entities, so the
    /// active index is a position in the checked list, not a fixed slot among five.
    /// </summary>
    private int FirstTabWithResults()
    {
        var selected = SelectedEntities;
        for (var i = 0; i < selected.Count; i++)
        {
            if (CountFor(selected[i]) > 0) return i;
        }
        return 0;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Text shown in the collapsed multiselect. Lists the selected entity kinds when one or two are
    /// picked, otherwise falls back to a compact "N types selected" summary.
    /// </summary>
    private string GetMultiSelectionText(IReadOnlyList<string> selectedValues)
    {
        var labels = selectedValues
            .Select(v => Enum.TryParse<SearchEntity>(v, true, out var e) ? GetEntityLabel(e) : v)
            .ToList();

        return labels.Count switch
        {
            0 => "All entity types",
            1 => labels[0],
            2 or 3 => string.Join(", ", labels),
            _ => $"{labels.Count} entity types selected"
        };
    }

    private static string GetEntityLabel(SearchEntity entity) => entity switch
    {
        SearchEntity.Products => "Products",
        SearchEntity.Customers => "Customers",
        SearchEntity.Suppliers => "Suppliers",
        SearchEntity.SalesOrders => "Sales Orders",
        SearchEntity.PurchaseOrders => "Purchase Orders",
        _ => entity.ToString()
    };

    private async Task OnSearchKeyUp(KeyboardEventArgs e)
    {
        if (e.Key == "Enter") await Search();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Fires when the entity multiselect changes. The result set is re-run against the new selection,
    /// so the tabs reflect the chosen kinds immediately rather than only after the next explicit search.
    /// </summary>
    private async Task OnSelectionChanged()
    {
        if (_hasSearched && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_query))
            await Search();
        else
            StateHasChanged();
    }

    private async Task Search()
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_query)) return;

        var entities = SelectedEntities;
        //if (entities.Count == 0)
        //{
        //  _hasSearched = true;
        //            _results = new GlobalSearchResultDto();
        //          _activeTab = 0;
        //        return;
        //  }

        _loading = true;
        _hasSearched = true;
        try
        {
            _results = await SearchService.Search(_query, entities, MaxResults);
            _activeTab = FirstTabWithResults();
            TotalResults = _results.ProductItems.Count +
            _results.CustomersItems.Count +
            _results.SuppliersItems.Count +
            _results.SalesOrdersItems.Count +
            _results.PurchaseOrdersItems.Count;

        }
        catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
        finally { _loading = false; }
    }
}

@page "/settings/currencies"
@rendermode InteractiveServer
@attribute [Authorize]
@inject IPricingService PricingService
@inject IExchangeRateService ExchangeRateService
@inject ISnackbar Snackbar
@inject IDialogService DialogService

<PageTitle>Currencies - IOMS</PageTitle>

<MudText Typo="Typo.h4" Class="mb-4">Currencies & Exchange Rates</MudText>

<MudTabs Elevation="2" Rounded="true" ApplyEffectsToContainer="true" PanelClass="pa-4">
    <MudTabPanel Text="Currencies">
        <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled" Color="Color.Primary" StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Add"
                   OnClick="OpenCurrencyDialog" Class="mb-3">Add Currency</MudButton>

        <MudTable Items="@_currencies" Dense="true" Hover="true" Striped="true" Loading="@_loadingCurrencies" Elevation="0">
            <HeaderContent>
                <MudTh>Code</MudTh>
                <MudTh>Name</MudTh>
                <MudTh>Symbol</MudTh>
                <MudTh>Base</MudTh>
            </HeaderContent>
            <RowTemplate>
                <MudTd><strong>@context.Code</strong></MudTd>
                <MudTd>@context.Name</MudTd>
                <MudTd>@context.Symbol</MudTd>
                <MudTd>@(context.IsBaseCurrency ? "âœ“ Base" : "")</MudTd>
            </RowTemplate>
        </MudTable>
    </MudTabPanel>

    <MudTabPanel Text="Exchange Rates">
        <MudTable Items="@_rates" Dense="true" Hover="true" Striped="true" Loading="@_loadingRates" Elevation="0">
            <HeaderContent>
                <MudTh>From</MudTh>
                <MudTh>To</MudTh>
                <MudTh>Rate</MudTh>
                <MudTh>Effective Date</MudTh>
            </HeaderContent>
            <RowTemplate>
                <MudTd>@context.FromCurrency</MudTd>
                <MudTd>@context.ToCurrency</MudTd>
                <MudTd>@context.Rate.ToString("F6")</MudTd>
                <MudTd>@context.EffectiveDate.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd")</MudTd>
            </RowTemplate>
        </MudTable>
    </MudTabPanel>
</MudTabs>

@code {
    private List<CurrencyDto> _currencies = new();
    private List<ExchangeRateDisplayDto> _rates = new();
    private bool _loadingCurrencies = true, _loadingRates = true;

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        await LoadCurrencies();
        await LoadRates();
    }

    private async Task LoadCurrencies()
    {
        _loadingCurrencies = true;
        try { _currencies = await PricingService.GetCurrencies(); }
        catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
        _loadingCurrencies = false;
    }

    private async Task LoadRates()
    {
        _loadingRates = true;
        try
        {
            var data = await ExchangeRateService.GetExchangeRates();
            _rates = data
                .OrderByDescending(r => r.EffectiveDate)
                .Take(50)
                .Select(r => new ExchangeRateDisplayDto
                {
                    FromCurrency = r.FromCurrencyCode,
                    ToCurrency = r.ToCurrencyCode,
                    Rate = r.Rate,
                    EffectiveDate = r.EffectiveDate
                }).ToList();
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
        _loadingRates = false;
    }

    private async Task OpenCurrencyDialog()
    {
        var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<CurrencyDialog>("Add Currency", new DialogParameters(),
            new DialogOptions { MaxWidth = MaxWidth.Small, FullWidth = true, CloseButton = true });
        var result = await dialog.Result;
        if (result != null && !result.Canceled)
            await LoadCurrencies();
    }

    private class ExchangeRateDisplayDto
    {
        public string FromCurrency { get; set; } = "";
        public string ToCurrency { get; set; } = "";
        public decimal Rate { get; set; }
        public DateTime EffectiveDate { get; set; }
    }
}

        catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add($"Error: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error); }
        finally { _loading = false; }

    {
        var currencies = await PricingService.GetCurrencies();

        var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<ExchangeRateDialog>("Add Exchange Rate", parameters,

        {

                await ExchangeRateService.DeleteExchangeRate(id);
                await Load();
                Snackbar.Add("Exchange rate deleted", Severity.Success);
            }
            catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
        }

@inject INotificationTemplateService TemplateService

<MudDialog>
    <DialogContent>
        <MudTextField @bind-Value="_eventType" Label="Event Type" Required="true" Variant="Variant.Outlined"
                      Placeholder="e.g. OrderCreated, InvoiceOverdue" Margin="Margin.Dense" Class="mb-3" />
        <MudSelect @bind-Value="_channel" Label="Channel" Required="true" ShrinkLabel="true" Variant="Variant.Outlined" Margin="Margin.Dense"Class="mb-3">
            @foreach (var ch in Enum.GetValues<NotificationChannel>())
            {
                <MudSelectItem Value="@ch">@ch</MudSelectItem>
            }
        </MudSelect>
        <MudTextField @bind-Value="_subject" Label="Subject" Required="true" ShrinkLabel="true" Variant="Variant.Outlined" Margin="Margin.Dense"Class="mb-3" />
        <RichTextField @bind-Value="_bodyTemplate" Label="Body Template" Required="true"
                      Lines="6" Placeholder="Use {{Variable}} placeholders..." />
    </DialogContent> 
    <DialogActions> 
        <MudButton OnClick="Cancel">Cancel</MudButton>
        <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled" Color="Color.Primary" OnClick="Submit" Disabled="@_saving">
            @if (_saving) { <MudProgressCircular Size="Size.Small" Indeterminate="true" Class="mr-2" /> }
            Save
        </MudButton>
    </DialogActions>
</MudDialog>

@code {
    [CascadingParameter] private IMudDialogInstance MudDialog { get; set; } = null!;
    [Parameter] public NotificationTemplateDto? Existing { get; set; }

    private string _eventType = "", _subject = "", _bodyTemplate = "";
    private NotificationChannel _channel = NotificationChannel.Email;
    private bool _saving;

    protected override void OnParametersSet()
    {
        if (Existing != null)
        {
            _eventType = Existing.EventType;
            _channel = Existing.Channel;
            _subject = Existing.Subject;
            _bodyTemplate = Existing.BodyTemplate;
        }
    }

    private async Task Submit()
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_eventType) || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_subject)) return;
        _saving = true;
        try
        {
            var dto = new CreateNotificationTemplateDto(_eventType, _channel, _subject, _bodyTemplate);
            if (Existing != null)
                await TemplateService.UpdateTemplate(Existing.Id, dto);
            else
                await TemplateService.CreateTemplate(dto);
            MudDialog.Close(DialogResult.Ok(true));
        }
        catch { MudDialog.Close(DialogResult.Cancel()); }
        finally { _saving = false; }
    }

    private void Cancel() => MudDialog.Cancel();
}

@page "/settings/price-lists"
@rendermode InteractiveServer
@attribute [Authorize]
@inject IPricingService PricingService
@inject ISnackbar Snackbar
@inject IDialogService DialogService



<PageTitle>Price Lists - IOMS</PageTitle>

<MudText Typo="Typo.h4" Class="mb-4">Price Lists & Discounts</MudText>

<MudTabs Elevation="2" Rounded="true" ApplyEffectsToContainer="true" PanelClass="pa-4">
    <MudTabPanel Text="Price Lists">
        <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled" Color="Color.Primary" StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Add"
                   OnClick="OpenPriceListDialog" Class="mb-3">Create Price List</MudButton>

        <MudTable Items="@_priceLists" Dense="true" Hover="true" Striped="true" Loading="@_loadingLists" Elevation="0">
            <HeaderContent>
                <MudTh>Name</MudTh>
                <MudTh>Effective From</MudTh>
                <MudTh>Effective To</MudTh>
                <MudTh>Active</MudTh>
            </HeaderContent>
            <RowTemplate>
                <MudTd><strong>@context.Name</strong></MudTd>
                <MudTd>@context.EffectiveFrom?.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd")</MudTd>
                <MudTd>@context.EffectiveTo?.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd")</MudTd>
                <MudTd><MudChip T="string" Size="Size.Small" Color="@(context.IsActive ? Color.Success : Color.Default)">@(context.IsActive ? "Active" : "Inactive")</MudChip></MudTd>
            </RowTemplate>
        </MudTable>
    </MudTabPanel>

    <MudTabPanel Text="Discounts">
        <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled" Color="Color.Primary" StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Add"
                   OnClick="OpenDiscountDialog" Class="mb-3">Create Discount</MudButton>

        <MudTable Items="@_discounts" Dense="true" Hover="true" Striped="true" Loading="@_loadingDiscounts" Elevation="0">
            <HeaderContent>
                <MudTh>Name</MudTh>
                <MudTh>Type</MudTh>
                <MudTh>Value</MudTh>
                <MudTh>Min Qty</MudTh>
                <MudTh>Valid</MudTh>
                <MudTh>Active</MudTh>
            </HeaderContent>
            <RowTemplate>
                <MudTd><strong>@context.Name</strong></MudTd>
                <MudTd>@context.DiscountType</MudTd>
                <MudTd>@(context.DiscountType == DiscountType.Percentage ? $"{context.Value}%" : Taka.H(context.Value))</MudTd>
                <MudTd>@context.MinimumQuantity</MudTd>
                <MudTd>@context.StartDate.ToString("MMM-dd") - @context.EndDate?.ToString("MMM-dd")</MudTd>
                <MudTd><MudChip T="string" Size="Size.Small" Color="@(context.IsActive ? Color.Success : Color.Default)">@(context.IsActive ? "Active" : "Inactive")</MudChip></MudTd>
            </RowTemplate>
        </MudTable>
    </MudTabPanel>
</MudTabs>

@code {
    private List<PriceListDto> _priceLists = new();
    private List<DiscountDisplayDto> _discounts = new();
    private bool _loadingLists = true, _loadingDiscounts = true;

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        await LoadPriceLists();
        await LoadDiscounts();
    }

    private async Task LoadPriceLists()
    {
        _loadingLists = true;
        try { _priceLists = await PricingService.GetPriceLists(); }
        catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
        _loadingLists = false;
    }

    private async Task LoadDiscounts()
    {
        _loadingDiscounts = true;
        try
        {
            var data = await PricingService.GetDiscounts();
            _discounts = data.Select(d => new DiscountDisplayDto
            {
                Id = d.Id, Name = d.Name, DiscountType = d.Type, Value = d.Value,
                MinimumQuantity = d.MinQuantity ?? 0, StartDate = d.StartDate ?? DateTime.MinValue, EndDate = d.EndDate, IsActive = d.IsActive
            }).ToList();
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
        _loadingDiscounts = false;
    }

    private async Task OpenPriceListDialog()
    {
        var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<PriceListDialog>("Create Price List", new DialogParameters(),
            new DialogOptions { MaxWidth = MaxWidth.Medium, FullWidth = true, CloseButton = true });
        var result = await dialog.Result;
        if (result != null && !result.Canceled)
            await LoadPriceLists();
    }

    private async Task OpenDiscountDialog()
    {
        var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<DiscountDialog>("Create Discount", new DialogParameters(),
            new DialogOptions { MaxWidth = MaxWidth.Small, FullWidth = true, CloseButton = true });
        var result = await dialog.Result;
        if (result != null && !result.Canceled)
            await LoadDiscounts();
    }

    private class DiscountDisplayDto
    {
        public Guid Id { get; set; }
        public string Name { get; set; } = "";
        public DiscountType DiscountType { get; set; }
        public decimal Value { get; set; }
        public int MinimumQuantity { get; set; }
        public DateTime StartDate { get; set; }
        public DateTime? EndDate { get; set; }
        public bool IsActive { get; set; }
    }
}

@inject ITaxService TaxService

<MudDialog>

    <DialogContent>
        <MudForm @ref="_form">
            <MudTextField @bind-Value="_name" Label="Tax Name" Required="true" ShrinkLabel="true" Variant="Variant.Outlined" Margin="Margin.Dense"/>
            <MudTextField @bind-Value="_code" Label="Code" Required="true" Class="mt-3" ShrinkLabel="true" Variant="Variant.Outlined" Margin="Margin.Dense"/>
            <MudNumericField @bind-Value="_rate" Label="Rate (%)" Min="0" Max="100" Format="N2" Required="true" Class="mt-3" ShrinkLabel="true" Variant="Variant.Outlined" Margin="Margin.Dense"/>
            <MudSelect @bind-Value="_taxType" Label="Tax Type" Required="true" Class="mt-3" Variant="Variant.Outlined" Margin="Margin.Dense">
                @foreach (TaxType t in Enum.GetValues<TaxType>())
                {
                    <MudSelectItem Value="@t">@t</MudSelectItem>
                }
            </MudSelect>
            <MudCheckBox @bind-Value="_isCompound" Label="Compound Tax" Class="mt-3" CheckedIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.CheckBox" UncheckedIcon="@Icons.Material.Outlined.CheckBoxOutlineBlank" />
            <MudCheckBox @bind-Value="_isActive" Label="Active" Class="mt-1" CheckedIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.CheckBox" UncheckedIcon="@Icons.Material.Outlined.CheckBoxOutlineBlank" />
        </MudForm>
    </DialogContent>
    <DialogActions>
        <MudButton OnClick="Cancel">Cancel</MudButton>
        <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled" Color="Color.Primary" OnClick="Submit">Save</MudButton>
    </DialogActions>
</MudDialog>

@code {
    [CascadingParameter] private IMudDialogInstance MudDialog { get; set; } = null!;
    [Parameter] public TaxRateDto? ExistingRate { get; set; }
    private MudForm _form = null!;

    private string _name = "", _code = "";
    private decimal _rate = 0;
    private TaxType _taxType = TaxType.VAT;
    private bool _isCompound = false, _isActive = true;

    protected override void OnParametersSet()
    {
        if (ExistingRate != null)
        {
            _name = ExistingRate.Name;
            _rate = ExistingRate.Rate;
            _taxType = ExistingRate.TaxType;
            _isActive = ExistingRate.IsActive;
        }
    }

    private async Task Submit()
    {
        await _form.ValidateAsync();
        if (!_form.IsValid) return;
        try
        {
            var dto = new CreateTaxRateDto(_name, _code, _rate, _taxType, _isCompound, _isActive);
            if (ExistingRate != null)
                await TaxService.UpdateTaxRate(ExistingRate.Id, dto);
            else
                await TaxService.CreateTaxRate(dto);
            Snackbar.Add("Tax rate saved", Severity.Success);
            MudDialog.Close(DialogResult.Ok(true));
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
    }

    private void Cancel() => MudDialog.Cancel();
}

@code {
    private List<TaxRateDto> _taxRates = new();
    private List<TaxJurisdictionDisplayDto> _jurisdictions = new();
    private bool _loadingRates = true, _loadingJurisdictions = true;

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        await LoadRates();
        await LoadJurisdictions();
    }

    private async Task LoadRates()
    {
        _loadingRates = true;
        try { _taxRates = await TaxService.GetTaxRates(); }
        catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
        _loadingRates = false;
    }

    private async Task LoadJurisdictions()
    {
        _loadingJurisdictions = true;
        try
        {
            var data = await TaxService.GetJurisdictions();
            _jurisdictions = data
                .OrderBy(j => j.Name)
                .Select(j => new TaxJurisdictionDisplayDto
                {
                    Id = j.Id, Name = j.Name, Code = j.Code, Country = j.Country, State = j.State ?? ""
                }).ToList();
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
        _loadingJurisdictions = false;
    }

    private async Task OpenTaxRateDialog()
    {
        var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<TaxRateDialog>("Add Tax Rate", new DialogParameters(),
            new DialogOptions { MaxWidth = MaxWidth.Small, FullWidth = true, CloseButton = true });
        var result = await dialog.Result;
        if (result != null && !result.Canceled)
            await LoadRates();
    }

    private async Task EditTaxRate(TaxRateDto rate)
    {
        var parameters = new DialogParameters { ["ExistingRate"] = rate };
        var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<TaxRateDialog>("Edit Tax Rate", parameters,
            new DialogOptions { MaxWidth = MaxWidth.Small, FullWidth = true, CloseButton = true });
        var result = await dialog.Result;
        if (result != null && !result.Canceled)
            await LoadRates();
    }

    private async Task OpenJurisdictionDialog()
    {
        var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<JurisdictionDialog>("Add Jurisdiction", new DialogParameters(),
            new DialogOptions { MaxWidth = MaxWidth.Small, FullWidth = true, CloseButton = true });
        var result = await dialog.Result;
        if (result != null && !result.Canceled)
            await LoadJurisdictions();
    }

    private class TaxJurisdictionDisplayDto
    {
        public Guid Id { get; set; }
        public string Name { get; set; } = "";
        public string Code { get; set; } = "";
        public string Country { get; set; } = "";
        public string State { get; set; } = "";
    }
}

        catch { MudDialog.Close(DialogResult.Cancel()); }
        finally { _saving = false; }
    }

        await LoadConversions();

    private async Task LoadUnits()

        _loadingUnits = true;
        try { _units = await UoMService.GetUnitsOfMeasure(); }
        catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add($"Error loading units: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error); }
        finally { _loadingUnits = false; }

    private async Task LoadConversions()
    {
        _loadingConversions = true;
        try { _conversions = await UoMService.GetConversions(); }
        catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add($"Error loading conversions: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error); }
        finally { _loadingConversions = false; }
    }

    private async Task OpenUomDialog()
    {
        var parameters = new DialogParameters<UoMDialog>();
        var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<UoMDialog>("Add Unit of Measure", parameters,
            new DialogOptions { MaxWidth = MaxWidth.Small, FullWidth = true, CloseButton = true });
        var result = await dialog.Result;
        if (result is { Canceled: false })
        {
            await LoadUnits();
            Snackbar.Add("Unit created successfully", Severity.Success);
        }
    }

    private async Task OpenConversionDialog()
    {
        var parameters = new DialogParameters<UoMConversionDialog> { { x => x.Units, _units } };
        var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<UoMConversionDialog>("Add Conversion", parameters,
            new DialogOptions { MaxWidth = MaxWidth.Small, FullWidth = true, CloseButton = true });
        var result = await dialog.Result;
        if (result is { Canceled: false })
        {
            await LoadConversions();
            Snackbar.Add("Conversion created successfully", Severity.Success);
        }
    }

    private async Task DeleteUnit(Guid id)
    {
        var confirm = await DialogService.ShowMessageBoxAsync("Confirm Delete", "Delete this unit of measure?", "Delete", "Cancel");
        if (confirm == true)
        {
            try
            {
                await UoMService.DeleteUnitOfMeasure(id);
                await LoadUnits();
                Snackbar.Add("Unit deleted", Severity.Success);
            }
            catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
        }
    }

    private async Task DeleteConversion(Guid id)
    {
        var confirm = await DialogService.ShowMessageBoxAsync("Confirm Delete", "Delete this conversion?", "Delete", "Cancel");
        if (confirm == true)
        {
            try
            {
                await UoMService.DeleteConversion(id);
                await LoadConversions();
                Snackbar.Add("Conversion deleted", Severity.Success);
            }
            catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
        }
    }
}

                        <MudSelectItem Value="@so.Id">@so.OrderNumber - @so.Customer.CustomerName</MudSelectItem>
                    }
                </MudSelect>
            </MudItem>
            <MudItem xs="12" sm="6">
                <MudDatePicker @bind-Date="_shippedDate" Label="Shipped Date" ShrinkLabel="true" Variant="Variant.Outlined" Margin="Margin.Dense"/>
            </MudItem>
            <MudItem xs="12">
                <RichTextField @bind-Value="_notes" Label="Notes" Lines="2" />
            </MudItem> 
        </MudGrid>
    </DialogContent>
    <DialogActions>
        <MudButton OnClick="Cancel">Cancel</MudButton>
        <MudButton Color="Color.Primary" Variant="Variant.Filled" OnClick="Submit">Create</MudButton>
    </DialogActions>
</MudDialog>

@code {
    [CascadingParameter] private IMudDialogInstance MudDialog { get; set; } = null!;

    private Guid _salesOrderId;
    private DateTime? _shippedDate = DateTime.Today;
    private string? _notes;
    private List<SalesOrderDto> _salesOrders = new();

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        var result = await SalesServices.GetSalesOrders(null, null, 1, 200);
        _salesOrders = result.Items;
    }

    private void Cancel() => MudDialog.Cancel();

    private async Task Submit()
    {
        try
        {
            var dto = new CreateDeliveryNoteDto(_salesOrderId, null, _shippedDate, _notes);
            await ShippingService.CreateDeliveryNote(dto);
            Snackbar.Add("Delivery note created.", Severity.Success);
            MudDialog.Close(DialogResult.Ok(true));
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
    }
}

    private List<DeliveryNoteDto> _deliveryNotes = new();

    private bool _loading;

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync() => await LoadData();

    private async Task LoadData()
    {
        _loading = true;
        try
        {
            var paged = await ShippingService.GetDeliveryNotesPagedAsync(_search, 1, 100);
            _deliveryNotes = paged.Items;
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { Snackbar.Add(ex.Message, Severity.Error); }
        finally { _loading = false; }
    }

    private async Task CreateDeliveryNote()
    {
        var parameters = new DialogParameters<DeliveryNoteCreateDialog>();
        var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<DeliveryNoteCreateDialog>("New Delivery Note", parameters,
            new DialogOptions { MaxWidth = MaxWidth.Small, FullWidth = true, CloseButton = true });
        var result = await dialog.Result;
        if (result is not null && !result.Canceled) await LoadData();
    }
}

@page "/"
@rendermode InteractiveServer
@attribute [Authorize]
@using System.Diagnostics
@inject IBranchService BranchService
@inject ILogger<Home> Logger

<PageTitle>Dashboard - IOMS</PageTitle>

<div class="tm-page">
    <TmPageHeader Icon="📊" Title="Dashboard" Subtitle="Welcome back! Here's what's happening with your business today." WrapActions="true">
        <Actions>
            <DashboardQuickActions />
        </Actions>
    </TmPageHeader>

    @* The filter strip is the dashboard's single control surface: it owns the range selector, the
       store selector and refresh. Every tile below is a self-loading card that reacts to the range
       and reload token pushed down here, so this page only composes the grid. *@
    <DashboardHeader DateRange="@_dateRange"
                     StoreFilter="@_storeFilter"
                     Stores="@_stores"
                     DateRangeChanged="@OnDateRangeChanged"
                     StoreFilterChanged="@OnStoreFilterChanged"
                     OnRefresh="@Reload" />

    <div class="tm-dash">
        <DashboardKpiRow Range="@_range" ReloadToken="@_reloadToken" />

        @* ── Sales and purchasing over time ────────────────────────────── *@
        @* Paired in an equal two-column row: the two overview cards share a layout, and
           tm-dash-cols (3fr/1fr) would squeeze the purchase chart to a third of the
           width and leave its axis unreadable. *@
        <div class="tm-dash-row">
            <SalesOverviewCard Range="@_range" ReloadToken="@_reloadToken" />
            <PurchaseOverviewCard Range="@_range" ReloadToken="@_reloadToken" />
        </div>

        @* ── Product leaders and the stock behind them ──────────────────── *@
        <div class="tm-dash-row">
            <TopProductsCard Range="@_range" ReloadToken="@_reloadToken" />
            <StockLevelsCard Range="@_range" ReloadToken="@_reloadToken" />
        </div>

        @* ── Inventory and store position ───────────────────────────────── *@
        <div class="tm-dash-row">
            <InventoryOverviewCard Range="@_range" ReloadToken="@_reloadToken" />
            <StoreOverviewCard Range="@_range" ReloadToken="@_reloadToken" StoreFilter="@_storeFilter" />
        </div>

        @* ── Live operational feeds ─────────────────────────────────────── *@
        <div class="tm-dash-row">
            <RecentOrdersCard Range="@_range" ReloadToken="@_reloadToken" />
            <RecentTransactionsCard Range="@_range" ReloadToken="@_reloadToken" />
        </div>

        <div class="tm-dash-row">
            <RecentActivitiesCard Range="@_range" ReloadToken="@_reloadToken" />
            <SystemAlertsCard Range="@_range" ReloadToken="@_reloadToken" />
        </div>

        <AnalyticsPromoCard />
    </div>
</div>

@code {
    private const string AllStores = "All Stores";

    private string _dateRange = DashboardRanges.DefaultLabel;
    private string _storeFilter = AllStores;

    /// <summary>
    /// Resolved window behind the filter strip's range selector. It drives every range-scoped tile,
    /// and is re-resolved on every change so each card's period label and span caption describe the
    /// exact period in force.
    /// </summary>
    private DashboardRange _range = DashboardRanges.Resolve(DashboardRanges.DefaultLabel, DateTime.UtcNow);

    /// <summary>
    /// Bumped whenever the tile data must be re-read from the source (range change, toolbar refresh).
    /// Each card reloads only when this changes, so unrelated re-renders — such as the store filter —
    /// do not re-query.
    /// </summary>
    private int _reloadToken;

    private List<string> _stores = new();

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        await LoadStores();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Refreshes the branch list the store selector is built from. Reloaded on every refresh so a
    /// store added or renamed while the dashboard is open appears without a full page reload. If this
    /// fails the selector simply stays on "All Stores" and every store-scoped card shows the full
    /// set, which is the safe default.
    /// </summary>
    private async Task LoadStores()
    {
        var branches = await SafeAsync(() => BranchService.GetBranches(), new List<BranchDto>(), "GetBranches");
        _stores = branches
            .Where(b => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(b.Name))
            .Select(b => b.Name!)
            .Distinct(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            .OrderBy(n => n)
            .ToList();

        // A store that no longer exists (deleted while the filter was applied) would otherwise leave
        // the dashboard showing nothing with no obvious way back.
        if (_storeFilter != AllStores && !_stores.Contains(_storeFilter, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
        {
            _storeFilter = AllStores;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Toolbar refresh: re-read the branch list and force every tile to reload.
    /// </summary>
    private async Task Reload()
    {
        var started = Stopwatch.GetTimestamp();

        await LoadStores();
        _reloadToken++;

        Logger.LogInformation("Dashboard refreshed in {ElapsedMs:F0} ms", Stopwatch.GetElapsedTime(started).TotalMilliseconds);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Applies a new period to the whole dashboard. Resolving the window and bumping the reload token
    /// is all that is needed: every range-scoped card reads the new <see cref="DashboardRange"/> and
    /// reloads itself, so changing the filter moves the whole page, not just the charts above the fold.
    /// </summary>
    private Task OnDateRangeChanged(string v)
    {
        _dateRange = v;
        _range = DashboardRanges.Resolve(v, DateTime.UtcNow);
        _reloadToken++;
        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// The store selector narrows the cards that are per-store by nature. It is applied in memory by
    /// the store card, so no tile is re-queried and the choice is instant.
    /// </summary>
    private Task OnStoreFilterChanged(string v)
    {
        _storeFilter = v;
        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Runs the branch lookup and substitutes an empty list on failure. The failure is logged at
    /// Error with the full exception so an outage is visible in the log stream.
    /// </summary>
    private async Task<T> SafeAsync<T>(Func<Task<T>> call, T fallback, string label)
    {
        try
        {
            return await call();
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Logger.LogError(ex, "Dashboard load '{DashboardStep}' failed.", label);
            return fallback;
        }
    }
}
