namespace TradeFlow.Web.Components.Shared.Dashboard;

/// <summary>
/// One selectable dashboard period. <see cref="From"/> and <see cref="To"/> are inclusive calendar
/// days, and <see cref="Months"/> is non-zero only for the month-based presets, where it drives the
/// span wording instead of the day count.
/// </summary>
public sealed record DashboardRange(string Label, DateTime From, DateTime To, int Months = 0)
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Inclusive day count. The dashboard service reads a trailing "last N days" window and nothing
    /// else, so this is the single number that makes that window land exactly on From/To. That is why
    /// a month preset is measured in real days rather than rounded to 30/90/365 â€” "This Month" on the
    /// 3rd is three days of data, not a month, and "Last 3 Months" is never a fixed 90.
    /// </summary>
    public int Days => (To.Date - From.Date).Days + 1;

    /// <summary>Span wording shown under the card title, e.g. "7 days to 1 Oct 2026".</summary>
    public string Caption
    {
        get
        {
            if (Months > 0)
            {
                // "This Month" resolves to a single month, where repeating the same name on both ends
                // of a range would read as nonsense.
                if (From.Year == To.Year && From.Month == To.Month) return To.ToString("MMMM yyyy");
                return $"{From:MMM yyyy} â€“ {To:MMM yyyy}";
            }

            return Days == 1
                ? $"Today Â· {To:d MMM yyyy}"
                : $"{Days} days to {To:d MMM yyyy}";
        }
    }
}

/// <summary>
/// The dashboard's period presets, in the order they appear in every range selector. The header
/// strip and both overview cards read this one list, so a preset can never be offered in one place
/// and missing from another.
/// </summary>
public static class DashboardRanges
{
    public const string Today = "Today";
    public const string Last7Days = "Last 7 Days";
    public const string Last30Days = "Last 30 Days";
    public const string ThisMonth = "This Month";
    public const string Last3Months = "Last 3 Months";
    public const string Last6Months = "Last 6 Months";
    public const string Last12Months = "Last 12 Months";

    /// <summary>Preselected range of every dashboard range selector.</summary>
    public const string DefaultLabel = Last7Days;

    public static readonly IReadOnlyList<string> Labels = new[]
    {
        Today, Last7Days, Last30Days, ThisMonth, Last3Months, Last6Months, Last12Months
    };

    /// <summary>
    /// Turns a selector label into a concrete window relative to <paramref name="today"/>.
    /// An unrecognised label resolves to the default period, which is the period the selector is
    /// actually showing, instead of falling through to some other preset's day count.
    /// </summary>
    public static DashboardRange Resolve(string? label, DateTime today) => label switch
    {
        Today => new DashboardRange(Today, today.Date, today.Date),
        Last7Days => TrailingDays(today, Last7Days, days: 7),
        Last30Days => TrailingDays(today, Last30Days, days: 30),
        ThisMonth => new DashboardRange(ThisMonth, new DateTime(today.Year, today.Month, 1), today.Date, Months: 1),
        Last3Months => TrailingMonths(today, Last3Months, months: 3),
        Last6Months => TrailingMonths(today, Last6Months, months: 6),
        Last12Months => TrailingMonths(today, Last12Months, months: 12),
        _ => TrailingDays(today, DefaultLabel, days: 7)
    };

    /// <summary>
    /// A window of <paramref name="days"/> days ending today, inclusive. Yesterday therefore counts
    /// as day one of "Last 7 Days", not day zero.
    /// </summary>
    private static DashboardRange TrailingDays(DateTime today, string label, int days) =>
        new(label, today.Date.AddDays(-(days - 1)), today.Date);

    /// <summary>
    /// Starts on the first of the month N months back so the window contains whole months, and ends
    /// today, which may be mid-month.
    /// </summary>
    private static DashboardRange TrailingMonths(DateTime today, string label, int months)
    {
        var first = new DateTime(today.Year, today.Month, 1).AddMonths(-months);
        return new DashboardRange(label, first, today.Date, months);
    }
}
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using TradeFlow.Application.Interfaces;

namespace TradeFlow.Web.Components.Shared.Dashboard;

/// <summary>
/// Base for a self-loading dashboard tile. Each card owns the read that produces its own data rather
/// than the page loading every tile up front and pushing the result in as a parameter. That keeps the
/// load logic beside the markup that renders it, and lets a slow read hold up only its own card: the
/// children's parameter sets run concurrently, so the tiles fill in as each read returns.
/// </summary>
/// <typeparam name="TData">Shape of the read model the tile renders.</typeparam>
public abstract class DashboardTileBase<TData> : ComponentBase
{
    [Inject] protected IDashboardService DashboardService { get; set; } = default!;

    [Inject] protected ILogger<DashboardTileBase<TData>> Logger { get; set; } = default!;

    /// <summary>
    /// Period currently applied by the dashboard filter strip. Range-scoped tiles read
    /// <see cref="DashboardRange.Days"/> from it; the header caption reads its label.
    /// </summary>
    [Parameter]
    public DashboardRange Range { get; set; } = DashboardRanges.Resolve(DashboardRanges.DefaultLabel, DateTime.UtcNow);

    /// <summary>
    /// Opaque value the page bumps to force every tile to reload (toolbar refresh, range change). A
    /// tile reloads only when this changes, so an unrelated parent render â€” such as a store-filter
    /// change, which does not affect the tenant-wide reads â€” does not trigger a re-query.
    /// </summary>
    [Parameter]
    public int ReloadToken { get; set; }

    /// <summary>The read model rendered by this tile.</summary>
    protected TData Data { get; private set; } = default!;

    /// <summary>True until the current read completes, so the tile can show its own spinner.</summary>
    protected bool Loading { get; private set; } = true;

    /// <summary>Value rendered before the first read returns and when a read fails.</summary>
    protected abstract TData EmptyData { get; }

    /// <summary>Reads this tile's data for the current <see cref="Range"/>.</summary>
    protected abstract Task<TData> LoadAsync();

    private int _loadedToken = int.MinValue;
    private int _loadedDays = int.MinValue;

    protected override async Task OnParametersSetAsync()
    {
        // Reload only when the window or the explicit reload token actually changed. This is what
        // stops every tile re-querying on each parent render.
        if (_loadedToken == ReloadToken && _loadedDays == Range.Days) return;

        _loadedToken = ReloadToken;
        _loadedDays = Range.Days;

        Loading = true;
        Data = EmptyData;

        try
        {
            Data = await LoadAsync();
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            // Substitute the empty value so one failed read degrades to an empty tile rather than
            // taking the whole dashboard down. The failure is logged at Error with the exception, so
            // an outage is distinguishable in the log from a genuinely empty dashboard.
            Logger.LogError(ex, "Dashboard tile '{DashboardTile}' failed; rendering an empty tile.", GetType().Name);
            Data = EmptyData;
        }
        finally
        {
            Loading = false;
        }
    }
}

@code {
    protected override List<StockLevelDto> EmptyData { get; } = new();

    protected override Task<List<StockLevelDto>> LoadAsync() =>
        DashboardService.GetStockLevels(8);

    /// <summary>
    /// Health is judged on the reorder level, which is the same threshold the rest of the app uses
    /// for its low-stock alerts. A negative available quantity (reserved beyond physical stock) is
    /// called out separately because it is a data-integrity problem rather than a normal shortage.
    /// </summary>
    private static (string Label, string Pill) Classify(StockLevelDto s)
    {
        if (s.AvailableQuantity < 0) return ("Oversold", "tm-pill tm-pill-red");

        if (s.ReorderStockLevel > 0 && s.AvailableQuantity <= s.ReorderStockLevel)
            return ("Reorder", "tm-pill tm-pill-amber");

        if (s.AvailableQuantity <= 0) return ("Out of stock", "tm-pill tm-pill-red");
        if (s.ReorderStockLevel > 0 && s.AvailableQuantity <= s.ReorderStockLevel * 2)
            return ("Low", "tm-pill tm-pill-yellow");

        return ("Healthy", "tm-pill tm-pill-green");
    }
}

@code {
    private const string AllStores = "All Stores";

    /// <summary>
    /// Store picked in the filter strip. Applied in memory over the already-loaded breakdown rather
    /// than triggering a re-query, so switching stores is instant and the read stays per-range.
    /// </summary>
    [Parameter] public string StoreFilter { get; set; } = AllStores;

    protected override List<StoreOverviewDto> EmptyData { get; } = new();

    protected override Task<List<StoreOverviewDto>> LoadAsync() =>
        DashboardService.GetStoreOverview(Range.Days);

    private List<StoreOverviewDto> FilteredData
    {
        get
        {
            if (StoreFilter == AllStores) return Data;

            // "Unassigned" is the bucket for orders with no branch, so it is included when the user
            // explicitly picks it rather than being dropped by the name comparison.
            return Data
                .Where(s => string.Equals(s.StoreName, StoreFilter, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                .ToList();
        }
    }
}

@* Shared SVG area chart for the dashboard overview cards.
   Hand-built rather than MudChart because the layout needs a gradient-filled area under the line
   and a "K"-abbreviated left axis, which MudChart does not expose. Chart.js / ApexCharts are not
   present in wwwroot, so this avoids adding a dependency. *@

<div class="tm-ov-area">
    @* Uniform scaling (the default preserveAspectRatio) rather than "none": stretching the
       viewBox to fill the container also stretches the plot stroke out of round. Axis labels are
       HTML positioned over the SVG rather than <text> nodes, because Blazor's parser reserves the
       <text> tag and rejects attributes on it. *@
    <svg viewBox="0 0 @ViewW @ViewH" class="tm-ov-area-svg" role="img" aria-label="@AccessibleLabel">
        <defs>
            @* Unique per instance: several of these charts render on the dashboard at once and a
               shared gradient id would let one chart's <defs> satisfy another's url(#...) reference. *@
            <linearGradient id="@_gradientId" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
                <stop offset="0%" stop-color="@Accent" stop-opacity="0.34" />
                <stop offset="100%" stop-color="@Accent" stop-opacity="0.02" />
            </linearGradient>
        </defs>

        @* Horizontal gridlines. *@
        @for (var g = 0; g <= GridLines; g++)
        {
            var y = AxisTop + PlotHeight * g / GridLines;
            <line x1="@AxisLeft" y1="@y.ToString("0.##")" x2="@(ViewW - AxisRight)"
                  y2="@y.ToString("0.##")" stroke="#eef0f4" stroke-width="1" />
        }

        @* The fill and the stroke share one path so they can never drift apart. *@
        @if (LinePath.Length > 0)
        {
            <path d="@AreaPath" fill="url(#@_gradientId)" stroke="none" />
            <path d="@LinePath" fill="none" stroke="@Accent" stroke-width="2"
                  stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-linecap="round" />
        }
    </svg>

    @* Left-hand value axis, highest value at the top. *@
    <div class="tm-ov-ylabels" aria-hidden="true">
        @for (var g = 0; g <= GridLines; g++)
        {
            <span class="tm-ov-ylabel" style="top:@YLabelTop(g).ToString("0.##")%;">
                @FormatAxis(MaxY * (GridLines - g) / GridLines)
            </span>
        }
    </div>

    @* Only the first and last dates are labelled; 30 of them would not fit. *@
    @if (Points.Count > 0)
    {
        <div class="tm-ov-xlabels" aria-hidden="true">
            <span>@Points[0].Label</span>
            <span>@Points[^1].Label</span>
        </div>
    }
</div>

@code {
    [Parameter, EditorRequired] public IReadOnlyList<(string Label, decimal Value)> Points { get; set; } = Array.Empty<(string, decimal)>();

    /// <summary>Stroke and gradient colour, e.g. "#3b82f6".</summary>
    [Parameter] public string Accent { get; set; } = "#3b82f6";

    [Parameter] public string AccessibleLabel { get; set; } = "Trend chart";

    private readonly string _gradientId = $"tmAreaFill{Guid.NewGuid():N}";

    // Fixed viewBox units; the SVG scales to the container width proportionally.
    private const int ViewW = 1000;
    private const int ViewH = 260;
    private const int AxisLeft = 52;
    private const int AxisRight = 8;
    private const int AxisTop = 8;
    private const int AxisBottom = 26;
    private const int GridLines = 4;

    private static readonly double PlotHeight = ViewH - AxisTop - AxisBottom;
    private static readonly double PlotWidth = ViewW - AxisLeft - AxisRight;

    private decimal Peak => Points.Count == 0 ? 0m : Points.Max(p => p.Value);

    /// <summary>
    /// Upper axis bound. Rounded up to a clean 1/2/2.5/5 x 10^n step so the gridlines land on
    /// readable values, and never below 1 so an all-zero series does not divide by zero.
    /// </summary>
    private decimal MaxY
    {
        get
        {
            var raw = Peak;
            if (raw <= 0) return 1m;

            var magnitude = (decimal)Math.Pow(10, Math.Floor(Math.Log10((double)raw)));
            var normalised = raw / magnitude;
            var step = normalised switch
            {
                <= 1m => 1m,
                <= 2m => 2m,
                <= 2.5m => 2.5m,
                <= 5m => 5m,
                _ => 10m
            };

            return step * magnitude;
        }
    }

    private string LinePath => BuildPath(closeArea: false);

    private string AreaPath => BuildPath(closeArea: true);

    private double PlotX(int index) => Points.Count <= 1
        ? AxisLeft + PlotWidth / 2
        : AxisLeft + PlotWidth * index / (Points.Count - 1);

    private double PlotY(decimal value) => AxisTop + PlotHeight * (double)(1m - value / MaxY);

    /// <summary>
    /// Vertical position of an axis label as a percentage of the rendered chart height. The SVG is
    /// laid out in viewBox units and the labels are positioned in CSS, so the gridline offset has to
    /// be scaled by the same AxisTop/PlotHeight/ViewH ratio the plot uses or they drift apart.
    /// </summary>
    private double YLabelTop(int gridIndex) => 100.0 * (AxisTop + PlotHeight * gridIndex / GridLines) / ViewH;

    /// <summary>
    /// Builds the polyline through every point. Points are joined with straight segments rather
    /// than a spline: a 30-point smooth curve would overshoot between samples and can dip below
    /// zero between two low days, which would render a dip that is not in the data.
    /// </summary>
    private string BuildPath(bool closeArea)
    {
        if (Points.Count == 0) return string.Empty;

        var sb = new System.Text.StringBuilder();
        for (var i = 0; i < Points.Count; i++)
        {
            sb.Append(i == 0 ? "M " : " L ");
            sb.Append(PlotX(i).ToString("0.##"));
            sb.Append(' ');
            sb.Append(PlotY(Points[i].Value).ToString("0.##"));
        }

        if (closeArea && Points.Count > 1)
        {
            var baseline = AxisTop + PlotHeight;
            sb.Append($" L {PlotX(Points.Count - 1).ToString("0.##")} {baseline.ToString("0.##")}");
            sb.Append($" L {PlotX(0).ToString("0.##")} {baseline.ToString("0.##")} Z");
        }

        return sb.ToString();
    }

    /// <summary>Abbreviates the axis the way the reference does: 0, 5K, 10K, 20K.</summary>
    private static string FormatAxis(decimal value)
    {
        if (value <= 0) return "0";
        if (value >= 1_000_000m) return $"{value / 1_000_000m:0.##}M";
        if (value >= 1_000m) return $"{value / 1_000m:0.##}K";
        return value.ToString("0");
    }
}

<DashboardCardShell Title="Top Selling Products by Revenue" ViewAllHref="/products/list" ViewAllText="All Products" FillHeight="true" Loading="@Loading">
    <div class="tm-panel-body" style="padding:4px 6px 8px;">

            // Items arrive ordered by revenue (GetTopProducts groups by product and sorts on

                        <div class="d-flex align-center" style="gap:8px; margin-top:4px;">

                }
            </MudItem>
            <MudItem xs="12" sm="4">
                @if (_selectedChild != null)
                {
                    <MudList T="CategoryDto">
                        @foreach (var cat in FilteredCategories(_categories.Where(c => c.ParentCategoryId == _selectedChild.Id)))
                        {
                            <MudListItem @onclick="() => SelectFinalCategory(cat)">
                                @cat.Name
                            </MudListItem>
                        }
                    </MudList>
                }
            </MudItem>
        </MudGrid>
        <MudDivider Class="my-2" />
        <MudText Typo="Typo.body2">Current selection: <b>@CurrentSelection</b></MudText>
    </DialogContent>
    <DialogActions>
        <MudButton OnClick="Cancel">Cancel</MudButton>
        <MudButton Color="Color.Primary" Variant="Variant.Filled" OnClick="Confirm" Disabled="@(_finalSelected == null)">Confirm</MudButton>
    </DialogActions>
</MudDialog>

@code {
    [CascadingParameter] private IMudDialogInstance MudDialog { get; set; } = default!;
    [Parameter] public List<CategoryDto> Categories { get; set; } = new();
    [Parameter] public Guid? SelectedCategoryId { get; set; }

    private string _search = string.Empty;
    private List<CategoryDto> _categories = new();
    private CategoryDto? _selectedParent;
    private CategoryDto? _selectedChild;
    private CategoryDto? _finalSelected;

    protected override void OnInitialized()
    {
        _categories = Categories;
        if (SelectedCategoryId.HasValue)
        {
            _finalSelected = _categories.FirstOrDefault(c => c.Id == SelectedCategoryId);
            if (_finalSelected != null)
            {
                _selectedChild = _categories.FirstOrDefault(c => c.Id == _finalSelected.ParentCategoryId);
                _selectedParent = _selectedChild != null ? _categories.FirstOrDefault(c => c.Id == _selectedChild.ParentCategoryId) : _categories.FirstOrDefault(c => c.Id == _finalSelected.ParentCategoryId);
            }
        }
    }

    private IEnumerable<CategoryDto> FilteredCategories(IEnumerable<CategoryDto> cats)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_search))
            return cats;
        return cats.Where(c => c.Name.Contains(_search, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
    }

    private void SelectCategory(CategoryDto cat)
    {
        _selectedParent = cat;
        _selectedChild = null;
        _finalSelected = null;
    }
    private void SelectSubCategory(CategoryDto cat)
    {
        _selectedChild = cat;
        _finalSelected = null;
    }
    private void SelectFinalCategory(CategoryDto cat)
    {
        _finalSelected = cat;
    }
    private void Cancel() => MudDialog.Cancel();
    private void Confirm() => MudDialog.Close(DialogResult.Ok(_finalSelected));
    private string CurrentSelection
    {
        get
        {
            if (_finalSelected != null)
            {
                var names = new List<string>();
                var cat = _finalSelected;
                while (cat != null)
                {
                    names.Insert(0, cat.Name);
                    cat = _categories.FirstOrDefault(c => c.Id == cat.ParentCategoryId);
                }
                return string.Join(" > ", names);
            }
            return "None";
        }
    }
}

         data-placeholder="@Placeholder"
         style="min-height:@(_minHeight)px; background:#fff; border-radius:0 0 8px 8px;"></div>

@code {
    private string _editorId = "rte-" + Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N")[..8];
    private DotNetObjectReference<RichTextField>? _dotNetRef;
    private string? _pendingValue;
    private bool _initialized;

    [Parameter] public string? Value { get; set; }
    [Parameter] public EventCallback<string?> ValueChanged { get; set; }
    [Parameter] public string? Label { get; set; }
    [Parameter] public string? Placeholder { get; set; }
    [Parameter] public bool Required { get; set; }
    [Parameter] public string? Class { get; set; }
    [Parameter] public int Lines { get; set; } = 3;

    private int _minHeight => Lines * 24 + 24;

    protected override void OnParametersSet()
    {
        if (!_initialized)
            _pendingValue = Value;
    }

    protected override async Task OnAfterRenderAsync(bool firstRender)
    {
        if (firstRender)
        {
            _dotNetRef = DotNetObjectReference.Create(this);
            await JS.InvokeVoidAsync("RichTextEditor.initialize", _editorId, _pendingValue, _dotNetRef);
            _initialized = true;
        }
    }

    [JSInvokable]
    public async Task OnContentChanged(string html)
    {
        Value = html;
        await ValueChanged.InvokeAsync(html);
    }

    public async ValueTask DisposeAsync()
    {
        try
        {
            if (_initialized)
                await JS.InvokeVoidAsync("RichTextEditor.dispose", _editorId);
        }
        catch { /* component already detached */ }
        _dotNetRef?.Dispose();
    }
}

using System.Globalization;

namespace TradeFlow.Web.Utility;

/// <summary>
/// Renders money with a styled, larger à§³ symbol: "<span class="cash-sign">à§³</span>1,250.00".
/// H/Ho return MarkupString for direct use in Razor markup; Text/Text0 return plain strings
/// for strings built in code (toasts, labels).
/// </summary>
public static class Taka
{
    public const string Sign = "à§³";

    private const string Mark = "<span class=\"cash-sign\">" + Sign + "</span>";

    public static MarkupString HIcon() =>  (MarkupString)(Mark);

    public static MarkupString H(decimal value, string format = "N2")
        => (MarkupString)(Mark + value.ToString(format));

    public static MarkupString Ho(decimal value)        => H(value, "N0");

    public static MarkupString H(int value)
        => (MarkupString)(Mark + value.ToString("N0"));

    public static MarkupString H(long value)
        => (MarkupString)(Mark + value.ToString("N0"));

    public static string Text(decimal value, string format = "N2")
        => Sign + value.ToString(format);

    public static string Text0(decimal value)
        => Sign + value.ToString("N0");
}

@using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.Authorization
@inject AuthenticationStateProvider AuthenticationStateProvider
@inject TradeFlow.Infrastructure.Services.TenantContext TenantContext

@* Wraps the routed page rather than sitting beside it. Blazor only guarantees that it awaits a
   *parent's* OnInitializedAsync before initialising that parent's children; two components rendered
   next to each other are initialised in render order with no ordering guarantee between them, and a
   sibling that yields (which GetAuthenticationStateAsync does whenever revalidation is in flight)
   lets the page's first query run first. TenantProvider fails closed on an unresolved tenant, so
   that race surfaces as a failed circuit rather than as wrong data. *@
@ChildContent

@code {
    [Parameter] public RenderFragment? ChildContent { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Populates the circuit-scoped <see cref="TradeFlow.Infrastructure.Services.TenantContext"/>
    /// from the Blazor authentication state.
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <c>IHttpContextAccessor.HttpContext</c> is <c>null</c> once a Blazor Server circuit is
    /// established, so the tenant has to be captured from the <c>AuthenticationStateProvider</c>
    /// once and held for the life of the circuit.
    /// </remarks>
    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        var authenticationState = await AuthenticationStateProvider.GetAuthenticationStateAsync();
        var principal = authenticationState.User;

        if (principal.Identity?.IsAuthenticated != true)
        {
            return;
        }

        var tenantClaim = principal.FindFirst("TenantId")?.Value;
        if (!Guid.TryParse(tenantClaim, out var tenantId) || tenantId == Guid.Empty)
        {
            // Left unresolved on purpose. TenantProvider fails closed, so an authenticated user
            // without a valid tenant gets an error rather than another tenant's data.
            return;
        }

        TenantContext.Set(tenantId, principal.FindFirst(System.Security.Claims.ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier)?.Value);
    }
}

<div class="tm-daterange">
    <MudSelect T="string"
               Label="Range"
               Value="_preset"
               ValueChanged="OnPresetChanged"
               Variant="Variant.Outlined"
               Margin="Margin.Dense"
               ShrinkLabel="true"
               Dense="true"
               Style="min-width:175px">
        @foreach (var p in GetPresets())
        {
            <MudSelectItem Value="@p.Label">@p.Label</MudSelectItem>
        }
        <MudSelectItem Value="@CustomLabel">@CustomLabel</MudSelectItem>
    </MudSelect>

    <MudDatePicker Date="FromInternal"
                   Label="From"
                   Variant="Variant.Outlined"
                   Margin="Margin.Dense"
                   ShrinkLabel="true"
                   AutoClose="true"
                   Disabled="@(!IsCustom)"
                   AdornmentIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.CalendarMonth"
                   Adornment="Adornment.End"
                   DateChanged="OnFromChanged" />
    <MudDatePicker Date="ToInternal"
                   Label="To"
                   Variant="Variant.Outlined"
                   Margin="Margin.Dense"
                   ShrinkLabel="true"
                   AutoClose="true"
                   Disabled="@(!IsCustom)"
                   AdornmentIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.CalendarMonth"
                   Adornment="Adornment.End"
                   DateChanged="OnToChanged" />
</div>

@code {
    private const string CustomLabel = "Custom";

    /// <summary>Inclusive start of the range. Null means no lower bound.</summary>
    [Parameter] public DateTime? From { get; set; }
    /// <summary>Inclusive end of the range. Null means no upper bound.</summary>
    [Parameter] public DateTime? To { get; set; }

    /// <summary>Raised once after any change (preset, picker or custom edit).</summary>
    [Parameter] public EventCallback<(DateTime? From, DateTime? To)> RangeChanged { get; set; }

    private string? _preset;
    private DateTime? FromInternal { get; set; }
    private DateTime? ToInternal { get; set; }

    private bool IsCustom => _preset == CustomLabel;

    protected override void OnParametersSet()
    {
        FromInternal = From;
        ToInternal = To;

        if (_preset != CustomLabel)
            _preset = MatchPreset()?.Label ?? CustomLabel;
    }

    private sealed record Preset(string Label, DateTime From, DateTime To);

    private static List<Preset> GetPresets()
    {
        var today = DateTime.Today;
        return new()
        {
            new Preset("Today", today, today),
            new Preset("Last 7 Days", today.AddDays(-6), today),
            new Preset("This Month", new DateTime(today.Year, today.Month, 1), today),
            new Preset("Last Month", new DateTime(today.Year, today.Month, 1).AddMonths(-1), new DateTime(today.Year, today.Month, 1).AddDays(-1)),
            new Preset("This Year", new DateTime(today.Year, 1, 1), today),
            new Preset("Last Year", new DateTime(today.Year - 1, 1, 1), new DateTime(today.Year - 1, 12, 31))
        };
    }

    private Preset? MatchPreset() =>
        GetPresets().FirstOrDefault(p => From?.Date == p.From && To?.Date == p.To);

    private Task OnPresetChanged(string? label)
    {
        _preset = label == null || label == CustomLabel ? CustomLabel : label;
        if (IsCustom)
            return Task.CompletedTask;

        var p = GetPresets().FirstOrDefault(x => x.Label == _preset);
        return p != null ? RangeChanged.InvokeAsync((p.From, p.To)) : Task.CompletedTask;
    }

    private Task OnFromChanged(DateTime? date) => RangeChanged.InvokeAsync((date, To));

    private Task OnToChanged(DateTime? date) => RangeChanged.InvokeAsync((From, date));
}

@* Shared pagination footer used by every list page. CurrentPage is zero-based. *@
<div class="pagination-footer">
    <span>Showing @GetShowingText()</span>
    <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; flex-wrap:wrap;">
        <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px;">
            <span style="font-size:12px;">Rows per page:</span>
            <select class="rows-select" value="@PageSize" @onchange="OnPageSizeChanged">
                <option value="10">10</option>
                <option value="25">25</option>
                <option value="50">50</option>
                <option value="100">100</option>
            </select>
        </div>
        <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:4px;">
            <button class="page-btn" title="First page" @onclick="() => OnGoToPage.InvokeAsync(0)" disabled="@(CurrentPage == 0)">
                <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.FirstPage" Size="Size.Small" />
            </button>
            <button class="page-btn" title="Previous page" @onclick="() => OnPrev.InvokeAsync()" disabled="@(CurrentPage == 0)">
                <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.ChevronLeft" Size="Size.Small" />
            </button>
            @{
                var visible = GetVisiblePages();
                @for (int i = visible.start; i < visible.end; i++)
                {
                    var pageIndex = i;
                    <button class="page-btn @(pageIndex == CurrentPage ? "active" : "")" @onclick="() => OnGoToPage.InvokeAsync(pageIndex)">@(pageIndex + 1)</button>
                }
            }
            <button class="page-btn" title="Next page" @onclick="() => OnNext.InvokeAsync()" disabled="@(CurrentPage >= TotalPages - 1)">
                <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.ChevronRight" Size="Size.Small" />
            </button>
            <button class="page-btn" title="Last page" @onclick="() => OnGoToPage.InvokeAsync(TotalPages - 1)" disabled="@(CurrentPage >= TotalPages - 1 || TotalPages <= 1)">
                <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.LastPage" Size="Size.Small" />
            </button>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

@code {
    [Parameter] public int CurrentPage { get; set; }
    [Parameter] public int PageSize { get; set; } = 10;
    [Parameter] public int TotalCount { get; set; }
    [Parameter] public int TotalPages { get; set; } = 1;
    /// <summary>Label used in the showing text, e.g. "Products", "Invoices".</summary>
    [Parameter] public string ItemLabel { get; set; } = "items";

    [Parameter] public EventCallback<int> OnGoToPage { get; set; }
    [Parameter] public EventCallback OnPrev { get; set; }
    [Parameter] public EventCallback OnNext { get; set; }
    [Parameter] public EventCallback<ChangeEventArgs> OnPageSizeChanged { get; set; }

    // Only a few page buttons stay visible; the rest are reached with the â€¹ â€º buttons.
    private const int MaxVisiblePages = 4;
    private (int start, int end) GetVisiblePages()
    {
        if (TotalPages <= MaxVisiblePages) return (0, TotalPages);
        int start = CurrentPage - MaxVisiblePages / 2;
        start = Math.Max(0, Math.Min(start, TotalPages - MaxVisiblePages));
        int end = start + MaxVisiblePages;
        return (start, end);
    }

    private string GetShowingText()
    {
        if (TotalCount == 0) return $"0 {ItemLabel}";
        var page = Math.Clamp(CurrentPage, 0, Math.Max(0, TotalPages - 1));
        var start = page * PageSize + 1;
        var end = Math.Min(start + PageSize - 1, TotalCount);
        return $"{start} to {end} of {TotalCount} {ItemLabel}";
    }
}

@* Inline sparkline for a KPI tile. No axes and no labels: the tile's headline figure already
   carries the magnitude, so the line only has to show shape. Stretched to fill whatever width the
   flex row gives it, which would distort the stroke, so the stroke is pinned with vector-effect. *@

@if (Points.Count > 0)
{
    <svg class="tm-spark" viewBox="0 0 @ViewW @ViewH" preserveAspectRatio="none"
         role="img" aria-label="@AccessibleLabel">
        <path d="@LinePath" fill="none" stroke="@Color" stroke-width="1.5"
              stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-linecap="round" vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke" />
    </svg>
}

@code {
    [Parameter] public IReadOnlyList<decimal> Points { get; set; } = Array.Empty<decimal>();
    [Parameter] public string Color { get; set; } = "#2563eb";
    [Parameter] public string AccessibleLabel { get; set; } = "Trend";

    private const int ViewW = 100;
    private const int ViewH = 28;

    /// <summary>Two units of headroom top and bottom so a peak is not clipped by the stroke.</summary>
    private const int PadY = 2;

    private decimal Min => Points.Count == 0 ? 0m : Points.Min();
    private decimal Max => Points.Count == 0 ? 0m : Points.Max();

    private string LinePath
    {
        get
        {
            if (Points.Count == 0) return string.Empty;

            // A single sample has no shape to draw, so it becomes a level line across the full width
            // rather than a dot, which the non-uniform scale would render as a squashed ellipse.
            if (Points.Count == 1)
            {
                var mid = ScaleY(Points[0]).ToString("0.##");
                return $"M 0 {mid} L {ViewW} {mid}";
            }

            var sb = new System.Text.StringBuilder();
            for (var i = 0; i < Points.Count; i++)
            {
                var x = ViewW * i / (double)(Points.Count - 1);
                sb.Append(i == 0 ? "M " : " L ");
                sb.Append(x.ToString("0.##"));
                sb.Append(' ');
                sb.Append(ScaleY(Points[i]).ToString("0.##"));
            }
            return sb.ToString();
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Maps a value onto the viewBox, highest value at the top. A flat series has no span to scale
    /// against and would divide by zero, so it is drawn down the middle of the tile.
    /// </summary>
    private double ScaleY(decimal value)
    {
        var span = Max - Min;
        if (span == 0) return ViewH / 2d;
        return PadY + (ViewH - (PadY * 2)) * (double)(1m - (value - Min) / span);
    }
}

namespace TradeFlow.Web.Middleware;

/// <summary>
/// Logs unhandled exceptions with full diagnostic context and returns a generic 500 so that
/// exception detail, stack traces, and connection strings never reach the client.
/// Previously a failed dashboard query was written to the console and swallowed, which made a
/// database outage indistinguishable from a genuinely empty dashboard.
/// </summary>
public sealed class GlobalExceptionLoggingMiddleware
{
    public const int UnhandledExceptionEventId = 1000;
    public const int SlowRequestEventId = 1001;

    private static readonly string[] SensitiveFragments =
    [
        "password=",
        "pwd=",
        "user id=",
        "uid=",
        "server=",
        "data source=",
        "initial catalog="
    ];

    private readonly RequestDelegate _next;
    private readonly ILogger<GlobalExceptionLoggingMiddleware> _logger;

    public GlobalExceptionLoggingMiddleware(RequestDelegate next, ILogger<GlobalExceptionLoggingMiddleware> logger)
    {
        _next = next;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    public async Task InvokeAsync(HttpContext context)
    {
        var started = Stopwatch.GetTimestamp();

        try
        {
            await _next(context);
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException) when (context.RequestAborted.IsCancellationRequested)
        {
            // A circuit disconnect or client navigation is not a fault; log it below Debug only.
            _logger.LogDebug(1002, "Request {Method} {Path} aborted by the client", context.Request.Method, context.Request.Path);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(
                UnhandledExceptionEventId,
                ex,
                "Unhandled exception for {Method} {Path} (TraceId {TraceId}, Tenant {TenantId})",
                context.Request.Method,
                context.Request.Path,
                context.TraceIdentifier,
                ReadTenantId(context));

            if (!context.Response.HasStarted)
            {
                context.Response.Clear();
                context.Response.StatusCode = StatusCodes.Status500InternalServerError;
                await context.Response.WriteAsJsonAsync(new
                {
                    error = "An unexpected error occurred.",
                    traceId = context.TraceIdentifier
                });
            }

            return;
        }

        var elapsedMs = Stopwatch.GetElapsedTime(started).TotalMilliseconds;
        if (elapsedMs > 1500)
        {
            _logger.LogWarning(
                SlowRequestEventId,
                "Slow request {Method} {Path} took {ElapsedMs:F0} ms",
                context.Request.Method,
                context.Request.Path,
                elapsedMs);
        }
    }

    private static string? ReadTenantId(HttpContext context) =>
        context.User?.FindFirst("TenantId")?.Value;

    public static string Redact(string? value)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
            return string.Empty;

        var redacted = value;
        foreach (var fragment in SensitiveFragments)
        {
            var index = redacted.IndexOf(fragment, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
            while (index >= 0)
            {
                var end = redacted.IndexOf(';', index);
                if (end < 0)
                    end = redacted.Length;
                redacted = string.Concat(redacted.AsSpan(0, index), "***", redacted.AsSpan(end));
                index = redacted.IndexOf(fragment, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
            }
        }

        return redacted;
    }
}

namespace TradeFlow.Web.Middleware;

/// <summary>
/// Adds hardening response headers to every request. Blazor Server renders the shell as HTML
/// and then communicates over a WebSocket, so the browser-side protections that matter here are
/// framing control, MIME sniffing control, and referrer/permission leakage reduction.
/// </summary>
public sealed class SecurityHeadersMiddleware
{
    private static readonly string[] ScriptSources =
    [
        "'self'",
        "'unsafe-inline'",
        "blob:",
        "data:",
        "https://fonts.googleapis.com",
        "https://fonts.gstatic.com",
        "https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com"
    ];

    private static readonly string[] StyleSources =
    [
        "'self'",
        "'unsafe-inline'",
        "https://fonts.googleapis.com"
    ];

    private static readonly string[] ConnectSources =
    [
        "'self'",
        "ws:",
        "wss:",
        "https://fonts.googleapis.com",
        "https://fonts.gstatic.com",
        "https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com"
    ];

    private static readonly string[] ImgSources =
    [
        "'self'",
        "data:",
        "blob:",
        "https:"
    ];

    private static readonly string[] FontSources =
    [
        "'self'",
        "data:",
        "https://fonts.gstatic.com"
    ];

    private readonly RequestDelegate _next;

    public SecurityHeadersMiddleware(RequestDelegate next) => _next = next;

    public Task InvokeAsync(HttpContext context)
    {
        context.Response.OnStarting(static state =>
        {
            var httpContext = (HttpContext)state;
            var headers = httpContext.Response.Headers;

            // Framing is limited to the same origin. Same-origin iframes are used by the print
            // route to generate PDF downloads without navigating; cross-origin embedding stays
            // blocked by both frame-ancestors 'self' and X-Frame-Options SAMEORIGIN.
            const bool allowSelfFraming = true;

            headers["X-Content-Type-Options"] = "nosniff";
            headers["X-Frame-Options"] = allowSelfFraming ? "SAMEORIGIN" : "DENY";
            headers["Referrer-Policy"] = "no-referrer";
            headers["X-Permitted-Cross-Domain-Policies"] = "none";
            headers["Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy"] = "same-origin";
            headers["Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy"] = "same-origin";
            headers["Permissions-Policy"] =
                "camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=(), interest-cohort=()";

            // HSTS is only emitted over TLS; sending it on plaintext is a no-op at best.
            if (((HttpContext)state).Request.IsHttps)
                headers["Strict-Transport-Security"] = "max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains";

            headers["Content-Security-Policy"] = BuildCsp(allowSelfFraming);
            headers["Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only"] = BuildReportOnlyCsp();

            return Task.CompletedTask;
        }, context);

        return _next(context);
    }

    private static string BuildCsp(bool allowSelfFraming) =>
        string.Join("; ", new[]
        {
            "default-src 'self'",
            $"script-src {string.Join(' ', ScriptSources)}",
            $"style-src {string.Join(' ', StyleSources)}",
            $"connect-src {string.Join(' ', ConnectSources)}",
            "font-src " + string.Join(' ', FontSources),
            "img-src " + string.Join(' ', ImgSources),
            "object-src 'none'",
            "base-uri 'self'",
            "form-action 'self'",
            allowSelfFraming ? "frame-ancestors 'self'" : "frame-ancestors 'none'",
            "manifest-src 'self'",
            "worker-src 'self' blob:"
        });

    // The reporting policy omits frame-ancestors (report-only silently ignores it) and relaxes
    // the script/style sources MudBlazor's runtime needs, so violations surface in reports
    // before the enforcing policy is tightened.
    //
    // font-src must be listed explicitly here. Without it font requests fall back to
    // default-src 'self', which rejects fonts.gstatic.com, and every page load reported a
    // violation for a font the enforcing policy was already allowing.
    private static string BuildReportOnlyCsp() =>
        string.Join("; ", new[]
        {
            "default-src 'self'",
            "script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' 'unsafe-eval' https: blob: data:",
            "style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https:",
            "font-src 'self' data: https://fonts.gstatic.com",
            "connect-src 'self' ws: wss: https:",
            "img-src * data: blob:",
            "object-src 'none'",
            "base-uri 'self'"
        });
}

using System.Net;
using System.Net.Mail;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;

namespace TradeFlow.Web.Services
{

    public class EmailSettings
    {
        public string Host { get; set; } = "smtp.gmail.com";
        public int Port { get; set; } = 587;
        public string Username { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        public string Password { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        public string FromEmail { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        public string FromName { get; set; } = "IOMS System";
        public bool EnableSsl { get; set; } = true;
    }

    public interface IEmailService
    {
        Task SendEmailAsync(string toEmail, string subject, string htmlBody);
    }

    public class SmtpEmailService : IEmailService
    {
        private readonly EmailSettings _settings;
        private readonly ILogger<SmtpEmailService> _logger;

        public SmtpEmailService(IOptions<EmailSettings> settings, ILogger<SmtpEmailService> logger)
        {
            _settings = settings.Value;
            _logger = logger;
        }

        public async Task SendEmailAsync(string toEmail, string subject, string htmlBody)
        {
            try
            {
                using var message = new MailMessage();
                message.From = new MailAddress(_settings.FromEmail, _settings.FromName);
                message.To.Add(toEmail);
                message.Subject = subject;
                message.Body = htmlBody;
                message.IsBodyHtml = true;

#pragma warning disable CA1416, SYSLIB0006
                using var client = new SmtpClient(_settings.Host, _settings.Port);
                client.Credentials = new NetworkCredential(_settings.Username, _settings.Password);
                client.EnableSsl = _settings.EnableSsl;
                await client.SendMailAsync(message);
#pragma warning restore CA1416, SYSLIB0006
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex, "Failed to send email to {Email}", toEmail);
                throw;
            }
        }
    }

}
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.Web;

namespace TradeFlow.Web.Services;

public sealed record RenderedDocument(string Html, string Title, string Reference, string FileName);

public interface IPrintDocumentRenderer
{
    Task<RenderedDocument> RenderSalesOrderAsync(SalesOrderDto order);
    Task<RenderedDocument> RenderPurchaseOrderAsync(PurchaseOrderDto order);
    Task<RenderedDocument> RenderQuoteAsync(SalesQuoteDto quote);
    Task<RenderedDocument> RenderSalesReturnAsync(SalesReturnDto salesReturn);
    Task<RenderedDocument> RenderPurchaseReturnAsync(PurchaseReturnDto purchaseReturn);
    Task<RenderedDocument> RenderInvoiceAsync(InvoiceDetailDto invoiceDetail);
    Task<RenderedDocument> RenderProductAsync(ProductDetailViewDto product);
    Task<RenderedDocument> RenderCustomerAsync(CustomerDto customer, decimal outstanding = 0,
        IEnumerable<SalesOrderDto>? orders = null, IEnumerable<StatementInvoiceRowDto>? invoices = null);
    Task<RenderedDocument> RenderSupplierAsync(SupplierDto supplier, IEnumerable<PurchaseOrderDto>? orders = null);
}

public sealed class PrintDocumentRenderer : IPrintDocumentRenderer
{
    private readonly IServiceProvider _services;
    private readonly ILoggerFactory _loggerFactory;

    public PrintDocumentRenderer(IServiceProvider services, ILoggerFactory loggerFactory)
    {
        _services = services;
        _loggerFactory = loggerFactory;
    }

    public Task<RenderedDocument> RenderSalesOrderAsync(SalesOrderDto order) =>
        RenderCoreAsync("Sales Order", order.OrderNumber, order.Status.ToString(), (nameof(PrintDocumentBody.SalesOrder), order));

    public Task<RenderedDocument> RenderPurchaseOrderAsync(PurchaseOrderDto order) =>
        RenderCoreAsync("Purchase Order", order.OrderNumber, order.Status.ToString(), (nameof(PrintDocumentBody.PurchaseOrder), order));

    public Task<RenderedDocument> RenderQuoteAsync(SalesQuoteDto quote) =>
        RenderCoreAsync("Sales Quotation", quote.QuoteNumber, quote.Status.ToString(), (nameof(PrintDocumentBody.Quote), quote));

    public Task<RenderedDocument> RenderSalesReturnAsync(SalesReturnDto salesReturn) =>
        RenderCoreAsync("Sales Return", salesReturn.ReturnNumber, salesReturn.Status.ToString(), (nameof(PrintDocumentBody.SalesReturn), salesReturn));

    public Task<RenderedDocument> RenderPurchaseReturnAsync(PurchaseReturnDto purchaseReturn) =>
        RenderCoreAsync("Purchase Return", purchaseReturn.ReturnNumber, purchaseReturn.Status.ToString(), (nameof(PrintDocumentBody.PurchaseReturn), purchaseReturn));

    public Task<RenderedDocument> RenderInvoiceAsync(InvoiceDetailDto invoiceDetail) =>
        RenderCoreAsync("Invoice", invoiceDetail.Invoice.InvoiceNumber, invoiceDetail.Invoice.Status.ToString(), (nameof(PrintDocumentBody.InvoiceDetail), invoiceDetail));

    public Task<RenderedDocument> RenderProductAsync(ProductDetailViewDto product) =>
        RenderCoreAsync("Product Details", product.SKU ?? "â€”", "", (nameof(PrintDocumentBody.Product), product));

    public Task<RenderedDocument> RenderCustomerAsync(CustomerDto customer, decimal outstanding = 0,
        IEnumerable<SalesOrderDto>? orders = null, IEnumerable<StatementInvoiceRowDto>? invoices = null) =>
        RenderCoreAsync("Customer Details", customer.CustomerName, customer.IsActive ? "Active" : "Inactive",
            (nameof(PrintDocumentBody.Customer), customer),
            new Dictionary<string, object?>
            {
                [nameof(PrintDocumentBody.CustomerOutstanding)] = outstanding,
                [nameof(PrintDocumentBody.CustomerOrders)] = orders?.ToList() ?? new List<SalesOrderDto>(),
                [nameof(PrintDocumentBody.CustomerInvoices)] = invoices?.ToList() ?? new List<StatementInvoiceRowDto>()
            });

    public Task<RenderedDocument> RenderSupplierAsync(SupplierDto supplier, IEnumerable<PurchaseOrderDto>? orders = null) =>
        RenderCoreAsync("Supplier Details", supplier.SupplierName, supplier.IsActive ? "Active" : "Inactive",
            (nameof(PrintDocumentBody.Supplier), supplier),
            new Dictionary<string, object?>
            {
                [nameof(PrintDocumentBody.SupplierOrders)] = orders?.ToList() ?? new List<PurchaseOrderDto>()
            });

    private async Task<RenderedDocument> RenderCoreAsync(string title, string reference, string statusText, (string Key, object? Value) document, Dictionary<string, object?>? extraParameters = null)
    {
        await using var renderer = new HtmlRenderer(_services, _loggerFactory);

        var documentParameters = new Dictionary<string, object?>
        {
            [nameof(PrintDocumentBody.DocTitle)] = title,
            [nameof(PrintDocumentBody.DocRef)] = reference,
            [nameof(PrintDocumentBody.StatusText)] = statusText,
            [document.Key] = document.Value
        };

        if (extraParameters is not null)
        {
            foreach (var pair in extraParameters)
            {
                documentParameters[pair.Key] = pair.Value;
            }
        }

        var parameters = ParameterView.FromDictionary(documentParameters);

        var html = await renderer.Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(async () =>
        {
            var output = await renderer.RenderComponentAsync<PrintDocumentBody>(parameters);
            return output.ToHtmlString();
        });

        var fileName = title + " " + (reference == "â€”" ? "" : reference);
        fileName = new string(fileName.Where(c => char.IsLetterOrDigit(c) || c == '-' || c == '_' || c == ' ').ToArray()).Trim();
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(fileName)) fileName = "document";

        return new RenderedDocument(html, title, reference, fileName);
    }
}

using TradeFlow.Application;
using TradeFlow.Domain.Entities;
using TradeFlow.Infrastructure;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.HttpOverrides;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.RateLimiting;
using MudBlazor.Services;
using System.Threading.RateLimiting;
using TradeFlow.Shared.Constants;
using TradeFlow.Web.Components;
using TradeFlow.Web.Components.Account;
using TradeFlow.Web.Middleware;
using TradeFlow.Web.Services;
using System.Globalization;

var builder = WebApplication.CreateBuilder(args);

// Force BDT (à§³) as the currency symbol app-wide so every ToString("C") / Format="C"
// renders à§³ instead of inheriting the server culture's $ symbol.
var appCulture = (CultureInfo)CultureInfo.GetCultureInfo("en-US").Clone();
appCulture.NumberFormat.CurrencySymbol = "à§³";
CultureInfo.DefaultThreadCurrentCulture = appCulture;
CultureInfo.DefaultThreadCurrentUICulture = appCulture;

// Add MudBlazor
builder.Services.AddMudServices();

// Email service
builder.Services.Configure<EmailSettings>(builder.Configuration.GetSection("Email"));
builder.Services.AddScoped<IEmailService, SmtpEmailService>();

// Server-side document rendering (PrintDocumentBody -> HTML string for client-side PDF/print)
builder.Services.AddScoped<IPrintDocumentRenderer, PrintDocumentRenderer>();

// Add Infrastructure (DbContext, Identity, Repository, TenantProvider, caching)
builder.Services.AddInfrastructure(builder.Configuration);

// Add Application Services (AutoMapper, all business services)
builder.Services.AddApplication();

// Add services to the container.
builder.Services.AddRazorComponents()
    .AddInteractiveServerComponents();

// No FallbackPolicy here on purpose. A blanket RequireAuthenticatedUser fallback is also applied
// to the Blazor *endpoint* by the endpoint authorization conventions, which would make
// /Account/Login itself require authentication. The Identity cookie handler then challenges that
// request and redirects to /Account/Login?ReturnUrl=... forever.
//
// Pages are gated explicitly instead: every routable component under Components/Pages carries
// [Authorize] (admin pages use the Administrator policy), and Components/Account/Pages/Manage
// imports [Authorize] via its _Imports.razor. The anonymous /Account sign-in pages are left
// untouched.
builder.Services.AddAuthorization(options =>
{
    options.AddPolicy(AuthorizationPolicies.Administrator, policy => policy
        .RequireAuthenticatedUser()
        .RequireRole(Roles.Admin));

    options.AddPolicy(AuthorizationPolicies.Manager, policy => policy
        .RequireAuthenticatedUser()
        .RequireRole(Roles.Admin, Roles.Manager));
});

builder.Services.AddDatabaseDeveloperPageExceptionFilter(); 

builder.Services.AddCascadingAuthenticationState();
builder.Services.AddScoped<IdentityRedirectManager>();
builder.Services.AddScoped<AuthenticationStateProvider, IdentityRevalidatingAuthenticationStateProvider>();

builder.Services.AddSingleton<IEmailSender<ApplicationUser>, IdentityNoOpEmailSender>();

// Throttle credential endpoints so the Identity lockout counters are not the only defence
// against password spraying.
//
// The limiter is partitioned by client IP rather than left as a single global bucket: an
// unpartitioned fixed window of 10/minute would mean one attacker exhausts the budget and locks
// out every legitimate user behind the same gateway.
builder.Services.AddRateLimiter(options =>
{
    options.RejectionStatusCode = StatusCodes.Status429TooManyRequests;

    var authPermitLimit = builder.Configuration.GetValue("RateLimiting:AuthPermitLimit", 10);

    options.AddPolicy("auth", httpContext =>
        RateLimitPartition.GetFixedWindowLimiter(
            partitionKey: httpContext.Connection.RemoteIpAddress?.ToString() ?? "unknown",
            factory: _ => new FixedWindowRateLimiterOptions
            {
                PermitLimit = authPermitLimit,
                Window = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(1),
                QueueLimit = 0,
                AutoReplenishment = true
            }));
});

var app = builder.Build();

// Apply pending migrations and seed roles, users, and reference data (idempotent).
//using (var seedScope = app.Services.CreateScope())
//{
//    await TradeFlow.Infrastructure.Identity.SeedData.InitializeAsync(seedScope.ServiceProvider);
//}

// Behind IIS / Nginx / a cloud load balancer the app sees the proxy's scheme and IP,
// not the client's. Without this, UseHttpsRedirection 307-redirects the SignalR
// negotiate/post requests (killing the Blazor circuit with "connection closed" on the
// client) and the rate limiter partitions by the proxy's IP instead of the client's.
app.UseForwardedHeaders(new ForwardedHeadersOptions
{
    ForwardedHeaders = ForwardedHeaders.XForwardedFor | ForwardedHeaders.XForwardedProto
});

// Configure the HTTP request pipeline.
if (app.Environment.IsDevelopment())
{
    app.UseMigrationsEndPoint();
}
else
{
    app.UseExceptionHandler("/Error", createScopeForErrors: true);
    // The default HSTS value is 30 days. You may want to change this for production scenarios, see https://aka.ms/aspnetcore-hsts.
    app.UseHsts();
}
app.UseStatusCodePagesWithReExecute("/not-found", createScopeForStatusCodePages: true);
app.UseHttpsRedirection();

app.UseMiddleware<SecurityHeadersMiddleware>();
app.UseMiddleware<GlobalExceptionLoggingMiddleware>();

app.UseRateLimiter();

app.UseAntiforgery();

app.MapStaticAssets();

var razorComponents = app.MapRazorComponents<App>();

// A Blazor EditForm posts back to its own route, so a sign-in attempt arrives at the
// /Account/Login *page* endpoint rather than at the Identity endpoint group. Attach the same
// limiter to those pages, otherwise the throttle would only cover external login and the page
// posts would slip past it.
razorComponents.Add(endpointBuilder =>
{
    if (endpointBuilder is RouteEndpointBuilder routeBuilder
        && routeBuilder.RoutePattern.RawText is { } route
        && route.StartsWith("/Account", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
    {
        endpointBuilder.Metadata.Add(new EnableRateLimitingAttribute("auth"));
    }
});

razorComponents.AddInteractiveServerRenderMode();

// Add additional endpoints required by the Identity /Account Razor components.
app.MapAdditionalIdentityEndpoints();

app.Run();
